Twi Twerɛbea Ho Mmara
NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi kasa fa Asante Twi twerɛbea ho mmara ho. Yɛbɛkyerɛkyerɛ Asante 
Twi twerɛbea ho mmara a ɛfa edin, adeyɛ, dinnsiananmu ne edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu 
ho mu. Yɛbɛdi kan akyerɛkyerɛ twerɛbea ho mmara a ɛfa edin ho mu, na afei 
yɛde edinnsiananmu atoa so. Yeinom akyi no, yɛbɛkasa afa edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu, 
adeyɛ ne ɔkyerɛfoɔ ho. Yei bɛboa wo ama woahunu ɛkwan a yɛfa so de edin, 
dinnsiananmu, edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu, adeyɛ ne ɔkyerɛfoɔ di dwuma wɔ Asante 
Twi kasa mu. Yɛbɛtumi de saa twerɛbea ho mmara yi adi dwuma wɔ Borɔfo kasa 
mu nso.
Adesua yi bɛkɔ awieeɛ no, na wotumi:
1. Gyina edin ne dinnsiananmu ho mmara so twerɛ ɔkasamu ahodoɔ
2. Gyina edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu ho mmara so twerɛ ɔkasamu ahodoɔ
3. Gyina adeyɛ ne ɔkyerɛfoɔ ho mmara so twerɛ ɔkasamu ahodoɔ
Adwempɔ Ahodoɔ
• Edin di dwuma sɛ ɔyɛfoɔ, ɔyɛtia, ɔgyefoɔ, edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne edin 
kasasin ti.
• Dinnsiananmu nso di dwuma sɛ ɔyɛfoɔ ne ɔyɛtia wɔ ɔkasamu mu.
• Edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu kyerɛkyerɛ edin mu. Mpɛn pii no, ɛtaa ba edin a 
ɛrekyerɛkyerɛ mu no akyi wɔ Asante Twi kasa mu.
• Adeyɛ kyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie anaa tebea bi mu. Ghana kasa ahodoɔ no 
mu bebree nni ɔyɛfoɔ ne adeyɛ ho mmara so. Asante Twi kasa atwerɛ mu 
no, yɛte edin ne adeyɛ ntam nanso sɛ adeyɛ no toa dinnsiananmu a ɛredi 
dwuma sɛ ɔyɛfoɔ so a, yɛtwerɛ bom.
• Ɔkyerɛfoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ adeyɛ mu na ɛtumi san kyerɛkyerɛ ɔkyerɛfoɔ 
foforɔ mu.

Nkraman
Ewiase nnipa nyinaa nim sɛ, nkraman yɛ mmoa a yɛde wɔn gyegye yɛn ani. Wɔgu 
mu ahodoɔ esiane wɔn su, wɔn bɔbea ne wɔn ahosuo nti. Wɔyɛ mmoa bi a wɔwɔ 
nan ɛnan a wɔfiri mpataku abusuakuo a na wɔte nwuram. Berɛ a yɛn nananom 
hyɛɛ aseɛ yɛnee mpataku yi de wɔn yɛɛ ha no, wɔn ani bɛgyee nnipa ho ma wɔkaa 
wɔn ho bɛnee nnipa. Wɔyɛ mmoa bi a wɔwɔ nkatedeɛ a wɔtumi de hunu nnipa

nneyɛɛ bi te sɛ ɔdɔ, ɔtan ne ahunahuna na wɔda ho suban adi kyerɛ onipa biara 
sɛdeɛ ne nneyɛɛ teɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ne nyinaa mu no, nkraman yɛ mmoa bi a wɔte pampan pa ara. Wɔsan nso yɛ 
mmoa bi a wɔte wɔte dede ahodoɔ pa ara a ɛmfa ho sɛ ɛwɔ fam anaa ɛsoro. Adeɛ a 
ɛma nkraman som bo pa ara ne sɛ, yɛtumi tete wɔn ma wɔdi dwuma ahodoɔ. Yɛwɔ 
nkraman a wɔtumi kyerɛ onifurani kwan da biara ɛnna nkraman a wɔwɔ atenka 
sononko no nso tumi kyekyere nnipa a wɔn werɛ ahoɔ no werɛ. Wɔsan tumi de 
nkraman hwehwɛ gye afoforɔ nkwa na wɔtumi te pampan a mfidie mpo ntumi 
nteɛ. Nnepa ahodoɔ a nkraman tumi da no adi kyerɛ nnipa yi nyinaa akyi no, wɔn 
nkwanna sua a wɔanyini ara bɛyɛ mfeɛ edu (10) kɔsi dunum (15). Wɔn som papa 
nti, nnipa gye nkraman yi tom sɛ wɔka wɔn abusua ho wɔ ewiase afanan nyinaa.
Dwumadie
1. Kyerɛkyerɛ dwuma a asɛmfua a yɛasan aseɛ no mu biara redi wɔ ɔkasamu 
no mu. Fa wo mmuaeɛ no toto w’afɛfoɔ deɛ ho.
a. Adesuafoɔ a wɔaben no tuu kwan nnora.
b. Mede sika manee Yaa wɔ Kyeraa.
c. Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ no twerɛɛ twerɛpono mono no so.
d. Wɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ Navrongo.
e. Ɔkwantuni no tɔɔ paanoo brɛɛ no.

1. Fa w’ankasa nsɛmfua kyerɛkyerɛ edin a ɛdi dwuma sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu 
mu. Ma yei ho nhwɛsoɔ mmienu na wo ne w’afɛfoɔ nkyɛ adwene wɔ 
ho.
2. Wo kyerɛkyerɛni de abasɛm a mfomsoɔ wowom bɛma wo. Kenkan 
abasɛm a wo kyerɛkyerɛni de bɛma wo no mu na fa hwehwɛ mfomsoɔ 
a ɛwowom no.
3. Kyerɛkyerɛ dinnsiananmu dwumadie a ɛyɛ ɔyɛtia ne ɔgyefoɔ no mu wɔ 
Asante Twi kasa mu. Fa toto ɔkasa foforɔ bi a wonim anaa wobɛpɛ sɛ 
wobɛsua ho.
4. Ma edin a ɛdi dwuma sɛ edin kasasin ti ho nhwɛsoɔ enum wɔ ɔkasamu 
mu wɔ Asante Twi mu. Wo ne wáfɛfoɔ nkyɛ adwene wɔ ho.
5. Montena baanu baanu na montwerɛ ɔkasamu ahodoɔ edu a 
edinnsiananmu a ɛwowɔ mu no ɛredi dwuma sɛ ɔyɛfoɔ, na hwɛ sɛ 
yɛtwerɛ dinnsiananmu no ne adeyɛ no bom anaasɛ yɛte ntam. Fa toto 
Ghana kasa ahodoɔ no ho na wo ne wáfɛfoɔ nkyɛ adwene wɔ ho.

Nkogudie.
Yei ne atenka a menyaa wɔ me mu.
Memaa m’awofoɔ ne ne titire, m’ankasa nsa sii fam. Yei maa hu kɛseɛ bi kaa 
me da mu no nyinaa maa mebisaa me ho sɛ, yei bɛtumi anya nsunsuansoɔ bɔne 
bi wɔ me daakye nwomasua so anaa? Yei remma mentumi nnya sukuupɔn mu 
akwannya anaa? Ansa na ɔhaw no bɛbene me soɔ no, mekɔgyee afotuo firii 
m’awofoɔ ne me fotufoɔ hɔ. Wɔnam wɔn adom ne wɔn nteaseɛ so yii me firii 
ɔsɛeɛ amena mu na akyire yi no, mehunuu sɛ, biribiara bɛyɛ yie.
Ampa ara, sɔhwɛ-twerɛ mu nkogudie yɛ adeɛ a ɛtumi nya nsunsuansoɔ bɔne 
wɔ nnipa so nanso metumi bɔ mmɔden nya ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a ɔbɛkyerɛ me adeɛ 
wɔ me nna a aka wɔ sukuu mu no a, ɛbɛboa ama deɛ ɛsiiɛ no rensi bio na 
ɛbɛsan ama me mmɔdemmɔ akɔ ɛkan.
Mehunuu sɛ nkogudie ka onipa abrabɔ ho na mmom, ɛkwan a yɛfa so pɛ ɔhaw 
no pomasiberɛ na ɛkyerɛ yɛn nkonimdie wɔ saa ɔhaw no so. Bio, mehunuu

Akwankyerɛ Susutwerɛ da nimdeɛ foforɔ bi adi fa atifiasɛm bi ho kyerɛ

Akwan ahodoɔ a yɛfa so twerɛ Akwankyerɛ Susutwerɛ
Sɛ wobɛtumi atwerɛ akwankyerɛ susutwerɛ amapa a, ɛho hia sɛ wobɛnya nteaseɛ 
a emu dɔ wɔ atifiasɛm a wɔde ama wo no ho.
Akwankyerɛ Susutwerɛ atifiasɛm ho nhwɛsoɔ ahodoɔ:
1. Kyerɛkyerɛ ɛkwan a yɛfa so nwono kɛntɛn.
2. Kyerɛkyerɛ ɛkwan a wɔfa so yi akannifoɔ wɔ wo sukuu mu.
3. Nkwan a w’adamfo bi pɛ pa ara ne abɛkwan nanso ɔnnim yɛ. Kyerɛkyerɛ no 
sɛdeɛ yɛsi yɛ no.
4. Sɛn na yɛsi yɛ afuo?
5. W’adamfo bi pɛ sɛ ɔbɛsra wo wɔ wo sukuu mu. Kyerɛ no ɛkwan.

Saa ɔfa yi da Ghana mmusuakuo ahodoɔ abosomdin ahodoɔ no adi wɔ berɛ a 
worehwɛ wɔn abɔseɛ wɔ wámammerɛ mu. Ɛbɛboa wo ama woahunu sɛnti a 
wɔbaeɛ ne abosomdin ahodoɔ no so mfasoɔ. Saa adesua yi bɛboa ama woate 
abadintoɔ ase na ama wode enidie a ɛfata ama Ghana amammerɛ ne amanneɛ 
ahodoɔ no. Ɔfa yi san kasa fa ɛkwan a yɛfa so pagya mmabunu kɔ wɔn mpanin 
mfeɛ so (Bragorɔ). Mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu yi bɛhwɛ nneyɛɛ ahodoɔ a ɛda adi wɔ: ansa 
na wɔbɛgoro bra, bragorɔ no ankasa ɛnna bragorɔ no akyi dwumadie ahodoɔ a 
ɛkɔ so wɔ w’amammerɛ ne afoforɔ deɛ mu wɔ Ghana. Wobɛsan asua mfasoɔ a 
ɛwɔ bragorɔ so ma asakyima, n’abusuafoɔ ne ne kuromfoɔ nyinaa. Ɛsɛ sɛ wotumi 
kyerɛ nneɛma a ɛsesɛ ne deɛ ɛda nso wɔ ɛkwan a wɔfa so pagya mmabunu kɔ wɔn 
mpanin mfeɛ so wɔ Ghana mmuasuakuo amammerɛ ahodoɔ no mu.
Adesua yi bɛkɔ awieeɛ no:
• Na woasua abosomdin, wɔn abɔseɛ ne wɔn dwumadie.
• Na wotumi pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm ɛkwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa so de ɔbabunu bi kɔ ne 
mpanin mfeɛ so (bragorɔ: ansa na wɔbɛgoro bra, bragorɔ no ankasa ɛnna 
bragorɔ no akyi dwumadie ahodoɔ)
• Na wotumi yɛ ntotoho fa akwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa so goro bra wɔ Ghana 
mmusuakuo ahodoɔ no mu no ho.

• Abosomdin ahodoɔ no abɔseɛ gyina ɔbosom pɔtee bi so
• Ayɔnkofa amapa da abosom ne ewiem atumfoɔ no ntam
• Wɔda wɔn abakɔsɛm adi kyerɛ wɔn a wɔsom wɔn no

ABOSOMDIN AHODOƆ
Wɔde edin ahodoɔ bi toto yɛn so esiane twaka a ɛda yɛne ewiem atumfoɔ bi 
ntam nti. Wɔfrɛ saa edin ahodoɔ yi sɛ abosomdin. Ansa na wobɛsua biribi afa 
abosomdin ho no, ɛsɛ sɛ wote asɛmfua abosom asekyerɛ ase yie.
Ɛdeɛn ne ɔbosom?
Abosom yɛ ahonhom a wɔtumi yɛ mmaa anaa mmarima. Wɔyɛ ewiem atumfoɔ a 
nnipa a wɔwↄ gyidie bi sε biribiara a εbεkↄ so wↄ wↄn asetena mu no, εyε adeε a 
abosom no bεtumi ayε ho biribi no na wɔsom wɔn.
Saa abosom yi wɔ honhom mu tumi kɛseɛ. Yɛtaa de ɔsom mu gyidie ne emu 
nnwuma ahodoɔ gyina hɔ ma wɔn. Saa ahonhom yi tumi yɛ mmarima anaa 
mmaa. Ɔsom mu ahonhom a wɔyɛ mmarima ne mmaa no mu bi ne Zeus, Apollo, 
Athena, Aphrodite, Artemis, ne deɛ wɔkeka ho. Ghanaman yi mu, mantam anaa 
abusuakuo biara wɔ abosom a wɔgye wɔn die. Abosom a wɔagye din pa ara wɔ 
Ghanaman yi mu no bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
• Nkranfoɔ: Dantu, Nae, Klote, La Kpa, ne wɔn a wɔkeka ho.
• Akanfoɔ: Kune, Tegare, Nyamaa, Antoa, ne wɔn a wɔkeka ho.
• Dagomba: Tambo, ne wɔn a wɔkeka ho.
• Abosom a wɔagye din pa ara bɛn na wɔwɔ wo kurom?
Abosomdin ahodoɔ
Wɔgyina gyidie ne ɔsom ahodoɔ so na ɛde abosomdin to nnipa binom. Abosomdin 
yɛ edin pɔtee a abusua, kuro, ɔsom anaa nnipakuo bi de to wɔn ho ɛnam twaka a 
ɛda wɔne abosom no ntam nti.

Abosomdin ahodoɔ no ho nhwɛsoɔ
Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi yɛ Abosomdin ahodoɔ no ho nhwɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ Ghanaman mu:
1. Ewefoɔ mmusuakuo no mu baako a ɛde Anlo a ɛwɔ Firaw Mantam mu 
no som bosom bi a wɔfrɛ no ‘Afa’ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔfiri Onyame hɔ na ɔsan yɛ 
abakan ma anyame ‘Bokɔ’ no din de ‘Amuzu’.
2. Akanfoɔ mu nso, wɔde abosom mmaa ne mmarima din gyina hɔ ma ɛnna 
ahodoɔ no. Ɛnam yei nti ɛda a yɛde wo obi no tumi nya nsunsuansoɔ wɔ 
ne din so. Sɛ ebia, ‘Adwo’ yɛ ɔbosom a ɔgyina hɔ ma Ɛdwoada, ne saa nti, 
wɔde edin ‘Adwoa’ to ɔbaa a yɛwoo no Ɛdwoada ɛnna sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima nso a, 
wɔto no edin ‘Kwadwo’.
Bobɔ abosomdin ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ soro hɔ no mmaako mmaako. Ma wo kyerɛkyerɛni 
ntie sɛdeɛ wosi bobɔ edin no. Wonim abosom bi a wɔwɔ wo kurom anaa wo 
mpɔtamu din?
Abosomdin ahodoɔ abɔseɛ
Abosomdin ahodoɔ no da nso firi ɔsom ahodoɔ mu a ɛgyina wɔn a wɔto edin no 
gyidie ne wɔn amammerɛ so. Sɛ ebia, Ewefoɔ mu no, wɔn abosomdin no abɔseɛ 
ne Yeʋe (Agradaa Nyame), Akanfoɔ nso nya wɔn abosomdin firi asuo ahodoɔ mu 
ɛnna Dangmefoɔ nso nya wɔn abosomdin firi Ɔbɔadeɛ Nyame hɔ ne deɛ ɛkeka 
ho.
Wonim wo din abɔseɛ?
Deɛ nti a wɔto abosomdin
Wɔgyina nneɛma ahodoɔ so na wɔto abosomdin. Wɔto nnipa bi abosomdin de 
kyerɛ dwuma a ɔbosom no di anaa ne tumi. Ebi nso gyina mmoa bi a wɔnya firii 
ɔbosom no hɔ, ebi nso gyina nnipakuo bi amammerɛ so anaa sɛdeɛ ɔbosom bi si 
teɛ.
Bio, sɛ awarefoɔ bi nnya awoɔ a, wɔkɔ abosom nkyɛn kɔpɛ mmoa. Wɔhyɛ ɛbɔ na 
wɔde wɔn ba no to ɔbosom no de di wɔn bɔhyɛ no so.
Abosomdintoɔ so mfasoɔ
Abosomdintoɔ wɔ nsunsuansoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔsom wɔn no abrabɔ 
so.
Mfasoɔ ahodoɔ a wɔn a wɔkura abosomdintoɔ no nya wɔ wɔn din no so na ɛdidi 
soɔ yi:
1. Yɛde hyɛ wɔn nso. Abosomdin boa ma yɛhunu ɔbosom pɔtee a onipa no 
som no ne beaeɛ pɔtee a onipa no firi.

Nsakraeɛ a ɛda adi wɔ mmarimaa nipadua mu
Nsakraeɛ a ɛda adi wɔ mmarimaa nipadua mu no bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi:

Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ no mu biara dwumadie ne wɔn so mfasoɔ mu. Saa 
ɔfa yi hwɛ sɛ wobɛnya nimdeɛ ne nteaseɛ afa Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ ho 
wɔ Asante amammerɛ mu. Wobɛhunu dwuma ahodoɔ a Akanfoɔ ahemfo no di ne

Adesua no bɛkɔ awieeɛ no, na adesuafoɔ no tumi:

nkumaa, asiahenefoɔ, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.)
Adwempɔ Ahodoɔ
• Agya no ne abusua a wɔdi agyadeɛ no ti (ɛha yi no, wɔto ana kɔ agya 
abusua mu).

abusua mpanimfoɔ ahodoɔ na wɔka bom yi wɔn.

Akanfoɔ Amammuo
Akanfoɔ Amammuo yɛ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛgyina ɔmanfoɔ no suahunu ne 
wɔn amammerɛ so. Akanfoɔ amammuo ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Ghana mpɔtam ahodoɔ no 
mu yɛ nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ. Saa nhyehyɛeɛ yi da nso wɔ mmusuakuo ahodoɔ no mu 
nanso nkuro no mu dodoɔ no ara nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ adekorɔ.
Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ mmusuakuo mu
Ghana ha yi no, asɛmfua ‘abusua’ asekyerɛ tumi yɛ abusua ketewa a emu nnipa 
no ne Agya, ɛna ne mma anaasɛ abusua tenten a emu nnipa no ne abusua ketewa 
no ne nnipa nkaeɛ bi te sɛ nananom, wɔfanom, sewaanom, anuanom ne wɔn a 
wɔkeka ho. Yei kyerɛ sɛ, Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ abusua mu no, yɛnya 
Agya, abusuapanin, odikuro, ahemfo, ahemfo nkumaa, asiahene ne amanhene ne 
wɔn a wɔkeka ho.
Dwumadie
Sɛn na Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ no si teɛ wɔ wo efie? Hwan ne abusua 
ketewa no ti? Hwan ne abusua tenten no ti? Woka abusua bi ho?
Adwumayɛmu Nhyehyɛeɛ Ɛpono yɛ mfoni a ɛda adwumakuo bi mu dwumadie 
ahodoɔ no nhyehyɛeɛ adi. Ɛkyerɛ nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ nkutahodie kwan a ɛda 
adwuma no mu mpanimfoɔ ne wɔn adwumayɛfoɔ no ntam.
Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ efie ho mfoni na ɛwɔ aseɛ ha yi;

1. Odikuro: Abusua tenten yɛ abusua a nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔwɔ mu no hunu 
wɔn ho sɛ wɔwɔ ayɔnkofa wɔ awareɛ anaa mogya mu no tena bom. Yei yɛ 
mmusuakuo ahodoɔ a wɔn nyinaa kura abusuadin baako, nana baako na 
wɔn nyinaa ka bom som ɔkannifoɔ baako. Wɔkura esu, anisoadehunu ne 
apɛdeɛ korɔ. Onipa a saa nnipakuo yi ka bom yi no sɛ wɔn kannifoɔ no na 
wɔfrɛ no Odikuro. Susudua a wɔgyina so yi Odikuro no da nso firi nkuro 
ahodoɔ no mu. Mmusuakuo no bi mu no, mmusuakuo no mu mpanimfoɔ na 
wɔka bom yi Odikuro no ɛnna ebinom nso wɔ hɔ a, saa adedie yi bɛyɛ awoɔ 
ntoatoasoɔ.
2. Abusuapanin: Abusuapanin yɛ onipa a abusua mu no ayi sɛ wɔn kannifoɔ. 
Wɔn dwumadie titire ne sɛ, wɔbɛhwɛ abusua no so na waboa ayi abusua no 
mu ɔhaw ahodoɔ afiri hɔ. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔda akannie esu ahodoɔ adi. Mpɛn pii no, 
ɔbarima na wɔtaa yi no sɛ abusuapanin.
3. Agya: Agya no ne abusua ketewa a n’ankasa ka ho bi, ne yere ne ne mma 
no ti. Agya no na ɔyɛ abusua no apɛdeɛ ma wɔn.

Sɛ yɛhwɛ Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ mfoni no firi soro a, yeinom mu

Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ nnidisoɔ no mu tiawa.

Pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm Odikuro dwumadie mmiɛnsa anaa deɛ ɛboro saa mu. Ɛne wo

Dwumadie 7.2
Hwehwɛ Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ wo kurom na pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm 
ɛso mfasoɔ mu.
Dwumadie 7.3
Yɛ wo ho sɛ abusuapanin na siesie ntɔkwa a ɛda nnipa baanu ntam ɛfa ɛka a 
baako de ɔfoforɔ no ho nti. Ebinom nso bɛyɛ wɔn ho sɛ abusuafoɔ a wɔn bo

ƆFA 7 AMAMMERƐ NE AMAMMUO
Dwumadie 7.4
W’adwenem no, wosusu sɛ Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ no ho da so hia? 
Kae sɛ wobɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo mmuaeɛ no mu.
AKANFOƆ AMAMMUO NHYEHYƐEƐ
Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ na ɛdidi soɔ yi;
1. Ɔmanhene
2. Ahemfo nkumaa
3. Ahemmaa
4. Asiahene
Afoforɔ a wɔka Akanfoɔ amammuo akannifoɔ a wɔka wɔn a wɔwɔ ɛsoro hɔ no ho 
bi ne Akwansrahene, apofofoɔhene, odikuro, abusuapanin ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
1. Ɔmanhene: Amanhene yɛ akannifoɔ ma nnipakuo anaa mmusuakuo bi. 
Wɔn na wɔn tumi so pa ara wɔ Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ no mu. 
Nkuro binom so no, saa diberɛ yi gyina adedie a ɛfiri ɛna anaa agya fam so. 
Ɔmanhene biara wɔ n’abodini. Nhwɛsoɔ, Ewefoɔ deɛ ne Fiagã, Akanfoɔ 
deɛ ne Ɔsagyefoɔ ɛnna Dagombafoɔ deɛ ne Yaa-Naa, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
 Ɔmanhene dwumadie ahodoɔ:
a. Ɔhwɛ nkuro nkumaa ne akɛseɛ so.
b. Ɔhwɛ adwabɔ ahodoɔ so.
c. Ɔhwɛ ɔman no nsase nyinaa so.
d. Ɔhwɛ siesie ntawantawa a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu.
e. Ɔhyɛ mmara ma ne manfoɔ hwɛ ma wɔdi so.
f. Ɔhwɛ ma kankɔ ne mpuntuo kɔ so wɔ ne mpɔtam.
g. Ɔhwɛ ma asomdwoeɛ ba ne man mma no ntam.
h. Ɔhwɛ ma nkabom ba ɔman no mu ɛnna afei nso ɔsi ne manfoɔ no ananmu 
wɔ amanhene adwabɔ ase.
2. Ahemfo nkumaa: Ahemfo nkumaa yɛ ahemfo a wɔhyɛ ɔmanhene ase pɛɛ. 
Wɔdi wɔn hene anaa tumi wɔ nkuro nkumaa anaa nkuro mmaako mmaako 
so. Wɔnam awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so na ɛdi saa diberɛ yi.
7
ƆFA 7 AMAMMERƐ NE AMAMMUO
 Ahemfo nkumaa dwumadie ahodoɔ:
a. Wɔyɛ amanhene ananmusifoɔ.
b. Wɔhwɛ ma wɔn manfoɔ nya ahobammɔ san di mmara so.
c. Wɔhwɛ siesie ntawantawa a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam.
d. Ɔhwɛ ma asomdwoeɛ ba ɔman no mu.
e. Ɔhwɛ nkonnwafie so.
3. Ahemmaa: Wɔhunu ahemmaa sɛ wɔyɛ honhom mu akannifoɔ ma mmaa a 
wɔwɔ wɔn mpɔtam ɛnna wɔsan nso kura ɔman abakɔsɛm. Wɔn dwumadie 
titire pa ara ne sɛ, wɔhwɛ mmaa a wɔwɔ wɔn kurom no so. Mmusuakuo a 
wɔdi ɛnadeɛ no, ɛyɛ Ahemmaa no na wɔyi obi ma ɔdi hene. Wɔtumi yi obi 
ma ɔno nso bɛyɛ ɔhemmaa hyɛ wɔn ase.
 Ahemmaa dwumadie ahodoɔ:
a. Wɔyɛ nnwuma ahodoɔ de boa ahemfo no wɔ Akanfoɔ amammuo 
nhyehyɛeɛ no mu
b. Wɔhwɛ siesie ntawantawa a ɛda mmaa ntam.
c. Wɔbɔ mmaa yiedie ho ban.
d. Wɔbɔ ne kuro no abakɔsɛm ho ban.
4. Asiahene: Asiahene yɛ nnipa anaa nnipakuo bi a wɔhwɛ yi obi wɔ 
adehyebusua mu ma no di ɔhene wɔ berɛ a wɔn mu biara ntumi nni ɔhene. 
Saa nnipakuo yi hyia fa adwene wɔ onipa a adedie aduru ne so no ho.
 Asiahene dwumadie ahodoɔ:
a. Wɔn na wɔyi onipa a adedie aduru ne so.
b. Wɔn na wɔhwɛ yɛ amanneɛ wɔ berɛ a ɔhene bi kɔ akuraa.
c. Wɔn na wɔhwɛ ma wɔtu ɔhene bi adeɛ so.
d. Wɔn na wɔda ɔhene foforɔ adi kyerɛ atenankonnwa ne ɔmanfoɔ.
e. Wɔyɛ afotufoɔ ma ɔhene.

MMƆAKYIRE NSƐMMISA
1. Hwan na ɔyɛ wábusua ketewa no ti?
2. Kyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie mmienu (2) a wohwehwɛ sɛ w’agya anaa wo

3. Kenkan abasɛm a ɛwɔ fam hɔ no na gyina so yɛ dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ 
mfoni ɛpono ma Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ ma saa mpɔtam no 
(Ɔmanhene, ɔhene, ahemfo nkumaa, asiahene). Fa nhwɛsoɔ a wohunuu

Abasɛm ‘A’
Ghana Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ
Ansa na ka-bi-ma-menka-bi amammuo rebɛba no, na Akanfoɔ amammuo wɔ 
Ghanaman mu ha dada. Saa amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ yi gyina nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ 
kwan a wɔahyehyɛ ahemfo ne mpanimfoɔ so. Mpɔtam anaa nkuraaseɛ mu no, 
ɔhene ne ne mpanimfoɔ bi te sɛ asiahene na wɔdi kuro no so yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ma 
kuro no. Na wɔgyina wɔn nimdeɛ, mfeɛ ne wɔn osuahunu so na wɔde yiyi saa 
mpanimfoɔ no. Yɛyi nkuraaseɛ si nkyɛn a, amanhene na wɔdi nkuro akɛseɛ a 
nkuraaseɛ nkuraaseɛ bebree hyehyɛ aseɛ so. Wɔn na wɔhwɛ siesie ntawantawa 
ma asomdwoeɛ ba ɔman no mu. Ahemfo a wɔyɛ atenankonnwa no na wɔtu 
Ɔmanhene fo ma ɔyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma ɔman no atu mpɔn. Ɔmanhene na 
ɔdi Akanfoɔ amammuo nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no kan. Ɔmanhene na 
ɔman no mu tumi nyinaa hyɛ ne nsa. Na Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ no gye 
dodoɔ-amammuo ne enidie a yɛde ma mpanimfoɔ tom.
4. Pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ no dwumadie 
ne ɛso mfasoɔ mmiɛnsa (3) ma ɔman no mu.

ASANTE TWI KASADWINI
Ano Kasadwini ne Atwerɛ Kasadwini
NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi kasa fa Asante Twi Ano ne Atwerɛ Kasadwini ho. Wobɛsua biribi afa 
Nsaguo/Mpaeyie ho wɔ Ano Kasadwini mu. Wobɛsan asua biribi afa ɛso mfasoɔ 
ne sɛdeɛ wɔsi yɛ no ho. Yɛbɛboa wo ama woakyerɛ w’adwene afa sɛnti a nsaguo/
mpaeyie ho hia ma wo nkurɔfoɔ. Saa ɔfa yi ho bɛhia ama wo sɛ woresua Asante 
Twi a ɛne adesuadeɛ bi te sɛ Ɔsom ahodoɔ ho adesua wɔ twaka. Ɔfa yi bɛma 
woanya nimdeɛ a ɛho hia a ɛbɛma w’ani agye w’amammerɛ ne afoforɔ deɛ ho. 
Saa ɔfa yi bɛsan ama woahunu biribi afa Asantefoɔ Nsuiɛ ho. Yɛbɛma woakenkan 
nneɛma bi afa Nsuiɛ ho. Yɛbɛyɛ mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu afa Nsuiɛ so mfasoɔ ho. Bio, 
saa ɔfa yi bɛma woanya nimdeɛ afa Abasɛm ne ɛho adesua ho. Wo kyerɛkyerɛni 
bɛdi mo anim ama moayɛ mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu afa Abasɛm su ahodoɔ no ho sɛ ebia, 
agorɔmma, nsɛntitire, nhyehyɛeɛ, sibeaberɛ, ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
Saa ɔfa yi bɛkɔ awieeɛ no, na wotumi:
• Kyerɛ Nsaguo/Mpaeyie nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ Asante Twi mu (ɔfrɛ, amannebɔ 
ɛnna nhyira ne nnome)
• Pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm nsuiɛ mu (ne dwumadie ne ɛso mfasoɔ)
• Pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm Abasɛm su ahodoɔ no mu (nhwɛsoɔ, agorɔmma, asɛntitire, 
nhyehyɛeɛ, sibeaberɛ, ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne ne deɛ ɛkeka ho).
• Kenkan Abasɛm bi na woakyerɛ w’adwene afa ho (nwoma no edin, 
asɛntitire, nsɛmfua dwumadie, kasasu ahodoɔ, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.)
Adwempɔ ahodoɔ
• Nsaguo/mpaeyie yɛ nananom kwan a wɔfa so bɔ mpaeɛ
• Nsaguo/Mpaeyie kura nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa wɔ ne dwumadie mu: 
ɔfrɛ, amannebɔ ɛnna nhyira ne nnome.
• Asɛntitire no ne abasɛm no nnyinasoɔ
3
ƆFA 8 KASADWINI
• Nhyehyɛeɛ no ne nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ kwan a wɔafa so ahyehyɛ dwumadie 
ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ abasɛm no mu
• Sibeaberɛ no yɛ ɛberɛ ne beaeɛ a abasɛm no mu dwumadie ahodoɔ no kɔ 
so
• Ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne no yɛ ɛnne pɔtee a yɛte no wɔ abasɛm bi twerɛ mu
• Nsuiɛ da ɔbra kanko no mu baako dwumadie adi, ɛma yɛhunu sɛ obi 
ahwere ne ho nipa bi, yɛde srɛ adeɛ, yɛde da atenka sononko bi adi ne deɛ 
ɛkeka ho.
NSAGUO/MPAEYIE
Yɛbɛyɛ mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu afa nsaguo/mpaeyie nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa a ɛyɛ ne 
nhyehyɛɛ no ho. Nsaguo/Mpaeyie nhyehyɛeɛ nonom ne ɔfrɛ, amannebɔ ɛnna 
nhyira ne nnome.
Ɛdeɛn ne Nsaguo/Mpaeyie?
Nsaguo/Mpaeyie ne sɛ worehwie nsa (nsaden) anaa ahwiedeɛ bi ama nananom 
nsamanfoɔ anaa ahonhom. Ɛyɛ ɛkwan a yɛfa so de yɛn abisadeɛ to nananom anim 
wɔ Abosonsom mu. Ayim-Aboagye (1993: 165 as cited in 1996:9) ka sɛ, ɛyɛ 
adeyɛ bi a wɔde nsuo anaa nsaden gu fa de frɛ nananom de bisa wɔn nkyɛn mmoa. 
Mmeaeɛ bi wɔ hɔ a, wɔde nneɛma bi te sɛ ɛmo tumi gu nsa/yi mpaeɛ. Nsaguo/
Mpaeyie di akoten pa ara yie wɔ Abibiman mu. Wɔnam nsaguo/mpaeyie so frɛ 
nananom nsamanfoɔ a wɔdi akoten wɔ yɛn asetena mu ma wɔba yɛn adwabɔ biara 
ase. Ɛyɛ Abusuapanin, ahemfo anaasɛ mpanimfoɔ binom na wɔgu nsa anaasɛ wɔyi 
mpaeɛ wɔ adwabɔ ahodoɔ bi te sɛ abadintoɔ, awaregyeɛ, afahyɛ, ahensie ne deɛ 
ɛkeka ho ase Akanman mu wɔ Ghanaman mu ha.
Dwumadie 8.1
Hwɛ nkuro foforɔ so nsaguo/mpaeyie a ɛwɔ sini ahodoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi mu. 
Twerɛ deɛ wohunu fa nsaguo/mpaeyie nhyehyɛeɛ ho na fa deɛ wohunuiɛ no 
toto nsaguo/mpaeyie nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ sini a ɛwɔ ɛfam hɔ no mu ho.

ƆFA 8 KASADWINI
Nsaguo/Mpaeyie Nhyehyɛeɛ
Nsaguo/Mpaeyie nhyehyɛeɛ nonom ne ɔfrɛ, amannebɔ ɛnna Nhyira ne Nnome.
Ɔfrɛ
Ɔfrɛ yɛ ɛberɛ a nsagufoɔ/mpaeyifoɔ no bobɔ nananom nsamanfoɔ ne ahonhom 
nkaeɛ no din mmaako mmaako de to nsa frɛ wɔn. Nsagufoɔ no di kan bɔ 
Tweaduampɔn din na afei ɔde Asase Yaa, abosom nkumaa na afei wafrɛ nananom 
nsamanfoɔ. Ɔfrɛ a ɛwɔ nsaguo/mpaeyie mu no yɛ ɛkwan a wɔfa so bɔ Tweaduampɔn 
anaa ahonhom nkaeɛ no pono mu de bɔ wɔn amanneɛ fa dwumadie a ɛrebɛkɔ so 
no ho. 
Nhwɛsoɔ:
Ɔfrɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ Asante Twi mu:
Tweaduampɔn Kwame, yɛkyerɛ wo nsa na yɛmma wo nsa!
Asase Yaa, Nsa!
Asubosom ne nnuabosom, mo nsa nie!
Nananom nsamanfoɔ, mommɛgye nsa nnom!
Ahum ne aham, mo nso mo nsa nie!
Amannebɔ
Amannebɔ a ɛwɔ nsaguo/mpaeyie mu no da botaeɛ pɔtee nti a wɔregu nsa anaa 
wɔreyi mpaeɛ no. Yei bɛtumi ayɛ adesrɛ anaa aseda. Ɛha yi no, nsagufoɔ no de 
botaeɛ anaa sɛnti a ɔrefrɛ ahonhom no wɔ saa dwumadie no mu no to dwa. Ɛha na 
nsagufoɔ srɛ ahobammɔ firi wɔn hɔ.
Awieeɛ (nhyira ne nnome)
Nsaguo/Mpaeyie fa yei mu na nsagufoɔ no da nananom nsamanfoɔ ase anaa ɔhyɛ 
wɔn bɔ sɛ, sɛ wɔyɛ biribi ma no a, ɔde biribi bɛda wɔn ase. Nsagufoɔ no srɛ 
nnome firi nananom abosomfoɔ nkyɛn de ma wɔn atamfo. Nsagufoɔ no sane srɛ 
nhyira firi nananom abosomfoɔ nkyɛn de ma wɔn adɔfo ne wɔn a wɔreyɛ biribi 
pa de aboa ɔman no. Ɛduru berɛ bi nso a, wɔyi mmusuo de dwira ɔman no ho wɔ 
nhyira ne nnome mu. Mfoni a ɛwɔ ɛfam ha no yɛ nsaguo/mpaeyie ho nhwɛsoɔ.

NSUIƐ
Nnwennweneho asɛmmisa:Sɛ wohwere w’abusuani bi a, atenka bɛn na wonya?
Ɛdeɛn ne Nsuiɛ?
Nsuiɛ yɛ nneyɛeɛ a obi da no adi anaa awerɛhodwom a obi to wɔ ɛberɛ a ne 
ho onipa bi awuo anaa wakae ne ho onipa bi a wawu dada. Yɛhunu nsuiɛ sɛ 
anwonsɛm fa bi. Yei kyerɛ sɛ, nsuiɛ yɛ anwonsɛm a yɛde moma owufoɔ bi. Nsuiɛ 
yɛ adeɛ a yɛyɛ de gya owufoɔ bi kwan wɔ ɛberɛ a ɔrefiri ateasefoɔ asase so akɔ 
ɔman foforɔ so.
Nsuiɛ dwumadie
Abibiman mu ha no, yɛde nsuiɛ di dwuma ahodoɔ pii. Nsuiɛ dwumadie no mu bi 
na ɛdidi soɔ yi;
1. Wɔde gyam owufoɔ no.
2. Wɔde gya owufoɔ no kwan.
3. Wɔde to nkra.
4. Yɛde srɛ adeɛ ma owufoɔ.
5. Ɛda ayɔnkofa a ɛwɔ yɛn ne owufoɔ no ntam adi.
Nsuiɛ so mfasoɔ
Nsuiɛ so mfasoɔ na ɛdidi soɔ wɔ ɛfam hɔ no;
1. Yɛde hyɛ owufoɔ no animuonyam
2. Ɛka ateasefoɔ ne awufoɔ bom
3. Ɛma yɛhunu sɛ obi ahwere ne ho onipa
4. Yɛde to ana
5. Yɛde bue ɛkwan ma owufoɔ no kɔ nseɛdo
 Mfoni 8.4: Nsuiɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ

ƆFA 8 KASADWINI
ABASƐM SU AHODOƆ
Abasɛm
Abasɛm yɛ atwerɛ kasadwini afa no mu baako. Ɛyɛ twerɛsɛm a ɛdi ɔkasa nhyehyɛeɛ 
so. Abasɛm di ɔkasa mmara ne ne nhyehyɛeɛ so. Ne nhyehyɛeɛ no nte sɛ ɛdwom. 
Wɔnam so de nimdeɛ, adwene ne atosɛm ma wɔn akenkanfoɔ.
Dwumadie 8.11
Kyerɛkyerɛ sɛdeɛ wosi te abasɛm ase na fa toto adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ no deɛ ho.
Abasɛm su ahodoɔ
• Agorɔmma: Wɔyɛ nnipa, mmoa anaa biribiara a wɔde wɔn di dwuma wɔ 
kasadwini dwumadie mu. Abasɛm no gyina twaka a ɛda agorɔmma ahodoɔ 
no ntam so. Agorɔmma ho hia yie wɔ abasɛm papa biara mu na mmom, 
otiban no wɔ nsunsuansoɔ amapa ma abasɛm no nhyehyɛeɛ so. Otiban no 
ne agorɔba titire a ɔwɔ abasɛm no mu ɛnna ɔkotiafoɔ no nso ne agorɔba bi 
a ɔko tia otiban no na ɔsan nso de ɔhaw pii ba abasɛm no nhyehyɛeɛ mu. 
Agorɔba-a-ɔnsesa-ne-su: Yei yɛ agorɔba kumaa a ɔnsesa ne su wɔ abasɛm 
mu ɛnna Agorɔba-a-ɔsesa-ne-su nso yɛ agorɔba kumaa a ɔtumi sesa ne su 
tebea ahodoɔ mu wɔ abasɛm mu.
• Asɛntitire: Yei yɛ asɛm pɔtee a abasɛm bi de to dwa anaa kasa fa ho sɛ ebia 
boasetɔ, setie, ɔdɔ, koroyɛ, nkabom, adwumaden, anigyeɛ ne deɛ ɛkeka ho. 
Abasɛm tumi nya asɛntitire nkorabata a ɛboa ma asɛntitire no ankasa wie 
mudie.
• Sibeaberɛ: Yei boa ma yɛhunu adeɛ a abasɛm no kasa fa ho. Ɛka biribi fa 
ɛberɛ ne beaeɛ a abasɛm bi mu dwumadie ahodoɔ kɔ so sɛ ebia (asetena mu 
nsɛm, abakɔsɛm, amammerɛ ne amanneɛ anaa atenaeɛ bi). Sibeaberɛ taa 
kasa fa ɛberɛ, beaeɛ, ewiem nsakraeɛ, asetena mu nsɛm ne deɛ ɛkeka ho a 
abasɛm bi kɔ so mu.
• Nhyehyɛeɛ: Yei yɛ nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ kwan a wɔfa so hyehyɛ abasɛm bi 
mu dwumadie ahodoɔ. Ɛda adwempɔ ne nneyɛeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ abasɛm no 
mu adi. Ɛkasa fa akaasie, apereapereɛ ne ɔhaw ahodoɔ ho. Ɛtumi yɛ biribi a 
ɛkɔwie yie, ɛkɔ so tɔɔtee anaasɛ ɛnkɔwie yie sɛdeɛ anka na wɔhwehwɛ no 
no.
10
ƆFA 8 KASADWINI
• Ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne: Yei yɛ beaeɛ a ɔkenkanfoɔ no gyina hunu deɛ abasɛm no 
nyinaa kasa fa ho. Ɛsane da ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne a ɔgyina so de twerɛ abasɛm no 
adi. Ɛbɛtumi ayɛ ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne ɛdi kan (ɔkasafoɔ no ka abasɛm no ho) anaa 
ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa (wɔtwerɛ abasɛm no fa agorɔmma bi ho a 
ɔkasafoɔ no nka ho bi). Dinnsiananmu a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne 
a ɛdi kan no mu ne ‘me’ ne ‘yɛn’ ɛnna ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa nso 
dinnsiananmu no ne ‘ɔno’, ‘ne’ ne ‘wɔn’.
• Atenka: Yei yɛ atenka a ɔtwerɛfoɔ bi nam ne dwumadie so de n’akenkanfoɔ 
kɔ mu. Wɔnam mfoniyɛ, asetena mu nsɛm, nneɛma ahodoɔ, adwempɔ, 
dwumadie ahodoɔ ne deɛ ɛkeka ho so na ɛde tebea no to dwa wɔ abasɛm 
no nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Ɛbɛtumi ayɛ awerɛhosɛm, nkonimdie, anigyeɛ, anidasoɔ 
anaa owuo.
Dwumadie 8.12
Wo ne wo yɔnko mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm abasɛm su ɛnan (4) mu tiawa. Fa wo 
mmuaeɛ no to adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ no anim.
Dwumadie 8.13
Ma wo kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ mma wo abasɛm nwoma bi na wo ne wo yɔnko nkenkan 
na mompɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm ne su ahodoɔ no mu. Fa nwoma no mu nsɛm no bi 
foa wo mmuaeɛ no so. Wo ne wo yɔnko nkyɛ adwene wɔ wo mmuaeɛ no ho.
EXTENDED READING
Agyekum, K. (2013). Introduction to literature (3rd ed.). Adwinsa Publication.

ƆFA 8 KASADWINI
ABASƐM MU MPƐNSƐMPƐNSƐMU
Dwumadie 8.14
Woasua abasɛm su ho adeɛ dada. Emu dodoɔ sɛn na wokae? Ne nyinaa yɛ 
nsia (6).
Adɛn nti na esu no mu biara ho hia?
Abasɛm mu mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu
Abasɛm mu mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu ne sɛ, worekenkan abasɛm, anya mu nteaseɛ na 
woakyerɛ w’adwene afa abasɛm no mu asɛntitire, nhyehyɛeɛ, kasasu ne abasɛm 
su nkaeɛ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ kasadwini mu no ho. Worepɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm abasɛm 
bi mu a, ɛho bɛhia sɛ wobɛhyɛ deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi nso:
ATRAPƆEƐ ESU AKWANKYERƐ AHODOƆ
1 Nsɛntitire ahodoɔ  
(Ɛdeɛn)
Ɛdeɛn na ɛkasa fa ho?
Adwempɔ ahodoɔ bɛn na ɛwom?
Bɔ no tɔfa.
2 Asɛntitire/Nnyinasoɔ 
(Adɛn)
Ɛdeɛn ne ɔtwerɛfoɔ no botaeɛ titire?
3 Ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne Hwan na ɔrekasa?
Hwan ne otiefoɔ/bɛhwɛadefoɔ no?
Ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne a woteɛ no yɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ 
no anaasɛ agorɔba no deɛ?
4 Sibeaberɛ (Ɛhenefa 
ne Ɛberɛ bɛn?)
Ɛdeɛn na ɛma wohunu ɛberɛ ne beaeɛ 
a wɔtwerɛɛ nwoma no wɔ mu? Fa 
nhwɛsoɔ pɔtee taa wo mmuaeɛ no akyi.
Nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na sibeaberɛ wɔ wɔ 
asɛntitire no so?
12
ƆFA 8 KASADWINI
ATRAPƆEƐ ESU AKWANKYERƐ AHODOƆ
5 Twerɛbea (Ɛkwan 
bɛn so/Sɛn)
Hwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no ne ɛnne no.
Nsɛmfua ahodoɔ bɛn na ɔtwerɛfoɔ 
no de dii dwuma? Emu nsɛm no yɛ 
mpanin kasa anaa nnɛɛmmafoɔ kasa?
Hwehwɛ ɛkwan a ɔtwerɛfoɔ no faa so 
de atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ ahodoɔ ne 
ɔkasamu nhyehyɛeɛ di dwuma.
Nkɔmmɔbɔ wom? Wahyehyɛ no wɔ 
ɛkwan sononko bi so?
Mfoniyɛ ahodoɔ no mu deɛ ɛwɔ he na 
ɔde dii dwuma?
Tebea bɛn na ɔtwerɛfoɔ anaa 
ɔkenkanfoɔ no wɔ mu? Sɛn na ɔsi da 
no adi fa? Twaka bɛn na ɛda tebea no 
ne asɛntitire no ntam?
6 Kasasu ahodoɔ Kyerɛkyerɛ kasasu ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ 
abasɛm yi mu sɛ ebia nnyinahɔma, 
asesɛsɛm, sɛnipa, mfoniyɛ, 
anihanehane, kasakoa ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
Dwumadie 8.15
1. Ma wo kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ mma wo abasɛm nwoma. Montena baanu baanu 
nkenkan abasɛm nwoma no na momfa nhwehwɛ deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi:
a. agorɔmma
b. sibeaberɛ
c. asɛntitire
d. Nsɛntitire/adwempɔ ahodoɔ
2. Fa wo nhwehwɛmu anodisɛm no to dwa mma adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ no 
mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm mu.

ƆFA 8 KASADWINI
Dwumadie 8.16
Montena akuakuo nkenkan abasɛm nwoma (Ɛsɛ sɛ abasɛm nwoma no ka anaa 
fra abasɛm nwoma ahodoɔ a wɔagye atom sɛ wɔnkenkan no Asante Twi mu 
no ho). Bɔ nwoma a woakenkan no mu nsɛm no tɔfa na montena akuakuo 
mfa nhwehwɛ na mompɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm kasasu ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa (3) anaa deɛ 
ɛboro saa a mohunuu no wɔ akenkan no mu ne nsunsuansoɔ a ɛwɔ wɔ tebea 
anaa asɛntitire no so.

MMƆAKYIRE NSƐMMISA
8.1: NSAGUO/MPAEYIE
1. Ɛdeɛn ne nsaguo/mpaeyie?
2. Ɔfrɛ so mfasoɔ ne sɛn wɔ nsaguo/mpaeyie mu?
3. Kyerɛ ‘amannebɔ’ ase wɔ nsaguo/mpaeyie nhyehyɛeɛ mu.
4. Kyerɛkyerɛ awieeɛ a ɛyɛ nhyira ne nnome no ase wɔ nsaguo/mpaeyie 
nhyehyeee mu.
5. Bobɔ nneɛma a wɔde gu nsa anaa yi mpaeɛ ahodoɔ no bi din.
6. Twerɛ nnipa baasa biara a wɔtumi gu nsa anaa yi mpaeɛ wɔ wo mpɔtam.
7. Kyerɛ sɛnti baako a wɔgu nsa anaa wɔyi mpaeɛ de dome.
8.2: NSUIƐ
1. Ɛdeɛn ne nsuiɛ? Fa w’ankasa nsɛmfua kyerɛkyerɛ mu.
2. Hwan ne osufoɔ?
3. Twerɛ nsuiɛ dwumadie mmiɛnsa (3).
4. Ɛberɛ bɛn na wɔde nsuiɛ di dwuma?
5. Twerɛ nsuiɛ so mfasoɔ enum (5). Yi enum (5) no mu mmiɛnsa (3) na fa 
w’ankasa nsɛmfua kyerɛkyerɛ mu fann.
8.3: ABASƐM SU AHODOƆ
1. Twerɛ abasɛm su ahodoɔ no?
2. Kyerɛ agorɔmma ahodoɔ a wɔwɔ abasɛm mu.
3. Ɛdeɛn ne asɛntitire wɔ abasɛm mu?
4. Kyerɛkyerɛ asɛntitire ahodoɔ a yɛbɛnya wɔ abasɛm bi mu.
5. Nsonsonoeɛ bɛn na ɛda agorɔba-a-ɔsesa-su ne agorɔba-a-ɔnsesa-su 
ntam?
6. Ɛdeɛn ne ‘ɔkasafoɔ ɛnne’ a ɛwɔ abasɛm mu?
8.4: ABASƐM MPƐNSƐMPƐNSƐMU
1. Kyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ahodoɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nso wɔ ɛberɛ a 
yɛrepɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm abasɛm bi mu.

2. Kyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wobobɔɔ din wɔ asɛmmisa (1) no mu mmiɛnsa 
(3) mu tiawa.
3. Fa w’ankasa nsɛmfua kyerɛkyerɛ kasasu ahodoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi ase.

 PATAKU NE APƆNKYE BA BI
 Na apɔnkye ba bi wɔ hɔ a ɔrefu abɛbɛn a na ɛma no dwene sɛ ɔyɛ 
apɔnkyenini a wanyini a ɔno ara bɛtumi ahwɛ ne ho. Enti, da koro 
anwummerɛ bi a mpɔnkyekuo no nyinaa firi wɔn adidiiɛ rekɔ efie no, ne 
maame frɛɛ no nanso apɔnkye ba yi ammua na mmom, ɔkɔɔ so ara wee 
ɛserɛ nketewa mono no. Akyire yi a ɔmaa ne tiri soɔ no, na mpɔnkyekuo 
no nyinaa kɔgya no.
 Na aka ɔno nko ara. Na owia rekɔtɔ. Na biribiara sunsum ayɛ tenten 
rewea fam. Mframa nwununwunu bi bɔeɛ a na ɛma ɛserɛ no yɛ 
dede huhuhuhu. Apɔnkye ba no ho popoeɛ wɔ ɛberɛ a ɔkaee Pataku 
otirimuɔdenfoɔ no. Afei, ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ wɔɔ ntwɛtwɛdɛ wɔ nwura mu hɔ 
a na ɔresu frɛ ne maame. Nanso na Pataku no wɔ dɔtɔ bi ase a ɛbɛn 
apɔnkye ba no!
 Apɔnkye ba no hunuu sɛ, n’anidasoɔ asa.
 Ɔde ɛnne a ɛrepopoɔ kaa sɛ,”Owura Pataku,” “Menim sɛ worebɛkyere 
me awe me. Nanso deɛ ɛdi kan no, bɔ me nnwom mma mensa sɛdeɛ 
mɛtumi.”
 Pataku ani gyee asɛm a apɔnkye ba de too n’anim no ho, enti ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ 
bɔɔ dwom dɛɛdɛ bi maa Apɔnkye ba no nso hyɛɛ aseɛ dii asa maa ne ho 
baee no.
 Saa berɛ yi nyinaa no, na mpɔnkyekuo no nam nyaa rekɔ efie. 
Anwummerɛ mu mframa no de nnwom no mu nnyegyeeɛ no kɔɔ akyire. 
Nkraman a wɔhwɛ mpɔnkyekuo no soɔ no wɛnn wɔn aso. Wɔtee sɛ ɛyɛ 
dwom a Pataku to wɔ ɛberɛ a ɔrebɛkyere aboa bi awe no, na ɛberɛ tiawa 
bi mu no, wɔsan tuu mmirika baa adidibea hɔ. Pataku dwom no gyaee 
prɛkopɛ wɔ ɛberɛ a na ɔredwane a nkraman no sa no na ɔfrɛɛ ne ho 
ogyimfoɔ sɛ ɔtiee apɔnkye ba no afotuo too dwom maa no wɔ ɛberɛ a na 
anka ɛsɛ sɛ ɔkum no no.
 Ɛmma biribiara nnyi w’adwene mfiri wo botaeɛ so.

NOƆRE DƐMƐ DIIBU
Dagaare fonologyi (dagaare voonebie)
KYƐYUOBU 
Zanezanneba, yɛ waabo yaane wa ne a wɛlemɛ ŋa naŋ kyaare a kɔkɔre zannoo 
daŋkyinparekparaa. Te na kyɛyuo la a sɛgebinyaane ane a sɛgebidaare a kɔkɔre 
poɔ. Te na zanne la a sɛgebie ama yeli zaa. Aseŋ ziiri na a naŋ maŋ are yelbiri poɔ. 
Te na la zanne la lɛnɛɛ te naŋ na de a sɛgebie ama poŋ eŋ a zagre na a kɔkɔre poɔ, 
a kaa lɛ a naŋ na soŋ ka te tōɔ sɛge kyɛ kanne a kɔkɔre ka o taa pare. A zannoo 
ŋa ba deɛ are ko a Dagaare zannoo yoŋ, kyɛ a na soŋ la ka te taa gɔɔloŋ kaŋa a 
zannoo bɔgre mine teseŋ Bɔrefɔ ane a kɔkɔɛ mine naŋ poɔ. A wɛlemɛ ŋa na soŋ 
te la ka te baŋ voonebie tontonne ane a toma a kɔkɔre zannoo poɔ. A zu kpulluu 
zaa la, ka a zannoo ŋa poɔ te na tōɔ baŋ la, a bigri, a maale a nɔpoɔ foɔlaa pelee 
a Dagaare kɔkɔre poɔ. 
A zannoo ŋa baaraa zaa, yɛ na tōɔ:
1. Bigri a Dagaare sɛgebinyaane ane a boɔloo ziiri. (aseŋ; nɔgbama duobu 
bee sigibu ane a zelle lomboi)

SECTION 1 DAGAARE VOONEBIE 
Yelbulo
 Boɔloo la kone kaŋa naŋ tu noɔre yi a e yɛlɛ a kɔkɔre poɔ. V oonebie la 
kombie na te naŋ maŋ de maale ne yelbie a bebiri zaa dɛmo diibu poɔ. A 
voonebie boɔloo poɔ, tɛgebo mine be be la a maŋ pɔgra kyɛ yuoro pɛnnoo 
yɛlɛ yelbu saŋa. A voonebie ama taa la areziiri yelbiri poɔ. V oonnoo e la 
pɛnnoo yiibu naŋ maŋ vɛŋ ka te tōɔ boɔle yelbiri. A yelzu kaŋa la pɛnnoo 
tɛgebo.
VOONEBIE PARƐƐ
Dagaare voonebie poŋ eŋ la ziiri ayi. Ka ana la voonebidaare ane voonebinyaane. 
A voonebie parɛɛ ama la maŋ lantaa maale yelbiri. Te na baŋ yeli ka yelbiri zaa 
yi la a voonebie ama boŋyeni boŋyeni poɔ. Aseŋ a yelbiri, die poɔ, voonebie ata 
la lantaa. Ka ana la /b/, /i/, ane /e/. A voonebiri /i/ ane /e/ la a voonebinyaane 
ka a voonebiri /d/ meŋ e voonebidaa. A wɛlemɛ poɔ, te na di la dɛmɛ kyaare a 
voonebie ama zaa a kaa lɛnɛɛ a naŋ tona 
Sɛgebinyaane
Sɛgebinyaane e la voonebie naŋ be yeli poɔ. A voonebie ama boɔloo saŋa, pɛnnoo 
ba pɔgera. A pɛnnoo ba pɔgera, kyɛ ka anaŋ na pɔge, a maŋ pɔge la fẽẽ lɛ a 
noɔre poɔ. A naŋ ba pɔgera bee pɔgera fẽẽ zuiŋ, voonebinyaane boɔloo yire la 
gbolgbol. V oonebinyaane e la nimizeɛ yelbie maaloo poɔ. Yelbiri kyɛbe a bat aa 
voonebinyaane bee a ba taa voonoo kaŋa naŋ waa aŋa voonebinyaaŋa. Te na di la 
dɛmɛ kyaare a voonebinyaane toŋ nimizeerɛ ama a yelbiri maaloo poɔ a karenderi 
ayi gane poɔ. A yelzu na poɔ te naŋ na di a dɛmɛ la kɔkɔtɛgɛ.
Sɛgebinyaane bigruu
N zanezaneba, sɛgebinyaane bigruu poɔ, bommanoo mine be be la ka te maŋ 
de mane ne. Ana la ka te maŋ boɔle ka bommanoo. A bommanoo ama pare la a 
voonebinyaane waaloo zaa o naŋ taa. A mommanoo ama la, nɔgbama duobu bee 
sigibu, nɔgbama arezie ane a zelle lomboi na naŋ tona toma a voonebiri boɔloo 
saŋa. A yi a ata ama puoriŋ, anaare soba be be la. Ona la zelnyaga tããnoo/lɔnnoo. 
Gaanaa kɔkɔɛ zaa naane taa a anaare soba ŋa. Dagaare taa o la. Te piili di dɛmɛ 
kyaare a bommanoo ama.

SECTION 1 DAGAARE VOONEBIE 
Nɔgbana arezie
A bommanoo ŋa wulo la zie na a nɔgbama naŋ are a voonebinyaaŋa boɔloo saŋa. 
Ziiri ayi la be be; nɔgbama fuuluu bee yɛroo. Ka a voonebiriŋ boɔle, a nɔgbama 
maŋ fuuli la bee a nɔgbama yɛrɛɛ la. A ŋa zuiŋ, voonebinyaane poŋ eŋ la ziiri ayi, 
fuuluu voonebinyaane ane yɛroo voonebinyaane. A fuuluu voonebinyaane mine 
la; /u, ɔ, o/. A yɛroo voonebinyaane mine la /i, ɛ, e, a/
Toma
A kyɛ, wuli Dagaa fuuluu sɛgebinyaane ane yɛroo sɛgebinyaane.
Zelle duobu
A ŋa wulo la lɛnɛɛ a zelnyaga naŋ maŋ are a noɔre poɔ voonebinyaane boɔloo 
saŋa. Te de la ka ka fōō boɔla voonebinyaaŋa, a noɔre naŋ yuoe la saŋa na a yɔgɔ 
naŋ sigi. A ŋa na baŋ e la duobo, sɔga bee sigi. Ka fōō sigri a yɔgɔ ka o sigi, a 
voonebinyaaŋa naŋ na yi e la sigibu voonebinyaaŋa aseŋ; /a/. Ka teneŋ yuo a 
noɔre zaa, kyɛ ba sigi teseŋ a voonebinyaane sigibo, a voonebinyaaŋa na e la sɔgɔ 
voonebinyaaŋa. Aseŋ; /e,o/. Kyɛ ka fōō na boɔle sɛgebinyaa duoraa, a noɔre maŋ 
yuo la kyɛlee; o ba maŋ yuo o zaa aŋa a sɔga voonebinyaŋa. Aseŋ; /i, u/.
Toma
Piili boɔla a Dagaare voonebinyaane. Veŋ ka fo teɛroŋ are ko ana naŋ duoro, 
sigire bee sɔga.
Zelle lomboi
A mannoo ŋa wulo la zelle zie na a voonoo naŋ tu yi. Te de la ka ka fōō boɔla 
voonebinyaaŋa, a zelle zie kaŋa maŋ dɔɔŋ la. Te ba maŋ tōɔ woŋ a dɔɔno eŋ. Zelle 
lomboi ata la be be a tona a toma ŋa. A ziiri ama la a zelle nyoɔre, zelle sɔga ane a 
zelle kpaare. Azuiŋ, te taa la zellenyoɔre voonebinyaane, zellesɔga sɛgebinyaane 
ane a zellekpaare sɛgebinyaane. Ka fōō boɔla zellenyoɔre voonebinyaaŋa, a zelle 
niŋeŋ la ka a boɔla maŋ dɔɔ. Aseŋ; /i, e,e/. Zellesɔga boɔloo, a zelle sɔga la maŋ 
dɔɔŋ. Aseŋ; /a/.
A zellekpaare voonebinyaaŋa meŋ dɔɔŋ la a zelle puoriŋ. Aseŋ; /u,o,o/

SECTION 1 DAGAARE VOONEBIE 
Voonebidaare
Aŋa te naŋ da yeli a a wɛlemɛ nan pare poɔ na, voonebidaare e la a kɔkɔre voonebie 
mine a yi voonebinyaane puoriŋ. 
A voonebidaare ama la voonebie na ka fōō boɔla a, a pɛnnoo naŋ yiri maŋ pɔge 
la. Azuiŋ a pɛnnoo naŋ yire kyɛ a yiibu maŋ e la toɔ. 
Azuiŋ tye na baŋ yeli ka voonebidaare e la tulimo ne a voonebinyaane; ka 
pɛnnoo yire a voonebinyaane poɔ kyɛ pɔgra a voonebidaare poɔ. Te maŋ de la 
voonebidaare ane voonebinyaane lantaa a maale yelbiri. 
Sɛgebidaare bigruu
Ka foo boora ka fo bigiri segebidaare, bommanne mine be be la ka fo na tu kyɛ 
bigiri. A bommanne na ata fo naŋ na de manne ne segebidaare bigiruu la: naane 
boɔloo zie, boɔloo irug, ane voonoo. Te na di la deme kyaare a bommanne ama 
kyɛ de amine toŋ ne toma.
Naane boɔloo zie
Da la a nɔpoɔfoolaa boma naŋ maŋ to taa a segebidaare boɔloo saga. Aga fo naŋ 
nye a voonebie boɔloo sini poɔ na, a Ghana kɔkɔre voonebie boɔloo tuyiziiri la, 
nogbama, naŋbane ne nyemɛ, tamanyini, Talambaaloŋ, zelle ne nyemɛ amk. 
A ama mine la a Ghana kɔkɔre voonoo tuyiziiri.
• Nɔgbama: A nogbama voonebie boɔloo poɔ, a nogbama ayi zaa maŋ mare 
la taa. Aseŋ; /p/, /b/, /m/
• Tamanyene: tamanyene voonebie boɔloo poɔ, te maŋ de la a zelenyoore te 
to ne a tamanyini. A tamanyene voonebie mine la, /t/, /d/, /s/, /n/.
• Nogbama ne nyemɛ: A ama boɔloo, a sazu nyemɛ maŋ seene la a pulig 
nogbane. Aseŋ /f/
• Zelle ne nyemɛ: A voonoo boɔloo saga a zelesoga maŋ ta la a nyemɛ. Aseŋ, 
/j/
• Talambaaloŋ: A talambaaloŋ voonebie voonoo saga, te maŋ tage la a 
zelekpaare gaa ne a talaŋ zu. Aseŋ, /k/, /g/
Toma
Bɔ Dagaare yelbie ka a piili a boɔloo ziiri na naŋ zanne.

SECTION 1 DAGAARE VOONEBIE 
Boɔloo Iruq
A gaa wulo la lenee pɛnnoo naŋ maŋ poŋe segebidaare boɔloo saga. A segebidaare 
boɔloo saga a pɛnnoo poŋebo maŋ do gaŋ la taa. Aseŋ, a segebidaare mine voonoo, 
a pɛnnoo maŋ poŋe la o zaa kyɛ yuo bare tontobaa. A maŋ tu la a pɛnnoo do gaŋ 
taa ga kyɛ ka te bigiri a segebidaare mine a Ghana kɔkɔre poɔ. A nɔpoɔ maŋ tage 
la kyɛ gmenne a voonoo boɔloo saŋa. A voonoo irug ama mine la, tɛgebo, fooroo, 
nya-erme, amk, a ama mine la a Ghana kɔkɔre segebidaare boɔloo irug.
•  Tɛgebo: Aŋa o yuori, a voonoo boɔloo poɔ a pɛnnoo maŋ tege la. A pɛnnoo 
maŋ tɛge la o zaa are , bee a tɛ ge fee, a pɛnnoo paa na daa yi la tontobaa.
 Aseŋ, /p/, /b/, /t/ /d/, /k/, /g/, /m/, /n/. A yi a zie na a pɛnnoo naŋ na tu yi na, te 
na baŋ poŋ la a tɛgebo voonoo eg zagere ayi poɔ. Ana la, noare tɛgebo ane 
nyoare tɛgebo. Ka a pɛnnoo tu nooreg yi, te boole a la purdaayi tɛgebo. 
Aseŋ, /p/,/b/, /t/, /d/, /k/, /g/. Ka a pɛnnoo meŋ la tu nyoore yi, onaŋ la nya-
ɛreme tɛgebo. Aseŋ; /m/, /n/.
• Fooroo: A fooroo voonebie boɔloo poɔ, pɛnnoo ba poŋera fee zaa, kyɛ vuo 
na a pɛnnoo naŋ maŋ tu yi e la fee le ka a pɛnnoo maŋ yire feefee le. Azuig, 
a nɔpoɔ maŋ duuro la. Aseŋ; /f/, /s/.
• Foore-kyɛlee: V oonebie boɔloo poɔ, dabie ayi la be be. A dendeg, pɛnnoo 
maŋ poŋe la o zaa. A dabie ayi soba poɔ, a pɛnnoo maŋ daa yire la fee fee (a 
ba maŋ daa yi tontobaa le). Aseŋ /t/
• Zelle ne tamanyene: voonebie boɔloo poɔ, a zelenyoore na seene la a 
tamanyene zu a veg ka a pɛnnoo tu a noore lomboi yi. Aseŋ, /l/
• Miinuu: A zelle la maŋ boole a miinuu voonebie a zelle la a boɔloo nimizie 
soba kyɛ ka amine paa sonna. A tamanyene la a zie kaŋa naŋ maŋ soŋe a 
miinuu voonebie boɔloo. A miinuu voonebiri kaŋa la /r/
Voonoo
N nonneba zanezaneba, a mannoo ata soba te na maŋ de bigire ne segebidaare 
la voonoo. Ka teneg boola voonebidaare, a nɔpoɔ naŋ gaŋ sigi a kɔkɔpoɔ maŋ 
wele la ziiri ayi. Amine poɔ, o maŋ dɔɔnɔ la, amine poɔ meŋ o ba dɔɔnɔ. ka foo 
boola segebidaare ka a kɔkɔpoɔ dɔɔnɔ, voonoo segebidaa la. Ka foo boola ka a 
kɔkɔpoɔ ba dɔɔnɔ meŋ, ba-voonoo segebidaare la. V oonoo segebidaare mine la: 
/g/, /d/, /m/, /b/. A ba-voonoo segebidaare mine la: /f/, /s/, /k/, /t/ amk.

Yelbiri zaa taa la o gaŋgyere na poɔ o naŋ be . A wɛlemɛ ŋa poɔ te na zanne la a 
gangye bɛrɛ ama; Yoe, Bigruu, Eroŋ, ane Eronwuluu. Ka fooŋ baŋ a gangyere, 
ana soŋ la ka fo baŋ yelbiri kaŋa zaa tɛgɛ ane o toma yɛlɛ poɔ.
A zannoo baaroo zaa fo na toɔ
i.  De yoe yelbie eŋ a zagre poɔ ( aseŋ; yomenne, bonweere yoe, yofuu, 
bonseene yoe)
ii. De bigruu yelbie eŋ zagere poɔ, (aseŋ; bigri teɛwulli, yagroŋ bigruu ane 
meɛroŋ bigruu a kyɛ de a maale ne yɛlɛ
iii. De eroŋ yelbie eŋ eroŋ kyelaa, eroŋ nemburee ane eroŋ naŋ derɛ eterɛ 
ayi.
iv. De eronwuluu yelbie eŋ zagere poɔ (aseŋ lɛnɛɛ eroŋwuluu, zie eronwuluu, 
wagere eronwuluu, etaabo zie eronwuluu)
Yelbulo
 Yoe ŋmaa lɛ la boma yoe. A naŋ baŋ po-eŋ la yomenne, yofuu, bonweere 
yoe, ane yoseene. Yagroŋ bigruu la bigruu na naŋ maŋ wulo boma yagroŋ 
bee mannoo. Meɛroŋ bigruu meŋ maŋ wulo la yuori bee yoleɛre waaloŋ. 
Eroŋ la yelbiri naŋ maŋ wulo ka yeli kaŋa e la bee erɛ la. Eroŋ parɛɛ 
ata la bebe; Eroŋ kyelaa, Eroŋ nemburee ane Eroŋ naŋ derɛ eterɛ ayi. . 
Eronwuluu la maŋ pege eroŋ, bigruu, ane eronwuluu mine. Eroŋwuluu 
na baŋ po-eŋ la zagre ama poɔ; Lɛnɛɛ eronwuluu, Zie eronwuluu, 
Wagere ronwuluu, Bui bui eronwuluu, Ananso eronwuluu ane Etaabo zie 
eronwuluu.

Boŋ la Eroŋ Yelbiri?
Boŋ ka fo e baguo ŋa. Sɛge a yel-erre na zaa fo naŋ e zenɛ.
Boŋ ka fo nyɛ kyaare a fo sakuuri zannoo bɔgere. Sɛge a fo teɛrɛ zaa.
Nare ka fo wuli fo taaba fo teɛroŋ ka yɛ de di dɛmmɛ.
Eroŋ yelbiri wulo la yeli naŋ e bee erɛ. A eroŋ e la yelbie bee yelŋmaare mine naŋ 
wulo yeli waaloŋ, teseŋ; baa, nyuuri, so, nɔŋ, kyiiri, baŋ, boɔra amk.
Eroŋ na baŋ be la yɛlɛ poɔ a taa eterɛ bee a koŋ taa eterɛ. A eterɛ yelbie na naŋ 
maŋ tu eroŋ yelbiri yɛlɛ poɔ la ka te maŋ boɔle ka eterɛ sonna. Eroŋ yelbie na 
baŋ po-eŋ la zagere naŋ kyaare eterɛ sonna. A zagere ama la eroŋ kyelaa, eroŋ 
namburee, ane eroŋ na naŋ derɛ eterɛ ayi.
Eroŋ kyelaa
Eroŋ kyelaa maŋ de la eterɛ naŋ tuuro a yɛlɛ poɔ. Amine la; maale, mɔŋ, ɔŋ, di, 
sɛge, ŋmɛ amk. Yɛlɛ mine te naŋ de manne ne la ama naŋ tu.
1. A karema da doge la mui.
2. A karembiiri da ɔŋ la kõɔ
3. Dɛre ne Ayɔɔ ɔɔ la mui
4. Bie kaŋa wane la tewɔma
5. A noba kpɛ la a lɔɔre.
A yelbie na soɔmaa naŋ tõɔne a parɛɛŋ la a eroŋ kyelaa.A eterɛ bee a eterɛ sonna 
maŋ tu la a eroŋ puori. Aseŋ; 1 poɔ, a eterɛ la mui. Ka a 5 poɔ meŋ, lɔɔre la a eterɛ
Eroŋ Nemburee
Eroŋ nemburee e la eroŋ yelbie naŋ ba dera eterɛ bee eterɛ sonna yɛlɛ poɔ. Yelbie 
bee yelŋmaara mine na baŋ tuuro la kyɛ gbɛɛ yaga, eroŋwulluu maŋ la. A yelbie 
ama mine la, kpi, age, hieri, koŋ, baa amk. Kaa a yeldemannewulli ama naŋ tu.
1. A bie hiere la.
2. A dakyeɛ maŋ age la wieou.
3. A karembie le la tɔntɔbaa lɛ
A yelbie na soɔmaa naŋ tõɔne a parɛɛŋ e la eroŋ nemburee. Ka fõõ kaa 
yeldemannwuli 2 ne 3 poɔ, a yelbie na naŋ tu a eroŋ ba e eterɛ kyɛ a e la eroŋwuluu. 
A ba e eterɛ sonna. A puoriŋ, te na zanne la eroŋwuluu.

Boŋ la eroŋwuluu?
Kaa a enfuoni ŋa naŋ tu velaa. Wola ka a baapaaba bama kyɛnɛ? wagere buo poɔ 
la a bebiri na daare? Yeŋ ka a yeli ŋa erɛ? Bonso ka a yeli ŋa erɛ?
Eroŋwuluu e la yelbie bee yelŋmaara naŋ maŋ pege eroŋ yɛlɛ poɔ ka o pare 
kyaane velaa. Eroŋwuluu na baŋ pege la o tɔ eroŋwuluu. Leɛ teɛre lɛ fo naŋ kyeŋ 
gaa sakuuri zenɛ. O da e la maaroŋ bee wieou, bee fɔɔŋ. Kaapɔge, fo da kyɛŋ la 
wieou gaa a sakuuri. A yelbiri wieou, wulo la lɛ fo nan kyɛŋ gaa a sakuuri. Azuiŋ 
wieou e la eroŋwuluu yelbiri. Eroŋwuluu zaa po-eŋ la zagere poɔ kyaare lɛ a naŋ 
maŋ pege a eroŋ. A zagere la; lɛnɛɛ, be zie, wagere, bui bui, etaabo zie, ananso.
Lɛnɛɛ eroŋwuluu
1. A eroŋwuluu ŋa wulo la lɛ yeli naŋ e. aseŋ;
2. A karembiiri kyɛŋ gaa la a sakuuri wieou.
3. A bɔle ŋmeɛreba ŋmɛ la a bɔle maaroŋ lɛ
4. A yieliyielibe yieli la baaloŋ lɛ
5. A nuulee da yieli la soŋ a sagane poɔ
Be zie eronwuluu.
Be zie eroŋwuluu maŋ wuli la duoro kyaare zie na a yeli naŋ e.
Kaa a yeldemannewulli ama naŋ tu.
1. A karembiiri are la a yeŋeŋ.
2. Dabuo ane Ayuo gana la a saazu.
3. A karembiiri yaare la a gampɛlɛ ziezaa.
4. A bibiiri kpeɛrɛ la Kaleo.

A wɛlemɛ ŋa gyɛle la Dagaare kɔkɔre sɛgebo begɛ. Te na de la kyaare a begɛ ama 
naŋ kyaare yuori yelbie, eroŋ yelbie, yoleɛrɛ ane bigruu yelbie. A begɛ ama la na 
soŋ fo de a, yuori yelbie, eroŋ yelbie, yoleɛrɛ ane bigruu yelbie toŋ ne toma. A 
begɛ ama meŋ be la Bɔrefɔ poɔ.
A yelzu ulee ŋa zannoo baaroo zaa ka fo na tõɔ
1. De yuori ne yoleɛrɛ begɛ sɛge ne yɛlɛ
2. De bigruu begɛ sɛge ne yɛlɛ
3. De eroŋ ne eronwulluu begɛ sɛge ne yɛlɛ

Baare
Baare e la donne mine a andonɛɛ zaa naŋ baŋ ka a e nensaaleba zɔmenne. A maŋ 
eɛ boore-tɛɛtɛɛ, gyogi tɛɛtɛɛ, waaloŋ tɛɛtɛɛ, ane meɛroŋ tɛɛtɛɛ. A eɛ doŋgbɛɛ-
anaare naŋ yi mɔbaa boorɔ poɔ. Dakoroŋ saŋa deme la da de mɔbaare tona ne 
naãkpãã toma ka a leɛ yiri donne a tuuro noba. A tu la a noba tuubu ŋa poɔ a milli 
noba. A maŋ toɔ baŋ la nensaala enkyere teseŋ; nɔmmo bee popɛle. Azuiŋ a zoro 
la nensaala posaã a meŋ maŋ tõɔ wuli ka a baŋɛɛ la. Gaŋ a zaa, baare wono la 
nyuu yaga. Boŋ zaa nyuu ba para baa.. A toori meŋ wono la gaa tɔɔre. Dɔɔne zaa 
ba para baa toori. Boŋ naŋ so kaa baa yɛlɛ soma yaga la, fo naŋ baŋ wuli la baa 
ka o baŋ a tõɔ e yɛlɛ ko neɛ. Baare naŋ nyɛ wulibu na baŋ de la zɔŋa wẽɛ ka o gaa

Ka fooŋ na de eroŋ bee eronwuluu yelbie maale ne yɛlɛ, begɛ mine bebe la naŋ 
seŋ ka te tu. A begɛ ama la maŋ soŋ ka a yɛlɛ kyaane, a taa pare, a kyɛ soŋ ka a 
kannema wuli ba teɛroŋ a sɛgere poɔ. A begɛ ama tuubu maŋ soŋ la ka sɛgere taa 
pare bammo a kɔkɔreŋ.
Eroŋ yelbiri
Sɛre ka te piili ne a eroŋ sɛgebo begɛ, ka te leɛ teɛre bone naŋ la eroŋ yelbie. Kaa 
a yɛlɛ ama naŋ tu. A yelbie na naŋ kyaane la a eroŋ yelbie;
1. A koɔraa maŋ kyɛ la teere koɔbo saŋa zaa.
2. A sakubiiri maŋ gaa la sakuuri bebiri zaa.
Eroŋ yelbiri bee eroŋ yelŋmaa la yelbiri naŋ bigre yeli naŋ e. A eroŋ maŋ la a 
yelgbɔge yieme yelzu.
Begɛ te naŋ maŋ de eroŋ yelbiri sɛge ne yɛlɛ
A sɛgere begɛ mine te naŋ maŋ de eroŋ yelbiri sɛge ne yɛlɛ waa la tɛɛtɛɛ a Ghana 
kɔkɔrɛɛ poɔ.
A begɛ mine la a ama:
1. A eroŋ yelbiri la maŋ wuli bone na a erɛ naŋ erɛ.
 Aseŋ:
a. A baa wuoli la a yiriŋ.
 A yelbiri wuoli la wulo bone na a baa naŋ erɛ.
b. A sakubie maŋ zɔŋ la kuriwiri bebiri zaa.
 A yelbiri zɔŋ la wulo bone na a sakubie naŋ erɛ.
2. Eroŋ yelbiri maŋ wuli la a erɛ waaloŋ yɛlɛ poɔ.

a. Bayɔɔ poɔ pɛlɛɛŋ a e-nyɛ baaraaŋ.

Eronwuluu
Te zanne la begɛ na zaa te naŋ maŋ tu a sɛge yɛlɛ ne eroŋ yelbie. Ka te pãã kaa 
begɛ na te naŋ na tu kyɛ de eronwuluu maale ne yɛlɛ.
Fo naŋ teɛre la bone naŋ la eronwuluu?
Eronwuluu la yelbiri naŋ bigire eroŋ bee o tɔ eronwuluu yɛlɛ poɔ. A maŋ bigire la, 
wagre, zie, etaabo zie amk. Eronwuluu ba naŋ de maale ne yɛlɛ mine la a ama 
naŋ tu:
1. Ba wa la kyɛ (zie)
2. Te taɛ a zie gbelin-ayopoi saŋa. (wagere)
3. A bɔle ŋmeɛreba ŋmɛ ne la popeɛloŋ (etaabo zie)
A eronwuluu yelbie a yɛlɛ ama poɔ la kyɛ, gbelin-ayopoẽ ane popeɛloŋ
Begɛ/ tontonne
A begɛ na fo naŋ maŋ tu kyɛ de eronwuluu maale ne yɛlɛ eɛ tɛɛtɛɛ a Ghana kɔkɔɛ 
poɔ. Begɛ/ a tontonne mine la a ama:
1. Eronwullu maŋ la a yelizu eronwuluu yelŋmaa poɔ.
 Aseŋ:
a. A dɔɔ yeli la gboligboli yaga;
b. A yeli da baarɛɛŋ tontobaa.
A yɛlɛ ayi ama poɔ, gboligboli ane tontobaa e la eronwuluu yelŋmaare kyɛ la 
toŋ eronwuluu yelŋmaare yelizu toma.
2. A maŋ toŋ la eronwuluu bigiru toma.
 Aseŋ:
a. Ba maŋ deɛŋ la velaa yaga
b. A karembiiri toŋ la soŋ te pare
A yɛlɛ ama poɔ, a eronwuluu, yaga, bigire la a eronwuluu velaa. Kyɛ ka te 
pare meŋ bigire soŋ a yɛlɛ ayi soba poɔ.
3. Adverbs can be joined to any other word class and written as one word.

KYƐYUOBU
A wɛlemɛ ŋa na kaa la a yelyagesɛgre parɛɛ. Yelyagesɛgeraa sɛgebo taa la tɔnɔ 
ko a Ghana kɔkɔɛ ane a zannoo bɔgere mine aseŋ Bɔrefɔ ane Saadayel yelmanne.
A yelzu ulee ŋa zannoo baaroo zaa ka fo na tõɔ
1. Sɛge yelmanne/sɛgeremannaa yelyagesɛgeraa
2. Sɛge yelbigiri /sɛgerebigiraa yelyagesɛgeraa
3. Sɛge yel-e mannoo yelyagesɛgeraa
Zannoo yelbulo
• Yelyagesɛgeraa la yelyaga neɛ naŋ maŋ sɛge ka a kyaare yelzuri bee 
yelnyɔgere.
• Yɛ na zanne la yelyagesɛgeraa parɛɛ ata.
o Yelmanne/sɛgeremannaa yelyagesɛgeraa e la senselloŋ wogi ba naŋ 
maŋ sɛge ka o pukyaare a sɛgerɛ teɛroŋ a mannoo poɔ.
o Yelbigiri/sɛgerebigiri yelyagesɛgeraa waa la gɔɔloŋ sɛgere kaŋa ba 
naŋ maŋ vɛŋ ka karembiirii manne bee bigri bone, neɛ, zie, yelzannoo 
kaŋa, enkyere amk.
o Yel-e mannoo yelyagesɛgeraa ŋa e la yelyagesɛgeraa naŋ maŋ boɔrɔ 
ka o bigri bee manne yɛlɛ kyaare boŋkaŋa. O maŋ tere la duoro ka a 
kyaane a kyaare yelzu kaŋa bee yelbulo mine.
• Yelyagesɛgere zaa taa la meɛroŋ tɛɛtɛɛ

YELBULO
Te zanne la yelzuri mine a wɛlemɛ naŋ pare poɔ. Fo na baŋ teɛre la bone naŋ la 
yɛlɛ yelzuri? A yɛlɛ yelkpɛlɛ la boŋ? Ka fõõ ne a karembi-tɔ wa di dɛmɛ baare 
sɛge a fo nɔ-iri biŋ.
Pãã de a fo nɔ-iri manne ne a ama naŋ tu a puliŋ kyɛ.
Yɛlɛ yelzuri
Yɛlɛ yelzu e la yɛlɛ naŋ maŋ yeli kyaare ne a yelbul-gboli a dabegere poɔ. Yɛlɛ 
yelteɛre la a yɛlɛ na naŋ maŋ soŋ yɔlle a yelbul-gboli.
Yelyagesɛgeraa
Ka yelyagesɛgeraa na soma, aseŋ ka o tu gɔɔloŋ kaŋa. A yelbulo seŋ ka a sɛge ka 
a lantaa soŋ a dabegere poɔ. Ka a ŋa na nyɛ eebo a seŋ ka duoro naŋ yitaa ka a 
lantaa, ka yel-erre tutaa velaa , a wuli danseɛ, a kyɛ de yelmanne wuli, amk
Yelmanne yelyagesɛgeraa
Yelmanne yelyagesɛgeraa waa la senselloŋ wogi ŋa a sɛgerɛ naŋ maŋ wuli lɛ 
yelkaŋa naŋ e. A sɛgerɛ maŋ waa ŋa a neɛ meŋɛ naŋ nyɛ a yeli ne nimiri bee ka 
ba manne ko o la. Yelbie naŋ wulo e-pare la ka a seŋ ka a sɛgerɛ maŋ de sɛge neŋ 
a yelyagesɛgeraa. Yeli naŋ e-pare, donne sensenllɛ, saadayeli, naapeɛle sensellɛ 
amk
A mannoo yeliyagesɛgerɛ yelnyɔgraa kaŋa la ka o de gɔɔlombie teseŋ yɛmbulo, 
tulimo, damanne eŋe ka a mannoo taa noɔ ane kaama. A mannoo o de sobiri a taa 
senselloŋ waaloŋ ko a kannema.
•  Sɛge yeliyagesɛgeraa a manne fo bebidɛndɛŋ sakuuri poɔ.
• Sɛge yeliyagesɛgeraa a manne wuli fo bondinɔnaa
• Sɛge senselloŋ kyaare lɛnɛɛ fo naŋ da di holidee kaŋa naŋ pare.
• Sɛge manne yeli kaŋa naŋ e fo nyɔvore poɔ ka fo zanne yɛŋ
• Sɛge manne yelsoŋ kaŋa naŋ kpɛ fo nyɔvoreŋ kyɛ wuli lɛnɛɛ fo naŋ e a ta be.

yelbigiri yelyagesɛgesɛgeraa
Boŋ la yelbigiri yelyagesɛgeraa?
Yelyagesɛgeraa kaŋa naŋ wullo yelkaŋa: boŋ, neɛ, zie, nyɔvore yɛlɛ, zu nyiili 
yɛlɛ, yeli naŋ erɛ waaloŋ amk. Fo paa na de la gɔɔloŋ kaŋa a manne ka a kyaane 
welweli kyaare a bone na fo naŋ wuli. Bigruu yelyagesɛgeraa seŋ ka o kpɛ taa 
soŋ, a kyaane ka a kɔkɔre taa kyɛlloo a kyɛ wulo yelmeŋa gaŋ teɛroŋ
Yelyagesɛgeraa sɛgebo meɛroŋ
Bigiruu yelyagesɛgeraa meɛroŋ yitaa ne la a anaŋ te naŋ zanne dare naŋ pare.
1. Kyɛyuobu: O maŋ piili ne la yeli naŋ na tage a kankanna teɛroŋ kyaare a 
yelzu ka o kyaane. Ana baŋ waa la sooroo naŋ ba boɔrɔ nɔiraa naŋ kyaare a 
yelzu yiibu zie.
2. Soga Dabegere: kyɛ la ka a yelyagesɛgeraa ananso maŋ manne kyaane. A 
dabegere kaŋa zaa maŋ piili ne la yelzu naŋ maŋ nyɔge kanna teɛroŋ kyɛ 
wuli ba bone na naŋ seŋ ka ba nyɛ a dabegere poɔ. A maŋ tere la duoro naŋ 
kyaane ane yeldemannewulli mine.
3. Kpulluu: Leɛ kaa a yelbulo na naŋ sɛge eŋe a dabege dɛndɛŋ soba poɔ a 
wuli a yɛmbulo na naŋ be a sɔga dabegɛ poɔ.
Bigiruu yelyagesɛgeraa yelzuri mine.
• Sini bee bondinɔnaa bigruu
• Ghana meŋa soobo bibiri tigiri
• Manne wuli gane kaŋa fo naŋ nɔŋ yaga
• Manne wuli bone fo naŋ baŋ kyaare meŋa soobo ane yelmeŋa sori tuubu.
• Manne wuli fo zɔmeŋɛ.
• Manne bigiri fo nansaal-teŋa dɛndɛŋ gaabo.

2. Sɔga dabegere: Gbɛɛ yaga o maŋ taa dabegere ata bee a gaŋ lɛ a ko 
yelyagesɛgere wogiri. A kyɛ la ka fo maŋ de a yelyaga zaa pɔge a yelzu ka 
o kpɛ. Dabegere zaa seŋ ka o maŋ taa yelbuli bonyeni. A ŋaa na soŋ la ka 
yɛlɛ pare kyaane welweli. A soŋ la ka fo maŋ piili dabegere zaa ka o taa 
yelnyɔgeraa na naŋ be a piiluu dabegere poɔ.
3. Kpulluu: A yɛlɛ zu kpulluu ŋa la maŋ are ko a yelzu na sɛgere bee a dɛmmo 
naŋ kyaare. A zu kpulluu maŋ nyɔge la sɛgere yelbullo zaa lantaa ka neɛ kaa 
o kyɛ ŋmaa sɛrɛɛ kyaare a sɛgere zaa.

 Ka a bidɔgerebaŋ wa nyɛ kyilluu kaŋa a pɔgelee eŋaŋ, ba maŋ piili nara la

ŋmemɛ nyaabo.

• Ba maŋ wuli la a pɔgelee yiri zu kaabo, aseŋ bondirii maaloo, sagre

• Ba maŋ wuli ba la ba sããkoŋseɛre ane a yiele.

kponnuŋ kpeɛrɛ tu ne a sobie ama.

1. Ba kponnuŋ kpeɛbo yeltuuri maŋ tōɔ kɔɔre ta la daa gbuli bee kyuu.
2. Ba maŋ biŋ la a pɔgebilii na a yikpoŋ dampuori, kyɛ e ka a ba kyɛmmine zeŋ 
ne ba a deɛnɛ ne ba.
3. A kponnuŋ sobie poɔ, a pɔgebilii maŋ vɔle la gyɛlɛ. A wulo la ba naŋ na tōɔ

1. Gonseɛ kyuu poɔ la ka ba maŋ toŋ a. Ba boɔle o la Dipo. Ka a saŋa wa ta,

2. A pɔgelee saamine maŋ de o la ko a balzuzeɛ na naŋ kaara a Dipo yeltarre.
3. A kponnuŋ kpeɛbo saŋa, teŋgbandaana maŋ bare la kōɔ. A poŋ a pɔgelee zu. 
kyɛ e ka o zeŋ a kogi zu amk.

1. A Ga noba kponnuŋ kpeɛbo la Otofo. Ba maŋ de la pɔgelee naŋ kyɛnɛ baara

kpɛ a kponnuŋ.
Akan noba
1. A maŋ piili la Yedaare bee Yidaare bebiri. Ba maŋ de la bebie ayopoẽ a e o.
2. Sɛre ka ba de a pɔgelee tu a sori na, a pɔge kpoŋ naŋ kaara a kponnuŋ 
kpeɛbo na peɛre la a pɔge eŋa ane o seɛ yeli zaa. Ba maŋ eɛ ŋa ka ba baŋ ka 
a pɔge naŋ ba ta dɔɔ zaa bee o ba taa poɔ.
Wola ka fo noba maŋ kpɛ kponnuŋ?
Dɔɔbili kponnuŋ kpeɛbo
Dɔɔbilii kponnuŋ kpeɛbo ba pore Ghana poɔ. Noba fẽẽ la erɛ a. Ewe noba boɔloo 
la Tudedease. Ka Sissala boɔla Baala. Ka Ga boɔla Plamatemɔ/ Butrumwɔɔ/
Deŋtuwoo. Vagla noba boɔla o la Pellaa. Bidɔba kponnuŋ kpeɛbo ba maŋ e tigiri. 
Kuori daare la ka a Vagla kpeɛrɛ Pellaa. Ka a Ewe meŋ de malefare tona ne a 
Tudedeasi.
A kponnuŋ kpeɛbo yelituuri mine la a ama naŋ tu:
1. Ba naŋ maŋ iri o yoŋ yi o taaba poɔ a wuli o yelpaala.
2. Ba maŋ wuli o la dɔɔloŋ bee dɔɔ ferebo toma.
3. Ba maŋ wuli o la nembɛree.
4. Eŋa ane seɛ peeroo maŋ bebe la.
5. Sããkom yeltarre zaa la ka ba maŋ wuli a dɔɔlee.
A yeltuuri ama eɛ tɛɛtɛɛ a tenne poore; bonzuiŋ a sããkom yɛlɛ ba e boŋyeni a 
Ghana kɔkɔrɛɛ poɔ.

KYƐYUOBU
A wɛlemɛ ŋa kaa la yelkããyeli ane yelkããsɛgre a Dagaare kɔkɔre poɔ. Te na 
zanne la yeli kyaare kaaloo a yelkãã-yeli poɔ. Te na zanne la a kaaloo ananso. 
Te na kaa la ŋmensɔre tɔna ane bone nanso ka a seŋ ka te maŋ puoro. Te zaa 
na nyɛ la eŋkpeɛŋaa a wuli bone naŋ so ka kaaloo e nimizeɛ te noba poɔ. A 
zannoo ŋa kyaare la a Ghana kɔkɔre zannoo kyɛ taa kpɛzie ko zannoo bɔgre 
mine teseŋ, ŋmenpuori zannoo yɛlɛ. A wɛlemɛ na soŋ fo la ne gɔɔloŋ ka fo tōɔ 
gyɛle fo saãkonoŋ ane kɔkɔyobo sããkonyɛlɛ. A wɛlemɛ ŋa la kyaare la kuori zie 
koŋkombie a Ghana kɔkɔrɛɛ poɔ. Te na di la dɛmɛ kyaare koŋkombie Dagaare 
poɔ. Te na kanne la sɛgre naŋ kyaare koŋkombie mine. Dɛmɛ diibu na pukyaare la 
koŋkombie tontonne. A yeli kaŋa naŋ poɔ la, a wɛlemɛ ŋa na kaa la senselloŋwogi 
nandaare. A yɛ karema na soŋe la ka yɛ di dɛmɛ kyaare senselloŋwogi nandaare 
tɛɛtɛɛ naŋ be be, aseŋ; dẽɛndẽɛmɛ, paabo/wuobu, yelnyɔgraa, eebo zie/wagre, ane 
manna leɛ nyaabo, amk.
A wɛlemɛ ŋa baaraa zaa, yɛ na tōɔ:
• Peɛre baŋ la kaaloo meɛroŋ a fo kɔkɔre poɔ ( boɔloo, yelboɔraa, ane a zu 
kpuluu)
• Di dɛmɛ kyaare koŋkombie (tontonne ane a tɔna.)
• Di dɛmɛ kyaare senselloŋwogi nandaare (dẽɛndẽɛmɛ, paabo/wuobu, 
yelnyɔgraa, eebo zie/wagre, ane manna leɛ nyaabo, amk)
• Gyɛlle senselloŋwogi (yelzu, yelnyɔgraa, gɔɔlombie amk)
Yelbulo
• Kaaloo e la te sããkonoŋ ŋmensɔre
• Kaaloo taa la dabie ata. Ana la: boɔloo, yelboɔraa, ane a zu kpuluu.
• A yelnyɔgraa la a yelbuli na a senselloŋ naŋ kyaare.

KAALOO
A dɛmmo na kyaare la a meɛroŋ lomboi ata na naŋ be kaaloo poɔ. Ka ana la a 
boɔloo, yelboɔraa, ane zu kpulluu.
Boŋ la kaaloo?
Kaaloo la kōɔ naŋ pore ko tebɛ bee kpenne ka a na iri sareka kaŋa. O e la te 
sããkon-sobiri kaŋa te naŋ maŋ tu a puori te ŋmemɛ. Ayim-Aboagye (1993: 165 
ba naŋ da de toŋ ne toma 1996:9) yeli ka kaaloo e la tonnoɔre na te naŋ maŋ de 
kōɔ, dããkpeɛne, bee dãã zaa boora, a pore biŋ teŋa a na tu a be boɔle te ŋmemɛ 
ane a kpenne kyɛ sɔre ba sommo. Ziiri mine bombie teseŋ kyi, mui la ka ba maŋ 
de kaale ne. Kaaloo e la yelkpoŋ te nensɔgela sããkonnoŋ yel-erre poɔ. Te maŋ tu 
la kaaloo poɔ kyɛ boɔle te sããkommine kpenne te yel-erre zaa poɔ teseŋ lambo 
ziiri. Ka ba wa poɔ te kyɛ guuro te. Ghana poɔ, balzuzeɛ bee Teŋgane soba la maŋ 
kaale lambo ziiri teseŋ bie yuori porebo zie, pɔge deebo zie, tige zie, Naa bimmu 
zie, ane a taaba mine.
Kaa a sini ŋa naŋ kyaare ziiri mine kaaloo. Kaa a kaaloo meɛroŋ soŋ a baŋ duoro 
na naŋ yire a kaaloo poɔ.

Kaaloo Meɛroŋ;
Kaaloo meɛroŋ zaa laa, a boɔloo, yelboɔraa, ane a zu kpulluu.
A boɔloo;
A boɔloo la saŋa na te naŋ maŋ boɔle a tebɛ ne a kpenne ka a iri a woŋ te boɔla. 
A neɛ naŋ kaala naŋ piili boɔle la Naabile ŋmene, ka teŋgane tu, ka a tebɛ zaa naŋ 
guuro ba meŋ tu, kyɛ ka a te sããkommine yoe boɔle tu. A kaaloo maŋ la a ŋmemɛ 
dendɔe ŋmeɛbo ka ba na baŋ ka te wa la ba zie. Kaa a kaaloo boɔloo ŋa naŋ tu:
Naabile ŋmene, nyɛ fo kōɔ!
Tengane, fo kōɔ la ŋa!
Nsaa Sibiri, iri de fo kōɔ!
Ka fōō iri, seŋe fo saa, Dakora!
Ka o meŋ seŋe te sããkoma Danaa
A yɛ saakōɔ la ŋa!
A Yelboɔraa
A yelboɔraa la yeli na eŋa ba naŋ kaala. A naŋ baŋ e la boŋ kaŋa sɔroo bee bareka 
puoruu. A kyɛ la ka kaalekaala na wuli a ŋmemɛ bone na yɛlɛ o naŋ boɔle ba. A 
kyɛ la ka a kaala maŋ sɔre a ŋmemɛ guubu.
A zu kpuluŋ
A kyɛ, ba maŋ tere la bareka puoruu kyɛ eŋ noɔre ko a ŋmemɛ bone na ba naŋ 
na de puori ba bareka ka a ba yelboɔraaŋ maale. A kaala maŋ la pɔ eŋ la neɛ zaa 
naŋ taa teɛroŋ faa kyaare a ba lambo na. A kaalekaala maŋ la sɔre la maaloo ko 
banaŋ zaa naŋ taa teɛroŋ velaa, a maala velaa kora a paaloŋ. Ka seɛ peeroo bee 
neɛ maaloo la, a saŋa ŋa, ba maŋ ko la noɔ bee doŋa. A enfuoni ŋa naŋ tu puliŋ 
wulo la kaaloo Ghana poɔ.

Teɛroŋ soorebiri
Ka fo nɔŋenaŋ kpi, wola ka a maŋ waa?
Boŋ la Konkombie?
A yelbiri yi la koni poɔ. Koŋkombie e la yiele naŋ wulo posaana neɛ naŋ kpi zuiŋ. 
Te maŋ de a la beɛle neɛ naŋ yi donɛɛŋ. O waa la mooreteroo ane nembaaloŋ 
yieluŋ. O maŋ taa la yelwiiraa gɔɔloŋ. Koŋkombie e la sããkompare toma te naŋ 
maŋ de a danna ne neɛ naŋ kpi a kyɛ beɛle a soba eŋ dapare soriŋ.
Koŋkombie tontonne
Te nensɔgela paaloŋ zaa poɔ, koŋkombie tona la tontɛɛtɛɛ. amine la:
i. De koŋ ne kuori.
ii. A de a beɛle ne kpeema eŋ dapare sori.
iii. A maŋ tere la duoro.
iv. A sɔrɔ la sudi kora a kpeema.
v. Wulo la sagebo ka te tɔsoba bɔrɛɛ la.
Koŋkombie ananso
Koŋkombie anaso mine la ama naŋ tu a puliŋ:
1. A danna la a kpeema a kora a kpeema gyerema.
2. A e la nyɔgetaa kaŋa ko dakoreŋ saŋa ane a zenɛ.
3. A wulo la sagediibu ka te nɔŋena bɔrɛɛ la. .
4. De beɛle ne neɛ naŋ kpi.
5. Wulo la sagebo ka dapare bebe la.

Senselloŋwogi nandaare
i. Dẽɛdeɛnɛ: Ona la neɛ, doŋa bee bone kaŋa zaa naŋ be senselloŋ poɔ. A 
dẽɛdeɛnema na baŋ e la noba bee donne. A dẽɛdeɛnemɛ yel-erre ane ba 
kpɛtaa eŋaŋ la ka a senselloŋ maŋ are. Ka Senselloŋ na soma, a maŋ yi 
la a dẽɛdeɛnema zie. A dẽɛdeɛkaraa zie la ka a senselloŋ paabo zaa be. A 
senselloŋ yeltuo bee dɔgeroŋ zaa maŋ tuo la a dẽɛdeɛkaraa. Dẽɛdeɛnemɛ 
mine la a dẽɛdeɛnkaraa, ona maŋ la a gandaa a deɛne zaa poɔ ane dẽɛdeɛkaraa 
dɔndɔma. A dɔndɔma la maŋ wa ne a yelwonni zaa a senselloŋ poɔ. 
Dẽɛdeɛnaburee meŋ bebe la. Onaŋ eŋ ba taa teɛroŋ leɛroo zaa a senselloŋ 
poɔ. Te la taa la dẽɛdeɛkyelaa, ona eŋ yelpaalaa zaa naŋ wa a senselloŋ poɔ, 
o maŋ leɛre la o yɛŋ a tu be.
ii. Yelnyɔgeraa: Ona la a yelbuli na a senselloŋ zaa naŋ kyaare. Gbɛɛ yaga, 
yeli naŋ e a senselloŋ poɔ maŋ yi la a dẽɛdeɛnemɛ yel-erre poɔ. Senselloŋ 
zaa maŋ taa la yelnyɔgere bilii mine naŋ maŋ soŋe ka a senselloŋ wuo.
iii. Eebo zie/wagere: Kyɛ la a senselloŋ eebo zie. A kyɛ maŋ ko te la duoro 
kyaare zie na bee wagere na a senselloŋ yeli naŋ e, bone a senselloŋ naŋ 
kyaare ( laŋkpeɛbo yɛlɛ, saadayeli, bee yipɔge.)
iv. Paabo/wuobu: A ŋa la a yel-erre tutaaloŋ bee wuobu a senselloŋ poɔ. O 
wulo la lɛnɛɛ a yelbulo ane a yel-erre naŋ maŋ tutaa ka a senselloŋ taa 
wommu. A na baŋ kyaare la nɔkpeɛne, yontayɛlɛ, bee yelwonni mine. A na 
baŋ e la yeli naŋ taa maaloo, bee ka o e yelwoloo kaŋa fo naŋ wa berɛ ka 
yelyuo kaŋa ŋmaa kpɛ.
v. A manna leɛkaa nyaabo: Yeli na a manna naŋ nyɛ ka a erɛ a senselloŋ 
poɔ. A na baŋ e la meŋa pukyaaraa ( a manna naŋ poɔ a senselloŋ yel-erre 
poɔ) bee neɛ kaŋa yɛlɛ; a senselloŋ kyaare la neɛ kaŋa ka a manna ba poɔ). 
Ka a senselloŋ pukyaare a manna, fo na nyɛ la, N, Maa. kyɛ ka a senselloŋ 
kyaare neɛ kaŋa, fo na nyɛ la, o, ba, yɛ, banaŋ.
vi. Enkyere: Teɛroŋ bee waaloŋ kaŋa a sɛgerɛ naŋ de eŋe a kannekanna, a 
sɛgerɛ maŋ vɛŋe la ka a zie taa waaloŋ kaŋa naŋ dɔɔnɔ a kannekanna sukyiri. 
A maŋ tõɔ e la posaanaa, dɔɔloŋ, popeɛloŋ, kyelloo, yeltuo, amk.

Phonology (Speech sounds of a Ghanaian language)
INTRODUCTION
Dear learner, you are welcome to this section which discusses the foundation 
of language (speech sounds). You will be introduced to the concepts of vowels 
and consonants of your language of study and how speech sounds are described 
(parametre). It will focus on where the speech sounds occur in words of a Ghanaian 
language. For example, where vowels and consonants can occur in a word of a 
Ghanaian language such as initial position, medial position, or final position of 
a word. Again, Dear learner you will be introduced to the distribution of vowels 
and consonants in their language, aiding them to form meaningful words and 
facilitate effective speaking and reading in the language. This section is essential 
for learners not only in the context of Ghanaian language studies but also to 
establish links with related subjects such as English and other languages. This 
section equips you with foundational knowledge and functional understanding 
of speech sounds and their role in language learning. In summary, you should be 
able to identify, explain, produce, and label vowel charts and consonant tables of 
your language of study.
At the end of this section, you should be able to:
1. Describe the vowels of a Ghanaian language using the right parameters 
(e.g., lip posture, tongue height and part of the tongue).
2. Describe the consonants of the Ghanaian language using the right 
parameters (e.g., voicing, place of articulation and manner of articulation).
3. Explain the distribution of vowels of the Ghanaian language (e.g., word 
initial, medial and final).
4. Explain the distribution of consonants of the Ghanaian language (e.g., 
word initial, medial and final).

SECTION1 SOUNDS OF THE LANGUAGE
Key ideas
 Production refers to the making or saying of a speech sound in language. 
Speech sound is a sound used in the formation of words for human 
communication. The production of speech sound involves obstruction 
which is the interruption of free flow of air during production of speech 
sounds. Sounds are distributed in languages and this refers to the place 
or position in a word where a sound can appear. Sound involves airflow 
which is a mass movement of air that is meant for the production of 
speech sounds. Another term for it is airstream.
TYPES OF SPEECH SOUNDS
Speech sounds can be grouped into two main types, namely vowels and consonants. 
It is the combination of these two types of sounds that produces words. In other 
words, all words are made up of individual speech sounds. For examples, the word 
pan consists of three individual speech sounds, that is, /p/, /a/, /n/. The sound /a/ 
is a vowel, whereas the sounds /p/ and /n/ are consonants. In the following topics 
we discuss both vowels and consonants focusing on how each is produced in a 
Ghanaian language.
The concept of vowel
The concept vowel refers as a speech sound in which production there is a little or 
no obstruction of the flow of air in the oral cavity. In other words, a speech sound 
which when being produced the air is not obstructed or it is minimally obstructed 
in the oral cavity is referred to as a vowel. Since in their production there is no 
or very little obstruction of airflow, vowels are comparatively heard louder when 
they are produced. Vowels are very important part of words. There cannot be a 
word without a vowel or vowel-like sound. This important role vowel plays in a 
word will later on in your second year be discussed when we are talking about the 
syllable.
Description of vowels
Dear learner, in describing vowels of a Ghanaian language, there are certain 
properties we use. These properties are often termed parametres. Parametres 
simply refer to the characteristics that a vowel possesses. The main parametres 
used in describing vowels are the tongue height, lip posture, and part of the tongue 
4

used during the production of the vowel sound. In addition to the three, there 
is a fourth parameter called advancement of the tongue root in some Ghanaian 
languages such as Akan. Let us begin the discussions of these parametres.
Lip position/posture
The parametre lip posture is used to determine the position your lips assume when 
you are producing a vowel. So, at this level, the lips assume two main postures 
or positions, namely rounded or unrounded. That is, whether the lips are rounded 
or they are not rounded when a vowel sound is being produced. Based on this 
posture of the lips, we can divide vowels of a Ghanaian language into two, namely 
‘rounded’ and ‘spread/unrounded.’ Some examples of rounded vowels are /u, 
o, ɔ/. examples of unrounded vowels, on the other hand, are /i, e, a/.
Activity
At this point, produce rounded and unrounded/spread vowels of your Ghanaian 
language of study.
Tongue height/Height of the tongue
This refers to the position of the tongue in reference to the root of the mouth when 
producing vowel sounds. It is assumed that when we are producing vowels, the 
mouth opens when we drop the jaw. This can be high, mid, or low. When we 
drop our jaws to the lowest possible position, the vowels produced in this way are 
referred to as low vowels. Examples of low vowel is /a/, and in some Ghanaian 
languages [æ]. When we open our mouth wide enough but not as low as when 
producing low vowels, then the vowels we produced are termed mid vowels. 
Some examples of mid vowels in a Ghanaian language are /e, o/. In producing 
high vowels, on the other hand, the mouth is significantly opened but not as wide 
as mid vowels, thereby allowing enough air to flow through the oral cavity. Some 
examples of high vowels in a Ghanaian language are /i, u/.
Activity
Begin practicing the production of vowels in your language of study focusing 
on how high or how low you raise your jaws or open your mouth.
5
SECTION1 SOUNDS OF THE LANGUAGE
Part of the tongue
This parametre refers to the area of the tongue where the vowel sound is produced. 
It is assumed that when we are producing vowels, some parts of the tongue 
move. We cannot easily feel this movement though. Three parts of the tongue 
are assumed to be involved when a vowel sounds is being produced. These parts 
are the front part, middle part, and back part. Based on that, the parametre gives 
us three classes of vowels, namely front, mid, and back vowels. In producing 
front vowels, it is the front part of the tongue that moves. Some examples of front 
vowels of a Ghanaian language are /i, e, ɛ/. For the production of mid vowels, 
the middle of the tongue is assumed to move. Therefore, the following vowel is 
an example of a mid-vowel: /a/. For back vowels, on the other hand, as the name 
suggests, it is the back of the tongue that is involved in their production. Some 
examples of back vowels of a Ghanaian language are: /u, o, ɔ/.
Activity
Practice how to produce vowels of your language of study with focus on the 
part of the tongue.
Having finished discussing the main parametres we use in describing vowels of 
a Ghanaian language, there is a fourth parametre as mentioned earlier in this 
sub-strand which is not common among Ghanaian languages. This parametre is 
advancement of the tongue.
Advancement of the tongue root (ATR): (Please, discuss only if applicable in 
your language). This parametre, which is prominent in a few Ghanaian languages 
including Akan, Dagbani, etc. It is used to determine the position the tongue root 
assumes when a vowel is being produced. By this parametre, we try to find out 
if there is tension or pressure on the tongue or not during production of vowels. 
When a vowel is produced with pressure on the tongue thereby causing the tongue 
root to draw back, we say that vowel is produced with Advanced Tongue Root 
(ATR) i.e. (+ATR) vowels. When vowels are produced with the tongue root in its 
natural neutral position, we label those vowels are Unadvanced Tongue Root i.e. 
(-ATR) vowels. Some examples of (+ATR) vowels are: /i, e, u, o/, and examples 
of (-ATR) vowels are /ɪ, ɛ, ɔ/.

Consonant Distribution
The concept consonant distribution simply refers to the position in a word where 
a consonant can occur in a particular Ghanaian language. A consonant that 
occurs at the beginning of a word is referred to as word initial consonant. When a 
consonant occurs at the middle of a word, we refer to it as word medial consonant. 
When a consonant occurs at the end of a word, we refer to refer to it as word final 
consonant. Let us note that some consonants can occur in all positions of a word. 
For example, in some Ghanaian languages, the consonant /m/ can occur in the 
three positions in a word.

and the position the consonants can occur in a word.

INTRODUCTION
This section discusses identification of key ideas in texts and discourse. It 
always gives information on specific ideas or knowledge to the reader or hearer. 
The information given may come from all perspectives such as education, 
industrialisation, mining among others. It may also indicate some cultural values 
such as respect, tolerance and patience. Identifying key ideas gives you a better 
understanding of the discourse. It also enhances your critical thinking skills and 
interpretation abilities. There are types of reading techniques namely skimming 
and scanning and the application of any of the type enables you to get the right 
information demanded at any time. Knowledge of the types is therefore essential 
in our everyday life. The concept of oral interpretation will also be discussed. We 
shall discuss the skills needed for effective interpretation. Interpretation plays 
important roles in facilitating communication across language barriers.
By the end of this section, you should be able to:
• Identify key ideas from appropriate discourse. E.g., cultural values 
(respect, kindness, tolerance and others), education, child trafficking, 
environment, industrialisation in Ghana, mining, GESI etc.,
• Discuss ideas and relevant opinions from selected discourse. E.g., 
cultural values (respect, kindness, tolerance and others), education, 
child trafficking, environment, industrialisation in Ghana, mining, GESI, 
STEM, etc.
Key Ideas
 Key ideas are the main messages that is relevant in any discourse. Some 
of the key ideas may center on cultural values such as respect, kindness, 
tolerance, patience, etc. In any discourse you can share relevant opinions 
on any discourse appropriately and interpret any discourse in your own 
understanding.

Key ideas are the essential ideas that the author or speaker wants to give 
to the reader or hearer/listener respectively. The ideas may include the 
claims, the reasons, conclusions, definitions, classifications, comparisons, 
evaluations, recommendations, etc. Key ideas can be expressed explicitly 
or implicitly.
• For you to identify the key ideas in discourse there is the need for you

that the discourse could deal with any topic such as mining, teenage 
pregnancy, natural disaster, educational issues among others. It must also 
be pointed out that it could also come in a text form, video or picture or

• In summary, my dear learner to identify the key ideas in a discourse which 
may be written or oral or visual, you may need to answer the following 
questions
1. Find who or what the passage discusses: Does this passage discuss a 
person, group of people or an entity?
2. Ask when the event took place: Does the information contain a 
reference to time?
3. Find where the event took place: Does the text name a place?
4. Ask why the event took place: Do you find a reason or explanation for 
something that happened?
5. Ask how the event took place: Does this information indicate a 
method or a theory?

You can also find it in the topic sentence.

Reading
By the end of the sub-strand you should be able to:
1. Discuss skimming using preview, overview and review.
2. Discuss scanning using the strategies (e.g., movement of eyes or finger, 
locating words and phrases)
3. Apply skimming and scanning to extract information or ideas from texts
Key ideas
 Skimming is going through a text rapidly to get the general information 
in the text while scanning involves looking for a specific information in 
a text. Scanning is a process of reading in which your eyes quickly run 
through a piece of text to find a piece of relevant information. Scanning 
and skimming are two different concepts of reading.
TYPES OF READING
There are types of reading skill or technique namely skimming, scanning, 
intensive reading and extensive reading. Dear learner, in this lesson you shall 
learn skimming and scanning techniques of reading.
Skimming
Skimming is a reading technique used to quickly identify the main ideas or key 
points in a text. It is the action of reading something quickly so as to note only the 
important points. Basically, skimming is reading rapidly in order to get a general 
overview of the material read. It is used to find specific facts in texts. It involves 
glancing over the material, focusing on headings, subheadings, bold text and key 
phrases to get a general understanding of the content. Skimming is useful when; 
time is limited, looking for specific information, you want to get an overview 
8
SECTION2 SHARING IDEAS AND ORAL INTERPRETATION
before reading in-depth and you are dealing with a large amount of text. Below 
are the skimming types.
Preview: An opportunity to view something before it is acquired or becomes 
generally available. Preview is done in an effort to learn about the ideas presented 
and the structure of their development.
Overview: Used to sample the reading material more thoroughly. A general review 
or summary of a subject.
Review: The review is done to re-familiarise yourself with the material you have 
previously read thoroughly or skimmed. A formal assessment of something with 
the intention of instituting a change if necessary.
Learner, in skimming, you can follow these steps
- Read the title
- Read the headings and sub-headings as well as topic sentences in each 
paragraph
- Look for important information such as date, names and unusual words.
- Read the conclusion

In summary you have learnt skimming and the steps as well as the types of 
skimming which you can apply. Dear learner, let us examine what is scanning.
Scanning
Scanning is reading rapidly in order to find facts without reading everything. 
Scanning helps you locate a particular fact while skimming tells you what general 
information is within a section.
Scanning involves looking for a specific information in a text. It can also be said 
to be a process of reading in which your eyes quickly run through a piece of text 
to find a piece of relevant information. In scanning the reader looks for a piece 
of specific information. An example of scanning is searching for the meaning 
of a word in a dictionary. Scanning helps the reader to locate particular facts in 
an entire text quickly. Students often use scanning when solving their reading 
comprehension questions.
It is important to know the purpose for scanning. You should know what you are 
searching for, eg title of a book, a website, a reference material, a particular word 
or phrase and a particular story you want to read etc. You should know how the 
material is structures either alphabetically, non-alphabetically, chronologically, 
by category, by titles /headings, by textual sense, by numbers among others.
Scanning helps a learner to read more and to develop love for reading.

When to scan
1. Scan before reading
2. Scan a number of questions to identify the one which you are most

3. When searching for particular information such as date, keywords etc.
The following shows how to do scanning after getting overview of a text and 
identifying the sections of the text you want to read.
1. Start scanning the text by moving your eyes and fingers quickly over it
2. When you have identified the information, word or the phrase you are 
searching for, read the information surrounding the word carefully
3. When you identified the information that requires attention, you read it 
thoroughly slowly.

Oral Interpretation and translation
By the end of the sub-strand, you should be able to:
 Discuss oral interpretation focusing on effective listening, encoding and 
decoding.
Key Ideas
 Oral interpretation is reframing the meaning of a speech most often orally 
into another language. The original language is the source language 
and the language in which it is rendered is the target language. In oral 
interpretation you must note the cultural differences and be accurate in 
giving the meaning of what you are to render in the language orally.
CONTENT
Interpretation is listening to a message in one language and rendering it orally 
in another language maintaining the original meaning, tone and context. It 
is the stylistic representation of a creative work or dramatic role. It is the act 
of explaining, reframing, or otherwise showing your own understanding of 
something. In interpretation you first have to understand the text or the piece 
given to you and then explain in your own words. In broader terms it is rendering 
a spoken or signed message into another spoken or signed language preserving 
the register and meaning of the source language content.
Dear learner, it must be noted that before you can do any interpretation, you must 
be well versed in the source and target language. Interpretation can be performed 
either simultaneously or consecutively between users of different languages.
Dear learner, know that in interpreting you do not embellish or over-exaggerate. 
State the ideas clearly. In interpreting you need to listen carefully, decode and 
encode as they serve as the process of communication and interpreting.

nyɛla di ni mali bachi shɛŋa n-tiri lahibali zaŋ kpa nira bee bini biɛhigu polo.

ii.  Bidibibila maa nyɛla zaɣ’ waɣili balli.
iii. Zilaata mali fahim n-gari Lahiri.

BƆ N-LEE BACHINIŊDILI?
Bɔ ka a niŋ asiba ŋɔ? Sabimi tuun’ tumda sɔŋ.
Bɔ ka tɛhi zaŋ kpa bɔhimbu yaɣa waliginsim polo? Sabimi a tɛha sɔŋ.
Niŋmi shili n-zaŋ a tɛha wuhi karinduu ka yi di alizama.
Bachiniŋdili nyɛla tuma bee niŋsim bachinima. Bachiniŋda lahi nyɛla bachinima 
bee yɛltɔɣiŋmasɔri shɛŋa ŋan wuhiri binshɛli biɛhigu (shɛhira; n-shihi, n-zooi,

Bachiniŋda ni tooi mali bee ka di ka niŋsimdeera. Bachinamda shɛŋa ŋan kuli 
kanna bachiniŋda nyaŋa m-booni niŋsimdeera. Bachiniŋda ni tooi pu n-doli ŋan 
deeri niŋsimdeera mini ŋan ku tooi deei niŋsimdeera.
Bachiniŋda ŋan deeri niŋsimdeera
Bachiniŋda ŋan deeri niŋsimdeera chanimi ni niŋsimdeera yɛltɔɣili ni. Shɛhira 
shɛŋa n-nyɛ n-duɣi, n-yu, n-duhi, n-tooi, n-di, n-sabi, n-bu, ŋan pahi. Shɛhira 
m-be yɛltɔɣ’ shɛŋa ŋan do gbunni ŋɔ.
1. Karimba maa duɣi shinkaafa.
2. Karimbihi maa tooi kom.
3. Azindoo mini Paɣiwuni ŋubi shinkaafa.
4. Bia zaŋ binwala na.
5. Daabihi maa kpe loori maa.
Bachi shɛŋa ŋan dalim maa zaa nyɛla ŋan deeri niŋsimdeera. Niŋsimdeera maa 
kanna bachiniŋdili maa nyaaŋa. Shɛhira, shɛhira 1 puuni, niŋsimdeera shinkaafa, 
ni shɛhira (5) niŋsimdeera loori maa.
Bachiniŋda ŋan bi deeri niŋsimdeera
Dimɔŋɔnima nyɛla bachiniŋa ŋa ka niŋsimdeera – di bi zaya ni di mali niŋsimdeera 
ka di gbunni yi palo yɛltɔɣili ni. Ŋannima ni tooi nyɛ bachinima bee yɛltɔɣiŋmasɔri 
n-doli ŋa amaa ŋannima tooi nyɛla bachiniŋdipahira. Shɛhira, n-kpi, n-yiɣi, 
n-yɛm, n-kuhi, n-zooi, ŋan pahi. Nyami shɛhira gbunni ŋɔ.
1. Bia maa yɛmdimi.
2. Sakpaleeŋga maa yiɣi yomyom.
3. Shikurubila maa liɣiya yim.

BƆ N-LE NYƐ BACHINIŊDIPAHIRILI?
Yulimi anfooni shɛli ŋan do gbunn maa. Wula ka bipola maa chana? Saha dini 
m-bala dabisili puuni? Ya polo ka lala binshɛli din niŋdi maa niŋda? Bɔ zuɣu ka 
din niŋdi maa niŋda?
Bachiniŋdipahira nyɛla bachi bee yɛltɔɣiŋmasɔri shɛŋa ŋan kahigiri bachiniŋdili 
gbunni yɛltɔɣili puuni. Bachiniŋdipahira ni tooi kahigi di bachiniŋdipahrili kpee 
gba. Tɛhimi a ni chaŋ kana shikuru shɛm yɛla, di di nyɛla, biɛlbiɛla, yomyom? 
A di naan tooi chani yomyoma n-chaŋ shikuru. Bachi maa yomyom wuhirila 
bee buɣisirila a ni chaŋ shɛm na shikuru dinzuɣu di nyɛla bachiniŋdipahrili.
