Yɛɣili ŋɔ ni, ti yɛn yulila Dagbani sabbu zalisi. . Ti yɛn yulila zalisi din jɛndi 
bachinamda, bachiniŋda, bachizaana ni bachibuɣisira. Zalisi din gbubi bachinamda 
ka ti yɛn daŋ yuli, ka naanyi yuli bachizaana, ka bachibuɣisira dolina, ka naanyi ti 
bachiniŋda mini bachiniŋdipahira. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛn chɛmi ka yi nya baŋsim din jɛndi 
zalisi mini tuma din gbubi bachinamda, bachizaana, bachibuɣisira, bachiniŋda ni 
bachiniŋdipahira Dagbani ni. Zal’ shɛŋa yi ni yɛn bɔhim maa ni tooi zaŋ m-maɣisi 
bal' shɛŋa kamani Silimiinsili.
Bɔhimbu sodolisi
1. Nammi yɛltɔɣa ka di doli bachinamda mini bachizaana sabbu zalisi.
2. Nammi yɛltɔɣa ka di doli bachibuɣisira sabbu zalisi.  3. Nammi yɛltɔɣa 
ka di doli bachiniŋda mini bachiniŋdipahira zalisi
Tɛh' gahinda
• Bachinamda tumdi bachikpani tuma, niŋsimdeera, din kahigira ni 
yɛltɔɣiŋmasɔɣu zuɣu.
• Bachizaana gba tooi nyɛ bachikpana bee niŋsimdeera yɛltɔɣa puuni.
• Bachibuɣisira kahigirila bachinamda.  Di tooi dooni bachinamdi’ shɛŋa 
di ni buɣisiri maa nyaaŋa Dagbani ni.
• Bachiniŋda wuhirila niŋsim bee biɛhigu.  Dagbani puuni, kalinli mini 
bachiniŋda dii bi saɣiri n-tiri taba, amaa saha shɛŋa beni ka di saɣira.  
Bachinamda mini bachiniŋda sabirimi waligiri taba.
• Bachiniŋdipahira kahigirila bachiniŋda ka ni tooi lahi kahigi di taba gba.

BACHINAMDA
Yaɣili din garila ni, ti daa yuli bachinamda.  Ti daa ti bachinamda shɛhira ka 
kahigi ŋa pubu.
Tɛha bɔhigu: A ni tooi teei bachinamda balibu maa? Sabimi ŋa n-sɔŋ.
Bachinamda nyɛla yuya bachinima n-ti niriba, luɣ’ shɛŋa, biŋkɔbiri ni binyɛra. 
Yɛltɔɣa tooi mali bachinamdili di puuni waawaayili. Bachinamda tooi chani ni 
bachibura kamani ‘maa’ bee ‘la’.
Bachizaana
Bachizaanili nyɛla bachi din ni tooi zani bachinamdili zaani kamani n, m, ma o, 
a, mani etc. Di ni tooi tum bachinamdili yɛltɔɣiŋmasɔɣu tuma.
Baŋma: Ghana bala pam ni bachizaana bi wuhiri paɣitali bee dotali. Lala n-nyɛ li 
Dagbani ni? Che ka a mini a kpee zamzam li ka yɛli yi karimba.
Bɔhimbu ŋɔ puuni ti yɛn yulila zalisi din gbubi bachinamda mini bachizaana.
Tuma
Yulimi sinii maa ka yɛli a tɛha ni nyɛ shɛli zaŋ kpa bachinamda tuma polo 
n-ti a taba.

Tuma
1. Buɣisimi bachinamdili ni nyɛ shɛli ka ti di shɛhira pia. Zaŋmi a labisibu 
maa n-wuhi karinzɔŋ maa zaa.
2. Laɣimmiya niriba ayiyi n-sabi bachinamda tuma diba ayiyi. Laɣimiya ni 
niriba ayi shɛba gba ka yi zamzam li yi bɔŋ maa puuni.
3. Kahigima bachizaanili ka ti di shɛhira pia. Zaŋmi a labisibu maa n-wuhi 
karinzɔŋ maa zaa.
a. Karimmiya lahibali din doli ŋɔ na yi bɔna puuni ka baŋ bachinamda 
mini bachizaana ŋan be di ni.
b. Yihimi bachinamda diba anu a ni baŋ lahibali maa ni maa n-nam 
yɛltɔɣ’ bɔbigu. Maalimi shili n-zaŋ a labisibu maa n-ti kariŋ zɔŋ 
maa ka yi zamzam li.
c. Yihimi bachizaana diba ata a ni baŋ lahibali maa ni n-nam yɛltɔɣa.  
Maalimi shili n-zaŋ a labisibu maa n-ti kariŋ zɔŋ maa ka yi zamzam 
li..
Bahi
Bahi nyɛla binkɔb’ shɛba ban yoli pam ka di wubisiri ba ti yinsi. Bɛ nyɛla ban 
mali zuliya bɔbigu ni biɛhi kɔŋkɔba, zaa ni ko’ kɔŋkɔba. Bɛ nyɛla naba anahi 
biŋkɔbiri ban yi yobahi ban be mɔɣuni la zuliya ni na.  Ninsalinima ban daa daŋ 
tooni na ni daa baligi baa ni bɛ gɔri mɔɣu, bɛ daa be ni ninsalinima ka daa lɛbigi 
hali ka bɛ mini ba ti be.  Bɛ nyɛla ban baŋdi ninsala biɛhigu kamani yurilim, 
suhuyiɣisili mini dabiɛm ka tooi baŋdi daadam viɛnyɛla.
Bahi nyɛla ban mali nyɔm ʒɛɣu pam. Bɛ lahi tooi nyɛla ban wumdi pam. Din ti 
bahi dariza pam nyɛla bɛ ni tooi wuhi ba ka bɛ tum tuma balibubalibu. Tumtumdi 
bahi nyɛla ban ni tooi sɔŋ nintarimba biɛɣu kam, ka bahi ban nyɛ balima bahi mi 
ni tooi sɔŋ ninvuɣ’ shɛba ban mali suhusaɣiŋgu. Bɛ lahi mali bahi m-bɔri ka faari 
ka baŋdi binshɛŋa maʒina ni ku tooi bo. Dimini bahi kuli sɔŋdi daadama viɛnyɛla 
ŋɔ maa zaa yoli, bɛ nyɛvuli waɣilim kuli nyɛla yuum pia zaŋ chaŋ pia ni anu.

BAŊSIM
Yi daa pun bɔhim bachibuɣisira ni nyɛ shɛli. Laɣimmiya bɔŋbɔŋ n-nam yɛltɔɣa 
diba atata ka di buɣisiri ŋan doya ŋɔ:
a. A kariŋ zɔŋ
b. A zosumo
c. A shikuru dundɔŋ
d. A dɔɣim
Bachibuɣisirili nyɛla din buɣisiri bee din kahigiri bachinamdili. Bachibuɣisira 
malimi kahigiri bee n-wuhiri nira bee bini biɛhigu bee ka di mali ŋa m-maɣisiri 
taba. Shɛhira:
a. Adam yuri ya' kura.
b. Bidibiga maa nyɛla zaɣ’ waɣili balli.
c. Suhudoo valim n-gari o tuzodoo.
Ti yi yuli (a), bachi kura buɣisirila yil' shɛli Adam ni yura.  Ti yi yuli (b) ni, 
bachinima waɣinli mini balli buɣisirila bidibiga maa zaa bee o biɛhigu ni nyɛ 
shɛli. Ka (c) puuni mi, bachi valim malila Suhudoo mini o tuzodoo m-maɣisiri 
taba.
Bachibuɣisira sabbu zalisi/tuma
Zalisi din jɛndi bachibuɣisira zaŋ nam yɛltɔɣa bela kɔŋkɔba Ghana bala puuni.
Zalisi din gbubi bachibuɣisira sabbu Dagbani ni:
1. Di kahigiri bachinamdili yɛltɔɣili puuni. Shɛhira:
a. War’ sabinli maa guuri n-nyaŋ o taba maa.
b. N nyala yili karili.
2. Di kanimina bachinamda shɛŋa di ni buɣisiri maa nyaaŋa Shɛhira:
a. Yili sabinli maa luya.
b. Paɣ’ karili kuli yiŋa.
 Yi daa pun bɔhim bachibuɣisira balibu. Di shɛhira shɛŋa n-do gbunni ŋɔ:
 N-zaŋ bachibuɣisira ŋan tirita n-nam yɛltɔɣa.
a. Loori ŋɔ nyɛla zaɣ’ palli.
b. Lala yili maa nyɛla m ba dini.

talahi m mini a zuɣu ni ti niŋ ti kpaŋ maŋa tatariga n-tuhi gu ti tiŋgbani 
namtiɛri. Di nyɛla ti zaɣ’ yino kam tuma ni ti yiɣisi zani n-taɣi ka gu 
Naawuni ni ti ti namtɛri shɛli maa. Muɣisigu shɛŋa ti ni tooi kuli nyari

BACHINIŊDA
Zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔ ti yɛn naai, a ni tooi nam yɛltɔɣa n-doli Dagbani bachiniŋda 
mini bachiniŋdipahira sabbu zalisi.
N-zaŋdi Dagbani bachiniŋda mini bachiniŋdipahira sabiri yɛltɔɣa tu ni di mali 
zalisi.  Zalisi ŋɔ sɔŋdi ka sabbu ni tiri ŋun karindi lahibal’ shɛli pe n-doli taba 
viɛnyɛla. N-zaŋdi sabbu zalisi tumdi tuma Dagbani ni ni sɔŋ a ka a nam yɛltɔɣ’ 
shɛŋa ŋan mali gbunni.
Pɔi ka ti paai zalisi maa, chɛliya ka ti teei ti mansi binshɛli din nyɛ bachiniŋda. 
Yulimiya shɛhira shɛŋa ŋan do gbunni ŋɔ. Bachi shɛŋa ŋan gbunni booibooi nyɛla 
bachiniŋda.
1. Pukpara maa maanila palo yuuni kam kɔbu saha,
2. Bihi maa chanila shikuru bɛ naba Alizumma dali kam.
3. Ti ŋmɛri bolli asiba kam ni ti ʒim tiligi.
Bachiniŋdili nyɛla bachi, bee yɛltɔɣiŋmasɔɣu shɛli di ni mali m-buɣisiri tuma, 
biɛhigu bee niŋsim. Bachiniŋda nyɛla ŋan be yɛltɔɣili yaɣ’ shɛli din mali 
niŋsimdeera di puuni. Yaha, bachininiŋdili n-nyɛ yɛltɔɣili yaɣ’ shɛli din mali 
bachiniŋdili di puuni maa zuɣu.
Bachiniŋda zaŋ nam yɛltɔɣa zalisi
Zuliyanima zal’ shɛŋa ŋan jɛndi bachiniŋda zaŋ tum tuma waliya. Zalisi maa 
shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:
1. Bachiniŋda wuhiri bachikpani ni tumdi tuma yɛltɔɣili puuni. Shɛhira:
a. Baa maa wahirila saamba saha kam.
 Kpe, bachiniŋdili wahirila yɛri ti la tuun’ shɛli bachikpani maa, ‘Baa 
maa’ ni tumda saha kam.
b. Shikurubihi maa barimi chani shikuru asiba kam.
 Bachiniŋdili barimi yɛri ti la bachikpani maa ‘Shikurubihi maa’ ni tumdi 
tuun’ shɛli.
2. Bachiniŋda wuhiri bachikpani biɛhigu yɛltɔɣili puuni. Shɛhira:
 Azindoo nyɛla doo.
 Kpe ŋɔ, bachiniŋdili ‘nyɛla’ yɛrila bachikpani maa ‘Azindoo’ biɛhigu.

3. Bachiniŋda tumdilia bachikpani tuma yɛltɔɣili yaɣ’ shɛli din mali 
niŋsimdeera. Shɛhira:
a. Loori maa guuri yaɣi.
 Bachiniŋdili ‘guuri’ n-nyɛ yɛltɔɣili maa yaɣ’ shɛli din mali niŋsimdeera 
maa ‘guuri yaɣi’ bachikpani.
b. Shikuurubihi maa bari n-chani shikuru asiba kam.
 Kpe yaha bachiniŋdili maa ‘bari’ n-nyɛ yɛltɔɣili maa yaɣ’ shɛli din mali 
niŋsimdeera maa ‘bari n-chani shikuru asiba kam’ bachikpani.
Baŋma: Bachinamda sabbu Ghana zuliya sabbu puuni zal' shɛŋa gba beni. Di 
shɛhira shɛŋa n-doli ŋɔ na:
4. Dagbani ni, di bi sabiri bachiniŋda m-pahiri bachizaana ni, di sabirila 
bachiniŋda ka ŋa za ŋa ko ka che bachizaana yɛltɔɣili puuni. Shɛhira:
a. O di saɣim.
 Kpe ŋɔ, bachizaanili ‘O’ bachikpani maa waligimi sabi ka che bachiniŋdili 
‘di’.
b. Bɛ da bua.
 Shɛhira ŋɔ puuni, bachizaanili ‘Bɛ’ waligimi sabi ka che bachiniŋdili 
‘da’.

Zaŋmi a maŋmaŋa bachinima n-wuhi binshɛli din nyɛ bachiniŋdili. Timi 
bachiniŋda shɛhira pia.

a. yɛltɔɣ’ gaŋa
b. yɛltɔɣ’ bɔbigu
c. yɛltɔɣ’ nabira.

n-tum tuma yɛltɔɣa maa puuni:
1. Bɛ kana kpe. (luɣ’ shɛli)
2. Asiba kurugi ayɔpɔi ka ti paai. (saha)
3. Bɛ ŋmɛya ni suhupiɛlli. (niŋsim ni niŋ shɛm)
Bachiniŋdipahira shɛŋa ŋan be yɛltɔɣ’ shɛŋa ŋan do zuɣusaa ŋɔ n-nyɛ; kpe, asiba, 
ni suhupiɛlli.

PILIGU
Yaɣili ŋɔ zahindila lahabali balibu. Pa Dagbani ko lahabali sabbu n-nyɛ baŋsim 
gahindili, baŋsim yaɣ’ shɛŋa kamani Silimiinsili mini Taarihi.
Zaŋ chaŋ baŋsim yaɣili ŋɔ ti yɛn naai a ni tooi;
1. Nam lahabali din wuhiri binshɛli ni niŋ shɛm
2. Nam lahabali din buɣisira
3. Nam lahabali din kahigira
Tɛh' gahinda
• Lahabali nambu nyɛla sabiri shɛli din ʒiri tɛha ka di mali yɛltɔɣikpani.
• A ni bɔhim lahabali balibu dibaata:
o Lahabali din wuhiri binshɛli ni niŋ shɛm nyɛla salinwaɣinli din sabi 
wuhiri nira tɛha zaŋ nam binshɛli o ni nya ka di niŋ.
o Lahabali din buɣisira nyɛla lahabali sabbu bal’ shɛli din bɔri ni 
shikurubila buɣisi binshɛli — binshɛli, ninsala, luɣ’ shɛli, nira nini ni 
nya shɛli, suhusaɣiŋgu bee suhupiɛlli, ŋan pahi.
o Lahabal’ shɛŋa ŋan kahigiri binshɛli niŋbu nia nyɛla di wuhi bee 
m-buɣisi binshɛli. Di bɔri ninneesim, kahigir’ shɛli din tuhi n-tiri 
bɔhindi shɛli, binshɛli sodoligu, bee tɛh’ bɔbigu.
• Lahabali balibu maa zaa malila ŋa biɛhigu ni ŋa nahiŋgban’ kɔŋkba.

YƐLTƆƔIKPANI
Yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din ʒiri lahabali yɛltɔɣikpani nyɛla yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din ʒiri satar’ shɛli di 
ni be maa ni kuli jɛndi binshɛli. Yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din sɔŋdi kahigiri lahabali,  yɛltɔɣ’ 
shɛli din ʒiri di yɛltɔɣikpani.
Sabbu/ Lahabali
Lahabali sabbu baŋsim shɛli din tu malibu ka naan yi sabi lahabali viɛlli. Tɛha 
maa tu ni ŋa ne ka pe n-doli taba satarili puuni viɛnyɛla. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla di ni ni 
tooi nya shɛli di yi niŋ ka, n-laɣindi lahabal’ shɛŋa ŋan ŋmani taba, n-kahigiri 
yɛl’ shɛŋa ka ŋa doli ŋa ni niŋ doli taba shɛm, n-tiri shɛhira ni anfooninima, n-tiri 
ŋmahima, ŋan pahi.
Lahabali sabbu nyɛla binshɛli sabbu bee sabbu baŋsim sodoligu din wuhiri tɛha 
bee din be suhu ni. Lahabali kam yɛrila yɛlikpan’ yini yɛla.
Lahabali balibu dibaata n-nyɛ yaɣili ŋɔ ni piina ni lahabal’ shɛli din wuhiri 
binshɛli ni niŋ shɛm.
Lahabali din wuhiri binshɛli ni niŋ shɛm
Lahabali din wuhiri binshɛli ni niŋ shɛm nyɛla din sabbu ŋmani salinwaɣinli 
lahabali din jɛndi lahabali yɛltɔɣikpani labiyɛli. Yɛl’ shɛŋa ŋan pa yɛlimaŋli bee 
ŋan nyɛ yɛlimaŋli teei nam yɛli. Niŋsim maa ni niŋ shɛm tooi pɛmi doli taba 
ka tooi sabiri ni ninvuɣ’ yino yɛligu (amaa pa saha kam). Lahibali din wuhiri 
binshɛli ni niŋ shɛm niŋsim tooi nyɛla niŋsim din pun niŋ gari ni suhu ni anfooni 
nambu, bee litiricha biɛlin’ shɛŋa gba nyɛla di ni zaŋ shɛŋa tum tuma n-vooi ban 
karindi tɛha.

Lahabali din buɣisira
Bɔ n-lee nyɛ lahabali din buɣisira?
Lahabali bal’ shɛli din buɣisiri binshɛli kamani bini, ninsala, luɣ’ shɛli bee biɛh’ 
shɛli din yɛn ti ŋun karindi neesim maŋa zaŋ kpa binshɛli di ni buɣisiri maa polo. 
Di tu ni di pe viɛnyɛla ka zaŋ yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din kpɛri zuɣu ni n-gbaai ban wumda.

haŋkali na kamani bɔhigu din bi bɔri labisibu nyɛla din viɛla.

ŋun karindi haŋkali na. Di tu ni di piligi ni satar’ palli saha shɛli kam di ni yɛn 
zaŋ tɛh’ palli n-tum tuma.
Kolvaai: Labiyɛli lahabali maa nia shɛli di ni pun kahigi di piligu maa ni ka zaŋ 
li gbuni ti ni bɔhim binshɛli lahabali maa maŋmaŋa karimbu puuni.

tiri ŋun karindi kahigibu lahabali, buɣisibu, bee bɔhimbu yaɣili kahigibu.
Lahabali din kahigira Sabbu Soya
Lahabali din kahigiri sabbu viɛnyɛla dolila tuun’ shɛli bee bɔhimbu yaɣ’ shɛli bɛ 
ni ti a maa gbaabu viɛnyɛla. Lahabal’ shɛŋa bɛ ni ni tooi ti a shɛhira shɛŋa;
1. Bɔ zuɣu ka niriba tu ni bɛ tuɣi chani zuɣusaa ni bɛ nya din beni?
2. Kahigimi wuhi zuɣupuri daalaafee daanfaani.
3. Kahigimi tihi ŋmabu barinanima
4. Pɔhim zuɣu alizama ni muɣisiri bɔhimbu shɛm.
Di yi zaya ni a sabi lahabali din kahigira di kpa talahi ni di doli so’ shɛŋa ŋan do 
gbunni ŋɔ;
a. Karimmi a bɔhimbu yaɣili bɔhigu maa viɛnyɛla.
b. Labi karim a ni sabi binshɛŋa zaŋ jɛndi baŋsim yaɣili maa. Kpaŋmi a maŋa 
ka a bɔhi a karimba ka o neegi a nini a yi bɔri lahabali.
c. Pumi tuma n-niŋ ŋan bi to, bin’ bihi.
d. Sabimi sodoligu ka di ti a lahabali maa biɛhigu (yulimi gbunni).
Sabimi yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din ʒiri yɛltɔɣikpani ka pili lahabali maa piligu bahi.
Tɛha tuma: A yi karim lahabali din kahigiri viɛnyɛliŋga sabbu soya ŋɔ naai, 
baŋsim dini ka a tɛhi ni di ni sɔŋ a viɛnyɛla ka a mali shili?

Lahabali maa piligu
Pilimi a bɔhimbu yaɣili ka ti yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din ʒiri lahabali yɛltɔɣikpani din kooni 
vaari a ni yɛn yɛli jɛndi binshɛli maa.
Lahabali maŋmaŋa Satara ata n-tooi be di puuni amaa di ni tooi lahi gari di yi 
niŋ ka lahabali maa waɣa. Kpe ka di yɛri kahigiri soya maa, tɛha bee bɔhimbu 
yaɣ’ shɛli a ni kahigira. Satarili kam tumi ni di yɛrila tɛh' yini yɛla ko. Dimbɔŋɔ 
yɛn chɛmi ka di ne ka pe viɛnyɛla. Di kpala talahi ni di zaŋ satarili kam gbuni 
yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din ʒiri yɛltɔɣikpani maa piligu satarili ni.
Kolivaai
Lahabali din kahigira kolivaai n-nyɛ din kooni vaari bɔhimbu yaɣ’ shɛli di ni 
kahigira. Kolivaai maa n-naari lahabli ni haŋkali voobo. Di wuhiri zaashee n-jɛndi 
kahigir’ shɛŋa di ni ti yɛltɔɣ’ shɛŋa ŋan ʒiri yɛltɔɣikpana maa mini lahabali maa 
maŋmaŋa satara maa.
Karimmiya lahabal’ shɛli din do gbunni ŋɔ ka yi niriba ayiyi kahigi lahabali din 
kahigira nahiŋgbana.

PILIGU
Yaɣili ŋɔ yɛn wuhi a mi yɛl' shɛŋa din jɛndi tiŋgbani yuya Ghana zuliyanima ni, 
ka di yaa leei jɛndila tiŋgbana yuya a taada ni. Di ni sɔŋ a ka a baŋ daliri mini 
anfaani shɛŋa ŋan be tiŋgbana yuya ni. Bɔhimbu ŋɔ ni sɔŋ a ka a baŋ yuya ni tiri 
shɛm ka niŋ nintiɣili ka ti jilima ni ti Ghana biɛhigu, kaya ni taada. Yaɣili maa 
lahi zamzam nira ni biri doo bee paɣa shɛm. Di yɛn Zamzammi n-doli soya din 
bɛni kamani pɔi ni di niŋbu, di niŋbu ni di niŋbu nyaaŋa a taada ni ni taada shɛŋa 
ŋan pahi Ghana tiŋgbani ni. A ni lahi bɔhim doo/paɣa bibu sangaya daanfaani ni 
nyɛ shɛli zaŋ n-ti bɛ ni niŋdi shɛba maa, bɛ yiŋnima ni bɛ ya zaa nangbanyini. 
Di tu ni a tooi kahigi niŋsim shɛŋa ŋan nyɛ yim mini ŋan nyɛ kɔŋkɔba doo/paɣa 
bibu Ghana bala ni.
Zaŋ chaŋ yaɣili ŋɔ ti yɛn naai, karimbia ni tooi:
• Bɔhim tiŋgbana yuya zaŋ kpa di piligu mini daliri polo.
• Kahigimi soya din wuhiri ni paɣa/doo biya (Doo/Paɣa bibu Sangaya: 
di piligu, sunsuuni ni bahigu). Zaŋmi Ghana zuliyanima ni niŋdi Doo/
Paɣa bibu Sangaya shɛm m-maɣisi taba.
Tah' gahinda:
• Tiŋgbana yuya piinimi ni tiŋgban’ gahinda.
• Bɛ mini shihi din pa daadama kpinila taba.
• Di wuhiri ban gbubi li maa taarihi ni nyɛ shɛli.
• Doo/Paɣa bibu nyɛla saha shɛli bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi yi ti saɣi ni bɛ tooi 
pa nam zuliya.
• Zaŋ kpɛhi nyɛla di zaŋ nira n-kpɛhi biɛhigu puuni.
• Doo/Paɣa bibu niŋdimi n-tiri bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi zaa.

TIŊGBANA YUYA
Di nyɛla yu’ shɛŋa ti ni mali ka di yila ti biɛhisi zaŋ chaŋ shihi bee yiko shɛŋa ŋan 
pa ninsalinima sani na. Lala yuya ŋɔ maa ka ti booni tiŋgbana yuya maa. Pɔi ka a 
karim zaŋ kpa tiŋgbana yuya polo, di tu ni a baŋ tiŋgbana ni nyɛ shɛli.
Bɔ n-lee nyɛ tiŋgbana?
Tiŋgbani ni tooi nyɛ tiŋgbandoo bee tiŋgbampaɣa. Di nyɛla shia, kamani buɣili 
ka niriba jamdi li ka mali yɛda ni di nyɛla din ni tooi maali bɛ yɛla. Tiŋgbana 
nyɛla din mali yiko shɛŋa daadama ni ka. Di tooi kpinila adiini bee jama soya. 
Bɛ ni tooi nyɛ dabba (tiŋgbani doo) bee paɣaba (tiŋgbani paɣa). Adiini shɛŋa 
tiŋgbana ŋan nyɛ dabba bee paɣaba m-bɔŋɔ Zuus (Zeus), Apolo (Apollo), Atina 
(Athena) Afurodite (Aphrodite) Aritemisi (Artemis)etc. Ghana puuni, bɔbili bee 
zuliya kam malila tiŋgbani shɛŋa bɛ ni dihi n-tabili. Tiŋgban’ shɛŋa ŋan yuya yi 
polo Ghana n-nyɛ:
Aŋkaranima (Ga): Dantu, Nae, Klote, La Kpa, etc.
Kambɔnsi (Akan): Kune, Tegare, Nyamaa, Antoa, etc.
Dagbamba: Tambo, Kpala, Gurigbaya etc.
Tiŋgban’ dini yuli n-lee yoli a yaɣili? Tiŋgbana yuya
Di nyɛla yuya zaŋ n-ti daadam shɛba ban mali dihitabili ni binshɛŋa bɛ ni jɛmda. 
Tiŋgbana yuya lahi nyɛla yu’ shɛŋa daŋ, tinsi, adiininima ni taada shɛba ni mali 
ka di nyɛla biɛhi’ shɛli din be bɛ mini tiŋgbana maa sunsuuni zuɣu.
Tiŋgban’ shɛŋa yuya
Din doli ŋɔ na nyɛla tiŋgban’ shɛŋa yuya zaŋ n-ti Ghananima:
1. Ayigbe tiŋa polo, Aŋunanima ban be Volta kuliga polo la jɛmdi tiŋgbani ka 
di yuli booni ‘Afa’, tiŋgbani din baŋdi yɛla din sɔɣi ka nyɛ buɣilana (Bokɔ) 
maa bidib’ tooni ka o yuli booni ‘Amuzu’.
2. Kambɔntiŋa polo, tiŋgban’ dabba mini tiŋgban’ paɣaba benimi zaŋ n-ti 
dakulo puuni dabisa. Lala zuɣu dakulo puuni dabisi shɛli bɛ ni dɔɣi bia 
ni tooi kpini bia maa yuli. Shɛhira, ‘Adwo’ nyɛla tiŋgbani din su Atani, 
dinzuɣu lala yuli maa maalimi n-tiri bɛ ni dɔɣi bipuɣin’ so Atani dali, di yi 
nyɛ doo mi ka bɛ bɔli o Kwadzo.
4
Yaɣili 6 TIŊGBANA YUYA MINI PAƔA BEE DOO BIBU
Bɔlimi tiŋgbana yuya ŋan be zuɣusaa ŋɔ maa. Che ka a karimba zahim a bolibu 
maa. A mi tiŋgbana yuya shɛhira a ya polo?
Tiŋgbana yuya piligu:
Tiŋgbana yuya bela taba ni adiini balibubalibu ni ka doli bɛ daadiini zalisi ni ban 
tiri yuya maa taada. Shɛhira, Ayigbenima zuliya ni, tiŋgbana yuya piligu yila 
Yeʋe (Tiŋgbani din su satahiŋga), Kambɔnsi ban tiŋgbana yuya yirila tiŋgbana 
din yi mɔɣa ni na, ka Kurɔbɔnima yu’ shɛŋa mi yirina tiŋgbani (Naawuni) din su 
nama sani na.
A mi a yuli piligu?
Daliri shɛŋa ŋan tahiri tiŋgbana yuya na
Daliri bɔbigu n-chɛri ka bɛ mali tiŋgbani/buɣiyuli n-tiri niriba. Di ni tooi zaŋ 
tiŋgbani yuli n-ti bia ni di wuhi tiŋgbani maa kpaŋmaŋa, yuya maa shɛŋa yirila 
tiŋgbani maa dariza ni na. Shɛŋa beni ka di yirila tiŋgbani maa jilima bee tiŋa 
maa nima kaya ni taada ni na.
Yaha, di yi ti niŋ ka paɣa ni doo bo bia yuui, bɛ tooi bɔri sɔŋsim tiŋgbana maa 
sani. Bɛ ni puli tiŋgbana maa ni bɛ yi ti ba bia bɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbani maa yuli m-boli 
bia maa.
Tiŋgbana yuya daanfaani
Tiŋgbana yuya mali anfaani balibu pam zaŋ n-ti ban jɛmdi li.
Ban mali tiŋgbana yuya ni nyari anfaani shɛŋa tiŋgbana yuya ni m-bɔŋɔ:
1. Baŋbu yom. Di sɔŋdi ka ti baŋdi nira ni jamdi tiŋgban’ shɛli ni o ni yi luɣ’ 
shɛli na.
2. Di wuhiri lala nira maa mini tiŋgbani maa ni kpini taba shɛm.
3. Tiŋgbana yuya nyɛla ti yaannima ni niŋ shɛli ka zali ti, ka di guri ka taɣiri ti 
kaya kpibu ka lahi kpaŋsiri li.
4. Di wuhiri bihilaamba dihitali ni nyɛ shɛli.
5. Adiini shɛŋa puuni, nira yi mali tiŋgbani yuli bɛ dihitabili nyɛmi ni di tiri o 
yiko, gubu tiim.
Tuma 6.1
1. Zaŋmi a maŋmaŋa bachinima n-wuhi tiŋgbani ni nyɛ shɛli?

DOO/PAƔA BIBU 
Yaɣili ŋɔ yɛn yulila doo/paɣa bibu sangaya, ka di jɛndi yaɣ’ shɛŋa ŋan be di 
puuni, tuun' shɛŋa ŋan tumdi pɔi ni sariya maa yihibu, din be sariya maa yihibu

Tɛh' bɔhigu
A ni tooi tɛhi n-nya taɣibu diba ata shɛŋa a ni daa nya a biɛhigu ni a ni daa nyɛ 
yuum pia (10) zaŋ chaŋ yuum pia ni anahi (14)?
Bɔ n-lee nyɛ Doo/Paɣa bibu?
Di nyɛla bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋŋa yi ti paai saha shɛli ka di wuhi ni o pa biya din 
ni che ka o tooi laɣim ni doo bee paɣa n-nam zuliya. Bipuɣinsi puuni, di tooi 
niŋdimi bɛ yi ti paai yuumpia (10) zaŋ chaŋ pia ni anahi(14) ka bidibisi mi dini 
nyɛ bɛ yi ti paai yuum pia ni ayi (12) zaŋ ni yuum pia ni ayɔbu (16)
Taɣibu din kanna bipuɣinsi ni
Taɣiri shɛŋa ŋan be bipuɣinsi ni shɛŋa n-nyɛ ŋan doli ŋɔ na:
• Bɛ sakpuɣa yɛligira
• Bɛ gbalipina ŋmɛlindimi
• Bɛ yiri gbuna
• Bɛ ni nya bɛ tuuli paɣibu
• Biha yibu
• Bɔɣilɔŋ kɔbiri mini tooni kɔbiri bilibu.
Taɣibu din be bidibisi ni
Bidibisi mi, taɣiri shɛŋa ŋan beni n-doli ŋɔ na:
• Tooni ŋmɛlimbu
• Bɔɣilɔŋ kɔbiri mini tooni kɔbiri bilibu.
• Nyɔɣu mini biya yɛligibu
• Kanjampina ŋmɛlimbu
• Kukoli ziligibu
• Teenkɔbiri bilibu
• Waɣilim pahibu
Ti ni nya ŋmahin’ shɛŋa ŋɔ maa n-wuhi ni nira biya biɛhigu puuni.
Doo/Paɣa bibu Sangaya
Di nyɛla kaya ni taada tuma din yihiri bilim ni n-kpɛhiri ninkurilim ni. Dina n-nyɛ 
sangali shɛli bɛ ni niŋdi n-tiri bia o zuɣupinibu bee suuna nyaaŋa. Di nyɛla soya 
din yihiri bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi n-kpɛhiri biɛhigu ni.

Wula ka yi booni doo/paɣa bibu a zuliya ni? Bɛ niŋdi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi zaa 
bibu sangaya maa? Bɔ n-nyɛ biɛhigu soya?
Biɛhigu soya nyɛla sangaya bee nahingban’ shɛŋa din yihiri nira biɛhi’ shɛli ni 
n-kpɛhiri biɛhi’ palli ni lala nira maa nyɛvuli ni. Bɛ ni tooi zaŋ nira n-kpɛhi 
biɛhisi kamani baɣisi (nyuhi koligu) bee n-kpɛhi adiini shɛli ni. Amaa ti ni yuuni 
biɛhigu so’ shɛli kpe ŋɔ nyɛla doo/paɣa bibu.
So’ shɛŋa ŋan be biɛhigu soya maa ni
So’ shɛŋa ŋan be doo/paɣa bibu ni nyɛla ŋan wali zaŋ n-ti zuliya balibu ka di 
nyɛla di yila bɛ kaya ni taada ni na. Shi’ shaŋa bɛ ni maana di piligu, di sunsuuni 
ni di bahigu nyɛla ti ni yɛn yuli shɛli gbunni ŋɔ.
N-Zaŋ Sangaya Din Wuhiri Ni Bia Bi Paɣa/Doo 
M-Maɣisi Taba: Nahingban’ Yinsi Bipuɣinsi Bibu:
1. Pɔi ni biɛhigu soya niŋbu
 Di yi ti niŋ ka bihi laamba maa nya taɣibu bɛ bipuɣinsi ni, bɛ piinila shi’ 
shɛŋa maalibu.
 Saha shɛŋa beni, di yi ti niŋ ka bipuɣiŋga maa nya o tuuli sɔrilim bee o 
paɣibu, bɛ tooi niŋdi soya ŋan do gbunni ŋɔ puuni shɛŋa:
8
Yaɣili 6 TIŊGBANA YUYA MINI PAƔA BEE DOO BIBU
a. Piligu bɛ yɛn waligila bipuɣinsi maa ka che bɛ dɔɣiriba m-pili ba shili 
maalibu zaŋ chaŋ biɛhigu soya taɣibu ŋɔ maa polo.
b. Bipuɣinsi maa laamba ni yɛli kpamba bee bɛ daadiini toondana ŋun su 
maalisi din jɛndi biɛhigu soya taɣibu ŋɔ maa polo zaŋ kpa bɛ nia ni nyɛ 
shɛli maa polo.
c. Paɣakpamba ban mali haŋkali ni laɣim bipuɣinsi maa n-niŋ duu, n-le ba 
baŋsim zaŋ kpa biɛhi’ shɛŋa din tu ni bipuɣiŋga ŋun saɣi dooyili kundi 
mali ka di sɔŋ ba ka bɛ lɛbi yidaampaɣ’ suma.
d. Di wuhiri bipuɣinsi maa dundɔŋ ni tuma kamani duɣibu, saɣiri kɔlibu, 
nɛma paɣibu ni di ni simdi ni o gbubi o maŋa kasi shɛm.
e. Di wuhiri ba nuuni tuumbaŋsim tuma kamani piɛri wuɣibu, yɛri tubu ni 
din pahipahi.
f. Bɛ lahi bɔhindi bɛ kaya yila mini waa wabu.
g. Bɛ lahi wuhiri ba di ni tu ni bɛ mini bɛ yidaannima ti laɣindi shɛm dama 
bɛ maani ba mi shili ni bɛ kuli dabba maa.
2. Di niŋbu saha
 Di niŋbu saha maa, buɣilana/tindana/paɣakpɛma ni yihi chiha ŋɔ bipuɣinsi 
maa zuɣu.
 O ni bahi kom n-ti bɛ tiŋgbana n-zaŋ bihi maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni ka lahi suhi ni 
bɛ sɔŋ ka bɛ naai tuma maa ni suhuyini. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ naan yi yihi chihi 
shɛŋa ŋan do’ gbunni ŋɔ:
a. Di ni zahim ba n-nya bɛ paliya. Bɛ yi yɛn niŋ li bɛ zaŋdi ba mi n-ti ʒili 
kuɣisabinli zuɣu, bee ka bɛ su ba kom mɔɣili bee teeku ni.
b. Buɣilana/tindana/paɣakpɛma maa ni pini bɛ zuɣiri.
c. Bipuɣinsi maa yɛn ʒinila kuɣubihi/gbana zuɣu bɛ ni yihiri chiha maa 
saha shɛli maa.
d. Bɛ ni tiri ba bindiri shɛŋa n-nyɛ gala mini nyu’ ŋmirita.
 Bɛ yi yihi chiha ŋɔ maa naai bɛ ni yɛli ba shili ni bɛ kaya ni taada nɛma, 
yɛri ni nachiinsi nɛma din pahi.
e. Di ni zali diɛma n-ti ba ni di niŋ ba maraaba n-kpɛhi niŋkurilim ni.
f. Diɛma ŋɔ saha, bɛ ni zaŋ yɛri mini neen’ shɛŋa ŋan mali liɣiri m-maali 
ba shili, n-yihi bɛ niŋgbuna polo n-wuhi bɛ taba ban nyɛ bidibisi maa ni 
bɛ nya ka piigi bɛ nyɛvuya ni paɣiba bɛ puuni.

• Tiŋa maa nima ni ti ninkur’ pala ŋɔ pina ka di wuhiri bɛ kpaŋ maŋa ni bɛ ni 
tooi yihi sariyanima maa zaa bɛ zuɣu maa. Pina maa shɛŋa ni tooi nyɛ liɣiri,

N-zaŋ sangaya din wuhiri ni bia bi paɣa/doo 
M-maɣisi taba: Waliginsim shɛŋa ŋan be di 
tuma ni zaŋ ti zuliyanima Ghana
Binyinsi shɛŋa ŋan be di puuni maa nyaaŋa, waliginsim shɛŋa bahi be di puuni 
zaŋ n-ti zuliyanima. Dina ka ti yɛn yuli gbunni ŋɔ.
Ayigbenima
1. Sangaya maa yihibu dolila tiŋ’ shɛli bee daliri, di ni tooi niŋ ka di di bakɔi 
bee goli.
2. Bɛ yɛn zaŋla bipuɣinsi maa n-niŋ yili maa nyaaŋa ka che ka bɛ zonima be 
bɛ sani n-yihiri ba ninsabiga ni.
3. Sangaya maa yihibu saha, gal' duɣirili ŋubbu lala saha ŋɔ maa wuhirila 
dɔɣim lahinli.
11
Yaɣili 6 TIŊGBANA YUYA MINI PAƔA BEE DOO BIBU
Kurobonima
1. Kurobonima yihirila doo/paɣa bibu sangaya (Dipo) n-tiri bɛ bipuɣinsi di yi 
ti niŋ ka molo moli n-zali bɛ tiŋgbani paɣa (Nene Kloweki) ka di niŋbu saha 
nyɛ February, ka di dabisi mi nyɛ dabisa anu.
2. Pɔi ka sangaya maa yihi bipuɣinsi maa laamba ni zaŋ ba n-ti ti bɛ daŋ maa 
tindaandoo bee tindaampaɣa ŋun su ‘Dipo’ tuma.
3. Sangaya maa yihibu saha mi, tindaandoo bee tindaampaɣa maa ni bahi kom 
n-ti tiŋgbana mini baɣiyu’ shɛŋa ŋan pahi n-ti bipuɣinsi maa ka di puuni 
shɛŋa nyɛ o ni pini bɛ zuɣuri tiŋli, ka dihi ba nama.
Aŋkaranima
1. Aŋkaranima ban niŋdila Otofo n-tiri bipuɣimbila o bilim ni bee saha shɛli 
kam di yi ti ʒiya ni bɛ niŋmi li.
Kambɔnsi
1. Sangaya maa yihibu dirila dabisa anii ka piini Atani bee Atalaata.
2. Pɔi ka sangaya maa yihi, tiŋa maa napaɣa ni vihi bipuɣinsi maa n-niŋ 
dihitabili ni bɛ so ʒi doo, ka lahi ka pua.
Wula ka doo/paɣa bibu sangaya niŋdi a taada ni?
Bidibisi bibu
Doo bibu sangaya yihibu dii bi yam zaŋ n-ti Ghana zuliyanima. Biɛla ban niŋdi li 
maa puuni, Ayigbenima booni li mi “Tudedeasi”, ka Sisaalanima booni li Baala, ka 
Aŋkaranima booni li Plamatsemɔ/Butrumwɔɔ/Deŋtuwoo, ka Vaglanima mi booni 
li Pellaa. Bidibisi bibu dii pa maaligu shɛli niriba ni maana. Shɛhira, Ayigbenima 
polo, bɛ yi da malifa n-ti bidibiga maa bɛ booni li mi ‘Tudedeasi’. O zaŋmi malifa 
maa n-gu ka taɣi o dundɔŋ ka mali li n-gɔri mɔɣu.
Sariya shɛŋa ŋan be di puuni shɛŋa n-nyɛ;
1. Di yihiri sangaya maa ni yɛn niŋ n-ti bi’ shɛba maa kpaŋa.
2. Di lɛri ba baŋsim zaŋ kpa dabilim polo mini paɣa mini doo laɣimbu polo.
3. Di ni zaŋ bihi maa n-kpɛhi ninkurilim ni.
4. Di ni tiɣisi ba ka maali ba shili.
5. Di lahi wuhiri ba kaya ni taada soya.

Yaɣili 6 TIŊGBANA YUYA MINI PAƔA BEE DOO BIBU
Di soya maa walimi n-doli tiŋ’ shɛli polo nira ni yina ka lahi doli niriba maa 
dihitabili ni nyɛ shɛli.
Doo/Paɣa bibu Sangaya daanfaani
i. Di wuhiri ni bia biya
ii. Di lɛri nira haŋkali zaŋ kpa taɣiri pala polo ni di ni simdi o gbubi li shɛm.
iii. Di tiri salo lahibali ni bia bi doo/paɣa ka saɣi doo kundi bee paɣa bɔbu.
iv. Di kpaŋsiri biɛh’ suŋ biɛhigu ni.
v. Di tiri nira mini o daŋ dariza.
vi. Di mali sɔŋsim n-ti ʒilɛli maa.
vii. Di lɛri bihi baŋsim suma biɛhigu ni.

PILIGU
Yaɣili ŋɔ yɛn wuhi a mi nam soya ni pe n-doya shɛm Ghana ʒilɛya puuni. Di 
zamdimi zaŋ kpa ninvuɣ’ shɛba ban mali tuma n-tumda nam soya maa ni pe 
n-doya shɛm maa ni ni bɛ ni kpa talahi shɛm. Yaɣili ŋɔ nia nyɛla di ti a baŋsim 
mini gbaabu zaŋ chaŋ nam soya maa ni pe n-doya shɛm a kaya puuni. A ni baŋ 
nanima tuma ni nyɛ shɛŋa ni bɛ ni kpa talahi shɛm a ya lɛbiginsim mini niriba 
biɛhisuŋ polo shɛm.
Zaŋ chaŋ yaɣili ŋɔ ti yɛn naai, karimbia ni tooi:
i. Vihi taada nam soya ni pe n-doya shɛm (ba, dɔɣirikpɛma, daŋkpɛma)
ii. Vihi taada nam soya ni pe n-doya shɛm (naa, kpambaliba, nagbahiriba, ni 
ban pahi)
Tɛha gahinda:
• Ba n-nyɛ bayili dɔɣim din pɔri kpɛma (dɔɣim maa kurimia yi biɛhi doli 
ba maa yaɣili kɔŋko).
• Mayili dɔɣim yaɣili polo, paɣa (ma) ni tooi nyɛ dɔɣim maa kpɛma.
• Daŋkpamba nyɛla taada yaɣa nanima ka kpamba piiri ba n-zaani lala 
zaashee maa.
3
YAƔILI 7 KAYA TUMA MINI NAM SOYA
NAM SOYA NI PE N-DOYA SHƐM
Vihi taada nam soya ni pe n-doya shɛm (ba, dɔɣirikpɛma, daŋkpɛma).
Taada nam soya
Taada nam soya nyɛla nam soya yaɣ’ shɛli din yi kurimbuni ha baŋsim mini 
biɛhigu puuni na. Taada nam soya din be ti ʒilɛya puuni Ghana tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni 
nyɛla ŋan pe n-doya viɛnyɛliŋga. Di ni pe n-doya shɛm maa nyɛla din be kɔŋkɔba 
n-doli zuliya, amaa ʒilɛya pam dina ni pe n-doya shɛm tooi ŋmani taba.
Nam soya din be daŋ puuni
Ghana tiŋgbani ni, bachi din nyɛ dɔɣim bee daŋ zami n-ti dɔɣim din pɔra la ka di 
nyɛ ba mini ma ni bihi bee daŋ din yɛlima la, di gbaala dɔɣim din pɔri maa mini 
daŋ maa ni niriba ban pahi kamani, yaannima, ŋahinima, pirinima, ŋahinsi, ni ban 
pahi. Dimbɔŋɔ yi be ti tɛha ni, nam soya ni pe n-doya shɛm daŋ puuni gbaala ba, 
dɔɣirikpɛma, daŋkpɛma, nanima, kparibɔɣuri, nagbahiriba mini nazuɣuri, ni ban 
pahi.
Tuma
Wula ka nam soya lee pe a yiŋa? Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a yiŋa dundɔŋ ni (dɔɣim din 
pɔra) kpɛma? Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a daŋ din yɛlima puuni kpɛma? A yi daŋ shɛli 
puuni na?
Anfooni din wuhiri kpamli ni pe n-doli taba shɛm nyɛla anfooni shɛli din 
wuhiri kpamli ni pe n-doli taba shɛm tumad uu puuni. Di wuhirila kpamba mini 
bɛ kpambaliba ni pe n-doli shɛm.
Nam soya yinsi puuni ŋuna, anfooni din wuhiri kpamli ni pe n-doya shɛm ni yɛn 
be shɛm m-bɔŋɔ;
4
YAƔILI 7 KAYA TUMA MINI NAM SOYA
Anfooni 7.1: Anfooni din wuhiri nam soya ni pe n-doya shɛm yili ni
1. Daŋkpɛma:
 Daŋ nyɛla ninvuɣ’ shɛba ban kpini taba yaankurimia puuni bee paɣakpuɣibo 
mini dokulibo puuni. Di nyɛla dɔɣim zaɣ’ bɔbili din laɣim m-mali daŋ yuli 
zaɣ’ yini mini yaandokur’ yino, ka bɛ zaa doli toondaan’ yino. Saha pam 
puuni bɛ laɣim malila biɛr’ yinsi, nia yinsi, bee m-bɔri yɛl’ yinsi. Niriba ŋɔ 
zaa ni laɣim pii ninvuɣ’ so ni o nyɛ bɛ toondana maa ka bɛ boli daŋkpɛma 
maa. So’ shɛli nira ni ni tooi doli n-leei daŋkpɛma bela kɔŋkɔba n-doli ʒilɛli 
kam. Kaya shɛŋa puuni, dɔɣirikpamba m-piiri daŋkpɛma maa ka shɛŋa mi 
puuni, kpamli maa tirimi doli ʒɛmana.
2. Dɔɣirikpɛma:
 Dɔɣirikpɛma maa nyɛla ninvuɣ’ so dɔɣim ni laɣim pii ni o leei bɛ kpɛma. 
Bɛ tuma nyɛla bɛ gari tooni gbubi ka tooi maani yɛlimuɣisir’ shɛŋa din be 
dɔɣim maa puuni. Di tu ni bɛ wuhi toondaantali nahingbana ni nyɛ shɛŋa. 
Saha pam puuni, doo ka bɛ tooi piiri leeri dɔɣimkpɛma.
3. Ba:
 Ba maa n-nyɛ dɔɣim din pɔri la zuɣu din gbaai ŋun maŋmaŋa, o paɣa, ni o 
bihi. Ba maa n-su dɔɣim maa yɛlibɔra fukumsi.
Tuma
Di yi nyɛ di ni pe n-doli taba shɛm, ŋuni n-lee mali yiko pam daŋkpɛma maa 
nyaaŋa, dɔɣirikpɛma mini ba? Zaŋmi bachinima biɛla m-buɣisi nam soya ni 
pe n-doli taba shɛm.
5
YAƔILI 7 KAYA TUMA MINI NAM SOYA
Kpamba ban za n-ti nam soya ni pe n-doya shɛm daanfaani
1. Daŋkpɛma
 Din pe n-doya ŋɔ nyɛla daŋkpɛma tuma puuni shɛŋa. Daŋkpɛma maa:
a. n-kariti saliya din be daŋ maa ni
b. n-guri ka taɣiri daŋ maa taarihi
c. n-guri ka taɣiri daŋ maa taada ni nyɛ shɛli
d. n-guri ka taɣiri bɛ yaannima tiŋgbana din be daŋ maa ni
e. n-zaŋdi daŋ maa ni kaya ni taada ni nyɛ shɛli n-wuhiri daŋ maa niriba 
ʒɛmani nti kpa ʒɛmani
2. Dɔɣirikpɛma
 Dɔɣirikpɛma maa tumdila tuum’ bɔbili ka di shɛŋa n-nyɛ din doli ŋɔ na:
a. N-guri ka taɣiri dɔɣim maa ka chɛri barina
b. N-kpaŋsiri dɔɣim maa ni niriba biɛrisuŋ
c. N-kpaŋsiri suhudoo
d. N-gbubi dɔɣim maa daarizichi kamani tiŋgbana, ya, ni din pahi.
e. M-maani zaba din be dɔɣim maa ni mini din yiri kpaŋa na.
f. N-zaani dɔɣim maa zaani tiŋa maa yɛlli kam puuni.
g. M-bɔri saɣisigu mini sɔŋsim n-tiri dɔɣim maa puuni niriba.
h. N-zaani dɔɣim maa zaani gbaari gbaabu din kpa talahi pam.
3. Ba
 Tuma pam ka ba maa tumdi yili maa ni. Di shɛŋa n-nyɛ din doli ŋɔ na:
a. N-zaani zalisi ka yuuni ka lala zalisi maa tumdi tuma
b. M-bɔri guligu n-tiri yili maa
c. M-bɔri yili maa zoosim mini toontibo
d. O nyɛla ŋun wuhira
e. M-bɔri o yiŋa nima yɛlibɔra n-tiri ba
Tuma 7.1
Zammiya yɛl’ kpɛma diba ata shɛŋa din nyɛ daŋkpɛma tuma. Zaŋmi a labisibu 
maa wuhi a kpee.
6
YAƔILI 7 KAYA TUMA MINI NAM SOYA
Tuma 7.2
Vihimi nya nam soya ni pe n-doya shɛm a ya ka Zamzam di daanfaani ni nyɛ 
shɛŋa.
Tuma 7.3
Tummi dɔɣirikpɛma tuma m-bo maligu n-ti samli zabili din be a daŋ puuni 
niriba ayi sunsuuni. Shɛba gba ni zani n-ti niriba ayi ban zabiri daŋ maa puuni 
maa. Zaŋmiya yi zaɣa niŋ dɔɣirikpɛma tuma din kpa talahi maa ni.
Tuma 7.4
A kpahimbu puuni, a tɛhiya ni taada nam soya maa na kpa talahi? Kpaŋmi a 
maŋa n-wuhi a daliri ni nyɛ shɛli.
Nam Soya ni pe N-Doya Shɛm
Nam soya maa ni pe n-doli taba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ;
1. Nazuɣu
2. Kparibɔɣiri
3. Paɣananima
4. Nagbahiriba
Din pe n-do zuɣusaa maa ŋun nyaaŋa, kpeen’ shɛba ni tooi lan beni pahi kamani 
kamonaa, kulipalikpɛma, daŋkpɛma, dɔɣirikpɛma, ni din pahi.
1. Nazuɣu
 Nazuɣuri maa nyɛla bal’ shɛba bee zuliya shɛba nanima. Bɛ nyɛla nanima 
ban za zaashe’ kara bɛ nam yaɣa maa ni. Lala zaashee maa nyɛla bɛ ni diri 
shɛli fali n-doli mayili bee bayili polo ka di doli yaɣ’ shɛŋa polo niriba ni 
yina. Nazuɣu kam malila yu’ shɛli bɛ ni booni o. Shɛhira, Aligbenima booni 
o mi Fiaga, ka Kambonsi booni o Osaajefu, ka Dagbamba booni o Yaa-Naa, 
ni din pahi.
 Nazuɣuri tuma ni nyɛ shɛŋa n-nyɛ:
a. N-nyɛ toondana n-ti lala yaɣili din mali tiŋkpansi mini tinsi maa.
b. N-tum kaya tuma mini tuun’ shɛŋa din pahi.
7

c. N-su bɛ lala yaɣa maa tiŋgbana maa fukumsi.
d. N-kari ka ŋmaai saliya shɛŋa din be bɛ yaɣa maa ni.
e. N-zali zalisi ka che ka che zalisi maa tum viɛnyɛliŋga bɛ yaɣili maa.
f. N-kpaŋsi lɛbiginsim mini toontibo bɛ yaɣili maa.
g. N-su suhudoo bɔmma fukumsi, naŋgbanyini mini laɣim n-tum niriba 
maa sunsuuni.
h. N-nyɛ laɣim n-tum shihirili ka lan za yaɣili maa zaani.
2. Kparibɔɣuri
 Kparibɔɣuri maa nyɛla na’ shɛba ban be nazuɣu maa gbunni. Bɛ sula yaɣ’ 
shɛŋa din bi galisi fukumsi kamani tinsi bee tiŋkpansi. Naa zaashee maa 
nyɛla fali n-diri doli nam dunoli.
 Kparibɔɣuri maa tuma ni nyɛ shɛŋa n-nyɛ:
a. N-tumda nazuɣu maa yi ti kani.
b. N-sɔŋ yuli ka biɛhigu chani viɛnyɛliŋga tiŋ’ shɛŋa din be bɛ yaɣa maa 
puuni.
c. N-tumdi saliya karibu tuma bɛ yanima puuni.
d. N-yuli ka suhudoo be bɛ yanima maa ni.
e. N-tum kali tuma n-ti o nam gbana/nam kuɣu.
3. Paɣananima
 Paɣananima maa nyɛla bɛ ni yuli shɛba ka bɛ nyɛ toondaannima zaŋ ti 
paɣaba ban be bɛ ya ka lan nyɛ ban su ʒɛmana baŋsim fukumsi. Bɛ tumdi 
tuma din kpa talahi pam n-yuuni bɛ ya paɣaba mini bipuɣinsi biɛhisuŋ zuɣu. 
Zuliya shɛba ban diri fali n-doli mayili yaɣili polo, saha shɛŋa paɣananima 
maa n-yɛri ka di zaana zaŋ chaŋ ŋun tu ni o leei naa nam dunoya nima maa 
yi pii ba naai. Bɛ ni tooi pii bɛ maŋmaŋa kparibɔɣuri paɣananima ni bɛ be 
bɛ gbunni tumda. 
 Paɣananima tuma ni nyɛ shɛŋa n-nyɛ:
a. Ni bɛ tabi n-sɔŋ nanima ni tuun’ shɛŋa bɛ ni tumdi nam soya zuɣu
b. N-kari saliya shɛŋa zaa din jɛndi paɣiba mini bipuɣinsi bɛ ya puuni
c. N-kpaŋsi paɣiba yikonima ni nyɛ shɛŋa.
d. Ni bɛ kpaŋsi ka zaŋ baŋsim wuhi bɛ ya maa ni piligi shɛm.

4. Nagbahiriba
 Nagbahira nyɛla ninvuɣ’ so bee ninvuɣ’ shɛba ban mali nuu timbu nam 
gbaabu puuni ka bɛ maŋmaŋa pa ban bɔri nam maa puuni nima. Bɛ laɣiŋgu 
maa laɣindimi n-gbaai gbaabu zaŋ chaŋ ŋun yɛn leei naa maa ni nyɛ so.
 Nagbahiriba maa tuma ni nyɛ shɛŋa n-nyɛ;
a. N-gbaai na’ so ŋun yɛn di
b. N-tum kaya tuma di yi niŋ ka naa maa kani
c. N-su naa yihibu fukumsi
d. N-zaŋ na’ palo maa n-wuhi kpambaliba maa mini niriba maa
e. N-nyɛ ban pahiri naa maa haŋkali parisi
Tuma 7.5
1. Zaŋmi a maŋmaŋa bachinima n-kahigi wuhi toondaannima ŋɔ ni nyɛ 
ninvuɣ’ shɛba. Zaŋmiya a labisibu maa n-wuhi yi taba maa:
a. Naa
b. Nam kparibɔɣu
c. Nagbahiriba

3. Karimmi lahibali din do gbunni maa ka nam tiŋa ni taada nam soya ni

 Kariŋ A
 Ghana tiŋgbani ni taada nam soya ni pe n-doya shɛm
 Pɔi ka dɛmɔkiraatia gomnanti nam soya daa naan yi ti kana, taada nam 
soya daa pun bela Ghana ʒilɛya maa puuni. Lala gomnantitali maa 
daa nyɛla din pe n-doli soli din nyɛ nanima mini kpambaliba. Tiŋa 
bee tiŋkpaŋa kam yaɣili, nanima n-daa yi gbubi tiŋkpansi nti pahi bɛ 
kpambaliba ban nyɛ nagbahiriba ban gbaari gbaabu n-tiri tinsi maa 
nima. Kpambaliba ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛ ni pii shɛba n-doli bɛ yɛm, yuma, 
ni milinsi polo. Tiŋkpansi maa ni nyaaŋa, nam yaɣili kam daa yi malila 
nazuɣu ŋun nyɛ di naa, ŋun daa yi su tinsi pam fukumsi ka yuuni ka 
biɛhigu chani viɛnyɛliŋga ka lan bɔri maligu n-tiri zaba din be lala 
yaɣili maa. Nazuɣu maa daa yi nyɛla ŋun deeri fasara o nam kparibɔɣiri 
nanima sani ka daa tooi piiri piibu zaŋ chaŋ o nam yaɣili maa biɛhisuŋ 
polo. Nazuɣuri maa n-daa yi nyɛ ban pa zuɣusaa nam soya maa ni pe 
n-doya shɛm puuni di yi niŋ ka lala yaɣili ma ka naa ŋun du n-gari naa 
kam. Nazuɣuri maa n-daa yi nam yiko fukumsi tiŋgbani maa ni zaa. 
Taada nam soya ŋɔ zaɣa daa chaŋ ti gbaali laɣimgbaai, jilima zaŋ ti 
kpambaliba ni tiŋa zaa laɣingbaai ni kpa talahi shɛm.
4. Zammi tuma diba ata shɛŋa ban su fukumsi taada nam soya ni pe n-doya 
shɛm puuni mini ŋa daanfaannima zaŋ ti ʒilɛli.

DAGBANI LITIRICHA
Baŋsim yaɣili: Nolni Baŋsim mini Baŋsim Sabirili
PILIGU
Yaɣili ŋɔ yɛn dila alizama n-jɛndi baŋsim yaɣ’ shɛli din be Dagbani nolni baŋsim 
mini baŋsim sabrili puuni. Di ni yooi yi tɛha zaŋ kpa kom bahibu din be nolni 
baŋsim puuni. Di ni tuui wuhi a ŋa anfaaninima mini di ni niŋdi shɛm. Alizama ni 
lahi jɛndi jɛma daanfaani mini jɛma daliri. Di ni kpaŋsi ya ka yi tɔhi ka di bɔ daliri 
shɛli din che ka jɛma mali anfaani n-ti ya niriba. yaɣili ŋɔ nyɛla din kpa talahi 
n-ti ya Dagbani bɔhimbu ni ka kpini bɔhimbu yaɣ’ shɛŋa kamani Adiini Bɔhimbu 
yaɣiili. Yaɣili maa ni ti ya baŋsim shɛli din kpa talahi ka yi baŋ yi kaya ni tada ni 
shɛba kaya ni tada. Yaɣili maa lahi tuui wuhiri ya kuyila Ghana ʒilɛya maa puuni. 
Yi ni di alizama n-jɛndi Dagbani kuyila. Yi ni lihi lahabal’ shɛŋa n-jɛndi kuyila 
shɛŋa. Alizama dibu ni jɛndila kuyilli maa tuma. Yaha, yaɣili ŋɔ tuui wuhiri ya 
salinwaɣinli ni nyɛ shɛli mini salinwɣinli yaɣa. Yi karimba ni sɔŋ ka yi di alizama 
n-jɛndi salinwaɣinli yaɣa, ŋannima n-nyɛ niriba, yɛltɔɣikpana, niŋsim ni niŋ pa 
taba shɛm, niŋsim ni niŋ luɣ’ shɛli polo, sasabira tɛha ni shɛŋa.
Zaŋ chaŋ yaɣili ŋɔ ti yɛn naai, di tu ni a tooi
• Baŋ Dagbani kom bahibu biɛhigu (kpahi neei, fabila ni bahigu)
• Di kuyila alizama (tuma mini anfaani)
• Di alizama jɛndi salinwaɣinli yaɣa (shɛhira, niriba, yɛltɔɣikpani, niŋsim 
ni pe taba shɛm, niŋsim ni niŋ luɣ’ shɛli polo, sasabira tɛha, ŋan pahi.).
• Vihi salinwaɣinli lahabali (yuli, yɛltɔɣikpani, bachi gahimbu, litiricha 
biɛlima, ŋan pahi.)
Tɛha gahinda
• Kom bahibu nyɛla Dagbamba jɛma
• Kom bahibu malila yaɣa ata, ŋannima n-nyɛ: Kpahi neei, Fabila ni Bahigu
• Yɛltɔɣikpani maa n-nyɛ lahabali ni jɛndi binshɛli

KOM BAHIGU
Alizama dibu yɛn jɛndila yaɣa ata din laɣim leei kom bahibu biɛhigu. Di zaŋla 
kpahi neei, fabila ni bahigu maa n-tum tuma.
Bɔ N-lee Nyɛ Kom Bahibu?
Kom bahibu nyɛla kom booi bahi n-ti kpiimba bee ti yaannima. Di nyɛla 
Dagbandabba jɛma bal’ shɛli ban jɛma nyɛ Dagbandɔhili ni niŋdi shɛm. Ayim-
Aboagye (1993: 165 din yina 1996:9) yɛliya ni di nyɛla tuun’ shɛli di ni mali 
kom, dam bee bunnyurili m-boori bahiri tiŋgbani ni ka di nia nyɛla di kpahi neei 
kpimmba bee yaannima ka suhuri bɛ sɔŋsim. Luɣ’ shɛŋa, bimbiɛlima kamani 
shiŋkaafa ka di mali bahira kom. Kom bahibu tumdila tuun’ shɛli din kpa talahi 
Gbanzabila tiŋgbana ni. Kom bahibu puuni, di boonila yaan’ shɛba di nya ka 
bɛ be biɛhigu ni ʒia kam puuni. Daŋ kpamba mini Dagbandɔhili toondonima 
m-bahiri kom laɣiŋgu kamani zuɣu pinibu, paɣa bɔbu, churi, kparigu yɛbu, ni 
laɣin’ shɛŋa ŋan ŋmani ŋa.

Kom Bahibu Biɛhigu
Kom bahibu biɛhigu nyɛla kpahi neei, fabila ni bahigu.
Kpahi neei
Yaɣili ŋɔ ka di kpahiri neeri ka booni kpiimba. Ŋun bahira kom maa piini booni 
Naawuni yuli, n-zaŋ tiŋgbana wuna pa, noli wuna bee daŋ tihi, ka naan yi zaŋ 
yaannnim m-pa. kom bahibu puuni, kpahi neei nyɛla din tumdi Naawuni bee 
kpiimba boligu bee dunoli kpahibu tuma m-baŋsi ba. Shɛhira, din do gbunni ŋɔ 
nyɛla Dagbamba ni kpahiri neeri kpiimba shɛm Dagbandɔhili jɛma ni.
Kpiɛŋlana Naawuni, A kom m-bɔŋɔ!, 
Daboli ŋɔ lana, a kom m-bɔŋɔ! 
M ba Sibiri, yiɣisi deegi a kom.
A yi neei nyin neei a ba Danaa.
Ka o gba neei ti yaba Bidira.
Yi saa kom m-bɔŋɔ.
Lahabali maa
Kom bahibu lahabali nyɛla din wuhiri daliri shɛli zuɣu di ni bahira kom maa. 
Dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi nyɛ suhugu bee paɣili. Yaɣili ŋɔ ni, ŋun bahiri kom ŋɔ yɛrila 
wuna daliri shɛli din che ka di paari ba m-bɔri ni bɛ be bɛ sani laɣiŋgu maa saha. 
Kpe ka ŋun bahiri kom maa suhiri bɛ gubu.
Bahigu maa
Yaɣili ŋɔ kom bahibu ni nyɛla din lo alikawuli ni di ni paɣi kpiimba bee wuna 
ni binshɛli yɔbu di yi niŋ ka bɛ ni bɔri shɛli niŋ. Ban bahira kom maa lahi nyɛla 
ban suhiri ni wuna yɛli noli n-ti ninvuɣ’ shɛba ban ban mali tɛh’ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ 
laɣiŋgu maa polo. ŋun bahira kom lahi suhiri toontibo wuna sani n-tiri ban be 
biɛr’ suŋ biɛhigu ni. Saha shɛŋa, kamani kashi maliŋ ni, binkɔrigili be yaɣili 
ŋɔ. Anfooninima ŋan do gbunni ŋɔ nyɛla kom bahibu saha shɛhira Ghana zuliya 
shɛŋa puuni.

KUYILA
Tɛha bɔhigu:
Wula ka ti be a a yi kɔŋ a dɔɣim?
Bɔ N-lee Nyɛ Kuyilli?
Di nyɛla yil’ shɛli din fabinda di bahi bahindi din yiini doli kuli bee ku’ malima 
ni. Di lahi nyɛla yil’ shɛli din yiini n-kumdi kuli ka wuhiri nandahima. Kuyilli 
nyɛla din yi yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi ni na. Kuyilli lahi nyɛla din ni tooi zaŋ shɛli m-paɣi 
kum. Kuyila nyɛla din yihiri kum biɛhigu ni n-kpɛhi kalinsi biɛhigu ni.
Kuyila tuma

Salinwaɣinli
Salinwaɣinli nyɛla baŋsim sabirili yaɣ’ shɛli din yam pam. Di wuhirila sabbu kam 
din doli alizama mini zuliya yɛltɔɣa zalisi. Salinwaɣinli maa dolila girama mini 
sintaɣisi zaligu viɛnyɛliŋga ka yirina kamani alizama la. Di bi doli kumsi kum pa 
taba. Di kuli tirila lahabali zaŋ chaŋ baŋsim shɛli, tɛh’ shɛli, ni salima polo zaŋ ti 
ninvuɣ’ so ŋun karinda.
Tuma 8.11
Kahigimi sabbu din nyɛ salinwaɣinli a maŋmaŋa milinsi puuni ka zaŋ a 
labisibu maa m-maɣisi a karimbikpee dini.
Salinwaɣinli yaɣa
Ninvuɣ’ so ŋun salinli puuni: Daadam kam, biŋkɔbigu, bee binnamdili kam di ni 
zaŋ tum tuma litiricha tuma ni. Salinli maa dolila alizam’ shɛli mini biɛh’ shɛli 
din be ninvuɣ’ shɛba ban be salinli maa ni sunsuuni. Ninvuɣ’ shɛba ban be salinli 
puuni kpa talahi pam salin’ viɛlli puuni, ka salinli maa me n-gili ninvuɣ’ so maa 
m-mali tuma zaŋ chaŋ salinli maa puuni yɛla ni niŋdi pari taba shɛm polo bee 
ŋuna n-nya nahiŋgu zaŋ chaŋ salinli maa puuni yɛl’ shɛŋa din niŋdi pari taba 
maa puuni. Ninvuɣ’ so salinli maa ni me n-gili maa n-nyɛ salinli maa zuɣu ka 
ninvuɣ’ so ŋun tuhi salinli maa ni me n-gili so maa mi nyɛ ŋun tahiri yɛlimuɣisira 
na salinli maa ni. Ninvuɣ’ so ŋun bi zoori salinli ni tɛha bi taɣiri salinli maa ni ka 
ninvuɣ’ so ŋun mi be salinli maa yaɣili kam taɣirimi doli yɛl’ palli kam din niŋdi 
salinli maa ni.
Yɛltɔɣikpani: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla haŋkali shɛli salinli maa bee lahibali maa ni ʒira, 
shɛhira kamani suɣulo, nodeebo, bee suhupiɛlli. Salinli ni tooi lan mali yɛltɔɣikpan’ 
shɛŋa pahi ka di sɔŋdi kahigiri salinli maa yɛlikpan’ zuɣu maa.
Niŋsim ni niŋ luɣ’ shɛli: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ salinli maa niŋsim shee. Di chaŋ ti gbaala 
lahibali zaŋ kpa salinli maa ni niŋ luɣ’ shɛli mini saha shɛli, ni salinli maa ni yɛri 
shɛli yɛla (biɛhigu, kurumbuni lahabali, kaya ni taada bee ʒiliɛli polo). Niŋsim 
ni niŋ luɣ’ shɛli gbaala saha, luɣ’ shɛli, ʒiliɛli biɛhigu, biɛhigu ni be shɛm, ni din 
pahi salinli maa ni niŋsim ni niŋdi luɣ’ shɛli maa ni.
Yɛla ni niŋ m-pe taba shɛm: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛla ni niŋ m-pe n-doli taba shɛm 
salinli ni. Di wuhirila tɛha mini niŋsim ni niŋ m-pe taba shɛm salinli ni. Di

niŋdimi doli zabili, niriba yi ti tuhiri taba, ni yɛlimuɣisira saha. Di ni tooi nyɛ 
niriba ni yu shɛli ka di niŋdi doli taba yimbayimba bee ka di kuli che n-gabi taba 
ka taɣibutaɣibu shɛŋa nira ni bi tɛhira beni.
Sasabira ni nya li shɛm bee n-tɛhi shɛm: Dimbɛŋɛ nyɛla yaɣ’ shɛli din yuuni 
yɛlizuɣu maa mini salinli maa zaa. Sasabira ni nya li shɛm maa kahigirila tɛh’ 
shɛli puuni salinli maa ni sabi maa. Di ni tooi sabi ka di nyɛla sasabira maa nuu 
bela din niŋdi salinli maa ni maa bee ka sasabira maa za kpaŋa sa ka yɛri din niŋdi 
salinli maa ni. Bachizaana din zaani ninvuɣ’ yino zaani maa n-nyɛ n, mani, m ka 
din zaani ninvuɣ’ shɛba zaani mi nyɛ o, bɛ, ŋuna, ni bana.
Biɛhigu: Biɛhigu maa nyɛla sasabira maa ni bɔri ni o zaŋ biɛh’ shɛli wuhi ban 
karinda maa. Di nyɛla biɛhigu din nyɛ muɣisigu bee nyaɣisim nambu ka di nyɛla 
o yɛn zaŋla anfooni, yɛla ni na niŋdi shɛm saha shɛli, binyɛra, tɛha bee binyɛra 
ni niŋdi shɛm ni yɛl’ shɛŋa m-pahi niŋsim ni niŋ luɣ’ shɛli maa. Di ni tooi nyɛ 
suhugarigu, nasaridibo, nyaɣisim, tahama bee alobo.

 Kunduŋ Mini Bubila
 Bubila n-daa beni ka o yila ni daa zooi shɛm zuɣu che ka o daa tɛhi ni o 
zoomi leei Bulaa ka ni tooi gbubi o maŋa. Lala zuɣu, dahinshɛli yuŋ ka 
biŋkɔbiri maa daa yi mɔri ŋubbu yɔɣu ni bɛ kuli ka o ma boli o, Bubila 
maa daa bi gbiligi nyaɣisi o ma ka kuli ŋubirila mo’ baligu ŋɔ. Saha biɛla 
sunsuuni o ni daa ti wuɣi o zuɣu, ka biŋkɔbiri maa zaa daa pun kuli.
 O kɔŋko n-daa kpalim. Wuntaŋa daa lurimi. Shilinshi’ waɣila n-daa 
kuli be tiŋgbani ni lɛbiri ginda. Ka pɔhim mah’ baligu ʒɛri li ka di lɛbiri 
gindi ni vuri din mali dabiɛm mɔri maa ni. Bubila maa nii daa sɔhigimi 
ka o tɛhiri kunduŋ yɛriga maa yɛla. Ka o da pili zɔri gindi mɔɣu maa ni 
ni nimmɔhi, n-kuhiri bɔri o ma shee. O daa na bi chaŋ m-pirigi, tibɔŋ 
shee, Kunduŋ maa m-bala!
 Bubila maa daa baŋya ni tahima lahi kani n-ti o.
 O nii daa sɔhirimi ka o yɛli, “Pahimi, m ba Kunduŋ, m mi ni a yɛn ŋubi 
ma mi. Amaa tuuli, pahimi suɣulo yilimi yilli niŋ ma, m bɔrimi ni n wa 
waa ka di dari n yaa tariga.”
 Kunduŋ maa suhu daa yu yil’ bil’ shɛli din yɛn yili ka o naan yi ŋubi 
Bubila maa, ka o daa to yil’ nyaɣisili bahina ka Bubila maa ŋma n-yiɣi 
ka jɔhijɔhi o napɔna ni ni nyaɣisim.
 Ka di kuli nyɛla, biŋkɔbiri maa daa kuli chanila biɛlabiɛla n-kuni yiŋa 
polo. Zaawuni pɔhim baligu maa ni, Kunduŋ maa ni daa piɛbisi o noli 
kamani kalamboo la vuri daa chaŋ katiŋa. Piɛkpara maa bahi daa 
yirigila bɛ tiba. Bɛ daa baŋ Kunduŋ ni yiini yil’ shɛli ka naan yi diri o 
chuɣu, ka saha bihi sunsuuni, bɛ daa pili n-guuri labiri mɔɣu maa ni. 
Kunduŋ maa yilli maa daa fɔya saha bihi sunsuuni, ka o ni daa zɔri ka 
Bahi maa duri o napɔŋkpahi maa, o daa boli o maŋa jɛrigu o ni lɛbi 
kalambopiɛbira ni di tiɣi Bubila nini maa, di ni daa simdi ni o niŋ shɛm 
nyɛla o tum o nakɔhigu tuma.
 Miri ka a ti che ka binshɛli ŋmaligi a tɛha ka che a nia ni nyɛ shɛli.

ORAL CONVERSATION
Phonology (Speech sounds of a Ghanaian language)
INTRODUCTION
Dear learner, you are welcome to this section which discusses the foundation 
of language (speech sounds). You will be introduced to the concepts of vowels 
and consonants of your language of study and how speech sounds are described 
(parametre). It will focus on where the speech sounds occur in words of a Ghanaian 
language. For example, where vowels and consonants can occur in a word of a 
Ghanaian language such as initial position, medial position, or final position of 
a word. Again, Dear learner you will be introduced to the distribution of vowels 
and consonants in their language, aiding them to form meaningful words and 
facilitate effective speaking and reading in the language. This section is essential 
for learners not only in the context of Ghanaian language studies but also to 
establish links with related subjects such as English and other languages. This 
section equips you with foundational knowledge and functional understanding 
of speech sounds and their role in language learning. In summary, you should be 
able to identify, explain, produce, and label vowel charts and consonant tables of 
your language of study.
After this section, you should be able to:
By the end of the lesson, you should be able to:
1. Describe the vowels of a Ghanaian language using the right parameters 
(e.g., lip posture, tongue height and part of the tongue).
2. Describe the consonants of the Ghanaian language using the right 
parameters (e.g., voicing, place of articulation and manner of articulation).
3. Explain the distribution of vowels of the Ghanaian language (e.g., word 
initial, medial and final).

SECTION1 SOUNDS OF THE LANGUAGE
Key ideas
 Production refers to the making or saying of a speech sound in language. 
Speech sound is a sound used in the formation of words for human 
communication. The production of speech sound involves obstruction 
which is the interruption of free flow of air during production of speech 
sounds. Sounds are distributed in languages and this refers to the place 
or position in a word where a sound can appear. Sound involves airflow 
which is a mass movement of air that is meant for the production of 
speech sounds. Another term for it is airstream.
4
SECTION1 SOUNDS OF THE LANGUAGE
TYPES OF SPEECH SOUNDS
Speech sounds can be grouped into two main types, namely vowels and consonants. 
It is the combination of these two types of sounds that produces words. In other 
words, all words are made up of individual speech sounds. For examples, the word 
pan consists of three individual speech sounds, that is, /p/, /a/, /n/. The sound /a/ 
is a vowel, whereas the sounds /p/ and /n/ are consonants. In the following topics 
we discuss both vowels and consonants focusing on how each is produced in a 
Ghanaian language.
The concept of vowel
The concept vowel refers as a speech sound in which production there is a little or 
no obstruction of the flow of air in the oral cavity. In other words, a speech sound 
which when being produced the air is not obstructed or it is minimally obstructed 
in the oral cavity is referred to as a vowel. Since in their production there is no 
or very little obstruction of airflow, vowels are comparatively heard louder when 
they are produced. Vowels are very important part of words. There cannot be a 
word without a vowel or vowel-like sound. This important role vowel plays in a 
word will later on in your second year be discussed when we are talking about the 
syllable.
Description of vowels
Dear learner, in describing vowels of a Ghanaian language, there are certain 
properties we use. These properties are often termed parametres. Parametres 
simply refer to the characteristics that a vowel possesses. The main parametres 
used in describing vowels are the tongue height, lip posture, and part of the tongue 
used during the production of the vowel sound. In addition to the three, there 
is a fourth parameter called advancement of the tongue root in some Ghanaian 
languages such as Akan. Let us begin the discussions of these parametres.
Lip position/posture:
The parametre lip posture is used to determine the position your lips assume when 
you are producing a vowel. So, at this level, the lips assume two main postures 
or positions, namely rounded or unrounded. That is, whether the lips are rounded 
or they are not rounded when a vowel sound is being produced. Based on this 
posture of the lips, we can divide vowels of a Ghanaian language into two, namely 
‘rounded’ and ‘spread/unrounded.’ Some examples of rounded vowels are /u, 
o, ɔ/. examples of unrounded vowels, on the other hand, are /i, e, a/.
5
SECTION1 SOUNDS OF THE LANGUAGE
Activity
At this point, produce rounded and unrounded/spread vowels of your Ghanaian 
language of study.
Tongue height/Height of the tongue:
This refers to the position of the tongue in reference to the root of the mouth when 
producing vowel sounds. It is assumed that when we are producing vowels, the 
mouth opens when we drop the jaw. This can be high, mid, or low. When we 
drop our jaws to the lowest possible position, the vowels produced in this way are 
referred to as low vowels. Examples of low vowel is /a/, and in some Ghanaian 
languages [æ]. When we open our mouth wide enough but not as low as when 
producing low vowels, then the vowels we produced are termed mid vowels. 
Some examples of mid vowels in a Ghanaian language are /e, o/. In producing 
high vowels, on the other hand, the mouth is significantly opened but not as wide 
as mid vowels, thereby allowing enough air to flow through the oral cavity. Some 
examples of high vowels in a Ghanaian language are /i, u/.
Activity
Begin practicing the production of vowels in your language of study focusing 
on how high or how low you raise your jaws or open your mouth.
Part of the tongue:
This parametre refers to the area of the tongue where the vowel sound is produced. 
It is assumed that when we are producing vowels, some parts of the tongue 
move. We cannot easily feel this movement though. Three parts of the tongue 
are assumed to be involved when a vowel sounds is being produced. These parts 
are the front part, middle part, and back part. Based on that, the parametre gives 
us three classes of vowels, namely front, mid, and back vowels. In producing 
front vowels, it is the front part of the tongue that moves. Some examples of front 
vowels of a Ghanaian language are /i, e, ɛ/. For the production of mid vowels, 
the middle of the tongue is assumed to move. Therefore, the following vowel is 
an example of a mid-vowel: /a/. For back vowels, on the other hand, as the name 
suggests, it is the back of the tongue that is involved in their production. Some 
examples of back vowels of a Ghanaian language are: /u, o, ɔ/.

Advancement of the tongue root (ATR): (Please, discuss only if appli-
cable in your language)
This parametre, which is prominent in a few Ghanaian languages including Akan, 
Dagbani, etc. It is used to determine the position the tongue root assumes when a 
vowel is being produced. By this parametre, we try to find out if there is tension 
or pressure on the tongue or not during production of vowels. When a vowel is 
produced with pressure on the tongue thereby causing the tongue root to draw 
back, we say that vowel is produced with Advanced Tongue Root (ATR) i.e. 
(+ATR) vowels. When vowels are produced with the tongue root in its natural 
neutral position, we label those vowels are Unadvanced Tongue Root i.e. (-ATR) 
vowels. Some examples of (+ATR) vowels are: /i, e, u, o/, and examples of (-ATR) 
vowels are /ɪ, ɛ, ɔ/.

The concept of consonant
As was mentioned earlier in the section, consonant is another type of speech sounds 
apart from vowel. The concept consonant refers to a speech sound in which during 
production the breath, which we have termed airflow, is at least obstructed. Based 
on this explanation, we can contrast vowel and consonant by saying that while in 
the production of vowel there is very minimal or no obstruction of airflow, there 
is significant obstruction of airflow when producing consonants. We combined 
vowels and consonants form a word.

Consonant Distribution
The concept consonant distribution simply refers to the position in a word where 
a consonant can occur in a particular Ghanaian language. A consonant that 
occurs at the beginning of a word is referred to as word initial consonant. When a 
consonant occurs at the middle of a word, we refer to it as word medial consonant. 
When a consonant occurs at the end of a word, we refer to refer to it as word final 
consonant. Let us note that some consonants can occur in all positions of a word. 
For example, in some Ghanaian languages, the consonant /m/ can occur in the 
three positions in a word.

INTRODUCTION
This section discusses identification of key ideas in texts and discourse. It 
always gives information on specific ideas or knowledge to the reader or hearer. 
The information given may come from all perspectives such as education, 
industrialisation, mining among others. It may also indicate some cultural values 
such as respect, tolerance and patience. Identifying key ideas gives you a better 
understanding of the discourse. It also enhances your critical thinking skills and 
interpretation abilities. There are types of reading techniques namely skimming 
and scanning and the application of any of the type enables you to get the right 
information demanded at any time. Knowledge of the types is therefore essential 
in our everyday life. The concept of oral interpretation will also be discussed. We 
shall discuss the skills needed for effective interpretation. Interpretation plays 
important roles in facilitating communication across language barriers.
By the end of this section, you should be able to:
• Identify key ideas from appropriate discourse. E.g., cultural values 
(respect, kindness, tolerance and others), education, child trafficking, 
environment, industrialisation in Ghana, mining, GESI etc.,
• Discuss ideas and relevant opinions from selected discourse. E.g., 
cultural values (respect, kindness, tolerance and others), education, 
child trafficking, environment, industrialisation in Ghana, mining, GESI, 
STEM, etc.
Key Ideas
• Key ideas are the main messages that is relevant in any discourse. Some 
of the key ideas may center on cultural values such as respect, kindness, 
tolerance, patience, etc. In any discourse you can share relevant opinions 
on any discourse appropriately and interpret any discourse in your own

Reading
By the end of the sub-strand you should be able to:
1. Discuss skimming using preview, overview and review.
2. Discuss scanning using the strategies (e.g., movement of eyes or finger, 
locating words and phrases)
3. Apply skimming and scanning to extract information or ideas from texts
Key ideas
 Skimming is going through a text rapidly to get the general information 
in the text while scanning involves looking for a specific information in 
a text. Scanning is a process of reading in which your eyes quickly run 
through a piece of text to find a piece of relevant information. Scanning 
and skimming are two different concepts of reading.
TYPES OF READING
There are types of reading skill or technique namely skimming, scanning, 
intensive reading and extensive reading. Dear learner, in this lesson you shall 
learn skimming and scanning techniques of reading.
Skimming
Skimming is a reading technique used to quickly identify the main ideas or key 
points in a text. It is the action of reading something quickly so as to note only the 
important points. Basically, skimming is reading rapidly in order to get a general 
overview of the material read. It is used to find specific facts in texts. It involves 
glancing over the material, focusing on headings, subheadings, bold text and key 
phrases to get a general understanding of the content. Skimming is useful when; 
time is limited, looking for specific information, you want to get an overview 
8

before reading in-depth and you are dealing with a large amount of text. Below 
are the skimming types.
Preview: An opportunity to view something before it is acquired or becomes 
generally available. Preview is done in an effort to learn about the ideas presented 
and the structure of their development.
Overview: Used to sample the reading material more thoroughly. A general review 
or summary of a subject.
Review: The review is done to re-familiarise yourself with the material you have 
previously read thoroughly or skimmed. A formal assessment of something with 
the intention of instituting a change if necessary.
Learner, in skimming, you can follow these steps
1. Read the title
2. Read the headings and sub-headings as well as topic sentences in each 
paragraph
3. Look for important information such as date, names and unusual words.
4. Read the conclusion

In summary you have learnt skimming and the steps as well as the types of 
skimming which you can apply. Dear learner, let us examine what is scanning.
Scanning
Scanning is reading rapidly in order to find facts without reading everything. 
Scanning helps you locate a particular fact while skimming tells you what general 
information is within a section.
Scanning involves looking for a specific information in a text. It can also be said 
to be a process of reading in which your eyes quickly run through a piece of text 
to find a piece of relevant information. In scanning the reader looks for a piece 
of specific information. An example of scanning is searching for the meaning 
of a word in a dictionary. Scanning helps the reader to locate particular facts in 
an entire text quickly. Students often use scanning when solving their reading 
comprehension questions.
It is important to know the purpose for scanning. You should know what you are 
searching for, eg title of a book, a website, a reference material, a particular word 
or phrase and a particular story you want to read etc. You should know how the 
material is structures either alphabetically, non-alphabetically, chronologically, 
by category, by titles /headings, by textual sense, by numbers among others.
Scanning helps a learner to read more and to develop love for reading.

When to scan
1. Scan before reading
2. Scan a number of questions to identify the one which you are most 
comfortable answering
3. When searching for particular information such as date, keywords etc.
The following shows how to do scanning after getting overview of a text and 
identifying the sections of the text you want to read.
1. Start scanning the text by moving your eyes and fingers quickly over it
2. When you have identified the information, word or the phrase you are 
searching for, read the information surrounding the word carefully
3. When you identified the information that requires attention, you read it 
thoroughly slowly.

Oral Interpretation and translation
By the end of the sub-strand, you should be able to:
 Discuss oral interpretation focusing on effective listening, encoding and 
decoding,
Key Ideas
 Oral interpretation is reframing the meaning of a speech most often orally 
into another language. The original language is the source language 
and the language in which it is rendered is the target language. In oral 
interpretation you must note the cultural differences and be accurate in 
giving the meaning of what you are to render in the language orally.
CONTENT
Interpretation is listening to a message in one language and rendering it orally 
in another language maintaining the original meaning, tone and context. It 
is the stylistic representation of a creative work or dramatic role. It is the act 
of explaining, reframing, or otherwise showing your own understanding of 
something. In interpretation you first have to understand the text or the piece 
given to you and then explain in your own words. In broader terms it is rendering 
a spoken or signed message into another spoken or signed language preserving 
the register and meaning of the source language content.
Dear learner, it must be noted that before you can do any interpretation, you must 
be well versed in the source and target language. Interpretation can be performed 
either simultaneously or consecutively between users of different languages.
Dear learner, know that in interpreting you do not embellish or over-exaggerate. 
State the ideas clearly. In interpreting you need to listen carefully, decode and 
encode as they serve as the process of communication and interpreting.

MƐNI JI KALELƐ?
Ngɛ kuuhi a mi ɔ, nyɛ ha munyunguhi etɛ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ kɛ kale nihi nɛ nyɔɔ se 
ɔmɛ.

- O huɛ nɛ o suɔ saminya
- O okplɔɔ
- O sukuu ɔ ngɛngɛ mi aloo e si fɔfɔɛ.
Kalelɔ ji munyungu nɛ a kɛ kaleɔ biɛ. Kaleli ji munyunguhi nɛ tsɔɔ nɔ ko aloo 
nɔ ko he so. Kaleli nɔhyɛ ni ji ba mumu, yumu, kungwɔzɔ, futaa, kpiti, gaga, fɛu, 
agbo, nyafii, legelege, fafɛ, pɔpɔɛ, gbigbli kɛ ekpa komɛ. Nɔhyɛ ni nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ 
tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a tsuɛ kaleli a he ni ha ngɛ munyuzahi a mi.
i. I suɔ we momohi.
ii. Nyumuyo ɔ ka nɛ e ngɛ legelege.
iii. Baake ye lo gbigbli ɔ kulaa.
Ngɛ (i) mi ɛ, munyungu momo ngɛ we ɔ nɛ munyu tulɔ ɔ suɔ ɛ kalee. Ngɛ (ii) mi 
ɛ, munyungu legelege ngɛ nyumuyo ɔ kalee. Ngɛ (iii) mi ɛ, munyungu gbigbli ngɛ 
lo ɛ kalee.
Kaleli slɔɔtohi
Wa ngɛ kaleli slɔɔtohi. Kaleli slɔɔtohi nɛ nyɛ maa kase amlɛ nɔ ɛ ji:
- Heninegbɔlɔ kaleli
- Yibɔ kaleli
- Su kaleli
Heninegbɔlɔ kaleli
Ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, heninegbɔlɔ biɛnanemidali ( jamɛ a, jamɛ a je, kikɛmɛ a, kikɛmɛ a je ) 
ya peeɔ heninegbɔli ejakaa a ngɛ nɔ ɔ he so tsɔɔe (biɛ he so tsɔɔmi). Hyɛ nɔhyɛ 
nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se nɔ ɔmɛ.
a. Jamɛ a lɔle ɔ kle.
b. Wa jamɛ a je nyumuwi ɔmɛ bui nɔ.
c. Naate kikɛmɛ a subai nɛ ɔ be wɛ wae.
d. Pɔtɔtɔɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a je ni tsumi nɔ ɔ mi.

5. Ni ɛmɔ kuɛ lɛle ɛ.

3. Ni kaselɛ ɛ hɔli tlukaa.

Omineomine peeminumyuhi woɛ nɛnali enyɛ ngɔ munyuza mi: nɛnalɛ tutuutu kɔ 
nɛnalɛ setsɛ. Nɛnalɛ ɛ kake ma nyɔ pee biɔ aloo biɔnanemidalɛ oti aloo nɛnalɛ 
tutuutu nɔ ngɔ peemimunyu ɛ sɛlee. Nɛnalɛ setsɛ ɛ ya peeɛ biɔ aloo biɔnanemidalɛ 
nɔ ngɔ nɛnalɛ tutuutu ɛ sɛlee. Nɛhyɔ ni nɔ nyɔɔ se ji nɔ ɛ nɔ: ha, mane, bi, he, hɔɔ, 
fiɔ kɔ ekpa komɔ. Nɛhyɔ ni ngɔ munyuzahi a mi ji:
1 . Fɛli ɛmɔ ha a bi ɛ ni tsɛwi komɔ.
2. Tsɛɛlɛ mane ni kaseli ɛmɔ nike ni.
3. Kojolɛ ɛ bi Lɛya a munyu ko.
4. Yo ɛ ke e huɔ ɛ apɛnu.
Ngɔ nɛhyɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɛ, nɛnalɛ setsɛ ɛ ji ‘bi’ nɔ nɛnalɛ tutuutu ɛ ji ‘ni tsɛwi’. Ngɔ 
nɛhyɔ nɛ ɛ mi ɛ, nɛnalɛ setsɛ ɛ ji ‘huɔ’ nɔ nɛnalɛ tutuutu ɛ ji ‘apɛnu’.
Ngɔ Dangme mi ɛ, wa tsu we hɔ kpɔ ngwɛhe biɔhi a he ni se wa tsuɛ se ngwɛhe 
biɔhi a he ni. Nɛhyɔ ni ji (tsu mi, tsu se, pa nya, pa tue, kpo nɛ, nga mi, kɔ ekpa 
komɔ). Nyɔ ma nyɔ sɔsɔ he.

1. Mɔni ji biɔ? Moo ngɛ mo nitsɔ o munyunguhi kɔ tsɛɛ sisi.

ominewe peemimunyu kɔ omineomine peemimunyu kuuhi a mi. A ha 
nɛhyɔ ni enyɛ ngɔ daka nɔ ɛ mi.

NYA TSƆƆMI
Mi gbami nɛ ɔ hyɛ mlaahi nɛ kudɔɔ nɔ kɛ ngmaa Gana gbihi. Wa maa sɛsɛ mlaahi 
nɛ kɔɔ biɛhi, peemimunyuhi, kaleli kɛ miblɛkeli a he. Wa maa sɛsɛ mlaahi nɛ 
kudɔɔ biɛhi a he kekle. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wa maa sɛsɛ mlaa nɛ kudɔɔ biɛnanemidali, 
kaleli kɛkɛ wa sɛsɛ mlaahi nɛ kudɔɔ peemimunyuhi kɛ miblɛkeli a he. Enɛ ɔ 
ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa le mlaahi nɛ kudɔɔ nɔ kɛ ngmaa biɛhi, biɛnanemidali, kaleli, 
peemimunyuhi kɛ miblɛkeli ngɛ Dangme mi. Mlaahi nɛ nyɛ kase ɔ maa ye bua  
nyɛ ngɛ Aflaane gbi ɔ mi hulɔ.
Ni kasemi mi nihi
1. Da mlaahi nɛ kudɔɔ biɛhi kɛ biɛnanemidali a ngmami nɔ kɛ ngma 
munyuzahi.
2. Da mlaa nɛ kudɔɔ kaleli a ngmami nɔ kɛ ngma munyuzahi.
3. Da mlaa nɛ kudɔɔ peemimunyuhi kɛ miblɛkeli a ngmami nɔ kɛ ngma 
munyuzahi.
Otihi
• Biɛhi tsuɔ ni kaa peelɔ, nɔnalɔ, nɔnalɔ setsɔ, biɛkalelɔ nɛ a tsuɔ ni kaa 
munyukpɔfa yi.
• Biɛnanemidali tsuɔ ni kaa peelɔ kɛ nɔnalɔ ngɛ munyuza mi.
• Kaleli kaleɔ biɛhi. Ngɛ Dangme mi ɔ, kaleli baa ngɛ biɛ nɛ a ngɛ kalee ɔ 
e se. Ekomɛ hu a baa ngɛ biɛ nɛ a ngɛ kaleɔ e hɛ kpɛ.
• Peemimunyu tsɔɔ nɔ peemi ngɛ munyuza mi. Ngɛ Dangme mi ɔ, wa hyɛ 
we peelɔ ɔ yibɔ loko wa tsuɔ peemimunyu ɔ he ni. Ke peelɔ kake jio, fuu 
jio ɔ, peemimunyu ɔ tsake we. A bla we peemimunyu ɔ kɛ peelɔ ɔ nɛ a 
ngmaa lɛ kaa munyungu kake.
• Miblɛkeli blɛkeɔ peemimunyuhi kɛ miblɛkeli kpahi a mi.

BIƐHI
Wa kase biɛhi a he ni ngɛ ni kasemi nɛ be ɔ mi. Wa de nɔhyɛ ni nɛ wa ngɔ mɛ kɛ 
wo glɛ munomunohi a mi.
Yi mi susumi mi sane bimi: O ma nyɛ kai biɛ slɔɔtohi ngɛ a glɛ nɔ lo? Moo ngma 
mɛ.
Biɛhi ji nimli a biɛhi, he biɛhi lohwehi a biɛhi kɛ nihi a biɛhi. Be babauu ɔ, 
munyuza hɛɛɔ biɛ kake. Biɛhi ma nyɛ hɛɛ heninegbɔlɔ ‘ko aloo komɛ’, ‘ɔ aloo 
ɔmɛ kɛ ‘a aloo amɛ’.
Biɛnanemidalɔ
E ji munyu nɛ ma nyɛ da si ngɛ biɛ nane mi. Nɔhyɛ nihi ji: lɛ, mo, imi, mɛ, wɔ, 
wa kɛ ekpahi. Ngɛ Gana gbihi babauu mi ɔ, a be biɛnanemidali ekpaekpa kɛ ha 
yo kɛ nyumu kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ Aflaane gbi mi ɔ. E ngɛ ja ngɛ Dangme mi lo? 
O kɛ nɔ ko nɛ sɛsɛ he nɛ nyɛ de heto ɔ ngɔ ha tsɔɔlɔ ɔ.
Ngɛ ni kasemi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, wa sɛsɛ mlaahi nɛ kudɔɔ biɛhi kɛ biɛ nanemidali a 
ngmami he.

i. Awo ya sɔlemi.
ii. Womi ɔ fɔɔ si.
iii. Nyasa ji manye yemi nya safie.
Ngɛ nɔhyɛ change to  munyuza nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, Awo, Womikɛ Nyasa peeɔ peeli

a. Nɔnali ngɛ munyuzahi a mi (Nɔnalɔ aloo nɔnalɔ setsɔ)
 Biɛhi ma nyɛ tsu ni kaa nɔnali ngɛ munyuzahi a mi. Nɔnalɔ ɔ ma nyɛ pee 
nɔnalɔ tutuutu aloo nɔnalɔ setsɔ. Nɔhyɛ ni ji:
i. Wa he womi ha Ama. (Nɔnalɔ)
ii. I kɛ change to  ningma tso ɔ ha Kojo. (Nɔnalɔ setsɔ)
iii. Alimo ngɔ nike ni mane Kosi. (Nɔnalɔ)
iv. Tɛɛkua he nɔ ko ha Tɛɛkpi. (Nɔnalɔ setsɔ)
b. Biɛhi daa si kaa sukaleli aloo biɛ kaleli. Enɛ ɔ ji biɛ nɛ ngɛ biɛ kpa kalee. 
Nɔhyɛ ni ji:
i. Dade pɛɛ ɔ ngɛ Ofoe dɛ.
ii. A nga sukuu sinya a.
iii. A he to womi.
iv. E he to womi baagi.
c. Munyukpɔfa yi: Biɛhi ma nyɛ da si kaa biɛmunyukpɔfa yi. Nɔhyɛ ni ji:
i. Na he jua wa.
ii. Tsu he ɔ mi dɔ la.
iii. Wa ba we.

Alahi
Ala ji we mi lohwe nɛ je kɛ wɛ tsuo le kaa a ji fiɛmi lohwehi. Ala munumunohi 
kɛ a bɔbɔɛ kɛ a su munomunohi nɛ ngɛ. A ji lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ piɛɛ pumi 
ogbeteehi a kuu ɔ he. Be nɛ blematsɛmɛ ngɔ ogbetee nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba we mi kɛ ha de 
dami ɔ, ogbetee ɔmɛ a su ba tsake nɛ a kɛ a he ba bɔ adesa kɛ e ni peepee he. A 
gugwɔ nuɔ nɔmlɔ adesa su komɛ kaa suɔmi, nɔ he numi, gbeye yemi, mɔbɔ nami 
kɛ fiɛmi he fu ma nɛ a ngɔɔ a he kɛ woɔ adesa ni peemihi a mi. Be babauu ɔ, alahi 
nuɔ nɔ he fu kɛ jee tsitsaa nɛ a nuɔ nɔ pɛmi hu he kɛ jeɔ tsitsaa. Nɔ nɛ haa nɛ ala 
he baa se nami wawɛɛ ji kaa, o ma nyɛ tsɔse mɛ nɛ a pee nɔ ha mo. Ala komɛ nyɛɔ 
nɛ a kpakaa hɛ yuyuli kɛ yaa kɛ baa daa be fɛɛ be nɛ ekomɛ hu woɔ adesahi a bua 
ke bua jɔmi be mɛ. A ngɔɔ alahi hu kɛ hlaa nɔ nɛ laa ejakaa a gugwɔ nuɔ nɔ he 
fu kɛ yaa tsitsaa he nɛ klama tete be nyɛe maa ya. Ala he ngɛ se nami wawɛɛ ha 
adesa se e wami se kɛ we saasaa. Ala yeɔ jeha nyɔngma aloo nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ pɛ. 
Ni komɛ po buɔ alahi kɛ piɛɛɔ a wekuli a he.

PEEMIMUNYUHI
Peemimunyuhi kɛ miblɛkeli ngɔmi kɛ pee munyuzahi ngɛ Gana gbihi a mi ɔ hiaa 
mlaa pɔtɛɛ komɛ. Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ waa nɛ a kɛ ngmaa gbi ɔ ngɛ e glɛ nɔ kɛ haa e 
kaneli. Mlaa amɛ yeɔ kɛ buaa kɛ haa munyuza ngmami nɛ sisi numi hiɔ he ngɛ 
Dangme mi.
Loko wa maa tu mlaa he munyu ɔ, nyɛ ha waa hyɛ nɔ nɛ ji peemimunyuhi. Moo 
hyɛ nɔhyɛ ni nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔmɛ. Munyunguhi nɛ a diki mi ɔ peeɔ peemimunyuhi.
1. Ngmɔ hulɔ ɔ gbaa ngmɔ daa gbo kɛ gbiɛ.
2. Jokuɛwi ɔmɛ nyɛɛɔ kɛ yaa sukuu daa Soha.
3. Wa tuɔ daa mɔtu kɛ kaa wa he mi.
Peemimunyu ji munyungu aloo munyukpɔfa nɛ tsɔɔ nɔ ko peemi. Peemimunyuhi 
peeɔ nɔ peemi oti pɔtɛɛ ngɛ munuyuza a mi.
Mlaahi nɛ kudɔɔ nɔ kɛ woɔ peemimunyuhi kɛ 
peeɔ munyuzahi.
Mlaahi nɛ kudɔɔ nɔ kɛ ngmaa munyuzahi nɛ a hɛɛ peemimunyuhi ngɛ munomuno 
ngɛ Gana gbi ɔmɛ a mi.
1. Peemimunyu tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ peelɔ ngɛ pee ngɛ munyuza mi. Nɔhyɛ ni:
a. Gbe ɔ kɔ lɛ.
 Ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, peemimunyu kɔ tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ nɛ munyungu “gbe’ kaa peelɔ ngɛ 
munyuza a mi ɔ pee kɛ si lɛ.
b. Kaseli ɔmɛ kuɔɔ okada kɛ yaa sukuu daa mɔtu.
 Peemimunyu kuɔɔ tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ nɛ munyungu “kaseli” kaa peelɔ ngɛ 
munyuza a mi ɔ peeɔ. Enyɔne ji kaa: Peemimunyu yaa hu tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ 
munyungu “kaseli” kaa peelɔ ngɛ munyuza a mi ɔ peeɔ.
2. Peemimunyuhi tsɔɔ peelɔ ɔ ngɛngɛ mi ngɛ munyuza a mi. Nɔhyɛ nɔ:
 Kojo na bua jɔmi benɛ a gbe ka a nya a.
 Ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, peemimunyu ‘na’ tsɔɔ wɔ peelɔ “Kojo” e ngɛngɛ mi. Ja nɔuu kɛ 
nɛ peemimunyu ‘gbe’ tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ ‘a’ kaa peelɔ ekpa ngɛ munyuza a mi ɔ pee.
3. Peemimunyu tsuɔ ni kaa peemi ɔ yi ngɛ munyuza a mi. Nɔhyɛ nɔ:
a. Lɔle wayoo ɔ maa fo wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
 Peemimunyu “ma fo” peeɔ yi kɛ haa peemi ‘maa fo wawɛɛ nitsɛ.’

NYA TSƆƆMI
Mi gbami nɛ ɔ hyɛ saneyo slɔɔtohi. Saneyo ngmami jeɔ kɛtsɛ klɛdɛɛ ko kpo ngɛ 
Gana gbihi, Aflaane gbi kɛ blema sanehi a ngmami mi.
Wa sɛsɛ munyutso nɛ ɔ bɔɔ he ni ngɛ wa ni kasemi nɛ be ɔ mi. O ma nyɛ kai nɔ 
nɛ ji munyuza oti lo? Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ sɛsɛ he konɛ nyɛɛ ngma nyɛ heto ɔmɛ.
Jahanɛ ɔ, moo ngɔ o heto ɔ kɛ to nɔ nɛ ngɛ ningma tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.
Loko ni kasemi ɔ maa ba nyagbe ɔ, kaselɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛ e;
1. ngma amaniɛbɔ saneyo
2. ngma kalemi saneyo
3. ngma peemiblɔnɔ saneyo
Otihi
• Saneyo ji ni ngmami blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ a guɔ kɛ jeɔ juɛmi aloo susumi kpo. 
Saneyo tsuaa saneyo jeɔ oti pɔtɛɛ ko kpo.
• Nyɛ maa kase saneyo slɔɔto etɛ a he ni.
o Amaniɛbɔ saneyo ji nyazia nyatsɔɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ kɔɔ oti pɔtɛɛ ko 
he. Ekomɛ ji bɔ nɛ nɔ ko ma je e nile kpo kɛ gu amaniɛbɔ he blɔ nɔ 
tomi ɔ nɔ.
o Kalemi saneyo ji saneyo nɛ kaleɔ nɔ ko: nihi, nɔ ko (adesa), he, nɔ nɛ 
o gu mi kɛ be hyɛ, he numi, nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae, kɛ ekpa komɛ.
o Peemiblɔnɔ saneyo ji saneyo nɛ tsɔɔ nɔ ko peemi. A gbaa munyutso ɔ 
mi fitsofitso kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ ɔ peemi bɔ aloo peemi blɔ nɔ.
• Saneyo fɛɛ saneyo ngɛ e ngmami blɔ nɔ tomi pɔtɛɛ nɛ a kɛ ngmaa lɛ.

MUNYUZA OTI KƐ AKPLAHE MUNYUZA
Munyuza oti ji munyuza nɛ tsɔɔ yi mi tomi oti pɔtɛɛ nɛ ngɛ kuku ngɛ saneyo ko 
mi ɔ mi. Akplahe munyuza ji munyuza nɛ yeɔ bua munyuza oti ɔ sisi numi.
Saneyo
Kɛtsɛ nɛ he hiaa kɛ ha saneyo ngmami. E sa nɛ o to yi mi tomi ɔ nya ngɛ kuku ɔ 
mi saminya. Enɛ ɔ ma nyɛ ya nɔ kɛ gu munyutso ɔ mi gbami, munyuhi a nya tomi 
nyatsɔɔ, nɔ mi mami kɛ he odase yemi, nɔ kɛ he tomi kɛ ekpa komɛ.
Saneyo ji ni ngmami blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ a guɔ kɛ jeɔ juɛmi aloo susumi kpo. Saneyo 
tsuaa saneyo jeɔ oti pɔtɛɛ ko kpo
Wa sɛsɛ saneyo slɔɔto etɛ he ni ngɛ mi gbami nɛ ɔ mi. Wa je sisi kɛ amaniɛbɔ 
saneyo.
Amaniɛbɔ saneyo
Amaniɛbɔ saneyo ji nyazia nyatsɔɔ nɛ bɔɔ nɔ ko he amaniɛ ngɛ oti pɔtɛɛ ko he. 
Nihi nɛ ji anɔkuale aloo nihi nɛ pi anɔkuale jeɔ kpo ngɛ amaniɛbɔ saneyo ngmami 
mi. Saneyo ɔ lomi hii nyatsɔɔ. A ngmaa amaniɛbɔ saneyohi ngɛ benɛbe mi ngɛ 
nihi a he susumi he. A tsuɔ he numi nihi kɛ munyuhezawoli a he ni konɛ tue buli 
nɛ na he numi.
Amaniɛbɔ saneyo bimi nɔhyɛ nihi
• Ngmaa saneyo kɛ kɔ o kekle ligbi ngɛ sukuu he.
• Ngmaa saneyo kɛ kɔ buajɔ blɔ hami ko nɛ o hɛ be nɔ jee gbleegbleegblee ɔ 
he.
• Ngmaa saneyo kɛ kɔ nɔ ko nɛ o kase ngɛ mo nitsɛ o he.
• Ngmaa saneyo kɛ kɔ ni kasemi ko nɛ o na kɛ gu nɔ ko nɛ o pee ngɛ blɔ 
kpɛkpɛɛ nɔ ɔ he.
Ni tsumi 5.1
He nuumi enyɔɔnyɔ kɛ tsu ni: Ngmaa munyuza oti kake kɛ akplahe 
munyuzahi enyɔ ngɛ fɔmi ligbi yemi ko he.

Kalemi saneyo
Mɛni ji kalemi saneyo?
E ji saneyo nɛ kaleɔ nihi, nihi (adesahi), he, nɔ nɛ o gu mi kɛ be hyɛ, he numi ngɛ 
blɔ klɛdɛɛ ko nɔ kɛ ekpa komɛ konɛ o kɛ bli nɔ nɛ o ngɛ kalee ɔ he foni nya kɛ ha 
e kaneli. E sa nɛ o to nya saminya nɛ gbi ɔ he ni tsumi nɛ je kpo kɛ gbla tue buli 
a juɛmi kɛ ba nɔ nɛ a ngɛ kanee ɔ nɔ.
Kalemi saneyo he blɔ nɔ tomi
Kalemi saneyo he blɔ nɔ tomi ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ saneyo nɛ wa kase he ni kɛ be ɔ ngɛ 
ɔ kɛ.
Nya blimi: E sa nɛ e je kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ he pɔtɛɛ nɛ saneyo ɔ kɔɔ. Tsu bimi nɛ hia 
we heto he ni kɛ tsɛ kaneli a juɛmi se kɛ wo ni kanemi ɔ mi.
Munyutso mi kukuhi: Hiɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a gbaa nihi nɛ a yaa tu he munyu ɔ kpɛ kɛ 
tsɔɔ. Munyutso oti ɔ nɛ je sisi numi kpo ngɛ munyutso kuku fɛɛ kuku mi kɛ gbla 
kaneli ɔmɛ juɛmi kɛ wo ni kanemi ɔ mi. Be fɛɛ be nɛ nɔ ko maa ngma kuku ehe 
ɔ, e sa nɛ yi mi tomi ehe nɛ je kpo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hulɔ.
Nya muɔmi: Yi mi tomi oti ɔmɛ nɛ o tu a he munyu ngɛ kuku ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, wo a 
nɔ ta ekohu aloo o do otihi nɛ ya nɔ ngɛ saneyo ɔ mi ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ wa kase 
ngɛ kuku ngmami mi ɔ.
Kalemi saneyo nɔhyɛ nihi
• Sɛni ngɔngɔɛ ko kalemi.
• Kale juɛmi ngɛ he yemi kɛ nɔ yemi he.
• Womi ko nɛ o suɔ wawɛɛ kalemi.
• Kale o kekle blɔ hiami nɛ o hia kɛ ya ma se.
• Kale o huɛ nɛ o suɔ saminya.

Peemiblɔnɔ Saneyo
Enɛ ɔ ji saneyo nɛ gblaa kanelɔ ɔ juɛmi kɛ baa munyutso ɔ he. A gbaa munyutso 
ɔ mi fitsofitso kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ ɔ peemi bɔ aloo peemi blɔ nɔ.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ a guɔ kɛ ngmaa peemiblɔnɔ saneyo
Loko o ma nyɛ ngma peemiblɔnɔ saneyo saminya a, e sa nɛ o nu munyutso ɔ sisi. 
Bimi nɔhyɛ ni komɛ ji nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ nɛ;
1. Mɛni he je e sa nɛ nihi a tsa nɔ nɛ a hi je mi nihi kasee?
2. Sɛsɛ se nami nɛ ngɛ yi mi puɛmi tsami he.
3. Tsɔɔ nyagba nɛ ngɛ tso poomi nɛ a du we kɛ ma nane mi ɔ he.
4. Bɔ nɛ sosia midia ngɛ wa ni kasemi blɔ nɔ tomi awi yee.
Ke o yaa ngma peemiblɔnɔ saneyo ko ɔ, e sa nɛ o tsu blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ a he ni.
a. Kane bimi ɔ saminya.
b. Kane nihi nɛ o kase kɛ be ngɛ saneyo ɔ he ɔ ekohu. Bɔɔ mɔde kaa o ma bi 
o tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nɛ e gba nihi a mi kɛ ha mo. Kane munyutso ɔ he ni ngɛ klamahi 
aloo womi kpahi a mi.
c. Ngɔɔ bimi ɔ kɛ wo munyutso nɛ sisi numi ngɛ a mi.
d. Moo pee mo nitsɛ o blɔ nya tom.
e. Moo ngma nya blimi kpitii ko kɛ je o saneyo ɔ sisi.
Yi mi susumi ni tsumi: Benɛ o kane blɔ nya tomi ɔ ta kɛ ha peemiblɔnɔ saneyo ɔ 
ngmami ɔ, mɛni kɛtsɛhi o maa suɔ nɛ o je ngɛ saneyo ɔ ngmami mi?
Peemiblɔnɔ saneyo he blɔ nɔ tomi
Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔmɛ ji blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ a kɛ ngmaa peemiblɔnɔ saneyo.

INTRODUCTION
This section discusses concepts under oral and written literature of a Ghanaian 
language. You will be introduced to the idea of libation under oral literature. You 
will be introduced to their significance and how they are performed. Discussions 
also focus on the importance of prayer, and why we make prayers. You will be 
encouraged to contribute to finding out why libation prayer is important among 
your people. This section is essential for you in the context of Ghanaian language 
studies and to establish links with related subjects such as Religious Studies. The 
section will equip you with the requisite skills to appreciate your culture and the 
cultures of other groups. The section also introduces you to the concept of funeral 
dirge among the Ghanaian community. You will be taken through a discussion 
on the funeral dirges among your people. You will look at some texts on some 
funeral dirges. Discussions will focus on the functions of the dirge. In addition, 
this section introduces you to the concept and elements of prose. Your teacher 
will facilitate discussions on the different elements of prose, which will include 
characters, themes, plot, setting, point of view and others.

Otihi
• Tɛlimi peeɔ kusumi kue fami blɔ nɔ tomi.
• Tɛlimi blɔ nɔ tomi etɛ pɔtɛɛ nɛ ngɛ. Mɛ ji: tɛlimi ɔ sisije/palemi, sɛgbi ɔ 
hami, tɛlimi ɔ nyagbe.
• Munyu oti ɔ ji juɛmi pɔtɛɛ nɛ nyazia nyatsɔɔ hɛɛ.
• Nyazia a lomi bɔ ji bɔ nɛ a plɛ kɛ lo nyazia a ha.
• He ya peeɔ he ko kɛ be pɔtɛɛ mi nɛ nyazia a ya nɔ ngɛ.
• Juɛmi kpo jemi ji nɔ nɛ nɔ ko da nɔ kɛ ngɛ nyazia a ngmae.
• Yana gbi tsuɔ ni kaa bɔ yemi la, nɔ ko nɛ si je mi, nɔ ko bimi, blɔ nɔ nɛ a 
kɛ he numi sɛgbi maneɔ nɔ kɛ ekpa komɛ.
TƐLIMI
Ni kasemi ɔ ma tsu tɛlimi blɔ nya tomi pɔtɛɛ etɛ ɔmɛ a he. E ma tsu tɛlimi ɔ sisije, 
sɛgbi ɔ hami kɛ tɛlimi ɔ nyagbe he ni.
Mɛni ji tɛlimi?
Tɛlimi ji blɔ nɔ nɛ nimli aloo adesahi guɔ nɛ a kɛ Tsakuetsɛ Ongmo Lao Siada 
tuɔ munyu. Dangme je ɔ tsuo he ye kaa Lao Siada kle kulaa pe adesa nɛ adesa be 
e he nyɛe maa su gbleegbleegblee. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a kɛ lɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ guɔ mumi 
mitsɛmɛ komɛ kaa jemɛawɔhi, kpadehi, zugba zu kɛ jemɛli aloo wɔhi a nɔ. A 
ngɔɔ nyu aloo da kɛ pueɔ zugba ejakaa a he ye kaa Tsaatsɛ Mawu yo ji Zugba zu 
nɛ ke a kɛ sɛgbi gu e nɔ ɔ, e kɛ ma ha e huno ɔ ma. Ngɛ maje he komɛ ɔ, a ngɔɔ 
blɛfo, ngma aloo omɔ kɛ tɛliɔ. Ayim-Aboagye (1993: 165 as cited in 1996:9) tsɔɔ 
nya kaa, e ji blɔ nɔ nɛ a woɔ nyu, akpɛtɛsi aloo da kpa komɛ kaa wai aloo kɔtsi kɛ 
pueɔ si konɛ a kɛ tsɛ mumihi nɛ a ba ye kɛ bua mɛ. Ngɛ maje he komɛ ɔ, a ngɔɔ 
blɛfo, ngma aloo omɔ kɛ tɛliɔ. Tɛlimi tsuɔ ni pɔtɛɛ ko ngɛ Aflikatsɛmɛ a kpɛti. 
Kɛ gu tɛlimi nɔ ɔ, a fɔɔ nimeli nɛ si je mi nine kɛ baa ma nya buami slɔɔtohi a mi 
konɛ a ba ye kɛ bua mɛ. Ngɛ Gana a, weku kpokploo nya dalɔ kɛ nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ 
tɛliɔ ngɛ he nya buami pɔtɛɛ komɛ kaa biɛ womi be, yo he ni tsumi be, jeha yemi 
be, matsɛ womi be kɛ be kpa komɛ.

Tɛlimi blɔ nɔ tomi
Tɛlimi blɔ nɔ tomi ɔmɛ ji: tɛlimi ɔ sisije, sɛgbi ɔ hami kɛ tɛlimi ɔ nyagbe.
Tɛlimi sisije/Palemi
Ngɛ tɛlimi sisije ɔ, a tsɛɔ mumi mitsɛmɛ tsuo. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tɛlie ɔ jeɔ sisi ngɛ Tsaatsɛ 
Mawu kɛ e yo Zugba zu a nɔ, kɛkɛ e tsɛ jemɛawɔhi, kpadehi/nimeli nɛ si, sɛhi, 
yohi, pahi kɛ ekpa komɛ. Tsɛmi nɛ ɔ ji blɔ nɔ nɛ a guɔ kɛ fɔɔ Opemɛno ɔ kɛ mumi 
mitsɛmɛ nine ngɛ nɔ nɛ a yaa pee ɔ he. Nɔhyɛ nɔ: tɛlimi ngɛ Dangme je.
Tsaatsɛ Mau, o nyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!,
Zugbazu, o nyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
Nɛnɛ Agu, tee si nɛ o ngɔ o nyu.
Ke o te si pɛ, o tsɛɛ o tsɛ Zuta
Nɛ e ma tsɛ o nɛ hulɔ.
Nyɛ hiɔmi nyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Sɛgbi ɔ hami
Sɛgbi nɛ ngɛ tɛlimi ɔ mi ɔ tsɔɔ nɔ pɔtɛɛ he nɛ a ngɛ tɛlie ngɛ. Enɛ ɔ ma nyɛ pee 
nɔ ko nɛ a ngɛ bie aloo sina nɛ a ngɛ hae. Ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tɛlie ɔ deɔ nimeli 
kɛ jemɛawɔ ɔmɛ nɔ he je nɛ e ngɛ mɛ tsɛe ngɛ kusumi ɔ peemi mi. Hiɛ ɔ ji he nɛ 
tɛlilɔ ɔ baa he piɛ pomi kɛ jeɔ a dɛ.
Tɛlimi nyagbe
Tɛlimi nyagbe ɔ ji he nɛ a naa nimeli ɔmɛ si ngɛ aloo a woɔ mɛ si kaa a maa pee 
nɔ ko pɔtɛɛ kɛ ha mɛ aloo kɛ ha wɔ ɔmɛ ke a ha a ni bimi ɔmɛ a heto ta. Tɛlilɔ ɔ 
biɔ jemɛawɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ gbiɛmi kɛ fɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɛ hɛɛ yi mi susumi yaya kɛ ha 
blɔ nya tomi ɔ. E biɔ gbaami kɛ haa nihi nɛ hɛɛ juɛmi kpakpa kɛ ha ma nɔ yami.

Tɛlimi he se namihi
Tɛlimi he ngɛ se namihi kaa bɔ nɛ jami kpa amɛ hu a kue fami he ngɛ se nami ɔ.

vi. E kɛ bu haa nimeli nɛ kpa sɛ.

BƆ YEMI/YANA GBI
Yi mi susumi bimi
Kɛ e peeɔ mo kɛɛ ke nɔ ko gbo mo?
Mɛni ji Yana gbi?
E ji bɔ yemi la aloo aywilɛho/kɔmɔ yemi la nɛ a kɛ yeɔ bɔ kɛ haa nɔ ko nɛ ho 
wena hue aloo anɔse we/gbeje ya. E ma nyɛ pee mɔbɔ aloo kɔmɔ yemi la nɛ a laa 
ngɛ gbi blɛuu mi kɛ yeɔ mɔbɔ/kɔmɔ kɛ haa nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ. A hyɛɔ yana gbi kaa asilɛ. 
Ngɛ gbi kpa mi ɔ, yana gbi ji asilɛ nɛ a kɛ jeɔ gbogboe yi.
Yana gbi blɔ nɔ tomihi
1. A kɛ yeɔ mɔbɔ ha gbogboe ɔ.
2. A kɛ woɔ gbogboe ɔ blɔ.
3. A kɛ haa sɛgbi kɛ ya haa nihi nɛ gbo kɛ sɛ hlami.
4. A kɛ baa gbaami kɛ jeɔ gbogboe ɔ dɛ.
5. A kɛ jeɔ a tsui mi nihi kpo.
Yana gbi he se namihi:
1. A kɛ yeɔ kɔmɔ ha nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ.
2. A kɛ tsɔɔ tsakpa nɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ ya nɔ kɛ be kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae amlɔ nɛ ɔ,

3. A kɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ nɔ laa mɛ ha.
4. E tsɔɔ tsakpa nɛ ngɛ weku bimɛ a kpɛti.
5. E tsɔɔ he tsukɔmi kɛ ha gbogboe ɔ
