BOBOOM
Popwara kanto bwɛ Ghana ne, ba na pae yera ba sale wa/wa-blwa tei ko tɔge de 
nabaara dwoa yam de yera yam kuri na nuŋi mɛ to mo. N na zeina se n lware kolo 
na pa se ba pae yera ba sale wa-balwa to de ko na jege ŋwaane tei se ba pa yera 
yam konto to. Zamesem dento wó zeini-m se n ni yera pam kuri chekke se ko pa 
n ta-n nege ya ye n swoi debam Ghana tiina nabaara kikia. Popwara kam ta tɛ 
chullu keim natɔga kalo na bere nɔn-keiri to mo (nɔn-keiri chullu). Bobwea yam 
wó nii wonnu telo na ke: te daare se nɔn-keiri chullu kikia yam laam bobo, chullu 
tem keim maŋa ne, chullu tem keim kwaga ne ko tɔge de nabaara kikia dwi dwi 
na wo Ghana ne to. N ta wó zamese chullu keim na jege nyɔɔre tei ko pae balo 
na wó ke te, ba tiina de ba kateiri dem maama to. N jege se n wane n maŋe chullu 
kikia yam wonnu telo na nye daane de telo na sere daane ko tɔge dwoa yadwonna 
yam baŋa ne Ghana ne to.
Popwara kanto beene se ka ti to, n wane n:
• Zane n nii wa/wa-balwa yera ko zege ya kuri na nuŋi mɛ de kolo ŋwaane 
ba pɛ ya to.
• Bwɛ chwei selo ba na tɔge da ba maa ke nɔn-keiri to (nɔn-keiri chullu: se 
te laam bobo, te keim maŋa ne de te keim kwaga ne).
• Kwei chwei selo ba na tɔge da ba maa ke nɔn-keiri chullu Ghana kateira 
yadwonna ne to n ma-n maŋe daane.
 Boboŋ-kura
• Yera yadwonna pae ya sale wa-balwa (ba sɛ naa kolo na mɔɔne ba to) mo.
• Ya kuri zege wonnu na jege dam ye dé ba nae te de yia to baŋa ne mo.
• Ya pae ko bere balo na jege yera yam konto dwi to kuri na nuŋi mɛ to.

YERA NA SALE DE WA/WA-BALWA TO
Yera yadwonna wora ba na kwei ba pae nɔɔna ko tɔge de ba boŋem na ye kolo de 
wonnu telo ba na kaane to ye te jege daane naa zeina te pae ba to mo. Yanto mo 
ba bwoi we wa/wa-balwa yera to. Se n wane n ga n ni wa/wa-balwa yera kuri, n 
jege se n lware wa/wa-balwa na ye kolo to mo.
Wa/wa-balwa ye bɛ mo?
Wa naa wa-balwa ye wonnu mo chichira (jworo wo dam) na zoa ye dé pae te 
zula ye dé kaane te de ta maa jege te chega. Maana mo ye tangwana, jwona naa 
bwi. Debam nabaara jege boŋem wonnu tem konto wone we te jege dam ye te 
wó wane te toŋe kolo dé na lage to. Wa-balwa yanto wae ya ye baara naa kaana. 
Wa yanto yadwonna ba na kaane to ye Zeus, Apollo, Athena, Ares, Aphrodite, 
Poseidon, Hades, Thanatos, Dionysus, Hera, Artemis, Hephaestus de Hermes. 
Wa yam konto nuŋi faŋa Giriiki teo kom mo. Faŋa Norse wɛchwoŋa kam ne de, 
wa nenɛɛne Hor, Odin, Tyr, Frey, Freya, Baldur de Loki mo wora ye ba nege ya 
chekke. Ghana ne, rigini maama naa dwi maama jege wa-balwa ba na sɛ ba pa ya 
ye ba kaane ya to. Wa yanto yadwonna mo ye:
i. Kasem: Kukula, Yeilinkuuri, Dɔlɔ, Zekko, etc.
ii. Ankara tiina: Dantu, Nae, Sakumɔ, Kɔɔle, Klote, La Kpa, etc.
iii. Gambwɛ: Kune, Tegare, Nyamaa, etc.
iv. Dagwana: Tambo, etc
Wa/wa-balwa yɔ mo abam kateiri dem nɔɔna yei chekke?
Wa/wa-balwa yera
Wa/wa-balwa yera ye yera mo na sale wa ye ba laam kwei ya ba pae nɔɔna ko 
tɔge de ba boŋem na ye kolo de wonnu telo ba na kaane to. Wa/wa-balwa yera 
yam yeini ya ye yera mo ba na pae nɔɔna ko tɔge de dwi, kateiri/daa, wɛ-chwoŋa 
de nabaara yam na sɛ ya pa kolo/wɛ delo to mo.

Yera yadwonna na sale de wa/wa-balwa
Yera yadwonna na sale de wa/wa-balwa to maana mo tento Ghana ne:
1. Ayigwei tiina dwi delo ba bwoi we Anlo to kaane jwoni dedwoŋi de yere mo 
“Afa”. De ye wa-balaŋa mo ye wolo na kaane de to ba bwoi o we, Bokɔ to 
bu-kwea yeini o jege yere mo ba bwoi we, Amuzu ye dento bere we o kwo 
mo kaane ‘Afa’.
2. Ko na tu Gambwɛ tei ne, dɛ de de wa mo, konto mo pa se ba ná loge-m dɛ 
delo to mo ba yeini ba kwei dɛ dem konto wɛ dem yere mo ba pa-m. Maana: 
Adwo na ye Totoŋa bobo wɛ dem yere to, ba ná loge busankana Totoŋa 
bobo dɛ ne, ba bwoi o we, Adwoa ye bakeira ye Kwadwo.
3. Ko na tu debam Kasena ŋwea ne, ko ye nɔɔno wom sɛ (wɛ) na ye kolo to 
mo ba pae yera yam ba sala. Maana: Tɔnɔsɛ, Kaperakuu, Apɛyuusi, Naabu, 
Zekkosɛ, Nayeimsɛ, Pewurayere, Katɔgɔsɛ, Kadɔlɔ, Nabaaresɛ, Kaluu, 
Kwarayewɛ, Yɔrɔ, Azolira, etc.
Kwaane se-n bwoŋi wa yam yera maana yam baŋa ne to n nii n tetere ne. Bwoŋi 
n bere n bereno wom se o nii n beeri dem na tɔge da. N yei wa yadwonna yera 
abam kateiri dem ne na?
Yera na sale wa/wa-balwa to kura na nuŋi mɛ
Yera na sale wa/wa-balwa to kura na nuŋi mɛ to ye dwi dwi mo ye ko ta sere 
daane dwi maama wone ko tɔge de dwi dem na pae ba yera tei to mo. ko na ye 
Ayigwei tiina, banto kwei ba yera na sale de wa yam to ba nuŋi ba nabaara wa 
ne mo, Gambwɛ maa kwei ba nuŋi bwi yera ne, Dangme tiina de maa kwei ba 
nuŋi ba wɛ delo na fɔge de mɔɔne wonnu to ne mo. Kasena kwei ba nuŋi bwi, 
tamgwana, jwona de nabaara baŋa ne mo.
Abam yei á yera yam kuri na nuŋi mɛ na?
Kolo ŋwaane ba pae yera ba sale wa/wa-balwa to
Ko kuri mo wora ye nɔɔna jege yera na sale de wa/wa-balwa to. Yera na sale wa/
wa-balwa to wae ko ye se ko maa bere wa yam konto na ke kolo ya pa nɔɔno 
wom naa dwi dem to mo. Tedwonna de wae ko ye we ba nɛ wa yam lane mo ye 
yadwonna ye kolo na bere dwi to ŋwaane mo naa ko ye kolo na maa seini wa yam

Ko woli da, woŋo yiniga na jege nɔɔno pa o tiŋi ni de wa yanto ye o na kolo o

su kolo y ana key a pa-o to. Maŋa kadwoŋi ne de, kaane de o baro ná jege lora 
cham, ba yeini ba tiŋi ni mo de wa yam konto se ba kwei de yere dem ba pa ba bu

Wa/wa-balwa yera jege wola yadwonna mo ko pae balo na jɔɔne de to ŋwea

naa ya na jege dam na maa pɔe bia bam to.

wora dé bwɛ ywo to bere bero mo ye ba bwoi ya we nɔn-keiri chullu mo.
Chulu keim natɔga
Nɔn-keiri chullu natɔge selo dwi dwi na wora to ye nabaara dwoa yam na sere 
daane tei to ŋwaane mo. Dé wó bwɛ ko tɔge de yiga na wó ti tei se chulu kom 
bobo, chulu kom keim maŋa ne, de chulu kom keim kwaga ne to bobwea.

Nye Daane
Busankane Nɔn-keiri chullu
1. Se chulu kom bobo
 Maŋa kalo tiina na maane we leira yadwonna tu ba busankana kam yera to, 
ba yeini ba bobo yiga tiim mo se chulu keim dem ke.
 Kuni dedɛ tiina na maane we busankana kam bobo ka wɔ wo naa ka na ka 
zarem mo ba yeini ba pa ba tɔge nɛ sento dwonna:
9

a. Ka-pɔɔre ba ba yera se ba pa nikaana ko tɔge nɔn-keiri chullu keim baŋa 
ne.
b. Busankane sem tiina laam wó ta de na-kwe naa kazem wolo na nii chulu 
kom keim baŋa ne to ba boboŋe dem we ba bukwa bam yi chulu keim.
c. Kazena balo na nii busankam-pwoli sento dwonna (kanyɛ) baŋa ne to 
laam wó la ba ba ke diga dedoa ne ye ba pa ba kwia se ba lware totoŋ-nɛ 
selo na maŋe nenɛɛne banzore wonnu, kanɔ totoŋa de tedwonna.
d. Busankam-pwoli sem wó na bera sɔŋɔ totoŋa baŋa ne nenɛɛne saŋem, 
weeru zwarem, zela zarem, de ye-tega kwɛɛm maama.
e. Ba ta zamese jeŋa totoŋa ne sare de tetwaro sɔɔm, zwanno keim, kamɔro 
mɔɔnem de yadwonna.
f. Ba ta zamese nabaara lei de sɛ dwi dwi ye ba lware kaane na jege se jeini 
tei to.
g. Ba ta jwoŋi bera ko tɔge de sarepeiga keim seeni ba na wora ba ti ba yiga 
se jwa seeni se ba wane baro sɔŋɔ ne ba zo to ŋwaane.
2. Chulu kom keim maŋa ne
 Chulu kom keim maŋa ne, wolo na ye kaanem tu to/ kangwoŋa kalo na 
lage o ke chulu kom o pa busankam-pwoli sem to yeini o ke wonnu tento 
tedwonna mo.
 Kangwoŋa kam /kazem wom de kateiri dem nakwa naa balo na lage ba 
ke chulu kom to de wó ke na-lworo se ko pa chulu keim dem ke de tɔge 
chwoŋa. Na-lworo kom kwaga ne, ba laam maa bobo de chulu kom keim na 
ye tei chekke to:
a. Kikia se ko maane ba chɔgem naa ba na lware baara lela. Dwoa yadwonna 
ke wonnu tento mo se ba maa nii busankane sem chɔge naa ba wo chɔge 
ne ba na wó jeini ba chulu kandwɛ-zwoni baŋa ne, ba swɛ nabara ne, de 
kikia yadwonna. Amaa Kasena chulu kom keim maŋa ne mo kangwoŋa 
kam tetere yeini o lware we busankana kam chɔge ka-tetere naa ka wo 
chɔge.
b. Kazem wom naa kangwoŋa kam laam wó fane busankam-pwoli sem 
pumpuru koro tem.
c. Chulu kom / gwoŋa kam tete keim ne, ba liŋi ba bobɔɔ, ba jeini ba sara 
wone, nantana ne naa yutuŋu baŋa ne.
d. Ba maa wó saŋe wodiiru dwi dwi (chechare-saŋe, pea, mum-pi, de 
tedwonna) ba pa ba.

Ka-yeiri Nɔn-keiri chullu Daane: Wonnu na sere daane tei 
dwoa yalo na wo Ghana ne to nabaara kikia maŋa ne.
Chulu kikia yalo na nye daane to kwaga ne, tedwonna wora te na sere daane ye 
temto mo dé wó bwɛ te bobwea kuri me.
Ayigwei tiina
1. Ko tɔge kateiri dem de kolo ŋwaane de na ke chulu kom to mo, chulu kom 
keim wó wane de kwei wiiki dedwe se ko vo ko yi chana dedoa.
2. Busankam-pwoli sem yeini ba wo sɔŋɔ kom kwaga ne mo ye ba yuudwonna 
de ba badwonna laam kwogili ba ye ba ke kwɛɛra maŋa kam konto.
3. Chulu keim dem maŋa ne ye ba di chechare dem to, ba nae ko pa ko ye 
maŋem mo na pae busankam sem lora to.

Krobo tiina
1. Krobo tiina bam ke chulu keim dem ba bwoi we Dipo to, ye ba yeini ba leiri 
Tega kam yere na ye Nene Kloweki to yuu ne mo ba pa tɔla. Ba kwei da 
yanu mo ba maa ke chulu kom Gungunfugu chana kam ne.
2. Se ko daare se chulu kom keim dɛ yi to, busankam-pwoli sem tiina yeini ba 
kwei ba mo ba bere wolo na ke kaanem ba diga kam ne ye o nii Dipo keim 
baŋa ne to.
3. Chulu kom keim maŋa ne, kaanem tu wom wó lwo na o daare o ke wonnu 
ne ka-fane ba yuu dɛ sem, ka-jeini nantana baŋa ne de tedwonna.
Ankara tiina
1. Ankara tiina wae ba ke chulu kom banto bwoi we Otofo to busankana ŋwea 
ne lela naa ko wae ko ye maŋa kalo maama na maŋe to.
Gambwɛ
1. Chulu kom keim yeini ko kwei da nana mo ye ko bobo Totoŋa boboa dɛ ne 
naa Totoŋa da-yalei dɛ ne mo.
2. Se chulu kom bobo, pa-kana kam yeini o zane busankane sem mo o nii 
jworo wone de yetega wone se lware ba yei baara naa ba yeiri se o daare o 
nii ba wolo na jege puga de.
Debam Kasena ke nɔn-keiri chullu tɛ mo? Boboŋe n nii.
Bakeiri Nɔn-keiri chullu
Bakeiri nɔn-keiri chullu keim dage kolo kateira dedɛ na ke Ghana ne to.Yalo 
fee ba na ke to mo ye kolo Ayigwei tiina na bwoi we, “Tudedeasi”, Sissala tiina 
de maa bwoi we, Baala; Ankara tiina de bwoi ba nyem kom we, Plamatsemɔ/
Butrumwɔɔ/Deŋtuwoo; ye Vagla maa bwoi we, Pellaa to mo. Kuni dedɛ, bakeiri 
nɔn-keiri chullu keim dae kolo na ke de kɔgɔ naa jeiro to. Maana, Ayigwei tiina 
yeini ba kwei peɔ mo ba pa bakeir-pwola ye ba we o taa mae o nii o sɔŋɔ tiina 
baŋa ne o daare o taa mae ko o tɔɔna.
Natɔge sem sedwonna mo tento:
1. ka-pɔɔre bakeir-pwoli sem se yera
2. Ba bere ba ba na wó nii ba tetere baŋa ne tei to, ba totoŋa na ye yalo to de 
sarepeiga kikia.
3. Ka-bere ba wonnu telo na bere we se laam ye baara to.
4. Ba ye-goa de ba na wó taa ke kaanem tei ba pae wa balwa yam to.
5. Ba bere ba nabaara wonnu kikia.

Nɔn-keiri chullu wola
1. Ko bere bero/nɔn-keiri.
2. Pae busankane de bakeiri sem ywono de wonnu telo na wó woli ba se ba 
maa ŋo ŋwea na lamma to.
3. Pae nɔɔna lware we busankane de bakeiri sem yi banzore de kadiri.
4. Ko ti bu-doŋo kom yiga ba yera wone de boboŋa/jworo wone se ba wane 
banzore naa kadiri wone.
5. Ko pae bu-doŋo kom (bakeir-pwoli sem de busankam-pwoli sem) nae bera 
ko tɔge de totoŋ-nɛ laaro telo ba na wó taa ke ba ŋwea ne.
6. Ko pae ba zamese ba nabaara wonnu.
7. Ko pae bu-doŋo kom ba chɔge ba tetere.
8. Ko woli pae busankam-pwoli sem nae wola se ba maa bobo jeŋa woŋo keim 
se ko zeini ba jwa.

KA-JWOORI-KA-MAANE BOBOŊA 
BWIA
Ka-jwoori-ka-maane boboŋa bwia wa yera baŋa 
ne
1. Maane abam kateiri dem ne se n popone yera yanu nɔɔna na pae ba diga 
kam dwi dem bia ye ya sale wa to.
2. Popone Kasena yera na sale de wa to yanu de ya kura na nuŋi mɛ to.
3. Popone wɛ delo na ye kaane to yere n tiŋi se n daare n popone yera yatɔ 
na sale de to.
4. Ta kolo ŋwaane nɔɔna na wó sɛ se ba kwei wa balwa yera ba maa pa ba 
bia abam kateiri dem ne to.
5. Pa nyɔɔre wonnu tetɔ nɔɔna balo na jege wa balwa yera to na nae.
Ka-jwoori-ka-maane boboŋa bwia nɔn-keiri 
chullu baŋa ne
1. Maŋe se ko veere nmo na nigi nɔn-keiri chulu kuri pa ko ye kolo to.
2. Pa n daare n maŋe se ko veere nyɔɔre wonnu tenu nmo kateiri dem na 
nae nɔn-keiri chullu keim baŋa ne to. Bɛ mo pae te jege nyɔɔre?
3. Maane n nii nɔn-keiri chullu kikia yam ne, te daa kɔ mo nmo boŋe we 
ko maŋe se dé fɔge dé nii te baa ne naa te za? Ta kolo ŋwaane nmo boŋe

 Ghana tiina nabaara dam dim yedaa
 Faŋa	 to	 maŋa	 kalo	 feila	 dam	 dim	 ta	 na	 wo	 zo	 kateira	 yam	 wone	 to,	
nabaara	dam	dim	mo	Ghana	kateira	yam	mae	ba	toŋa.	Dam	dim	dento

teo	kom	jaanem.	Pa-fara	bam	mo	ye	balo	na	wo	baŋa	natein-yia	yam	ne.

ko	zege	kateiri	nakwa,	pwa-balwa/pa-kandɛ	se	ko	vo	ko	yi	pɛ-faro	wom

Nabaara dam dim
Nabaara	dam	dim	ye	dam	dim	na	nuŋi	nabɔrɔ	kikia	de	ba	totoŋa	wone	to	mo.	
Nabaara	dam	dim	debam	Ghana	kateira	yam	ne	tigisi	mo	lanyerane	ne	natein-yia

wonnu na nye daane to.
Nabaara dam dim natein-yia dwi wone
Ghana	ne	ba	na	we	dwi	ko	wae	ko	ye	konkɔlɔ	dedoa	tiina	na	ye	kwo,	nu	de	ba	bia	
to	naa	sɔŋɔ	tiina	na	ye	konkɔlɔ	dedoa	tiina,	de	ba	chorro	tedwonna	ne,	nu/kwo	
nakwe,	nu/kwo	nyaana	de	zembaara,	nu/kwo	nakwa,	chorro	de	badwonna	maama	
mo.	Dé	na	maane	konto	dé	boboŋa	ne,	nabaara	dam	dim	natein-yia	dwi	wone	ye	
kwo,	sɔŋɔ	dwi	dem	yuu	tu,	diga	dwi	dem	yuu	tu,	nakwa,	pɛ-tiŋina,	pwa-balwa,	
pɛ-faro	de	badwonna	mo.	Konto	ye	dam	delo	de	dira	bam	na	mae	ywono	kolo	ba	
na	jege	nabaara	wonnu	baŋa	ne	to	mo	ba	maa	di	de.	Dam	dira	banto	kurim	zege	
nabɔrɔ	chwei	baŋa	ne	mo.

dwi	dem	yuu	tu?	Nmo	tɔge	n	wo	diga	dwi	wone	na?
Natein-yia	nyenyego	kom	bere	dam	dim	yedaa	kam	na	ye	tei	Ghana	kateira	yam

BOBOOM
Popwara kanto tɛ ni lara de poponem lara na ye kolo to mo Kasem taane dem ne. 
Popwara kanto wó ja n boboŋa ka vo na lwom/jwoni kaanem na tɔge de ye ni lara 
kikio to baŋa ne mo. Ka wó bere-m na lwom wola de ba na ke na lwom tei to. 
Bobwea yam ta wó ja-n boboŋa ya vo wɛ-lworo baŋa ne, de kolo ŋwaane dé na 
lwoori wɛ to. Nmo wó lelage n nii kolo ŋwaane nmo kateiri dem na tɔge na lwom 
baŋa de lwoori wɛ to. Popwara kanto jege ŋwaane ka pae nmo Kasem zamesem 
baŋa ne ye ka ta wó zeini nmo berem kateira yadwonna zamesem baŋa ne nenɛɛne 
Wɛchwoŋa de Ŋwea Naga na jege se ka taa ye tei to. Popwara kam wó zeini-m 
se n ta-n jege yi-suuri n pae n tetere dwi dem nabaara kikia de dwoa yadwonna 
nabaara kikia de. Popwara kam ta wó woli-m se n lware lusei na ye kolo Ghana 
teo kom ne to. Á wó ke bobwea lusei selo na wo abam kateiri dem ne to baŋa ne. 
N wó nii tapana na tɛ lusei taane to. A wó bwɛ lusei na toŋe kolo to bobwea. Se 
ko woli da, popwara kanto ta wó bere-m sensɔla na ye kolo de wonnu telo na wo 
sensɔla wone to. N bereno wom wó tɔge abam yiga se á bwɛ wonnu telo dwi dwi 
na wo sensɔla wone to, ye tento tedwonna mo ye keira, boboŋekurim, sensɔla 
naga, maŋa de jeiga, taro wom boboŋa, de tedwonna.
Popwara kanto tiim ne, n jege se n wane n:
• Zane na lwom yedaa na ye tei to Kasem ne (boboa kikia, kaanem / labaare 
dem tetere de gurim.)
• Bwɛ lusei bobwea ( se totoŋa de wola)) taro wom boboŋa na ye kolo to,, 
de tedwonna.
• Yɛ tapane na ye sensɔla to wone (tayuu, boboŋekurim, poponno botarebia 
kurim, nonoga taana, de tedwonna).

Boboŋ-kura
•  Na lwom ye nabaara wɛ-lworo mo.
• Na lwom na-tɔga kam pɔɔre ka zege kuni betɔ ':' Boboa kikia, kaanem / 
labaare dem tetere de gurim.
• Boboŋekurim dem mo ye sensɔla kam na tɛ kolo taane chekke to.
• Sensɔla naga ye kikia yam na vei tei sensɔla kam wone to.
• Jeiga de maŋa ye mɛ de maŋa kalo tete chekke sensɔla kam na ke to mo.
• Poponno boboŋe dem mo ye kolo na wo poponno wom yuu ne ye o wora 
o popone sensɔla kam konto to mo.
• Lua lei tɔge se ye ŋwea chullu wonnu mo na bere we, to wom nɔɔna sɛ 
we ba gɛ-o, to wom wo churu chwoŋa ne, ka ye chwoŋa mo nɔɔna na tɔge 
da ba mae ba ŋɔɔne de chira, to wom nɔɔna na mae ba bere ba boboŋa, de 
tedwonna.
NA LWOM
Dé wó bwɛ wonnu tetɔ telo tem na ye na lwom yedaa to bobwea. Na lwom yedaa 
kam ne, dé wó bwɛ wonnu tento tetɔ mo; boboa kikia, Kaanem / labaare dem 
tetere de gurim.
Na lwom ye kikio mo dé na ke dé mae dé kaane tangwana, jwona naa chira. Ko 
ye chwoŋa mo nɔɔna balo na tɔge nabaara wɛchwoŋa kam to na tɔge da ba mae 
ba ware wɛ. Kikio kolo dé bwoi we na lwom to ye na, mun-na, sana naa wodiiru 
tedwonna mo ba mae ba kaane tega kam naa wonnu tedwonna ne, tio, kandwɛ/peo, 
buga, etc, se ba ma ba lwoori ŋwea wonnu naa wola (Ayim-Aboagye, 1993: 165). 
Teene dedwonna ne, wodiiru tedwonna wae te mae te ke na lwom ne mumuna 
naa kamaana amaa Kasena nabaara ne, banto mae Kasena wodiiru telo maama 
dé nabaara bam deém na vare to mo ne mena de sunuga mo ba kaana. Ba ta mae 
nɔna de ba lwoi na. Konto maama ye koloŋwaane ye kaanem dem wora de ke to 
mo wó bere wonnu telo na wó ma te lwo na bam to. Na lwom debam Afereka ne 
ye wo-cheɔ mo kateira dedɛ ne. Konto ye chwoŋa mo naŋona na tɔge da ba mae 
ba ŋɔɔne de chira bam ye ba lwoori wola ba tei ne maŋa maama. Ghana ne, diga 
yuu tiina de kateiri dem nakwa wae ba lwoi na nabaara kikia yadwonna nenɛɛne 
bu yere pam, kadiri, paare tiŋim keim maŋa ne de tedwonna.

Gurim Dem
Konto mo ye kikio kom kwola; gurim dem jei ne mo na-lworu wom laam wó ke 
chira bam lei ye o daare o gwoni ni de ba ne, ba na ke o na lage kolo to ba pa-o

ba se ba chɔge puse-nyena boboŋa. O ta wó lwoori zaane o pa nɔɔna balo na zeini 
teo kom to. Wonnu tedwonna keim maŋa ne na-lworo yeini ko wora – bayaaro 
swɛɛm, chaa saŋem, bu doŋa sɛɛm/yere pam, etc. Nyenyero telo na wo kuri ne to 
bere Ghana ne dwoa yadwonna na lwoi ba na tei to mo.

LUA LEI
Ka-boŋe chekke bwia
Ko ye tɛ mo n yera ne maŋa kalo n yera nɔɔno na gɛ o ŋwea to?
Lua lei ye bɛ mo?
Lua lei ye lei selo ba na leeni lua maŋa ne de tigura wɛɛne se ko bere wo-chɔgɔ to 
mo. Kasena yeini ba leeni se lu-lea naa lu-fuli ne mo. Lua lei dwoa yam ye yatɔ 
mo: lusei, nagoro /tigura dedaane swogo lei. Selo ba na leeni kaane lua ne to ye 
lusei mo. Ba leeni se ba ma ba guli naa ba seini to wom mo ye se ta ye chulu woŋo 
de mo, se ta mae se kwei boboŋa. Dé ta wó ta we lua lei ye lei na leeni mɛɛmɛ ye 
se jege yu-vuru se leenim maŋa ne to mo. Lua lei ye seina taane mo ba na mae 
ba seini twa. Lua lei ye ŋwea chulu woŋo naa kikio mo ba na mae ba bane twa ba 
yage churu ne.
Kaane lua fulim ne de, ba yeini ba leeni swogo lei ko maŋe de ba na jeeri swogo 
kom ba beene naa ba na jege ko ba vei se ba lɔ.
Ko woli da, nagoro nye ne lusei mo tei ye sento ye tigura lei mo ba na leeni baaro 
lua ne ko maŋe de o na tege pwola ne ye ba zeŋe-o ba beene sɔŋɔ. Baaro lu-fuli 
ne de ba ta yeini ba mɔɔne nagoro, ye ba sae nagoro chwei zagem ne.
Lei sento maama ye lua lei mo na bere Kasena nabaara na ke tei ba bane ba chorro 
pae ba vei churu to.
Lua lei Totoŋa
i. Ko maa bere wo-chɔgɔ.
ii. Ko bere we twa de naŋona jege woŋo ba ke daane
iii. Ba tɔge lei sem baŋa ba maa pae labaare na jege ŋwaane to yi cheigina.
iv. Ko maa bane twa mo se ba yi churu.
v. Ko bere ba na gɛ ba nɔɔno tei to mo.
vi. Kateira yadwonna ne, lusei/nagoro ye fefeo chulu woŋo mo se ba ke toone 
ná goa.

SENSƆLA WO WONNU
Sensɔla
Sensɔla ye poponem lara dwoa yam dedoa mo. Ba kwei ŋwaŋa naa taane na 
popone tei to chwodɛ sem mo ba ma ba popone ka. Ka popone ka tɔge taane 
poponem wadɛ de taane na toŋe tei to mo pa ka lana. Ka ba popone ne seina taane 
tei, ka nam ba sɔɔna. Ka bere boboŋa, kikeeru, ye ka pae labaare yi garena.
Totoŋa 8.11
Maŋe se ko veere nmo na nigi sensɔla kuri pa ka ye kolo to se n daare n kwei 
n leira yam n ma-n maŋe de n dwonna bam nyena kelase dem ne to.
Sensɔle Wo Wonnu
1. Keira: Nɔɔno wolo, varem, naa kolo maama na ke totoŋe sensɔle wone 
to. Keira wae ba ye nabiina naa vara. Sensɔla lane maama zege keira bam 
totoŋ-nɛ na ye selo to baŋa ne mo. Keira sensɔla wone ye wo-cheɔ mo; ye 
keira dedɛɛra mo ye balo keim dem na saŋe naa de zege ba baŋa ne ye banto 
mo yeini ba na chane dem se ko bere sensɔla naga na vei tei to. Keira maana 
mo ye keiru dedɛɛro wolo na yeini o ni chane naa o yaare wonnu na vei tei 
to ŋwaane; keiru dedɛɛro wom dono/dom wom maa ye wolo na ke kikeeru 
se te taa daane naa te pae keiru dedɛɛro wom yaare to; keiru wolo na ba 
leiri o boboŋa sensɔla kam wone to de keiru wolo na leiri o boboŋa o toŋe 
wonnu se te taa vei de sensɔla kam nenɛɛne ko na maŋe tei to maama de ye 
keir-dwoa mo sensɔla wone.
2. Boboŋekurim: Konto mo ye sensɔla boboŋ-kuri naa ka nyɔɔne. Ko yeini 
ko zege keira bam kikeeru nenɛɛne bampono, negero naa wopwolo baŋa ne 
mo pae boboŋe dem nuŋi jase. Sensɔla wae ka jege boboŋekurim balwa na 
zeini pae boboŋekurim kamunu kom kuri zege chekke to.
3. Jei de maŋa: Konto ye labaare mo na bere jei naa maŋa kalo sensɔla kam 
na ke to. Ko na bere kolo to (tega baŋa ŋwea, faŋa wonnu, nabaara kikia naa 
tega siseina) ye te na mɛ te toŋe tei sensɔla wone to mo.
4. Sensɔla naga: Konto ye kikia na vei ya twoŋi daane tei sensɔla wone to 
mo. Ko ye nɔɔno na tigisi o boboŋa de o kikia sensɔla wone se ko bere ni-
sɛɛm, kazoe, de chane na pae wonnu vei tei to mo. Kikia yam na saŋe daane

 WIIRU DE BOBONA
 Bobona kadwoŋi deém mo wora ka nyea na gane ka pa se ka boŋe we 
ka de gaa laam ye bobɔlɔ mo ye ka wó wane ka nii ka tete baŋa ne. 
Dedaani dedoa, vara bam na nuŋi gaao ba beene sɔŋɔ to mo ka nu 
bwoŋi ka, bobona kam wo leiri ka nu ye ka wo ka gaao dim ne chore. 
Ko na ke fee pa se ka zeiŋi ka yuu to mo ka nɛ we vara bam maama kɛ.
 Ko laam daare kanto yerane mo. Wɛ maa to. Tega kam yibia bobo se ka 
zwori. Vio de maa bobo se ko taa dole pa se gaaro tem ke sɔɔ kolo na 
jege foone to. Bobona kam maa guli Wiiru wom gula pa se ka yera bobo 
se ya taa sae. Ka laam maa kare ka charega gaao kom wone ka beeri ka 
nu. Ka maŋe ka wo gɔge ka naga ye ka na Wiiru wom!
 Bobona kam lware we ka teena daa ba daga.
 “Jaanja, Wiiru,” ka bwoŋi o de foone, “A yei we n lage n di ne mo. 
Amaa leeni n pa ne se a lage se a sa a sam maama mo zem.”
 Wiiru wom yeini o swoi se o ke gegana fee mo se o laam daare o di, o 
laam maa bobo lei pa se bobona kam de to sam ne chore.
 Konto maama to ye vara bam ya vei mɛɛmɛ mo ba yɔɔre sɔŋɔ seeni. Ko 
nam na ye dedaani to, ko pɛ se Wiiru wom lei sem sɔɔ kom vo yiga yiga.

leeni leiŋa kalo o na yeini o leeni o daare o di to mo, ba maa ke lela ba

BOBOOM
Popwara kanto tɛ ni lara de poponem lara na ye kolo to mo Kasem taane dem ne. 
Popwara kanto wó ja n boboŋa ka vo na lwom/jwoni kaanem na tɔge de ye ni lara 
kikio to baŋa ne mo. Ka wó bere-m na lwom wola de ba na ke na lwom tei to. 
Bobwea yam ta wó ja-n boboŋa ya vo wɛ-lworo baŋa ne, de kolo ŋwaane dé na 
lwoori wɛ to. Nmo wó lelage n nii kolo ŋwaane nmo kateiri dem na tɔge na lwom 
baŋa de lwoori wɛ to. Popwara kanto jege ŋwaane ka pae nmo Kasem zamesem 
baŋa ne ye ka ta wó zeini nmo berem kateira yadwonna zamesem baŋa ne nenɛɛne 
Wɛchwoŋa de Ŋwea Naga na jege se ka taa ye tei to. Popwara kam wó zeini-m 
se n ta-n jege yi-suuri n pae n tetere dwi dem nabaara kikia de dwoa yadwonna 
nabaara kikia de. Popwara kam ta wó woli-m se n lware lusei na ye kolo Ghana 
teo kom ne to. Á wó ke bobwea lusei selo na wo abam kateiri dem ne to baŋa ne. 
N wó nii tapana na tɛ lusei taane to. A wó bwɛ lusei na toŋe kolo to bobwea. Se 
ko woli da, popwara kanto ta wó bere-m sensɔla na ye kolo de wonnu telo na wo 
sensɔla wone to. N bereno wom wó tɔge abam yiga se á bwɛ wonnu telo dwi dwi 
na wo sensɔla wone to, ye tento tedwonna mo ye keira, boboŋekurim, sensɔla 
naga, maŋa de jeiga, taro wom boboŋa, de tedwonna.
Popwara kanto tiim ne, n jege se n wane n:
• Zane na lwom yedaa na ye tei to Kasem ne (boboa kikia, kaanem / labaare 
dem tetere de gurim.)
• Bwɛ lusei bobwea ( se totoŋa de wola)) taro wom boboŋa na ye kolo to,, 
de tedwonna.
• Yɛ tapane na ye sensɔla to wone (tayuu, boboŋekurim, poponno botarebia 
kurim, nonoga taana, de tedwonna).

NA LWOM
Dé wó bwɛ wonnu tetɔ telo tem na ye na lwom yedaa to bobwea. Na lwom yedaa 
kam ne, dé wó bwɛ wonnu tento tetɔ mo; boboa kikia, Kaanem / labaare dem 
tetere de gurim.
Na lwom ye kikio mo dé na ke dé mae dé kaane tangwana, jwona naa chira. Ko 
ye chwoŋa mo nɔɔna balo na tɔge nabaara wɛchwoŋa kam to na tɔge da ba mae 
ba ware wɛ. Kikio kolo dé bwoi we na lwom to ye na, mun-na, sana naa wodiiru 
tedwonna mo ba mae ba kaane tega kam naa wonnu tedwonna ne, tio, kandwɛ/peo, 
buga, etc, se ba ma ba lwoori ŋwea wonnu naa wola (Ayim-Aboagye, 1993: 165). 
Teene dedwonna ne, wodiiru tedwonna wae te mae te ke na lwom ne mumuna 
naa kamaana amaa Kasena nabaara ne, banto mae Kasena wodiiru telo maama 
dé nabaara bam deém na vare to mo ne mena de sunuga mo ba kaana. Ba ta mae 
nɔna de ba lwoi na. Konto maama ye koloŋwaane ye kaanem dem wora de ke to 
mo wó bere wonnu telo na wó ma te lwo na bam to. Na lwom debam Afereka ne 
ye wo-cheɔ mo kateira dedɛ ne. Konto ye chwoŋa mo naŋona na tɔge da ba mae 
ba ŋɔɔne de chira bam ye ba lwoori wola ba tei ne maŋa maama. Ghana ne, diga 
yuu tiina de kateiri dem nakwa wae ba lwoi na nabaara kikia yadwonna nenɛɛne 
bu yere pam, kadiri, paare tiŋim keim maŋa ne de tedwonna.

Kaanem / labaare dem tetere
Kanto maŋa ne mo kolo tetere chekke ŋwaane kaanem dem na lage de ke to laam 
wó nuŋi kaanem tu/na-lworu wom ni. Ywo mo na-lworu wom wó lwoori wonnu 
telo maama o na lage to naa o bere yi-suuri de kolo maama na maŋe ko ke ba pa-o 
to. Kanto maŋa kam ne, na-lworu wom wó ta de wa yam kolo ŋwaane o na wora 
o lwoi na bam to. Ywo seeni mo na-lworu wom wó lwoori choom o nuŋi wa yam 
tei ne de.
Gurim Dem
Konto mo ye kikio kom kwola; gurim dem jei ne mo na-lworu wom laam wó ke 
chira bam lei ye o daare o gwoni ni de ba ne, ba na ke o na lage kolo to ba pa-o 
o ta wó jwoori ba tei. Na-lworu wom ta wó lwoori yezura naa zurim o daare o ta 
ba se ba chɔge puse-nyena boboŋa. O ta wó lwoori zaane o pa nɔɔna balo na zeini 
teo kom to. Wonnu tedwonna keim maŋa ne na-lworo yeini ko wora – bayaaro 
swɛɛm, chaa saŋem, bu doŋa sɛɛm/yere pam, etc. Nyenyero telo na wo kuri ne to 
bere Ghana ne dwoa yadwonna na lwoi ba na tei to mo.

LUA LEI
Ka-boŋe chekke bwia
Ko ye tɛ mo n yera ne maŋa kalo n yera nɔɔno na gɛ o ŋwea to?
Lua lei ye bɛ mo?
Lua lei ye lei selo ba na leeni lua maŋa ne de tigura wɛɛne se ko bere wo-chɔgɔ to 
mo. Kasena yeini ba leeni se lu-lea naa lu-fuli ne mo. Lua lei dwoa yam ye yatɔ 
mo: lusei, nagoro /tigura dedaane swogo lei. Selo ba na leeni kaane lua ne to ye 
lusei mo. Ba leeni se ba ma ba guli naa ba seini to wom mo ye se ta ye chulu woŋo 
de mo, se ta mae se kwei boboŋa. Dé ta wó ta we lua lei ye lei na leeni mɛɛmɛ ye 
se jege yu-vuru se leenim maŋa ne to mo. Lua lei ye seina taane mo ba na mae 
ba seini twa. Lua lei ye ŋwea chulu woŋo naa kikio mo ba na mae ba bane twa ba 
yage churu ne.
Kaane lua fulim ne de, ba yeini ba leeni swogo lei ko maŋe de ba na jeeri swogo 
kom ba beene naa ba na jege ko ba vei se ba lɔ.
Ko woli da, nagoro nye ne lusei mo tei ye sento ye tigura lei mo ba na leeni baaro 
lua ne ko maŋe de o na tege pwola ne ye ba zeŋe-o ba beene sɔŋɔ. Baaro lu-fuli 
ne de ba ta yeini ba mɔɔne nagoro, ye ba sae nagoro chwei zagem ne.
Lei sento maama ye lua lei mo na bere Kasena nabaara na ke tei ba bane ba chorro 
pae ba vei churu to.
Lua lei Totoŋa
i. Ko maa bere wo-chɔgɔ.
ii. Ko bere we twa de naŋona jege woŋo ba ke daane
iii. Ba tɔge lei sem baŋa ba maa pae labaare na jege ŋwaane to yi cheigina.
iv. Ko maa bane twa mo se ba yi churu.
v. Ko bere ba na gɛ ba nɔɔno tei to mo.
vi. Kateira yadwonna ne, lusei/nagoro ye fefeo chulu woŋo mo se ba ke toone 
ná goa.

SENSƆLA WO WONNU
Sensɔla
Sensɔla ye poponem lara dwoa yam dedoa mo. Ba kwei ŋwaŋa naa taane na 
popone tei to chwodɛ sem mo ba ma ba popone ka. Ka popone ka tɔge taane 
poponem wadɛ de taane na toŋe tei to mo pa ka lana. Ka ba popone ne seina taane 
tei, ka nam ba sɔɔna. Ka bere boboŋa, kikeeru, ye ka pae labaare yi garena.
Totoŋa 8.11
Maŋe se ko veere nmo na nigi sensɔla kuri pa ka ye kolo to se n daare n kwei 
n leira yam n ma-n maŋe de n dwonna bam nyena kelase dem ne to.
Sensɔle Wo Wonnu
1. Keira: Nɔɔno wolo, varem, naa kolo maama na ke totoŋe sensɔle wone 
to. Keira wae ba ye nabiina naa vara. Sensɔla lane maama zege keira bam 
totoŋ-nɛ na ye selo to baŋa ne mo. Keira sensɔla wone ye wo-cheɔ mo; ye 
keira dedɛɛra mo ye balo keim dem na saŋe naa de zege ba baŋa ne ye banto 
mo yeini ba na chane dem se ko bere sensɔla naga na vei tei to. Keira maana 
mo ye keiru dedɛɛro wolo na yeini o ni chane naa o yaare wonnu na vei tei 
to ŋwaane; keiru dedɛɛro wom dono/dom wom maa ye wolo na ke kikeeru 
se te taa daane naa te pae keiru dedɛɛro wom yaare to; keiru wolo na ba 
leiri o boboŋa sensɔla kam wone to de keiru wolo na leiri o boboŋa o toŋe 
wonnu se te taa vei de sensɔla kam nenɛɛne ko na maŋe tei to maama de ye 
keir-dwoa mo sensɔla wone.
2. Boboŋekurim: Konto mo ye sensɔla boboŋ-kuri naa ka nyɔɔne. Ko yeini 
ko zege keira bam kikeeru nenɛɛne bampono, negero naa wopwolo baŋa ne 
mo pae boboŋe dem nuŋi jase. Sensɔla wae ka jege boboŋekurim balwa na 
zeini pae boboŋekurim kamunu kom kuri zege chekke to.
3. Jei de maŋa: Konto ye labaare mo na bere jei naa maŋa kalo sensɔla kam 
na ke to. Ko na bere kolo to (tega baŋa ŋwea, faŋa wonnu, nabaara kikia naa 
tega siseina) ye te na mɛ te toŋe tei sensɔla wone to mo.
4. Sensɔla naga: Konto ye kikia na vei ya twoŋi daane tei sensɔla wone to 
mo. Ko ye nɔɔno na tigisi o boboŋa de o kikia sensɔla wone se ko bere ni-
sɛɛm, kazoe, de chane na pae wonnu vei tei to mo. Kikia yam na saŋe daane

sensɔla kam ne tei to wae ya ye mwale mwale se nɔɔno lware kolo na wó ke 
ko saŋe to naa ya wae ya pa se nɔɔno baa lware kolo na wó ba ko saŋe to.
5. Ta-toleno/taro zega naa boboŋa: Pwola kanto mo dé da dé maa nii sensɔla

INTRODUCTION
Dear learner, you are welcome to this section which discusses the foundation 
of language (speech sounds). You will be introduced to the concepts of vowels 
and consonants of your language of study and how speech sounds are described 
(parametre). It will focus on where the speech sounds occur in words of a Ghanaian 
language. For example, where vowels and consonants can occur in a word of a 
Ghanaian language such as initial position, medial position, or final position of 
a word. Again, Dear learner you will be introduced to the distribution of vowels 
and consonants in their language, aiding them to form meaningful words and 
facilitate effective speaking and reading in the language. This section is essential 
for learners not only in the context of Ghanaian language studies but also to 
establish links with related subjects such as English and other languages. This 
section equips you with foundational knowledge and functional understanding 
of speech sounds and their role in language learning. In summary, you should be 
able to identify, explain, produce, and label vowel charts and consonant tables of 
your language of study.
After this section, you should be able to:
1. Describe the vowels of a Ghanaian language using the right parameters 
(e.g., lip posture, tongue height and part of the tongue).
2. Describe the consonants of the Ghanaian language using the right 
parameters (e.g., voicing, place of articulation and manner of articulation).
3. Explain the distribution of vowels of the Ghanaian language (e.g., word 
initial, medial and final).
4. Explain the distribution of consonants of the Ghanaian language (e.g., 
word initial, medial and final).

SECTION 1 SHARING IDEAS AND ORAL INTERPRETATION
Key ideas
Production refers to the making or saying of a speech sound in language. 
Speech sound is a sound used in the formation of words for human 
communication. The production of speech sound involves obstruction 
which is the interruption of free flow of air during production of speech 
sounds. Sounds are distributed in languages and this refers to the place 
or position in a word where a sound can appear. Sound involves airflow 
which is a mass movement of air that is meant for the production of 
speech sounds. Another term for it is airstream.
TYPES OF SPEECH SOUNDS
Speech sounds can be grouped into two main types, namely vowels and consonants. 
It is the combination of these two types of sounds that produces words. In other 
words, all words are made up of individual speech sounds. For examples, the word 
pan consists of three individual speech sounds, that is, /p/, /a/, /n/. The sound /a/ 
is a vowel, whereas the sounds /p/ and /n/ are consonants. In the following topics 
we discuss both vowels and consonants focusing on how each is produced in a 
Ghanaian language.
The concept of vowel
The concept vowel refers as a speech sound in which production there is a little or 
no obstruction of the flow of air in the oral cavity. In other words, a speech sound 
which when being produced the air is not obstructed or it is minimally obstructed 
in the oral cavity is referred to as a vowel. Since in their production there is no 
or very little obstruction of airflow, vowels are comparatively heard louder when 
they are produced. Vowels are very important part of words. There cannot be a 
word without a vowel or vowel-like sound. This important role vowel plays in a 
word will later on in your second year be discussed when we are talking about the 
syllable.
Description of vowels
Dear learner, in describing vowels of a Ghanaian language, there are certain 
properties we use. These properties are often termed parametres. Parametres 
simply refer to the characteristics that a vowel possesses. The main parametres 
used in describing vowels are the tongue height, lip posture, and part of the tongue 
4
SECTION 1 SHARING IDEAS AND ORAL INTERPRETATION
used during the production of the vowel sound. In addition to the three, there 
is a fourth parameter called advancement of the tongue root in some Ghanaian 
languages such as Akan. Let us begin the discussions of these parametres.
Lip position/posture:
The parametre lip posture is used to determine the position your lips assume when 
you are producing a vowel. So, at this level, the lips assume two main postures 
or positions, namely rounded or unrounded. That is, whether the lips are rounded 
or they are not rounded when a vowel sound is being produced. Based on this 
posture of the lips, we can divide vowels of a Ghanaian language into two, namely 
‘rounded’ and ‘spread/unrounded.’ Some examples of rounded vowels are /u, 
o, ɔ/. examples of unrounded vowels, on the other hand, are /i, e, a/.
Activity
At this point, produce rounded and unrounded/spread vowels of your Ghanaian 
language of study.
Tongue height/Height of the tongue:
This refers to the position of the tongue in reference to the root of the mouth when 
producing vowel sounds. It is assumed that when we are producing vowels, the 
mouth opens when we drop the jaw. This can be high, mid, or low. When we 
drop our jaws to the lowest possible position, the vowels produced in this way are 
referred to as low vowels. Examples of low vowel is /a/, and in some Ghanaian 
languages [æ]. When we open our mouth wide enough but not as low as when 
producing low vowels, then the vowels we produced are termed mid vowels. 
Some examples of mid vowels in a Ghanaian language are /e, o/. In producing 
high vowels, on the other hand, the mouth is significantly opened but not as wide 
as mid vowels, thereby allowing enough air to flow through the oral cavity. Some 
examples of high vowels in a Ghanaian language are /i, u/.
Activity
Begin practicing the production of vowels in your language of study focusing 
on how high or how low you raise your jaws or open your mouth.
5
SECTION 1 SHARING IDEAS AND ORAL INTERPRETATION
Part of the tongue:
This parametre refers to the area of the tongue where the vowel sound is produced. 
It is assumed that when we are producing vowels, some parts of the tongue 
move. We cannot easily feel this movement though. Three parts of the tongue 
are assumed to be involved when a vowel sounds is being produced. These parts 
are the front part, middle part, and back part. Based on that, the parametre gives 
us three classes of vowels, namely front, mid, and back vowels. In producing 
front vowels, it is the front part of the tongue that moves. Some examples of front 
vowels of a Ghanaian language are /i, e, ɛ/. For the production of mid vowels, 
the middle of the tongue is assumed to move. Therefore, the following vowel is 
an example of a mid-vowel: /a/. For back vowels, on the other hand, as the name 
suggests, it is the back of the tongue that is involved in their production. Some 
examples of back vowels of a Ghanaian language are: /u, o, ɔ/.
Activity
Practice how to produce vowels of your language of study with focus on the 
part of the tongue.
Having finished discussing the main parametres we use in describing vowels of 
a Ghanaian language, there is a fourth parametre as mentioned earlier in this 
sub-strand which is not common among Ghanaian languages. This parametre is 
advancement of the tongue.
Advancement of the tongue root (ATR): (Please, discuss only if 
applicable in your language)
This parametre, which is prominent in a few Ghanaian languages including Akan, 
Dagbani, etc. It is used to determine the position the tongue root assumes when a 
vowel is being produced. By this parametre, we try to find out if there is tension 
or pressure on the tongue or not during production of vowels. When a vowel is 
produced with pressure on the tongue thereby causing the tongue root to draw 
back, we say that vowel is produced with Advanced Tongue Root (ATR) i.e. 
(+ATR) vowels. When vowels are produced with the tongue root in its natural 
neutral position, we label those vowels are Unadvanced Tongue Root i.e. (-ATR) 
vowels. Some examples of (+ATR) vowels are: /i, e, u, o/, and examples of (-ATR) 
vowels are /ɪ, ɛ, ɔ/.

Having discussed the nature of vowel sounds and the parametres used in describing

of consonants.
The concept of consonant
As was mentioned earlier in the section, consonant is another type of speech sounds 
apart from vowel. The concept consonant refers to a speech sound in which during 
production the breath, which we have termed airflow, is at least obstructed. Based 
on this explanation, we can contrast vowel and consonant by saying that while in 
the production of vowel there is very minimal or no obstruction of airflow, there 
is significant obstruction of airflow when producing consonants. We combined 
vowels and consonants form a word.

Consonant Distribution
The concept consonant distribution simply refers to the position in a word where 
a consonant can occur in a particular Ghanaian language. A consonant that 
occurs at the beginning of a word is referred to as word initial consonant. When a 
consonant occurs at the middle of a word, we refer to it as word medial consonant. 
When a consonant occurs at the end of a word, we refer to refer to it as word final 
consonant. Let us note that some consonants can occur in all positions of a word. 
For example, in some Ghanaian languages, the consonant /m/ can occur in the 
three positions in a word.
In the following activities, we will consider consonants of a Ghanaian language 
and the position the consonants can occur in a word.

INTRODUCTION
This section discusses identification of key ideas in texts and discourse. It 
always gives information on specific ideas or knowledge to the reader or hearer. 
The information given may come from all perspectives such as education, 
industrialisation, mining among others. It may also indicate some cultural values 
such as respect, tolerance and patience. Identifying key ideas gives you a better 
understanding of the discourse. It also enhances your critical thinking skills and 
interpretation abilities. There are types of reading techniques namely skimming 
and scanning and the application of any of the type enables you to get the right 
information demanded at any time. Knowledge of the types is therefore essential 
in our everyday life. The concept of oral interpretation will also be discussed. We 
shall discuss the skills needed for effective interpretation. Interpretation plays 
important roles in facilitating communication across language barriers.
After this section, you should be able to:
• Identify key ideas from appropriate discourse. E.g., cultural values 
(respect, kindness, tolerance and others), education, child trafficking, 
environment, industrialisation in Ghana, mining, GESI etc.,
• Discuss ideas and relevant opinions from selected discourse. E.g., 
cultural values (respect, kindness, tolerance and others), education, 
child trafficking, environment, industrialisation in Ghana, mining, GESI, 
STEM, etc.
Key Ideas
Key ideas are the main messages that is relevant in any discourse. Some of 
the key ideas may center on cultural values such as respect, kindness, 
tolerance, patience, etc. In any discourse you can share relevant opinions

KEY IDEA
Dear learner, before leaving home for your present school, what are the main 
points from the conversation you had with your parent/guardian? Share with peers.
The main points you shared with your peers are known to as key ideas. Key ideas are 
the essential ideas that the author or speaker wants to give to the reader or hearer/
listener respectively. The ideas may include the claims, the reasons, conclusions, 
definitions, classifications, comparisons, evaluations, recommendations, etc. Key 
ideas can be expressed explicitly or implicitly.
For you to identify the key ideas in discourse there is the need for you to understand 
the main concepts, arguments, and the points made. Note that the discourse 
could deal with any topic such as mining, teenage pregnancy, natural disaster, 
educational issues among others. It must also be pointed out that it could also 
come in a text form, video or picture or all the forms mentioned.
In summary, my dear learner to identify the key ideas in a discourse which may be 
written or oral or visual, you may need to answer the following questions
• Find who or what the passage discusses: Does this passage discuss a person, 
group of people or an entity?
• Ask when the event took place: Does the information contain a reference to 
time?
• Find where the event took place: Does the text name a place?
• Ask why the event took place: Do you find a reason or explanation for 
something that happened?
• Ask how the event took place: Does this information indicate a method or a 
theory?
NB: In a text, key ideas are sometimes italicised, boldened, or underlined. You 
can also find it in the topic sentence.

individuals or groups either in spoken form or written form. It involves the

Reading
After this section, you should be able to:
i. Discuss skimming using preview, overview and review.
ii. Discuss scanning using the strategies (e.g., movement of eyes or finger,

iii. Apply skimming and scanning to extract information or ideas from texts
Key ideas
Skimming is going through a text rapidly to get the general information in 
the text while scanning involves looking for a specific information in a 
text. Scanning is a process of reading in which your eyes quickly run 
through a piece of text to find a piece of relevant information. Scanning 
and skimming are two different concepts of reading.
TYPES OF READING
There are types of reading skill or technique namely skimming, scanning, 
intensive reading and extensive reading. Dear learner, in this lesson you shall 
learn skimming and scanning techniques of reading.
Skimming
Skimming is a reading technique used to quickly identify the main ideas or key 
points in a text. It is the action of reading something quickly so as to note only the 
important points. Basically, skimming is reading rapidly in order to get a general 
overview of the material read. It is used to find specific facts in texts. It involves 
glancing over the material, focusing on headings, subheadings, bold text and key 
phrases to get a general understanding of the content. Skimming is useful when; 
time is limited, looking for specific information, you want to get an overview 
8
SECTION 2 SHARING IDEAS AND ORAL INTERPRETATION
before reading in-depth and you are dealing with a large amount of text. Below 
are the skimming types.
i. Preview: An opportunity to view something before it is acquired or becomes 
generally available. Preview is done in an effort to learn about the ideas 
presented and the structure of their development.
ii. Overview: Used to sample the reading material more thoroughly. A general 
review or summary of a subject.
iii. Review: The review is done to re-familiarise yourself with the material 
you have previously read thoroughly or skimmed. A formal assessment of 
something with the intention of instituting a change if necessary.
Learner, in skimming, you can follow these steps
i. Read the title
ii. Read the headings and sub-headings as well as topic sentences in each 
paragraph
iii. Look for important information such as date, names and unusual words.
iv. Read the conclusion

In summary you have learnt skimming and the steps as well as the types of 
skimming which you can apply. Dear learner, let us examine what is scanning.
Scanning
Scanning is reading rapidly in order to find facts without reading everything. 
Scanning helps you locate a particular fact while skimming tells you what general 
information is within a section.
 Scanning involves looking for a specific information in a text. It can also be said 
to be a process of reading in which your eyes quickly run through a piece of text 
to find a piece of relevant information. In scanning the reader looks for a piece 
of specific information. An example of scanning is searching for the meaning 
of a word in a dictionary. Scanning helps the reader to locate particular facts in 
an entire text quickly. Students often use scanning when solving their reading 
comprehension questions.
It is important to know the purpose for scanning. You should know what you are 
searching for, eg title of a book, a website, a reference material, a particular word 
or phrase and a particular story you want to read etc. You should know how the 
material is structures either alphabetically, non-alphabetically, chronologically, 
by category, by titles /headings, by textual sense, by numbers among others.
Scanning helps a learner to read more and to develop love for reading.

Oral Interpretation and Translation
After this section, you should be able to:
Discuss oral interpretation focusing on effective listening, encoding and

Key Ideas
Oral interpretation is reframing the meaning of a speech most often orally 
into another language. The original language is the source language 
and the language in which it is rendered is the target language. In oral 
interpretation you must note the cultural differences and be accurate in 
giving the meaning of what you are to render in the language orally.
INTERPRETATION
Interpretation is listening to a message in one language and rendering it orally 
in another language maintaining the original meaning, tone and context. It 
is the stylistic representation of a creative work or dramatic role. It is the act 
of explaining, reframing, or otherwise showing your own understanding of 
something. In interpretation you first have to understand the text or the piece 
given to you and then explain in your own words. In broader terms it is rendering 
a spoken or signed message into another spoken or signed language preserving 
the register and meaning of the source language content.
Dear learner, it must be noted that before you can do any interpretation, you must 
be well versed in the source and target language. Interpretation can be performed 
either simultaneously or consecutively between users of different languages.
Dear learner, know that in interpreting you do not embellish or over-exaggerate. 
State the ideas clearly. In interpreting you need to listen carefully, decode and 
encode as they serve as the process of communication and interpreting.

Daadaa Guamu Nserahwɛ
Bea soronko bi wɔ mo kurom a wɔfrɛ hɔ guamu. Hɔ yɛ enyigye, na dede, eguadzifo 
so dzi akɔnaaba wɔ hɔ aber biara. Hɔ yɛ bea bi a adzetɔfo hyia adzetɔmfo tɔ 
ndzɛmba ahorow fi hɔn nkyɛn. Dɛm ndzɛmba yi bi nye nduaba na atododze 
afɛɛfɛw, atam, mbaduaba na fie ndzɛmba so. Dza erohwehwɛ wɔ hɔ biara, ibenya 
bi.
 Menye m’ebusuafo kɔ guamu hɔ kedzi gua dapɛn ewiei biara. Aka kakra ma 
yeedu hɔ a, metse dɛ eguadzifo reyɛ dede; mbrɛ binom repaa hɔn ndzɛmba no na 
binom so reserɛ abontsewdo.
Adze a m’enyi dzi kan bɔ do nye nduaba na atododze a wɔahyehyɛ no akɔndɔ 
akɔndɔ dɛmara wɔ apon do. Ekutudɛw, mpuwa a aberber kookɔɔ na borɔsuow 
akɛse nnyɛ na wɔ hɔ. Irisi hɔ ara nye yi, na ndzɛmba yi ne nkahuam no afa wo do. 
Iyi na opia me ma medze ahokeka kɔtɔ dza mepɛ. Afei, yewura atamfo na ntarfo 
hɔn patamu. Mudu mbrɛ sor ntar afɛɛfɛw, abaɛfor sekɛɛte na egudzi a ɔtsew gya 
yerɛyerɛw wɔ no a, munntum nntwa mu. Gyedɛ migyina hwehwɛ mu tɔ afofor ka 
dza mowɔ dadaw no ho.
Sɛ yɛkɔ hɛn enyim kakra wɔ gua no mu a, yekodu beebi a wɔtɔn mbaduaba na 
edwindze ahorow bi tse dɛ ahondze, nsakɔnadze nye adɔfo akyɛdze ahorow. 
Ndzɛmba ahorow pii a mbofraba dze dzi agor, nya mu esuadze tse dɛ mbaduaba, 
baluu afɛɛfɛw na dza ɔkeka ho pii wɔ hɔ. Sɛ muhu mbofraba a hɔn enyi gye 
ndzɛmba no ho no hɔn enyim sereserew no a, nna m’enyi agye papaapa.
Ekyir koraa no, yekodu beebi a wɔtɔn fie ndzɛmba nkotsee no. Ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ hɔ 
no bi nye gyaadze ndzɛmba, semina ahorow na ndzɛmba ahorow a yɛdze siesie 
dan mu na efiefi. Ber biara a yɛbɔkɔ guamu no, me maame totɔ ndzɛmba ahorow 
ma mosoa kɔ fie.
Yɛrosɔw do ahwɛ edzin ahorow bi so.

Dzin-tamsi yɛ nkasafua a yɛdze kyerkyerɛ dzin bi mu. Ɔsan kyerɛkyerɛ nyimpa,

i. Mepɛ adan adadaw.
ii. Banyimba no yɛ tsentsen tseatseaba.
iii. Ekuwa yɛ nyansanyi sen no nua banyin no.
Mfatoho (i) mu no, kasafua dadaw kyerɛkyerɛ dan pɔtsee a ɔkasafo no pɛ. (ii)

a. Kaar yi yɛ fofor.
b. Dɛm adan no yɛ maame no nedze.
c. Dɛm dan no yɛ me papa nedze.
d. Ekuwa rotɔ dɛm adan yinom.
Ntotoho dzin-tamsi
Suar sen, krɔn sen, kɛse sen, kakraba sen, kɛse sen na dza ɔkeka ho.
Yɛnhwɛ mfatoho yinom wɔ nsɛntɔw mu. Kasafua sen a odzi dzin-tansi no ekyir 
no na ɔma ntotoho no ba.
a. Amba no fufu no suar sen Araba nedze no.

Iyi yɛ dzin-tamsi a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ biribi no su, tsebea na no bɔbew. Ma yɛnhwɛ

2. Ekoo no tu faa.
3. Abofra no yar.
4. Kyɛnse no so papaapa.
Nkasafua a wɔakyeakyea hɔn no yɛ nyɛe a wɔmmfa ɔyɛtsia ana hɔn ntseasee 
ada edzi. Kasafua faa a odzi nyɛe tu ekyir no nnyɛ ɔyɛtsia mbom nyɛe-tamsi 
a. Mfatoho (4) mu so kasafua papaapa a odzi nyɛe so ekyir no yɛ nyɛe-tamsi.

Nyɛe a wɔfa ɔyɛtsia pɔtsee na ɔgyefo
Dɛm nyɛe yinom fa ɔyɛtsia ebien a kor yɛ ɔyɛtsia pɔtsee na kor so yɛ ɔgyefo. 
Ɔyɛtsia pɔtsee no nye dzin anaa dzinhyɛanamu a nyɛe no, no dwumadzi no tsia no 
pɔtsee. Ɔgyefo no yɛ dzin anaa dzinhyɛananmu a ɔtɔ do ebien no. Nyɛe a wɔtaa 
dzi dwuma wɔ ha bi nye ku, gye, ma, kyɛ, fir, fɛm. Ɔtɔfabi a, kasafua ma na ɔda 
ɔgyefo no edzi.
Mfatoho a ɔwɔ nsɛntɔw mu:
1. Papa no ku akrantse ma maame no.
2. Asɔrmba no kyɛ Sɔfo no ndzɛmba.
3. Kyerɛkyerɛnyi no pam ewifo no ma hɛn.
4. Kofi fɛm me buukuu.

Mfatoho: Akataasia no boor esutsen no kɔr n’egya.
Ofi esutsen no ano dze kɔ n’egya no nnwar biara naaso nna nkyɛ mepɛ dɛ 
muboguar nsu a no mu dɔ na ɔyɛ krɔngyenn akɔ ekyir. Nna bea no kyerɛ mbrɛ 
ndɛnkyɛm wɔ. Mereyɛ ahoboa ebesi esutsen no mu no, medze me se suoo mo 
tur no mu. Mobɔɔ mpaa huruwii tɔɔ nsu no mu boor dɛ mbrɛana murusua 
abor. Nna esutsen no mmpram dzendzen biara na no mu so yɛ hyew kakra dze 
naaso nna hu aka me ntsi munntum mmbor yie. Moboree dur nsu no finimfin 
no, awerɛfir mu ara na nsu no weew kakra ma mo koko kɛpeem dɛtsebo bi. 
Modween dɛ dɛnkyɛm a ma me yamu hyee me. Iyi maa itur no fii m’ano tɔɔ 
esutsen no mu. Mesanee kɔr mbrɛ hɔ dɔ bio. M’enyi baa moho do no nna 
mabor etwa esutsen edu n’egya. Medze ahopopo toow moho too nsu no egya 
hɔ. Biribiara baa ewiei naaso mohweer mo tur no

Henfa na worutu mbirika no? Ebɛnadze ntsi na worutu mbirika no?
Nyɛe-tamsi yɛ nkasafua anaa nsɛmfua a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nyɛe mu ma ntsease da 
edzi yie. Nyɛe-tamsi tum kyerɛkyerɛ ne nyɛnko nyɛe-tamsi so mu. Dwendwen 
mbrɛ isii nantsewee baa skuul ndɛ ho. Enantseew ntsɛntɛm anaa berɛww? Obi 
nantsew berɛww na obi so nantsew ntsɛntsɛm. Nkasafua berɛww na ntsɛntsɛm

MBOBƆDO NSƐMBISA
Ɔfa A: Nyɛe
1. Soronko bɛn na ɔwɔ nyɛe a ɔkyerɛ ndzeyɛɛ na nyɛe a ɔkyerɛ tsebea 
anaa su mu?
2. Hwehwɛ nyɛe a ɔwɔ akenkansɛm yi mu na fa toto wo nyɛnko nedze ho.
Medze ahoɔhar kɔr mpoano hɔ no, mutuu mbirika huruhuruwii na 
midzii agor wɔ asorɛkye no mu. Ewia bɔɔ dzendzenndzen ma ɔhyew 
baa mo wer mu ntsi m’ahom kaa moho. Muguaar po na midzii agor wɔ 
nsu no mu ber a nna medze enyigye mereserew. Nsunoma etu nenam 
nsu no enyi a wɔbobɔ hɔn ntsaban mu. Medze anhwea sii dan na medze 
mpoano mbobaa hyɛnhyɛn na abon siesiee dan no ho. Ɔyɛɛ kakra no, 
mutuu mpasar wɔ mpoano hɔ kakra. Afei, nna morohwehwɛ biribi wɔ 
hɔ a ɔbɛma makaa hɔ afebɔɔ.
3. Kyekyɛ nyɛe a inyae no mu kɔ ekuw ahorow no mu.
Ɔfa B: Nyɛe-tamsi
1. Kyerɛ dwuma ahorow a idzi no da biara, ber a idzi, mbrɛ isi dzi na 
siantsir a idzi dɛm dwuma no.
2. Bobɔ nyɛe-tamsi a wo nyɛnko dze dzii dwuma no nyina edzin na kyerɛ 
kuw a kor biara wɔ mu.
3. Fa nkasafua bɛyɛ eduonum (50) kyerɛw nsɛm fa nkorɔfo a enye hɔn tse 
na wimu nsakyeree a ɔwɔ hɔ ho.

 Mbɔdɔm
 Dodowara nyim dɛ mbɔdɔm yɛ fie mbowa a yɛtaa dze hɔn gyegye 
hɛn enyi. Mbɔdɔm gu mu ahorow na wɔda su ahorow so edzi. Bi yɛ 
atsentsen akɛse, bi so yɛ ntsiantsiaba pitsipiriww, bi ho yɛ futufutu, 
akɔkɔɔ, etuntum, fufuw, ntaataamu na adze. Wɔyɛ mbowa a hɔn anan 
yɛ anan a hɔn ase fi haban mu mbowa abɔyafo mu. Abakɔsɛm kyerɛ 
dɛ, ɔbɔmbɔfo bi na ɔdze abowa ɔbɔyafo bi fi ahayɛ mu baa fie. Ɔkyɛɛr 
fie no, abowa no bɛfaa nyimpa no su ma ɔnye nyimpa bɛtsenae. Wɔwɔ 
atsenka wɔ nyimpa no su ho dɛ ɔyɛ ɔdɔ, ɔtan nye suro. Wɔhwɛ iyi ho na 
hɔn so wɔda ho su edzi. Ɔda edzi pefee dɛ mbɔdɔm to mfar ankasa. Hɔn 
asowa kɔ ekyir na ɔyɛ har so. Dza ɔma mbɔdɔm som bo kɛse nye dɛ, 
nyimpa tum tsetse hɔn ma wodzi dwuma ahorow pii. Mbɔdɔm a wɔboa 
fie adzeyɛ no tum mpo boa enyifurafo ma wɔnantsew na mbɔdɔm bi so 
tum kyekyer nyimpa no werɛ ber a nyimpa wɔ awerɛhow mu. Ɔnam mfar 
a mbɔdɔm tse ntsi, nyimpa dze hɔn hwehwɛ adze a mfir mpo nnkotum 
ayɛ, nkankaara ber a dan abu egu nyimpa bi do ma wɔrohwehwɛ hɔn 
anaa mpo ber a wɔrohwehwɛ ndubɔn wɔ obi ho anaa beebi. Iyi nyina 
ekyir no, wonnyin nnkyɛr. Wodzi mfe du dze kesi duenum ara. Ber a 
hɔn ho hia ɔnam mboa a wɔdze boa nyimpa ntsi no, mbɔdɔm piinara so 
wohu hɔn dɛ wɔyɛ ebusuafo a wɔwɔ ɔdɔ.

Adwentsitsir
• Susukyerɛw yɛ akyerɛw bi a ɔda adwen edzi. Susukyerɛw biara wɔ

Adwentsitsir asɛntɔw yɛ dza okitsa adwen pɔtsee a asɛnsin no dze roto gua no. 
Asɛntɔw a ɔma nkyerɛkyerɛmu so yɛ asɛntɔw biara a ɔwɔ asɛnsin bi mu na ɔboa

Susukyerɛw
Nyimpa hia nyimdzee mapa ana oeetum akyerɛw susukyerɛw. Ɔwɔ dɛ ɔkyerɛwfo 
no tum boaboa ne nsɛmpɔw ano yie na ɔdze to gua wɔ asɛnsin mu. Mbrɛ yesi yɛ 
iyi nye dɛ, yɛboaboa nsɛm a wodzi nsɛ ano. Yɛkyerɛw hɛn nsɛnsisii no ndzidzido 
na yɛma ngyinado a ɔfata nye ntotoho dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata.
Susukyerɛw yɛ akyerɛw bi a ɔda adwen edzi. Susukyerɛw biara wɔ asɛntsitsir bi 
a ɔdze to gua.
Amandzɛɛbɔ susukyerɛw
Amandzɛɛbɔ susukyerɛw yɛ akyerɛwsɛm a ɔkasa fa asɛm pɔtsee bi ho. Otum yɛ 
abɔtsirmusɛm anaa nokwasɛm. Ɔyɛ ehiasɛm dɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no dze kodzisɛm ho 
nhyehyɛɛ a ɔwɔ hɔ dada no dzi dwuma. Iyi bi nye, kodzisɛm no ne ngyinado, 
adwenkyerɛ a ɔbɔ ebira na ne nkekaho a ɔhyɛ akenkanfo nkuran ma wɔkenkan. 
Yɛtaa dze dzinhyɛananmu me, mi, mo, mu dzi dwuma. Sɛ ɔyɛ nokwasɛm a, ɔwɔ 
dɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no nya ngyinado. Kabea a ɔtaa dzi dwuma wɔ ha nye apaho kabea. 
Ɔwɔ dɛ nsɛnsisii no ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu no yɛ esiado esiado. Kasasu ahorow nye 
adwenmu mfonyintwa ho hia yie dɛ mbrɛ akenkanfo enyi bɛgye akenkan no ho.
Nsɛm bi a yebotum akyerɛw ho amandzɛɛbɔ susukyerɛw
• Kyerɛw dza osii wɔ da a odzi kan a edze kɔr skuul.
• Kyerɛw edziban a epɛ ho asɛm.
• Kyerɛ Borɔnya akwanma a ndaansa yiara idzii no ho asɛm.
• Kyerɛw asɛm bi a osii a inyaa mu esuadze bi.

Ebɛnadze nye Sukyerɛ Susukyerɛw?
Iyi yɛ kwan a yɛfa do kyerɛkyerɛ nyimpa, bea bi, tsebea bi a obi akɔ mu anaa 
biribi no su wɔ susukyerɛw mu wɔ kwan soronko do ma asɛm no aada edzi yie. 
Ohia dɛ wɔhyehyɛ no yie na no mu nkasafua da atsenka edzi.
Sukyerɛ Susukyerɛw ne nhyehyɛɛ
Iyi ne nhyehyɛɛ tse dɛ amandzɛɛbɔ Susukyerɛw dze no pɛpɛɛpɛr
1. Nyienyim: Iyi yɛ nsɛm bi a ɔpa dza yɛrebɛka ho asɛm no ho tam. Obotum 
ayɛ asɛmbisa bi a onnhia nyiano na mbom sɛ yeriyi ano a nkyɛ ne nyiano 
bɔtwetwe akyerɛw no mu nsɛm epue.
2. Asɛm no ankasa: Ha na yɛka akyerɛw no mu nsɛmpɔw no ankasa kyerɛkyerɛ 
mu yie. Nsɛnsin ahorow a ɔwɔ ha no mu biara dze asɛntɔw tsistir a ɔma 
akenkanfo no enyi gye dɛ wɔbɛkenkan bi hyɛ ase. Dɛm nsɛntɔw yi tum ma 
yɛdze adwen bu nsɛm a yebohu wɔ dɛm asɛnsin no mu nye no ho mfatoho 
a ɔfata. Ɔwɔ dɛ asɛnsin biara da adwen fofor edzi.
3. Ewiei: Ha na eboa dza aka no nyinara ano bɔ no tɔfa. Iyi mu na edze wo 
nsɛm no nyinara ba ewiei dze twe akenkanfo hɔn adwen kɔ dza aka no dada 
no do.
 Tsirasɛm ahorow a yebotum akyerɛw ho sukyerɛ susukyerɛw na ɔka do yi.

NYIENYIM
Dɛm ɔfa yi kasa fa abosondzin a ɔwɔ Ghana kasahorow no mu ber a yɛdze adwen 
ritsim Mfantse kasa mu abosondzin na ne farbae do. Hom bohu siantsir a yɛto 
abosondzin na ne mfaso. Iyi ma yɛtse abadzinto ase na yɛdze obu ma Ghana 
abosom, kusum na amambra. Ɔfa kor yi ara so ma yehu amandze a yɛyɛ ma obi a 
oedu ne mpanyinyɛ mu (bragor). Dza yɛbɔhwɛ wɔ iyi ho no bi nye dwuma a yedzi 
ana wɔaagor obi bra, bragor no ankasa na bragor no ekyir dwumadzi. Yɛbɔhwɛ 
mfaso a ɔbranyi no, n’ebusuafo na kurow no nyina nya wɔ bragor mu so. Ɔwɔ dɛ 
itum kyerɛ nsɛ na nsorsoree a ɔwɔ mbrɛ wosi gor bra wɔ Ghana kasahorow no 
mu.
Adzesua no bɔkɔ ewiei no, nna osuanyi no;
• Tum pɛnsapɛnsa abosoondzin ne farbae mu.
• Tum pɛnsapɛnsa kwan a wɔfa do gor bra mu mu. (ansaana wɔbɔgor bra, 
bragor ankasa na bragor ekyir dwumadzi)
• Tum dze kwan a wɔfa do gor bra wɔ Mfantse amambra mu (ansaana 
wɔbɔgor bra, bragor ankasa na bragor ekyir dwumadzi) toto afofor dze 
ho.
Adwentsitsir
• Abosom bi hɔn edzin mu na yenya abosondzin.
• Abosondzin no nye abosom wɔ sunsum mu nkitsahodzi.
• Ɔma yehu hɔn a edzin no deda hɔn do no hɔn abakɔsɛm.
• Bragor yɛ ber a ɔkyerɛ mpanyinyɛ ma ne dɛm ntsi onyia no tum wo.
• Bragor ma ɔman no gye ɔbranyi no to mu.
• Mbaa na mbanyin nyinara wɔ amandze a wɔyɛ ma hɔn.

ABOSONDZIN
Edzin bi wɔ hɔ a yenya ɔnam nkitsahodzi a yɛnye esunsum bi wɔ ntsi. Iyinom na 
yɛfrɛ no abosondzin. Ansaana yɛbɛkenkan biribiara afa abosondzin ho no, ɔwɔ dɛ 
yehu abosom hɔn adzeban.
Ebɛnadze nye abosom?
Yɛwɔ abosom mbaa na abosom mbanyin. Wɔyɛ sunsum mu etumfo a nyimpa bi 
som hɔn ɔnam gyedzi a wɔwɔ wɔ hɔn mu dɛ wɔboa hɔn wɔ akwanhorow mu ntsi. 
Abosom wɔ susnsum mu tum soronko bi. Ɔyɛ a nyimpa dze gyedzi na ndzeyɛɛ 
ahorow takyer abosom ho. Abosom a wɔgye enyim som hɔn no bi nye Zeus, 
Apollo, Athena, Aphrodite, Artemis na adze. Ghanaman mu ha , mantɔw anaa 
kasakuw biara wɔ abosom a wɔwɔ gyedzi wɔ hɔn mu. Dɛm abosom yi bi nye;
1. Ga: Dantu, Nae, Klote, La Kpa, etc.
2. Akan: Kune, Tegare, Nyamaa, Antoa, Penkye Otu, Pra, Amisa etc.
3. Dagomba: Tambo, etc.
Abosom bɛn na wɔagye dzin papaapa wɔ beebi a etse no?
Abosondzin
Yegyina nyimpa ne gyedzi na no som do na yɛto abosondzin. Abosondzin yɛ 
edzin soronko bi a ɔdeda ebusua, nyimpakuw, ɔsom na amambra ahorow do osian 
hɔn nkitahodzi a wɔnye abosom no wɔ ntsi.
Abosom bi hɔn edzin
Dza ɔka do yi yɛ Ghana abosom bi hɔn edzin.
1. Sɛ ekɔ Anwonaman mu wɔ Firaw mantɔw mu a, Anwonafo a wɔwɔ hɔ no 
som bosom bi a ne dzin dze “Afa” a wɔkɔ no hɔ ebisa. “Afa” no bosomfo 
“Bokɔ” n’abakan dze “Amuzu”.
2. Akanman mu no, abosom dodowara hɔn edzin no bata nda ho. Iyi ntsi, 
Akanfo gyina da a wɔdze wo nyimpa no do ma no ho abosondzin. Mfatoho 
nye bosom “Adwo” ne da yɛ Dwowda ntsi wɔwo basiaba Dwowda a, wɔfrɛ 
no Adwoa na sɛ ɔyɛ banyin so a, wɔfrɛ no Kodwo.
Bɔ mbɔdzen dɛ ibosua mbrɛ wosi bobɔ abosondzin a ɔwɔ sor hɔ no. Wo 
kyerɛkyerɛnyi bɔboa wo. Abosom bɛn na wɔagye dzin papaapa wɔ beebi mbrɛ 
etse no?

ƆFA 6 ABOSONDZIN NA BRAGOR
Abosondzin ne farbae
Ɔsom biara mu na hɔn abosondzin ne farbae. Iyi taa gyina nyimpa no hɔn gyedzi 
na kusum amambu do. Sɛ ekɔ Anwonaman mu a, abosondzin ne farbae fi Yeʋe a 
ɔyɛ enyinam bosom. Akanfo hɔn abosondzin fi nsubosom mu. Dangmefo so nya 
hɔn abosondzin fi hɔn bosom a ɔboa abawo. Ana inyim wo dzin ne farbae a?
Siantsir a yɛto abosondzin
Siantsir bi wɔ hɔ a ɔma wɔto abosondzin. Wɔto edzin no bi dze kyerɛ bosom no 
dwumadzi. Bi so gyina abosom no hɔn ndamyɛ anaa hɔn mudzi wɔ ebisa mu do. 
Edzin no bi so wɔ hɔ a ne farbae fi awerɛkyekyesɛm a wonya no abosom no nkyɛn 
mu. Bi so da kusum edzi na dza ogyina bosom no su do so.
Bio, sɛ awarfo bi rohwehwɛ ba a, wɔkɔ abosom bi hɔ kɛgye mboa. Awarfo no hyɛ 
bɔ na wɔdze hɔn ba a wɔbɔwo no no to bosom no dze pon hɔn bɔhyɛɛ no.
Abosondzin ne mfaso
Abosondzin som bo wɔ akwanhorow pii do ma asomfo no papaapa. Mfaso a ɔwɔ 
abosondzin ho bi na ɔka do yi.
1. Yɛdze hyɛ nyimpa nsew dze hu bosom a obi som. Ɔma yehu fie anaa kurow 
a obi fi mu so.
2. Ɔkyerɛ nkitsahodzi a ɔda onyia no na ɔbosom no ntamu.
3. Yɛdze abosondzin to nkyirmba dze bɔ amambra ho ban.
4. Abosondzin ma yehu awofo bi hɔn gyedzi.
5. Beebi so, gyedzi nye dɛ hɔn a wokitsa abosondzin no wɔ tum anaa sunsum 
mu ahoɔdzen.
Dwumadzi 6.1
1. Fa woara wo nkasafua kyerɛ bosom adzeban.
2. Enye wo nyɛnko nkyerɛw edzin du a abosondzin wɔ mu.
3. Hom mfa dɛm abosondzin a ɔwɔ (2) no nkyerɛ esuafo nkaa a hom nye 
hɔn ka kasa kor na hom mfa hom dwumadzi no nto gua.
4. Ana ewɔ abosondzin ka wo dzin ho a? Sɛ ewɔ bi a, kyerɛ ne farbae. Sɛ 
innyi bi so a, kyerɛ abosondzin a ekyerɛwee no mu kor ne farbae.

BRAGOR
Beebi a yedu yi, yɛbɔhwɛ amandze a yɛyɛ ma obi a woedu ne mpanyinyɛ mu 
(bragor). Iyi mu no, yɛbɔhwɛ dwuma a yedzi ana wɔaagor obi bra, bragor no 
ankasa na bragor no ekyir dwumadzi wɔ Ghana kasahorow no mu.
Ndwendwenho nsɛmbisa
Ana ekaa nsesa ebiasa bi a ihun wɔ wo nyimpadua ho ber a idzii mfe du dze kesi 
duanan (mfe 10 kesi 14) no?
Bragor
Iyi yɛ abrabɔ mu gyinabew bi a banyimba anaa basiaba du ne mpanyinyɛ mu a 
ɔkyerɛ dɛ oedu ber a sɛ ɔyɛ basia a, obotum awo ba anaa banyin so a, obotum 
enyinsen obi. Ɔtaa si ber a basiaba no enya mfe 10-14 na mfe 12-16 wɔ mbanyimba 
mu. Dɛm mfe yi, ɔtɔfabi a, ɔsesa. Iyi dze nsesa bi ba nyimpa no ne nyimpadua 
mu.

Nsesa a ɔba basiaba no ne nyimpadua mu
• N’enumfo yɛ akɛse
• N’ayeradze na n’ambɔtoadze nhwi hyɛ ase fuw.
• Ɔhyɛ ase yɛ bra.
• No bɔbew sesa.
• Ne sisiw yɛ akɛse
Nsesa a ɔba banyimba no ne nyimpadua mu
• Ne banyin no yɛ kɛse.
• N’ayeradze na n’ambɔtoadze nhwi hyɛ ase fuw.
• No mpɔw yɛ akɛse.
• Ne menmu piw.
• Ofuw abɔdwesa.
• No mu twe ma ɔyɛ tsentsen.
• N’abɔdwe na n’afon ho nhwi hyɛ ase fuw.
Dɛm nsesa yi kyerɛ dɛ nyimpa no edu ne mpanyinyɛ mu.
Mbrɛ wosi gor bra
Sɛ wɔyɛ amandze to abofra dzin wie a, amandze a odzi hɔ nye bragor. Ɔyɛ 
amandze a wɔyɛ ma mbasiaba na mbanyimba dze ma hɔn do kɔ hɔn mpanyinyɛ 
mu dze kyerɛ dɛ woefi gyinabew kor mu kɔ fofor mu.
Pon a ɔwɔ ase ha yi kyerɛ mbrɛ Ghana kasakuw ahorow frɛ bragor.

ƆFA 6 ABOSONDZIN NA BRAGOR
Wɔfrɛ bragor dɛn wɔ wo kasaa mu? Wo nkorɔfo gor mbasiaba na mbanyimba 
nyina bra a? ebɛnadze nye esubɔ?
Esubɔ
Esubɔ yɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze anaa amandze ahorow a wɔyɛ dze ma obi do fi gyinabew 
kor mu kɔ fofor mu. Yetum bɔ obi esu wɔ edwumasua mu, sumadze ekuwekuw 
mu anaa ɔsom bi mu. Mbom esubɔ a yɛreka ho asɛm yi yɛ bragor a ɔdze nyimpa 
kɔ mpanyinyɛ mu.
Ndzeyɛɛ a ɔwɔ bragor mu
Kusum na amandze a ɔnnyɛ pɛr wɔ kasakuw ahorow no mu no ntsi, bragor mu 
ndzeyɛɛ no so nnyɛ pɛr. Ahoboa a wɔyɛ ana wɔaagor bra, bragor no ankasa na 
bragor ekyir dwumadzi bi na ɔka do yi.
Bragor Ntotoho: Nsɛdzi
Mbasiaba hɔn bragor
1. Dza wodzi kan yɛ ana wɔaagor bra
 Sɛ awofo hu nsesa bi wɔ hɔn mba mbasiaba ho a, wɔhyɛ ase yɛ ahoboa. 
Mpɛn pii no, sɛ basiaba bi yɛ n’asɔpɔn bra (brakan) a, wɔyɛ dza ɔkeka do yi.
• Wɔtsew mbasiaba no fi afofor ho na wɔhyɛ ase ma hɔn bragor ho 
nkyerɛkyerɛ.
• Ɔwɔ dɛ nsesa bi da edzi wɔ nyimpa no ne nyimpadua mu.
• Mbaampanyin a wɔwɔ bragor ho nyimdzee no frɛ basiaba no nye no 
kasa fa nsesa a aba ne nyimpadua mu ho ma ohu dɛ nsesa no ka abrabɔ 
ho. Wɔsan ma no abrabɔ mu nkyerɛkyerɛ bi a ɔfa awar ho.
• Wɔkyerɛ mbasiaba no fie ndzɛmbayɛ pii tse dɛ apra, mpa ne nsiesiei, 
edzibanyɛ, ndzɛmbahor na ahonyidzi mapa.
• Wɔsan kyerɛ mbasiaba no nsaanodwuma bi tse dɛ ahondzewen, 
kentewen, tanwen, kɛntsɛnwen na adze.
• Hɔn kusum adwontow na asaw so, wɔkyerɛ hɔn.
• Awofo no bɔ ɔbaahembaa na mpanyimfo biara a ɔfata amandzɛɛ ma o 
ɔbaahembaa no yɛ nhwehwɛmu.
• Wɔkyerɛ mbasiaba no mpa mu agodzi. Mekyerɛ, mbrɛ wobesi asɔ hɔn 
kunnom a wɔbɔwar hɔn no hɔn enyi wɔ mpa mu.

2. Bragor no mu dwumadzi ankasa
 Bra no ngoree no ankasa du a, bosomfo anaa mbaampanyin no dze nsa yi 
mpaa dze branyi no na dwumadzi no nyinara hyɛ nananom abosomfo no

mu anaa kwaa mu.

n’awerɛw so.
• Wɔdze ɔtɔ na kyirefuwa a wɔanoa ma no ma odzi (ɔmokomoko).
• Wɔdze no tsena asɛsɛgua do.Wowie sunsum mu dwumadzi yi nyinara yɛ 
konyimdzi mu a, wɔdze kente, ahondze na egudzi siesie no ho gɔsɔɔ.
 Afei wɔbɔ gua dze yɛ amandze ahorow.
 Guabɔ no ase na wɔdze afadze a no bo yɛ dzen hyehyɛ no gɔsɔɔ no. Wɔda no 
mpokuwa edzi ama mbanyin a wɔaso awar no aahwɛ etu awar ho anamɔn.

Bragor Ntotoho
Nsorsoree
Yɛdze nsɛdzi a ɔwɔ bragor ho wɔ kasakuw ahorow no mu no to nkyɛn a, yɛwɔ 
nsorsoree bi a ɔma kasakuw biara nedze da nsew. Bi na ɔwɔ ase ha yi.
Anwonafo
1. Mbeambea bi wɔ awonaman mu a bragor no dzi dapɛn kor kesi bosoom kor.
2. Woyi branyi no kɔ mfikyir na wɔma anyɛnkofo tsena ne nkyɛn gye n’enyi 
ma no ho annyɛ no kɔnn.
3. Amandze ne yɛ mu no, kyirefuwa noae a ɔmokomoko no kyerɛ dɛ ne 
mbadwoa bɔdɔr.
Krobɔfo
1. Krobɔfo gor hɔn mbasiaba Dipo ber a wɔdze ato gua wɔ Nana Kloweki a 
ɔyɛ asaasebosom no ne dzin mu ewiwe. Wɔyɛ no guabɔ tsitsir biara ase na 
odzi dapɛn kesi adapɛn ebien.
2. Ansaana wɔbɛyɛ amandze agor hɔn Dipo no, hɔn awofo dze hɔn kɛma hɔn 
bosom panyin no.
3. Dipo no gor mu ankasa no, bosomfo no yi mpaa na oyi ɔbranyi no ne tsir 
ase nhwi no ma ɔka kumaa bi wɔ n’apampamu. Afei, wɔdze no gyina abowa 
nwoma do.
Nkranfo
1. Nkranfo gor mbasiaba Otofo ber a wosusuaree.
Akanfo
1. Akanfo taa hyɛ bragor ase Dwowda anaa Benada ma odzi ndaawɔtwe.
2. Ɔbaahembaa dzi kan hwehwɛ basiaba no ho gye to mu dɛ ɔyɛ babun, oebu 
ne nsa ampa na onnyinsenii so.
Kwan bɛn na wɔfa do gor bra wɔ wo kurom?
Mbanyimba hɔn bragor
Ghanafo dodowara nntaa nngor mbanyimba bra. Kasakuw bi a wɔgor mbanyimba 
bra na ɔka do yi. Awonafo gor “Tudedeasi”, Sissalafo gor “Baala”, Nkranfo gor 
“Plamatsemɔ/Butrumwɔɔ/Deŋtuwoo”. Wɔnngor mbanyimba bra dɛ mbasiaba

dze no. Anwonafo mu no, itur a wɔdze ma banyimba no dɛ ɔmfa mbɔ n’ebusuafo 
ho ban na ɔmfa nyɛ ha nhwɛ fie no wɔfrɛ no ‘Tudedeasi’

KUSUM NDZEYƐƐ NA AMAMBU
Kusum Ntɔyɛɛ Na Amambu
NYIENYIM
Dɛm fa yi kyerɛ mbrɛ Ghana kusum na amambu tse. Ɔkyerɛkyerɛ kusum na 
amambu mu edzibewdzifo hɔn dwumadzi na hɔn bo a wɔsom.
Adzesua no bɔkɔ ewiei no nna osuanyi no tum;
1. yɛ kusum amambu mu nhwehwɛmu. (egya, Fibobow mu panyin, 
ebusuapanyin)
2. yɛ kusum amambu mu nhwehwɛmu. (ahemfo, ahemfo nkakraba, 
esihemfo)
Nsɛntsitsir
• Egya adzedzi (Egya pɔtsee bi n’ebusua) mu no, egya na ɔyɛ ebusua no ne 
tsir.
• Wɔfa anaa Na adzedzi mu no, ɔtɔfabi a, na no tum yɛ ebusua no ne tsir.
• Ebusua mpanyimfo yɛ mpanyimfo a ebusua mu baanodzifo anaa apamfo 
yi no.
KUSUM AMAMBU NHYEHYƐƐ
Hwehwɛ kusum amambu nhyenhyɛɛ mu (egya, ebusua ne tsir, ebusuapanyin).
Kusum Amambu
Kusum Amambu yɛ amambu a ogyina tsetse mpanyimfo hɔn adwen na kusum 
do. Kusum Amambu a ɔwɔ hɛn nkurow ahorow mu no wɔ nhyehyɛɛ soronko bi a 
ogyina dzibew do. Wɔahyehyɛ no ndzidzido ndzidzido. Kasakuw biara na nedze 
naaso bi dzi nsɛ.

Ebusuabɔ mu amambu nhyehyɛɛ
Ghanaman mu no, kasafua ebusua gyina hɔ ma yer, kun na (m)ba anaa ebusua 
tsentsen a nanabanyin na nanabasia, wɔfanom, nanom, nwɔfaasefo, nananom nye 
afofor bi ka ho. Iyi mu no, amambu nhyehyɛɛ no fa egya, ebusuapanyin, ahemfo, 
ahemfo nkakraba, esihenfo, amanhen na hɔn a wɔkeka ho.
Ndwendwenho dwumadzi
Hom efiefi amambu nhyehyɛɛ tse dɛn? Woana na ɔda hom ebusua a ɔyɛ yer, kun 
na mba no ano?
Woana so na ɔda hom ebusua tsentsen no ano? Eka ebusua no ho a?
Ebusuabɔ mu Amambu Nhyehyɛɛ pon
Iyi yɛ dzibewdzi atwer a ɔkyerɛ mbrɛ woesi ahyehyɛ edzibewdzifo na dɔm a 
wɔhyɛ hɔn ase nye hɔn dwumadzi. Efiefi mu amambu nhyehyɛɛ pon tse dɛ mbrɛ 
ɔwɔ ase ha yi.
Fig7.1: Ɔman mu Ebusuabɔ mu Amambu Nhyehyɛɛ pon
1. Ebusuapanyin: Ebusua yɛ nyimpakuw bi a wɔyɛ ɔbaatan bi n’asefo. 
Ebusua bi wɔ hɔ a, dzin kor na ɔda no mu mba no do a ɔda no edzi dɛ hɔn 
nyinara wofi panyin bi ase. Ebusua bi mu mba taa da su pɔtsee bi edzi. 
Wotum mpo dzi nsɛ wɔ kwan bi do. Nyimpa a ɔda dɛm dɔm yi ano no na 
wɔfrɛ no ebusuapanyin no. Beebi wɔ hɔ a, ebusua no nyinara hyia na woyi 
dɛm nyimpa no dɛ hɔn ebusuapanyin. Beebi so wɔdan ma nyimpa pɔtsee bi.
2. Fibobow mu panyin: Efiefi ahorow mu mba na wɔbɔ mu bɔ ebusua a 
woyi ebusuapanyin no. Dɛm efiefi yi na yɛtɔ dɛ yɛfrɛ hɔn fibobow no. Dɛm 
nkorɔfo yi taa yɛ ebusua tsentsen mu mba. Panyin a fibobow biara yi no

nye dɛ wɔhwɛ fibobow no mu mba no do na wɔsan boa ma asomdwee ba 
fibobow nkaa no mu. Afei, ɔwɔ dɛ wɔda baanodzi su edzi. Mbanyin na 
wɔtaa yi hɔn dɛ ebusuampanyimfo.
3. Egya : Sɛ kun, yer na mba tse fie a, kun no a ɔyɛ mbofra no hɔn egya no nye

Ebusuabɔ mu mpanyimfo hɔn dwumadzi
Ebusuapanyin:
i. Ɔyɛ ebusua mu no nyiara hɔn tsɛmbuafo
ii. Ɔno na onyim ebusua no n’abakɔsɛm yie na ɔhwɛ bɔ ho ban.
iii. Ɔbɔ ebusua no ne ndzeyɛɛ na ne nhyehyɛɛ ho ban.
iv. Ɔbɔ ebusua nsaase na egyapadze nkaa ho ban.
v. Ɔhwɛ dɛ ebusua no mu mba bɛtsetse nkyirmba wɔ kwan pa do.
Fibobow mu panyin:
i. Ɔbɔ fibobow no mu mba ho ban fi ɔhaw ahorow ho.
ii. Ɔhwɛ ma no dɔm no nya asetsena pa.
iii. Ɔhwɛ ma asomdwee ba no dɔm no mu.
iv. Ɔhwɛ fibobow no n'egyapadze tse dɛ nsaase, efiefi na adze do.
v. Ɔhyɛ siesie fibobow no mu mba ntamu akasakasa.
vi. Ogyina fibobow no mu mba no ananmu wɔ ɔman no mu nye guabɔ biara 
ase.
vii. Osi egyinae pa wɔ nsusuho mu ma fibobow no mu mba no.
Egya:
i. Ɔhyɛ mbra na ɔhwɛ ɔnye yer na mba no dzi.
ii. Ɔhwɛ ma no dɔm no nya beebi da na ɔbɔ hɔn ho ban so.
iii. Ɔhwɛ dɛ oibara benya apɔwmudzen dze enyin yie.
iv. Ɔkyerɛ abrabɔ mu kwan pa a wɔfa do a obesi hɔn yie.

Ɔmanhen
Amanhen yɛ edzibewdzifo a wɔdeda nyimpakuw a wɔtɔ dɛ wɔka kasa kor tse 
dɛ Gomoa, Agona, Ekumfi na dze. Mpɛn pii no, yetum nya amanhemfo dodow 
bi wɔ kasakuw kor mu. Wɔyɛ edzibewdzifo a hɔn tum krɔn sen ahemfo nkaa no 
nyina. Dɛm dzibewdzi yi fi wɔfa adzedzi anaa egya adzedzi mu. Iyi gyina bea 
no do. Ɔmanhen biara wɔ n’eguadzin. Mfatoho: Oguaa mahen dze Osabarimba, 
Efua Ajumako manhen dze Okokodurfo, Anwona mahen dze Fiaga, Yaa naa yɛ 
dagomba mahen no nwoma dzin.
Ɔmanhen no Dwumadzi
i. Ɔno na ɔman mu no nyinara nye nkurow na nkuraase pii hyɛ ne nsa.
ii. Ɔhwɛ yɛ n’asɛdze wɔ guabɔ biara ase dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata.
iii. Ɔno na bea no do nsaase nyina hyɛ ne nsa.
iv. Ɔbɔ amandze na amambra ho ban.
v. Ɔhwɛ ma no nkorɔfo nya mpontu.
vi.  Odzi amanyɛsɛm na sikasɛm ntotoe a ɔwɔ ne man no mu ho nsɛm.
vii. Ɔyɛ egua no ho amandze.
viii. Ɔhyɛ mbra ma ahemfo nkaa no dzi do.
Ahemfo nkakraba
Dɛm ahemfo yi mu bi yɛ ahemfo a wɔyɛ ahemfo nkakraba a hɔn nyinara hyehyɛ 
ɔmanhen no ase. Wɔwɔ nkurow nkraba a wɔhwɛ do. Iyi yɛ adzedzi a woegyina 
wɔfa adzedzi anaa egya adzedzi do ahyehyɛ ato hɔ dada.
Ɔmanhen n’apamfo hɔn dwumadzi:
i. Wotum si ɔmanhen no anan mu ber a ɔmanhen no nnyi hɔ.
ii. Wɔhwɛ dɛ ewurkadze nnkɔkɔ do wɔ ɔman no mu.
iii. Wodzi asɛm ma pɛrpɛr yɛ edwuma.
iv. Wɔbɔ nsaase ho ban.
v. Wɔhwɛ ma asomdwee ba.
vi. Wɔyɛ egua no ho atɔrmuadze na wodzi enyim ma wɔpa mbusu.
Mbaahembaa
Mbaahembaa yɛ mbasiafo hɔn sunsum mu baanodzifo na enyimdzifo a wɔbɔ 
abakɔsɛm ho ban. Wodzi dwuma soronko dze bɔ mbaa ho ban. Sɛ egua tɔ pan wɔ 
wɔfa adzedzi mu a, ɔbaahembaa na ɔka a obi nnka bio wɔ nyia wobesi no ɔhen ho 
ber a edzin ahorow abɔtɔ gua. Wotum so yi hɔn mbaahembaa nkakraba.

d. Wogyina hɔn nyimdzee do ma amamfo no nkyerɛkyerɛ.
Esihemfo
Esihemfo yɛ nyimpakuw bi a wɔwɔ tum kɛse wɔ ɔhen ne nsii mu wɔ ebusuadehye 
no mu. Hɔnankasa dze, wonntum nnyɛ ahemfo. Wohyia fa adwen kyerɛ nyia 
ahendzi no edu no do ber a egua no atɔ pan.
Esihemfo Hɔn Dwumadzi
i. Wosi ɔhen fofor.
ii. Ɔhen wu a, hɔn na wɔyɛ amandze.
iii. Wotu ɔhen.
iv. Wɔda ɔhen fofor no edzi kyerɛ apamfo no na ɔman mu no nyinara.
v. Wotu ɔhen no fo.

 AKENKANSƐM
 Ansaana abaefor kabimamenkabi amambu robɔbɔ adze no, nna kusum 
amambu tse ase. Dɛm kusum amambu yi gyina nhyehyɛɛ soronko bi 
do. Hɛn nkuraase na nkurow nkakraba no mu no, ɔhen (ɔdzekurow) 
na n’apamfo wɔda nkurow ano. Hɔn na wɔfa kurow no ho adwen. Dza 
wɔhwɛɛ ho paaw dɛm mpanyimfo yi nye hɔn nyansaa, mpanyinyɛ na 
hɔn suahu. Yeyi dɛm nkuroba yi mu ahemfo si nkyɛn a, yɛwɔ ahemfo 
a wɔkrɔn a hɔn nye amanhen. Hɔn na nna wɔhwɛ nkurow nkurow pii 
do siesie nsɛm na wɔhwɛ ma asomdwee tsena hɔ daa. Nna ɔmahen wɔ 
abaguafo a hɔn so wɔyɛ ahemfo a wotu no fo. Ɔwɔ dɛ ɔmahen n’adwen 
a ɔbɛfa biara yɛ dza ɔbɛyɛ mfaso ama ne mamfoe. Ɔmahen nye ahemfo 
mu panyin koraa a no tum bor nkaafo no nyinara hɔn dze do wɔ tumdzi 
nhyehyɛɛ pon no do. Ndzɛmba a dɛm kusum amambu hyehyɛɛ yi hwɛ 
kwan nye kabimamenkabi, obu na enyidzi a yɛdze ma mpanyimfo na 
mfaso a ɔwɔ hɔ dɛ ɔman no nyina bɛyɛ adwen kor.
4. Hom ndzi nkɔmbɔ mfa kusum amambu mu edzibewdzifo no hɔn 
dwumadzi ebiasa ho na hɔn bo a ɔsom ma amamfo no ho.

mfantsekasa mu kasadwin
Ano Kasadwin na Akyerɛw Kasadwin
NYIENYIM
Dɛm ɔfa yi kasa fa Mfantsekasa mu Ano na Akyerɛw kasadwin ho. Yɛbɛka ano 
kasadwin ne ba kor a ɔyɛ nsagu ho asɛm akyerɛ ne mfaso anaa no bo a ɔsom na 
mbrɛ wosi gu nsa. Bɔ mbɔdzen dɛ ebɛkyerɛ w’adwen wɔ mfaso a wo nkorɔfo 
nya wɔ nsagu ho, ho. Dɛm adzesua yi bɔboa wo wɔ adzesuadze nkaa bi tse dɛ 
ɔsom ahorow ho adzesua (Religious Studies) mu. Ɔbɛsan ama eehu mbrɛ ibesi 
apɛnsapɛnsa wo kusum mu nye afofor dze mu na ehu no bo a ɔsom. Ɔfa yi ara so 
mu no, yɛbɔhwɛ eyiadze osu n’adzeban wɔ Ghanaman yi mu na mbrɛ Mfantsefo 
so si hu no. Yebedzi eyiadze osu bi ho nkɔmbɔ na yɛdze hɛn adwen akɔ dwuma 
a wɔdze dzi do. Bio, ɔfa yi bɛkasa afa akyerɛwtsen na no ho ndzɛmba ho. Hom 
kyerɛkyerɛnyi bedzi hom enyim ma hom ahwɛ akyerɛwtsen ho ndzɛmba bi tse dɛ 
agofomba, nsɛntsitsir, nsɛnsisii, ber na bea (sibeaber), mbrɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no si hu 
ndzɛmba na ne nkekaho.
Adzesua yi bɔkɔ ewiei no, nna esuafo no tum:
• Kyerɛ nsagu ne nhyehyɛɛ wɔ Mfantsekasa mu (Ɔfrɛ, asɛm no ankasa, na 
ewiei).
• Pɛnsapɛnsa eyiadze osu mu dze kyerɛ no dwumadzi na no bo a ɔsom.
• Kyerɛkyerɛ akyerɛwtsen ho ndzɛmba bi tse dɛ agofomba, nsɛntsitsir, 
nsɛnsisii, obi n’adwenkyerɛ a ɔfa kasadwin no ho na ne nkekaho mu.
• Pɛnsapɛnsa akyerɛwtsen mu dze da tsirasɛm, nsɛntsitsir, nkasafua 
dwumadzi, kasasu ahorow na dza ɔkeka ho edzi.
Adwentsitsir
• Nsagu yɛ kusum kwan a yɛfa do nye esunsum ahorow kasa (Mpaabɔ).
• Nsagu nhyehyɛɛ wɔ nkyekyɛmu ebiasa: Ɔfrɛ, Asɛm no ankasa, na Ewiei.

• Nsɛntsitsir yɛ adwenmusɛm anaa nsɛmpɔw etsitsir a ɔda edzi wɔ kasadwin 
bi mu.
• Nsɛnsisii yɛ mbrɛ nsɛm a ɔwɔ kasadwin mu no si sisi ndzidzido ndzidzido.
• Sibeaber yɛ ber na bea a nsɛm a ɔwɔ kasadwin mu no sisi.
• Obi n’adwenkyerɛ a ɔfa kasadwin no ho.
NSAGU
Nsagu ho nkɔmbɔtwetwe yi begyina ndzɔma ebiasa do wɔ ne nhyehyɛɛ no mu do. 
Iyinom nye Ɔfrɛ, asɛm no ankasa na ewiei.
Ebɛnadze nye nsagu?
Nsagu nye dɛ yeruhue nsa egu famu dɛ afɔrbɔdze ama sunsum anaa bosom bi. 
Ɔyɛ kwan a wɔfa do bɔ mpaa wɔ ɔsom bi mu. Ayim-Aboagye (1993: 165 dɛ mbrɛ 
ɔdaa no edzi wɔ 1996:9) no kyerɛ dɛ ɔyɛ ndzeyɛɛ a wɔdze nsu, nsadzen anaa 
anondze bi tse dɛ nsa fenemfenem gu famu dze frɛ esunsum ahorow gye hɔn hɔ 
mboa. Beebi mpo wotum dze emo yɛ. Nsagu dzi akotsen papaapa wɔ ebibiman 
mu. Yɛnam nsagu do yɛto nsa frɛ ewuakɔr nsamanfo a yɛgye dzi dɛ wɔka hɛn ho 
no ma wɔba bagua ahorow ase. Ghanaman mu, hɔn a wogu nsa wɔ bagua mu tse 
dɛ abadzinto ase, awargye ase, afahyɛ ase, ahensi ase, na dza ɔkeka ho ase bi nye 
fibobow mu mpanyimfo, ebusuapanyin anaa edzibewdzifo nkaa no.
Activity 8.1
Hwɛ nsagu ho sen ahorow a ofi mbeambea a ɔka do yi. Hyɛ mbrɛ isi hu nsagu 
ne nhyehyɛɛ no nsew. Afei, fa toto dza ɔwɔ ase ha yi ho.
Nsagu ne nhyehyɛɛ
Nsagu ne nhyehyɛɛ nye Ɔfrɛ, Asɛm no Ankasa na Ewiei.
Ɔfrɛ
Ɔfrɛ yɛ nsagu nhyehyɛɛ no ne fa a odzi kan. Ha na yɛtwe hɛn adwen kɔ do dɛ 
esunsum bi wɔ hɔ na yɛto nsa frɛ hɔn dɛ wombetsie hɛn. Nyia orugu nsa no dzi 
kan frɛ Twerammpɔn Kwame. Afei, ɔfrɛ asaase efuwa na ɔdze asaase do abosom 
4

nkaa no toa do ana ɔaafrɛ ewuakɔr nsamanfo so. Ɔfrɛ yi na ɔbɔ esunsum ahorow 
no hɔn abobow mu dze twe hɛn adwen ba hɛn do.
Mfatoho bi na ɔwɔ ase ha yi.
Twerammpɔn Kwame, yɛkyerɛ wo nsa, yɛmma wo nsa.
Asaase Efuwa, bɛgye nsa.
Ɔgyeewusuw na Edumanu, hom mbɛgye nsa.
Ɔpanyin Kweku Adamu, Kɔbena Kɔm, Kɔbena Arhinful,
Abena Asantsewaa, Kwesi Eyipe, hom nsa nye iyi.
Asɛm no Ankasa
Nsagu mu asɛm no ankasa gyina hɔ ma nsagu no no botae.
Otum yɛ adzeserɛ anaa abawdobɔ. Dɛm ber yi na nyia orugu nsa no dze siantsir a 
ɔfrɛɛ hɔn no to esunsum no enyim na ɔserɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnka hɔn ho fi dwumadzi no 
ahyɛse nkodu ewiei. Ha so na ɔserɛ dwumadzi no mu bambɔ.
Ewiei
Ha na yɛda esunsum no ase dɛ yɛfrɛɛ hɔn no, wɔbɔɔ worata betsiei. Afei, yɛbɔ 
anhoba dɛ, sɛ wɔyɛ hɛn ebisadze no ma hɛn a, yɛbɛma hɔn biribi dɛ afɔrbɔdze. 
Yesan so bisa ndom ma hɔn a wɔmmpɛ kurow no ne yieyɛ anaa dwumadzi no, no 
nkɔdo. Hɔn a wɔper papa no dze, wobisa nhyira ma hɔn. Ɔtɔfabi a, dwumadzi tse 
dɛ akraguar ase no, wɔdze biribi bɔ afɔr ma esunsum no wɔ ha. Ghanaman mu 
nsagu ho mfonyin bi na ɔka do yi.

EYIADZE OSU
Asɛmbisa a ohia ndwendwenho:
Sɛ wo dɔfo anaadɛ wo busuanyi bi fi mu a, tsebea no tse dɛn?
Ebɛnadze nye eyiadze osu?
Eyiadze osu yɛ dirge wɔ Borɔfokasa mu. Kasafua yi fi Latin kasafua Derigi mu. 
Asekyerɛ nye ndwom anaa sukwadwom a mpɛn pii no ɔbata eyiyɛ anaa dwumadzi 
bi a yɛdze kaa ewufo ho. Wɔsan kyerɛ mu dɛ ɔyɛ awerɛhow ndwom bi a ɔda 
famu bɔkɔɔ. Eyiadze osu anaa sukwadwom yɛ ndwom a owieiwie awensɛm. 
Tserɛ, sukwadwom yɛ ndwom a yɛfa no dɛ awensɛm a yɛdze kamfo owufo. Yɛfa 
sukwadwom anaa eyiadze osu dɛ ɔyɛ amandze a yɛyɛ dze yi obi fi ɔbra kanko 
gyinapɛn no mu kor mu (atseasefo asaase) dze no kɔ fofor mu (samanadze).
Sukwadwom no dwumadzi
Sukwadwom wɔ Ebibiman mu kukum mu dzi dwuma pii. Bi na ɔka do yi.
1. Wɔdze su ewufo.
2. Wɔfa sukwadwom do nye ewufo dzi mpaapaamu.
3. Wɔdze to nkra wɔ samanadze
4. Wɔdze sukwadwom yɛ ntotɔserɛ ma ewufo.
5. Ɔnam sukwadwom do ma yehu tsebea a obi anaa nkorɔfo bi wɔ mu
Sukwadom ho mfaso
Sukwadwom ho mfaso bi na ɔwɔ ase ha yi.
1. Ɔda edzi dɛ ayɛyi na enyidzi a yɛdze ma ewufo.
2. Ɔma yehu nkitahodzi a ɔda tsetse na ndɛ nye ewuakɔr na atseasefo ntamu.
3. Ɔma yɛgye to mu dɛ yɛahwer adze.
4. Ɔkyerɛ ebusuabɔ anaa nkitahodzi a no mu nntsew da.
5. Sukwadwom ma yenya gyedzi dɛ owufo no enya tsenabea pa.
