AKYERƐWTSEN HO NDZƐMBA TSITSIR
Akyerɛwtsen
Akyerɛwtsen yɛ kasadwin a nkorɔfo taa kyerɛw papaapa. Borɔfokasa mu no, ɔyɛ 
prose a ofi Latin kasafua prosa a asekyerɛ nye tɔɔtsee. Ogyina hɔ ma akyerɛw 
biara a ɔfa kasakyerɛ na kasa su. Akyerɛwtsen dzi kasa mbra na kasa nhyehyɛɛ 
do pɛpɛɛpɛr na ɔkɔ waa dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse wɔ abrabɔ mu no ara pɛr. Onndzi nhyehyɛɛ 
soronko bi tse dɛ ngyegyee kor anaa dza ɔtse dɛm do. Yedua akyerɛwtsen do dze 
hɛn adwen, nsusui nye dza yɛwɔ to gua prɛkopɛr.
Dwumadzi 8.11
Kyerɛ mbrɛ isi tse akyerɛwtsen ase na fa toto esuafo afofor dze ho.
Akyerɛwtsen ho ndzɛmba tsitsir
i. Agofomba: Agofomba nye nyimpa, mbowa anaa abɔdze biara a wɔdze  
gyina hɔ wɔ akyerɛwtsen no mu wɔ dwumadzi bi ntsi. Asɛm a ɔkyerɛwfo 
no dze to gua no gyina agofomba no hɔn nkitahodzi do. Agofomba a wodzi 
akotsen wɔ akyerɛwtsen mu no yɛfrɛ hɔn etsiban anaa agofomba etsitsir. 
Agofomba ho hia papaapa tsitsir noara nye etsiban no. Hɔn na asɛm no 
nyinara gyina hɔn do. Ɔhaw anaa ndzepa bi si a, hɔn na ɔtaa kɔ ma hɔn. 
Yɛwɔ agofomba bi so a wɔko tsia dza otsiban no reyɛ no na wɔma ɔhaw 
ahorow so ba. Obi a ɔtse dɛm no, wɔfrɛ no ɔkotsianyi. Agofomba bi so wɔ 
hɔ a, hɔn adwen na hɔn su na hɔn ndzeyɛɛ mbrɛ ɔtse araa na ɔtse; wɔnnsesa 
da na yɛwɔ binom so a dza osisi wɔ nsɛm no mu no ma wɔsesa hɔn adwen, 
hɔn su na hɔn ndzeyɛɛ.
ii. Asɛntsitsir (Adwempɔw): Iyi nye asɛm anaa adwen pɔtsee a ɔkyerɛwfo no 
dze to gua a ɔpɛ dɛ akenkanfo hu. Mpɛn pii no, iyi gyina agofomba no hɔn 
nkitahodzi anaa hɔn ndzeyɛɛ ahorow do. Akyerɛw bi wɔ nsɛntsitsir nkumaa 
a wɔboa ma asintsitsir da edzi.
iii. Bea na ber (Sibeaber): Iyi ma akenkanfo hu ber pɔtsee nye bea pɔtsee a 
nsɛm a ɔwɔ akyerɛw no mu no sisi anaa sisii. Otum yɛ ɔpɛ ber, esusuow, 
Borɔnyaber, ewiaber, anadwe, ndɔnsia, anapa ndɔnwɔtwe na dza ɔkeka 
ho. Mbea no bi tum yɛ ahemfie, Firaw Mantɔw mu, Finimfin Mantɔw mu, 
Oguaa aban mu, skuul, fie, akwantu mu na ne nkekaho. Nsɛm a ɔkɔ do wɔ 
mbea no na dza osi wɔ ber ahorow no mu no nyinara ka ho bi.
10
ƆFA 8 KASADWIN
iv. Nhyehyɛɛ anaa Nsɛnsisii: Iyi yɛ kwan a ɔkyerɛwfo no si dze ne nsɛm a osisi 
(nsɛnsisii) no to gua esiado esiado. Mbrɛ osi hyehyɛ adwenkyerɛ bi a wɔbɔ 
ebira, ɔhaw ahorow, awerɛfir mu adwensakyer nye hɔn kɔfabae nyina ka ho.
v. 
vi. Ɔtowfo ne gyinabew: Iyi yɛ mbrɛ ɔkyerɛwfo anaa ɔtowfo no si hu dza ɔrokɔ 
do no. Otum dze noho hyɛ asɛm no mu na otum so hu no dɛ ofi ɔkasafo a 
otsia ebiasa no hɔ. Ɔkasafo a odzi kan dzinhyɛananmu bi nye Me, mo, mi 
na mu. Ɔkasafo a ɔtɔ do ebiasa dzinhyɛananmu so bi nye Ɔ, O, no, ne, wɔ, 
wo, hɔn.
vii. Tsebea: Iyi yɛ atsenka a ɔtowfo anaa ɔkyerɛwfo no pɛ dɛ akenkanfo nam hɔn 
atsenkadze ahorow no do nya. Obotum ayɛ awerɛhow, enyigye, enyidado 
na dza ɔkeka ho.
Dwumadzi 8.12
Enye wo nyɛnko nkyerɛkyerɛ akyerɛwtsen ho ndzɛmba etsitsir no mu anan 
na hom mfa nto gua.
Dwumadzi 8.13
Bisa wo kyerɛkyerɛnyi ma ɔma wo akyerɛwtsen bi. Enye wo nyɛnko nkenkan 
na no hom nhwehwɛ akyerɛwtsen ho ndzɛmba etsitsir a ɔwɔ mu no. Fa nsɛm 
wɔ dza hom kenkanee no mu taa wo mbuae no ekyir. Afei hom mfa nyiano 
no nto esuafo nkaa no enyim.

Phonology (Speech sounds of a Ghanaian language)
INTRODUCTION
Dear learner, you are welcome to this section which discusses the foundation 
of language (speech sounds). You will be introduced to the concepts of vowels 
and consonants of your language of study and how speech sounds are described 
(parametre). It will focus on where the speech sounds occur in words of a Ghanaian 
language. For example, where vowels and consonants can occur in a word of a 
Ghanaian language such as initial position, medial position, or final position of 
a word. Again, Dear learner you will be introduced to the distribution of vowels 
and consonants in their language, aiding them to form meaningful words and 
facilitate effective speaking and reading in the language. This section is essential 
for learners not only in the context of Ghanaian language studies but also to 
establish links with related subjects such as English and other languages. This 
section equips you with foundational knowledge and functional understanding 
of speech sounds and their role in language learning. In summary, you should be 
able to identify, explain, produce, and label vowel charts and consonant tables of 
your language of study.
By the end of the lesson, you should be able to:
1. Describe the vowels of a Ghanaian language using the right parameters 
(e.g., lip posture, tongue height and part of the tongue).
2. Describe the consonants of the Ghanaian language using the right 
parameters (e.g., voicing, place of articulation and manner of articulation).
3. Explain the distribution of vowels of the Ghanaian language (e.g., word 
initial, medial and final).
4. Explain the distribution of consonants of the Ghanaian language (e.g., 
word initial, medial and final).

SECTION 1 SOUNDS OF THE LANGUAGE 
Key ideas
 Production refers to the making or saying of a speech sound in language. 
Speech sound is a sound used in the formation of words for human 
communication. The production of speech sound involves obstruction 
which is the interruption of free flow of air during production of speech 
sounds. Sounds are distributed in languages and this refers to the place 
or position in a word where a sound can appear. Sound involves airflow 
which is a mass movement of air that is meant for the production of 
speech sounds. Another term for it is airstream.
TYPES OF SPEECH SOUNDS
Speech sounds can be grouped into two main types, namely vowels and consonants. 
It is the combination of these two types of sounds that produces words. In other 
words, all words are made up of individual speech sounds. For examples, the word 
pan consists of three individual speech sounds, that is, /p/, /a/, /n/. The sound /a/ 
is a vowel, whereas the sounds /p/ and /n/ are consonants. In the following topics 
we discuss both vowels and consonants focusing on how each is produced in a 
Ghanaian language.
The concept of vowel
The concept vowel refers as a speech sound in which production there is a little or 
no obstruction of the flow of air in the oral cavity. In other words, a speech sound 
which when being produced the air is not obstructed or it is minimally obstructed 
in the oral cavity is referred to as a vowel. Since in their production there is no 
or very little obstruction of airflow, vowels are comparatively heard louder when 
they are produced. Vowels are very important part of words. There cannot be a 
word without a vowel or vowel-like sound. This important role vowel plays in a 
word will later on in your second year be discussed when we are talking about the 
syllable.
Description of vowels
Dear learner, in describing vowels of a Ghanaian language, there are certain 
properties we use. These properties are often termed parametres. Parametres 
simply refer to the characteristics that a vowel possesses. The main parametres 
used in describing vowels are the tongue height, lip posture, and part of the tongue 
4

used during the production of the vowel sound. In addition to the three, there 
is a fourth parameter called advancement of the tongue root in some Ghanaian 
languages such as Akan. Let us begin the discussions of these parametres.
Lip position/posture:
The parametre lip posture is used to determine the position your lips assume when 
you are producing a vowel. So, at this level, the lips assume two main postures 
or positions, namely rounded or unrounded. That is, whether the lips are rounded 
or they are not rounded when a vowel sound is being produced. Based on this 
posture of the lips, we can divide vowels of a Ghanaian language into two, namely 
‘rounded’ and ‘spread/unrounded.’ Some examples of rounded vowels are /u, 
o, ɔ/. examples of unrounded vowels, on the other hand, are /i, e, a/.
Activity
At this point, produce rounded and unrounded/spread vowels of your Ghanaian 
language of study.
Tongue height/Height of the tongue:
This refers to the position of the tongue in reference to the root of the mouth when 
producing vowel sounds. It is assumed that when we are producing vowels, the 
mouth opens when we drop the jaw. This can be high, mid, or low. When we 
drop our jaws to the lowest possible position, the vowels produced in this way are 
referred to as low vowels. Examples of low vowel is /a/, and in some Ghanaian 
languages [æ]. When we open our mouth wide enough but not as low as when 
producing low vowels, then the vowels we produced are termed mid vowels. 
Some examples of mid vowels in a Ghanaian language are /e, o/. In producing 
high vowels, on the other hand, the mouth is significantly opened but not as wide 
as mid vowels, thereby allowing enough air to flow through the oral cavity. Some 
examples of high vowels in a Ghanaian language are /i, u/.
Activity
Begin practicing the production of vowels in your language of study focusing 
on how high or how low you raise your jaws or open your mouth.
5
SECTION 1 SOUNDS OF THE LANGUAGE 
Part of the tongue:
This parametre refers to the area of the tongue where the vowel sound is produced. 
It is assumed that when we are producing vowels, some parts of the tongue 
move. We cannot easily feel this movement though. Three parts of the tongue 
are assumed to be involved when a vowel sounds is being produced. These parts 
are the front part, middle part, and back part. Based on that, the parametre gives 
us three classes of vowels, namely front, mid, and back vowels. In producing 
front vowels, it is the front part of the tongue that moves. Some examples of front 
vowels of a Ghanaian language are /i, e, ɛ/. For the production of mid vowels, 
the middle of the tongue is assumed to move. Therefore, the following vowel is 
an example of a mid-vowel: /a/. For back vowels, on the other hand, as the name 
suggests, it is the back of the tongue that is involved in their production. Some 
examples of back vowels of a Ghanaian language are: /u, o, ɔ/.
Activity
Practice how to produce vowels of your language of study with focus on the 
part of the tongue.
Having finished discussing the main parametres we use in describing vowels of 
a Ghanaian language, there is a fourth parametre as mentioned earlier in this 
sub-strand which is not common among Ghanaian languages. This parametre is 
advancement of the tongue.
Advancement of the tongue root (ATR): (Please, discuss only 
if applicable in your language)
This parametre, which is prominent in a few Ghanaian languages including Akan, 
Dagbani, etc. It is used to determine the position the tongue root assumes when a 
vowel is being produced. By this parametre, we try to find out if there is tension 
or pressure on the tongue or not during production of vowels. When a vowel is 
produced with pressure on the tongue thereby causing the tongue root to draw 
back, we say that vowel is produced with Advanced Tongue Root (ATR) i.e. 
(+ATR) vowels. When vowels are produced with the tongue root in its natural 
neutral position, we label those vowels are Unadvanced Tongue Root i.e. (-ATR) 
vowels. Some examples of (+ATR) vowels are: /i, e, u, o/, and examples of (-ATR) 
vowels are /ɪ, ɛ, ɔ/.

Having discussed the nature of vowel sounds and the parametres used in describing 
the vowel sounds of your language, we now focus our attention on the production 
of consonants.
The concept of consonant
As was mentioned earlier in the section, consonant is another type of speech sounds 
apart from vowel. The concept consonant refers to a speech sound in which during 
production the breath, which we have termed airflow, is at least obstructed. Based 
on this explanation, we can contrast vowel and consonant by saying that while in 
the production of vowel there is very minimal or no obstruction of airflow, there 
is significant obstruction of airflow when producing consonants. We combined 
vowels and consonants form a word.

Consonant Distribution
The concept consonant distribution simply refers to the position in a word where 
a consonant can occur in a particular Ghanaian language. A consonant that 
occurs at the beginning of a word is referred to as word initial consonant. When a 
consonant occurs at the middle of a word, we refer to it as word medial consonant. 
When a consonant occurs at the end of a word, we refer to refer to it as word final 
consonant. Let us note that some consonants can occur in all positions of a word. 
For example, in some Ghanaian languages, the consonant /m/ can occur in the 
three positions in a word.

INTRODUCTION
This section discusses identification of key ideas in texts and discourse. It 
always gives information on specific ideas or knowledge to the reader or hearer. 
The information given may come from all perspectives such as education, 
industrialisation, mining among others. It may also indicate some cultural values 
such as respect, tolerance and patience. Identifying key ideas gives you a better 
understanding of the discourse. It also enhances your critical thinking skills and 
interpretation abilities. There are types of reading techniques namely skimming 
and scanning and the application of any of the type enables you to get the right 
information demanded at any time. Knowledge of the types is therefore essential 
in our everyday life. The concept of oral interpretation will also be discussed. We 
shall discuss the skills needed for effective interpretation. Interpretation plays 
important roles in facilitating communication across language barriers.
By the end of this you will be able to
• Identify key ideas from appropriate discourse. E.g., cultural values 
(respect, kindness, tolerance and others), education, child trafficking, 
environment, industrialisation in Ghana, mining, GESI etc.,
• Discuss ideas and relevant opinions from selected discourse. E.g., 
cultural values (respect, kindness, tolerance and others), education, 
child trafficking, environment, industrialisation in Ghana, mining, GESI, 
STEM, etc.
Key Ideas
 Key ideas are the main messages that is relevant in any discourse. Some 
of the key ideas may center on cultural values such as respect, kindness, 
tolerance, patience, etc. In any discourse you can share relevant opinions

KEY IDEA
Dear learner, before leaving home for your present school, what are the main 
points from the conversation you had with your parent/guardian? Share with peers.
The main points you shared with your peers are known to as key ideas. Key ideas are 
the essential ideas that the author or speaker wants to give to the reader or hearer/
listener respectively. The ideas may include the claims, the reasons, conclusions, 
definitions, classifications, comparisons, evaluations, recommendations, etc. Key 
ideas can be expressed explicitly or implicitly.
For you to identify the key ideas in discourse there is the need for you to understand 
the main concepts, arguments, and the points made. Note that the discourse 
could deal with any topic such as mining, teenage pregnancy, natural disaster, 
educational issues among others. It must also be pointed out that it could also 
come in a text form, video or picture or all the forms mentioned.
In summary, my dear learner to identify the key ideas in a discourse which may be 
written or oral or visual, you may need to answer the following questions
• Find who or what the passage discusses: Does this passage discuss a 
person, group of people or an entity?
• Ask when the event took place: Does the information contain a reference to 
time?
• Find where the event took place: Does the text name a place?
• Ask why the event took place: Do you find a reason or explanation for 
something that happened?
• Ask how the event took place: Does this information indicate a method or a 
theory?
NB: In a text, key ideas are sometimes italicised, boldened, or underlined. You can also find it 
in the topic sentence.

individuals or groups either in spoken form or written form. It involves the

Reading
By the end of the sub-strand you should be able to:
i. Discuss skimming using preview, overview and review.
ii. Discuss scanning using the strategies (e.g., movement of eyes or finger,

Key ideas
 Skimming is going through a text rapidly to get the general information 
in the text while scanning involves looking for a specific information in 
a text. Scanning is a process of reading in which your eyes quickly run 
through a piece of text to find a piece of relevant information. Scanning 
and skimming are two different concepts of reading.
Types of reading
There are types of reading skill or technique namely skimming, scanning, 
intensive reading and extensive reading. Dear learner, in this lesson you shall 
learn skimming and scanning techniques of reading.
Skimming
Skimming is a reading technique used to quickly identify the main ideas or key 
points in a text. It is the action of reading something quickly so as to note only the 
important points. Basically, skimming is reading rapidly in order to get a general 
overview of the material read. It is used to find specific facts in texts. It involves 
glancing over the material, focusing on headings, subheadings, bold text and key 
phrases to get a general understanding of the content. Skimming is useful when; 
time is limited, looking for specific information, you want to get an overview 
before reading in-depth and you are dealing with a large amount of text. Below 
are the skimming types.
8
SECTION 2 SHARING IDEAS AND ORAL INTERPRETATION 
1. Preview: An opportunity to view something before it is acquired or becomes 
generally available. Preview is done in an effort to learn about the ideas 
presented and the structure of their development.
2. Overview: Used to sample the reading material more thoroughly. A general 
review or summary of a subject.
3. Review: The review is done to re-familiarise yourself with the material 
you have previously read thoroughly or skimmed. A formal assessment of 
something with the intention of instituting a change if necessary.
Learner, in skimming, you can follow these steps
i. Read the title
ii. Read the headings and sub-headings as well as topic sentences in each 
paragraph
iii. Look for important information such as date, names and unusual words.
iv. Read the conclusion

In summary you have learnt skimming and the steps as well as the types of 
skimming which you can apply. Dear learner, let us examine what is scanning.
Scanning
Scanning is reading rapidly in order to find facts without reading everything. 
Scanning helps you locate a particular fact while skimming tells you what general 
information is within a section.
Scanning involves looking for a specific information in a text. It can also be said 
to be a process of reading in which your eyes quickly run through a piece of text 
to find a piece of relevant information. In scanning the reader looks for a piece 
of specific information. An example of scanning is searching for the meaning 
of a word in a dictionary. Scanning helps the reader to locate particular facts in 
an entire text quickly. Students often use scanning when solving their reading 
comprehension questions.
It is important to know the purpose for scanning. You should know what you are 
searching for, eg title of a book, a website, a reference material, a particular word 
or phrase and a particular story you want to read etc. You should know how the 
material is structures either alphabetically, non-alphabetically, chronologically, 
by category, by titles /headings, by textual sense, by numbers among others.
Scanning helps a learner to read more and to develop love for reading.

When to scan
1. Scan before reading
2. Scan a number of questions to identify the one which you are most 
comfortable answering
3. When searching for particular information such as date, keywords etc.
The following shows how to do scanning after getting overview of a text and 
identifying the sections of the text you want to read.
1. Start scanning the text by moving your eyes and fingers quickly over it
2. When you have identified the information, word or the phrase you are 
searching for, read the information surrounding the word carefully
3. When you identified the information that requires attention, you read it 
thoroughly slowly.

Oral Interpretation and translation
By the end of the sub-strand the learner should be able to:
 Discuss oral interpretation focusing on effective listening, encoding and

Key Ideas
 Oral interpretation is reframing the meaning of a speech most often orally 
into another language. The original language is the source language 
and the language in which it is rendered is the target language. In oral 
interpretation you must note the cultural differences and be accurate in 
giving the meaning of what you are to render in the language orally.
INTERPRETATION
Interpretation is listening to a message in one language and rendering it orally 
in another language maintaining the original meaning, tone and context. It 
is the stylistic representation of a creative work or dramatic role. It is the act 
of explaining, reframing, or otherwise showing your own understanding of 
something. In interpretation you first have to understand the text or the piece 
given to you and then explain in your own words. In broader terms it is rendering 
a spoken or signed message into another spoken or signed language preserving 
the register and meaning of the source language content.
Dear learner, it must be noted that before you can do any interpretation, you must 
be well versed in the source and target language. Interpretation can be performed 
either simultaneously or consecutively between users of different languages.
Dear learner, know that in interpreting you do not embellish or over-exaggerate. 
State the ideas clearly. In interpreting you need to listen carefully, decode and 
encode as they serve as the process of communication and interpreting.

Duzu a le dumangilenu ?
Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu, bɛhile edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ nsa nsa mɔɔ ɛbɛva 
wɔahile kɛsi ninyɛne/menli ɛhye mɔ de la;
• Wɔ sukulu sua ne anu
• Ɛ gɔnwo kpalɛ
• Wɔ ɛkponle ne
• Kɛ sukulu ɛkɛ ne si de la
Adwenle mɔɔ wɔ dumangilenu nwo a le kɛ, ɔle edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ yɛfa yɛkile kɛsi 
duma bie de la. Dumangilenu le edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ yɛfa yɛka edwɛkɛ yɛfale 
subane mɔɔ awie anzɛɛ deɛ bie lɛ la anwo.Dumangilenu ndonwo bie mɔ a le 
amunli, bile, akɔlɛnlome, fufule, ezinra, tendenle, kɛlɛma, futufutu, kpole, ekyi, 
ɛdenra, anyelielɛ, nyane, nrɛlɛbɛ, nɔhalɛ nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Ɛhye mɔ a le ndonwo 
mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛzi bɛva dumangilenu ndonwo bɛli gyima wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu la.
i. Mekulo azua dɛba.
ii. Kakula nrenyia ne le tendenle ɛdenra.
iii. Aku ze nwoma tɛla ɔ diema nrenyia ne
Wɔ ndonwo (i) ne anu, edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ dɛba ɛlɛkile amaa yɛanwu sua holɛ mɔɔ 
tendɛvolɛ ne kulo la. Wɔ (ii) ne anu, edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ tendenle nee ɛdenra ɛlɛkile 
amaa yɛanwu kɛ kakula nrenyia ne sonla baka ne de la. Wɔ (iii) anu noko bɛlɛdua 
edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ nwoma tɛla azo bɛava Aku nee ɔ diema nrenyia ne bɛatoto nwo.
Dumangilenu Ngakyile
Yɛlɛ dumangilenu ekpunli ngakyile, nuhua titili ne mɔ mɔɔ yɛbazukoa la a le;
• Fɔɔnwohilelɛ dumangilenu
• Dodohilelɛ dumangilenu
• Subanehilelɛ dumangilenu
• Ndotonwo dumangilenu
Wɔ ɛhye abo, fɔɔnwohilelɛ dumagya (ɛhye, ɛhendeɛ/zɔhane, ɛhye mɔ, ɛhendeɛ 
mɔ) a bɛfa bɛdi dumangilenu gyima a ɔluakɛ bɛkile deɛholɛ kpɔkyee mɔɔ bɛlɛka 
nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la. Nea ndonwo ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la:
a. Kale ɛhye le fofolɛ.
b. Raalɛ ne a lɛ azua ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ.
c. Sua ɛhendeɛ le me ze ɛdeɛ.
d. Aku ɛlɛtɔ azua ɛhye mɔ.

Ndotonwo dumangilenu
Yɛdua zo yɛfa menli anzɛɛ ninyɛne nwiɔ subane yɛtoto nwo. Ndotonwo 
dumangilenu ɛhye mɔ bie a le ekyi kpalɛ, anwuma kpalɛ, koatee kpalɛ, nwoma 
kpalɛ, dɔɔnwo/zonle…tɛla, ekyi…..tɛla nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Wɔ ndonwo ɛhye mɔ anu 
yɛva ndotonwo dumangilenu a yɛli gyima a.
a. Aleɛ ɛhye bolɛ ɛnyɛ se.
b. Aama ze nwoma kpalɛ tɛla Kofi.
c. Kale fufule ne anwo yɛ ndɛ kpalɛ tɛla nuhua buluu ne.
d. Wɔ ezukoa ne le ekyi tɛla me deɛ ne.
Dodohilelɛ dumangilenu
Dumangilenu ɛhye mɔ ka edwɛkɛ fale dodo nwo. Bɛdi dumangilenu gyima ɔluakɛ 
bɛkile duma bie ye dodo mɔɔ ɔde la. Nea ndonwo ɛhye mɔ.
a. Mendɔle awule bie.
b. Bɛdonle aholonvia nwiɔ.
c. Ɔhyia asikyɛlɛ ekyi.
d. Mbuluku dɔɔnwo wɔ me ɛlɛka ne anu.
Kɛside/subanehilelɛ dumangilenu
Kɛside/subanehilelɛ dumangilenu kile maa yɛnwu kɛsi duma bie de anzɛɛ subane 
mɔɔ duma holɛ ne da ye ali la. Bɛkile duma nu. Dumangilenu ndonwo dɔɔnwo ne 
ala vea ɛhye mɔ abo. Nea ndonwo ɛhye mɔ.
a. Kale ne le dɛba
b. Melɛ buluku ekyi bie.
c. Aleɛ ne le kɛlɛma.
d. Menwunle bɔɔso kpole bie.
Gyima
1. Sia kɔnlea edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnwunle bɛ wɔ ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ɛhye 
mɔlebɛbo la. Gua bɛ ekpunli fɔɔnwo nu wɔ fɔɔnwohilelɛ, dodohilelɛ 
anzɛɛ subanehilelɛ dumangilenu ne mɔ abo. Maa ndonwo bieko boka 
ekpunli ko biala anwo.
2. Kenga ɛgengadeɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la na kpondɛ dumangilenu ne mɔ 
mɔɔ wɔ nu la. Gua dumangilenu ne mɔɔ wɔkpondɛ la ekpunli fɔɔnwo

Kolaa na akɔlɛ abɔ mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa wɔ zɔhane nwonlomɔ ne la, ɛnee asɛɛ menli

Zɔhane sonla ne a vale aleɛ ebelete vile ye ɛya ne mɔɔ wɔ namule mɔɔ zua

Duzu a ɛyɛle ye nwonlomɔ ye a ? Kɛlɛhɛlɛ gyima ne mɔ.
Duzu adwenle a ɛlɛ ye wɔ wɔ sukulu ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ne mɔ anwo a ? Kɛlɛhɛlɛ wɔ 
nzuzulɛ ne mɔ.
Siezie ɛ nwo kɛ ɛbava wɔ nzuzulɛ ne wɔado gua amaa sukoavoma kɔsɔɔti awowɔ 
nwolɛ adwenle.
Yɛkpɔkɛ a le edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ kile nyɛleɛ la. Yɛkpɔkɛ eza noko kile 
edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ anzɛɛ ɛdendɛsinli mɔɔ kile gyinlabelɛ la (ndonwo; te nganeɛ, nyi, 
funvoa, nyia, kulo, kpɔ, ze/nwu, nee mɔɔ ɛha la.)
Yɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ finde ɛdendɛmunli nu la kola fa nyiavo anzɛɛ ɔnva nyiavo. Adenle 
ɛhye azo maa yɛnyia nyiavoanvakpɔkɛ, nyiavokpɔkɛ yɛɛ mɔnwonyiavokpɔkɛ.
Nyiavokpɔkɛ
Nyiavokpɔkɛ a le yɛkpɔkɛ ne mɔɔ fa nyiavo wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu la. Ndonwo bie 
mɔ a le to, no, ka, sa, di, kɛlɛ nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Ndonwo bie mɔ wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu
1. Kilehilevolɛ ne donle awule.
2. Sukoavoma ne zale nzule.
3. Kofi nee Adwoba di dwɔlɔfo.
4. Kale ne vale bakamra.
5. Adenduvoma ne vole kale ne.
Edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhyeɛhyea bɛ wɔ ɛdendɛmunli ne mɔ ko biala anu la 
le nyiavokpɔkɛ. Boavo ne anzɛɛ nyiavo ne toa yɛkpɔkɛ ne.Wɔ ndonwo 1 ne anu 
nyiavo ne a le awule yɛɛ wɔ ndonwo 5 ne anu nyiavo ne a le kale ne.
Nyiavoanvakpɔkɛ
Ɛhye mɔ a le yɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɛnva nyiavo la. Bɛngyia nyiavo na bɛ ndelebɛbo ala 
ali. Edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ anzɛɛ ɛdendɛsinli bie mɔ kola toa bɛ noko mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne 
ala ɛhye mɔ le yɛkpɔkɛngilenu. Ndonwo bie mɔ a le wu, tu, yalo, su, nyi nee mɔɔ 
ɛha la. Ndonwo wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu.
1. Bɛda ne ɛlɛyalo.
2. Nyamenleakatiba ne tu ndɛndɛ.
3. Sukoavo ne anye zo bulule arɛlevile nu.

Ɛvi azule ne anloa mɔɔ pɛ kɔ ɔ nzi la ɛnee ɛmbo mita abulanlu, noko akee 
ɛnee mekɛhulo kɛ mekɛweɛ kilomita ko azɛɛ mɔɔ bo la, wɔ azule mɔɔ abo kɔ 
na ɔle kalangala la anu. Ɛnee ɛkɛ ne bɔne ɛlɛnrɛne nwo.
Mɔɔ menzieziele me nwo kɛ mekɔ azule ne anu la, menvale me etu ne menzianle 
me gye nu na menvale nzɛlɛlɛ mendwule azule kpotolera ne anu. Menweɛle 
kɛ awie mɔɔ bɔ zo mɔɔ ɛlɛsukoa ɛweɛlɛ la. Ɛnee azule ne ɛzenlɛ anloa ɛnyɛ 
se yɛɛ nuhua le wuluwulu ekyi. Noko akee ɛzulolɛ ɛyɛlɛ hunle me,na ɔyɛle me 
kɛ melɛkɔ nyaanyaa.
Mendwule avinli la, arɛlevile nu ala, azule ne anu yɛle ɛse, na me kɛnra zile 
ndɛtɛlɛ ezukue zo na me adwenle yɛle me kɛ, ɛlɛnrɛne ɔ, na mɔɔ me adwenle 
yɛle me basaa la, etu ne vile me nloa anu dɔle azule ne anu.
Mɔɔ menwudwule azule ne ekyii la, eza mendɔle kuma nu bieko. Me nye kara 
me nwo zo la, ɛnee mewɔ azule ne anloa wɔ ɔ nzi lɔ. Ndɛndɛ nu ala, menvole 
mengɔle azɛlɛ ketekete ne azo. Ɔ muala rale awieleɛ, noko akee me konledeɛ 
ko kye mɔɔ melɛ ye la vile me sa.

SECTION 3 EDWƐKƐMGBƆKƐ NEE NGYEHYƐLEƐ
Duzu a le yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ?
Nea nvoninli ne mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la. Kɛ mbɛda ne mɔ ɛlɛsi anriandi ɛ ? Mekɛ ne 
boni anu a ɛhye ɛlɛkɔ zo a ? Nienwu a nyɛleɛ ne ɛlɛkɔ zo a ? Duzu ati a nyɛleɛ ne 
ɛlɛkɔ zo a ?
Yɛkpɔkɛngilenu a le edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ anzɛɛ ɛdendɛsinli mɔɔ kile nu maa yɛnyia 
yɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu la anwo ndelebɛbo kpalɛ a. Yɛkpɔkɛngilenu 
eza kola kilehile yɛkpɔkɛngilenu fofolɛ noko anu. Kɛsi ɛdiale ɛrale sukulu ɛnɛ 
ɛ, ɛdiale nyaanyaa, ndɛndɛ anzɛɛ ndɛndɛ kpalɛ? Bie a ɛdiale ndɛndɛ kpalɛ a 
ɛrale sukulu a. Edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ndɛndɛ kile kɛsi ɛdiale ɛrale sukulu la, ɛhye ati ɔle 
yɛkpɔkɛngilenu. Yɛgyinla kɛ yɛkpɔkɛngilenu si kile yɛkpɔkɛ nu la azo a, yɛnyia 
yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ekpunli ngakyile ne mɔ a. Ekpunli ngakyile ɛhye mɔ a le: kɛsi, 
ɛleka, mekɛ, dodo, deɛmɔti/bodane yɛɛ ɛleka-mɔɔ -ɔdwu la yɛkpɔkɛngilenu.
Kɛsi yɛkpɔkɛngilenu
Yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ɛhye kile kɛsi nyɛleɛ bie si, ɛlɛsi, zile anzɛɛ bazi la. Ndonwo bie 
mɔ a wɔ ɛdendɛmunli mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke anu la.
1. Sukoavo ne diale ndɛndɛ hɔle sukulu.
2. Nwɔhoadivoma ne lile nwɔhoa ne bɛtɛɛ.
3. Edwɛndovoma eku ne dole edwɛne ne aze bɛtɛɛ.
4. Aloma dole edwɛne fɛlɛko wɔ anwumanyunlu.
Ɛleka yɛkpɔkɛngilenu
Ɛleka yɛkpɔkɛngilenu kile ɛleka kpɔkyee mɔɔ nyɛleɛ bie hɔle zo anzɛɛ ɛlɛkɔ zo 
la. Ndonwo bie mɔ a bɛhile wɔ ɛdendɛmunli ne mɔ anu la.

2. Koasi nee Akasi ɛlɛda anwuma.
3. Sukoavoma ne kpondenle ngɛlata ne wɔ ɛleka biala.

Mekɛ yɛkpɔkɛngilenu
Mekɛ yɛkpɔkɛngilenu kile mekɛ kpɔkyee mɔɔ nyɛleɛ bie si la. Ndonwo bie mɔ a 
wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu wɔ aze ɛke la.
1. Sukoavoma mɔɔ bawie sukulu la hɛlɛle bɛ sɔnea ne anoma.
2. Ɛnɛ yɛbali yɛ ewiazo aleɛ ne wɔ ɔfese ɛkɛ.
3. Ayia bahɔ zo nwonlomɔ dɔne ngɔnla.
Dodo/fane yɛkpɔkɛngilenu
Ɛhye kile fane dodo mɔɔ nyɛleɛ bie si la. Yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ɛhye mɔ mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne 
ala bɔ ɛdendɛmunli bo anzɛɛ dwula ɛdendɛmunli. Nuhua ekyi bie a ta findevinde 
ɛdendɛmunli avinli a. Ndonwo bie mɔ a le ɛvolɛ ɛvolɛ, ɛvolɛ biala, ɛlɛ, dahuu, 
dapɛne biala, kenle ko biala nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Nea ndonwo ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ aze 
ɛdendɛmunli ne mɔ anu la;
1. Bɛdi ɛvoyia ɛvolɛ biala.
2. Yɛdi aleɛ kenle ko biala.
3. Bɛnlie subane ɛtane bɛndo nu ɛlɛ wɔ sukulu .
4. Bɛsi mbɛda adua kɛ dahuu bɛkpuda bɛ gye.
5. Meba ɛke dahuu.
Wɔ anwuma ɛdendɛmunli ne mɔ anu, dodo yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ne mɔ a le ɛvolɛ 
biala, kenle ko biala, ɛlɛ, nee dahuu. Yɛnwu yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ɛlɛ nee dahuu kɛ 
bɛvinde ɛdendɛmunli ne avinli. Wɔ ndonwo 5 ne anu, yɛkpɔkɛngilenu dahuu a 
dwula ɛdendɛmunli ne a.
Deɛmɔti/Bodane yɛkpɔkɛngilenu
Yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ɛhye mɔ kile deɛ mɔɔ ɔti bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ bie anzɛɛ deɛ mɔɔ ɔti 
nzidwɛkɛ bie si la. Yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ɛhye ndonwo bie mɔ a le ɔluakɛ, ɔti, noko 
akee, yemɔti, ɛdeɛ, amaa nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Ndonwo wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu a wɔ aze 
ɛke la.
1. Melɛfi ɛke ndɛ amaa telafeke angye me.
2. Sukulu maanle adenle ɔti sukoavoma ne hɔle suanu.
3. Mengɔle gua nu ɛdeɛ, noko meannyia fɛlɛ.

Ɛleka-mɔɔ-ɔdwu yɛkpɔkɛngilenu
Yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ɛhye a le edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ kile ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ bie 
bɛhɔdwu anzɛɛ ka yɛkpɔkɛngilenu fofolɛ anwo edwɛkɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu ɛleka mɔɔ 
nyɛleɛ ne ɛhɔdwu anzɛɛ nyɛleɛ ne kpɔmgbɔse.Yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ɛhye mɔ boa maa 
yɛkpogya edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la zo anzɛɛ bɛka bɛ aze. 
Ndonwo bie mɔ a le bɔkɔɔ, kolaa, somaa, kpalɛ, kpole kpalɛ, zɛhae, nwanwane 
nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Nea ndonwo ne mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la:
1. Dazia mɔɔ wɔ aleɛ ne anu la anloa yɛ se somaa.
2. Bɛyɛ sua ne anu bɔkɔbɔkɔ zɛhae.
3. Bɛbole awule ne kpole somaa.
4. Ɔlile aleɛ ne kɛlɛma bɔkɔɔ.
Gyima 1
Kakye nyɛleɛ ne mɔɔ hɔle zolɛ wɔ ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ne mɔlebɛbo la. Ɛbanyia 
yɛkpɔkɛngilenu bie mɔ mɔɔ ɛbava wɔahile nyɛleɛ ne mɔɔ hɔle zo wɔ nvoninli 
ne anu la. Dua yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ekpunli ngakyile mɔɔ yɛzukoa bɛ kɛkala la 
azo, gua yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔnyia bɛ la wɔ bɛ ekpunli fɔɔnwo ne 
mɔ abo. Akee ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo ɛbɔ nu ɛva zɔhane yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ne mɔ ɛhɛlɛ 
ɛdendɛmunli mɔɔ fale nvoninli ne anwo.

2. Kilehile yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ngakyile ne mɔ anu na maa ko biala anwo 
ndonwo nsa.
3. Fa ko biala anwo ndonwo nwiɔ kpomgba ɛdendɛmunli.
4. Gua yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ɛhye mɔ ekpunli nu wɔ yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ngakyile 
mɔɔ wɔzukoa la abo na kile deɛmɔti wɔgua bɛ wɔ zɔhane ekpunli 
ngakyile ne mɔ abo la.

MOBƆNU KPUYIA
Ngyɛnu A: Yɛkpɔkɛ
1. Duzu ɛweɛne a la nyɛleɛ yɛkpɔkɛ nee gyinlabelɛ yɛkpɔkɛ avinli a ?
2. Kpondɛ yɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛgengadeɛ ɛhye anu la kɔsɔɔti na fa wɔ 
nyelebɛnloa ne toto ɛ gɔnwo ɛdeɛ nwo.
 Mengɔle ɛnwea nloa lɔ la, menriandinle, menwuluwulule yɛɛ menzile 
agole wɔ azɛlɛkye ne mɔ anu. Ewia ne bɔle wienyi maanle me nwo 
yɛle wuluwulu na mendele nganeɛ kɛ mede ngoane nu. Menweɛle, 
membɔle nzule na menlile nwɔhoa wɔ azule ne anu, menzelele na 
menvale anyelielɛ menyɛle me nyunlu monvoo. Nyevilenu nloma ne mɔ

menyɛle ɛnweazo sua menvale kɔngɔlɔbɛsɛ yɛɛ awolɛ mralɛ menzieziele 
ye kɛlɛma bie. Mɔɔ mekɛ hɔle bie la, menyianle alagye memkpɔsale 
meneɛnleanle ɛnwea ne azo memkpondɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ na 
menyɛle ngakyelɛ debie mɔɔ me rɛle ɛnrvi ɛlɛ a.
3. Gua yɛkpɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔhile bɛ wɔ ɛgengadeɛ ne anu la ekpunli nu wɔ

Mɛla mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛkɛlɛ Nzema aneɛ ne la
MUKENYE
Ngyɛnu ɛhye ka mɛla mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛkɛlɛ Nzema aneɛ ne la anwo edwɛkɛ. 
Yɛbawowɔ adwenle wɔ mɛla mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛfa duma, yɛkpɔkɛ, dumagya nee 
dumangilenu bɛdi gyima la anwo. Yɛbali moa yɛawowɔ adwenle wɔ mɛla mɔɔ 
fale duma gyimalilɛ nwo la anwo, akee yɛbanlea dumagya, dumangilenu, yɛkpɔkɛ 
nee yɛkpɔkɛngilenu. Ɛhye baboa amaa wɔanwu mɛla ne nee kɛ bɛsi bɛfa duma, 
dumagya, dumangilenu, yɛkpɔkɛ nee yɛkpɔkɛngilenu bɛdi gyima wɔ Nzema aneɛ 
ne anu la. Ɛbahola wɔava mɛla ne mɔɔ wɔzukoa la wɔatoto aneɛ le kɛ Nrelenza 
ɛdeɛ ne anwo.
Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ngane ɛhye kahɔ awieleɛ la ɛbahola;
1. Wɔalua mɛla fɔɔnwo ne azo wɔava duma nee dumagya wɔali gyima wɔ 
ɛdendɛmunli ɛhɛlɛlɛ nu
2. Wɔalua mɛla fɔɔnwo ne azo wɔava dumangilenu wɔali gyima wɔ 
ɛdendɛmunli ɛhɛlɛlɛ nu
3. Wɔalua mɛla fɔɔnwo ne azo wɔava yɛkpɔkɛ nee yɛkpɔkɛngilenu wɔali 
gyima wɔ ɛdendɛmunli ɛhɛlɛlɛ nu
Adwenle Titili
• Duma di yɛvo, nyiavo, dievo yɛɛ ngilenu gyima, eza ɔle ɛdendɛsinli nu 
edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ titili.
• Dumagya noko di yɛvo, nyiavo anzɛɛ dievo gyima wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu.
• Dumangilenu kile duma anu. Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala bɛta bɛtoa duma ne 
mɔɔ bɛkile nu la ndinli zo
• Yɛkpɔkɛ kile nyɛleɛ anzɛɛ gyinlabelɛ. Saa yɛkɛlɛ aneɛ ne na duma 
nee yɛkpɔkɛ doa zo a, yɛngɛlɛ bɛ yɛmbɔ nu. Emomu, saa yɛkpɔkɛ doa 
dumagya a yɛkɛlɛ bɛ yɛbɔ nu.

Duma
Yɛli moa yɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ duma anwo. Yɛbobɔle duma ndonwo bie mɔ na 
yɛhilele duma ekpunli ngakyile mɔɔ ndonwo ne ko biala vea ɔ bo la.
Ndwenlenwo edwɛkɛmiza: Ɛbahola wɔahakye duma ekpunli ngakyile ne mɔ ɔ ? 
Kɛlɛhɛlɛ bɛ.
Duma kile edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ yɛfa yɛfɛlɛ menli, nleka, nane nane nee ninyɛne la. 
Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala saa yeanyɛ fee a ɛdendɛmunli da duma ko ali. Duma nee 
deɛholɛkilevolɛ ‘ne’ anzɛɛ ‘bie’ ta tu
Dumagya
Dumagya le edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ yɛkola yɛfa yɛsie duma agyakɛ anu a. Bie a le 
ɛhye mɔ; ye, ɔ, ɛ, wɔ, me, bɛ, yɛ nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Bɛkola bɛdi duma ɛdendɛsinli 
gyima.
Kakye ɛhye: Wɔ Gana aneɛ ne mɔ dɔɔnwo anu dumagya ɛngile mrenyia anzɛɛ 
mraalɛ. Asoo ɛhye le zɔ wɔ Nzema nu ɔ? Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo ɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ nwo 
na bɛva bɛ nyelebɛnloa ne bɛmaa bɛ kilehilevolɛ ne.
Wɔ ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ɛhye anu, yɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ mɛla mɔɔ fale duma nee dumagya

Mɛla/Gyima
Duma mɔɔ di yɛvo gyima la
1. Mɛla mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛfa duma yɛdi gyima wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu la le ngakyile 
wɔ Gana aneɛ ko biala anu. Wɔ Nzema nu, duma di gyima kɛ:
a. Yɛvo wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu
 Duma mɔɔ wɔ Gana aneɛ ne mɔ anu la ta di yɛvo gyima anzɛɛ gyinla 
yɛvo gyinlabelɛ. Bɛle edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ bɔ ɛdendɛmunli bo wɔ aneɛ 
mɔɔ dua Yɛvo-Yɛkpɔkɛ-Nyiavo anzɛɛ Dievo adenle zo wɔ ɛdendɛmunli 
ɛhɛlɛlɛ nu la.
 Ndonwo:
i. Akosu hɔle asɔne.
ii. Mbuluku awolɛ yɛ se.
iii. Nrɛlɛbɛ le ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu kunimililɛ sanvɛ.
 Wɔ anwuma ndonwo ne mɔ anu, yɛnwu kɛ aluma Akosu, mbuluku nee 
nrɛlɛbɛ gyi yɛvo gyinlabelɛ.
b. Nyiavo anzɛɛ Dievo wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu
 Duma noko kola di nyiavo anzɛɛ dievo gyima wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu. 
 Ndonwo:
i. Yɛdɔle buluku yɛmaanle Ama.(Nyiavo)
ii. Memaanle Pita pɛne.(Dievo)
iii. Kukua nwanle Hakim ahyɛlɛdeɛ.(Nyiavo)
iv. Akuba dɔle ahyɛlɛdeɛ maanle Hakim.(Dievo)
c. Duma noko kola di ngilenu gyima. Ɛhye le duma mɔɔ kile duma gyɛne 
anu la. Saa aluma nwiɔ doa zo a, mɔɔ li moa la ta di dumangilenu gyima 
yɛ ngilenu maa mɔɔ doa ye la. 
 Ndonwo:
i. Wolɔba kyɛnze ne wɔ Adu ɛkɛ.
ii. Bɛdo sukulu alenkɛ ne anu.
iii. Bɛdɔle nwoma baage.
5
SECTION 4 MƐLA MƆƆ BƐDUA ZO BƐKƐLƐ NZEMA ANEƐ NE LA
d. Duma ɛdendɛsinli edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ titili: duma noko kola yɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ 
titili ne mɔɔ wɔ duma ɛdendɛsinli nu la. Ndonwo:
i. Pɛne awolɛ yɛ se.
ii. Sua fofolɛ ne anu le wuluwulu.
iii. Yɛwɔ suanu.
iv. Sua kpole bie bule ɛnɛ.
 Kakye ɛhye: Mɛla mɔɔ wɔ kɛ bɛsi bɛfa dumagya bɛdi gyima wɔ 
ɛdendɛmunli nu wɔ Gana aneɛ aneɛ nu la le ngakyile.
2. Wɔ Nzema nu, dumagya di gyima kɛ:
a. Yɛvo wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu. 
 Ndonwo:
i. Mengɔle sukulu.
ii. Yɛnea sini kenle ko biala.
iii. Bɛsele mgbane mgbane.
b. Dumagya noko di nyiavo anzɛɛ dievo gyima wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu. Nea 
ndonwo ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la:
i. Koasi nwunle ye. ( Nyiavo)
ii. Aama vale pɛne maanle ye. (Dievo)
iii. Ama maanle ye pɛne.(Dievo)
iv. Kilehilevolɛ ne maanle yɛ suanu gyima.(Nyiavo)
c. Ɔle mɛla wɔ aneɛ ne anu kɛ saa yɛkpɔkɛ bie doa dumagya bie ndinli zo 
a yɛkɛlɛ yɛbɔ nu.
Gyima
1. Kile duma anu na maa nwolɛ ndonwo kɛyɛ bulu. Fa wɔ nyelebɛnloa ne 
to sukoavoma ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.
2. Wɔ bɛ ekpunli nwiɔ nwiɔ ne mɔ anu, bɛlɛhɛlɛ gyima mɔɔ duma di la anu 
nwiɔ. Bɛ nee ekpunli fofolɛ ɛbɔ nu na bɛwowɔ nwolɛ adwenle.
3. Kile dumagya anu na maa nwolɛ ndonwo kɛyɛ bulu. Fa wɔ nyelebɛnloa 
ne to sukoavoma ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.
a. Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ekpunli nu bɛgenga adawu ne mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la na 
bɛhile aluma nee dumagya mɔɔ wɔ nu la.
6
SECTION 4 MƐLA MƆƆ BƐDUA ZO BƐKƐLƐ NZEMA ANEƐ NE LA
b. Bɛva aluma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhile la bɛhɛlɛ ɛdendɛmunli mɔnwo 
nnu. Bɛziezie bɛ nwo kɛ bɛ nee sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛha la bawowɔ 
adwenle wɔ bɛ nyelebɛnloa ne mɔ anwo.
c. Bɛva dumagya ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhile la bɛhɛlɛ ɛdendɛmunli nsa. 
Bɛziezie bɛ nwo kɛ bɛ nee sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛha la bawowɔ adwenle 
wɔ bɛ nyelebɛnloa ne mɔ anwo.
Ndwea
Ndwea le nyɛmoa mɔɔ awie biala ze bɛ kɛ bɛle abebɛ wɔ aleɛabo ɛleka biala a. 
Bɛgua ye ngakyile dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛ subane, kɛ bɛsi bɛde yɛɛ bɛ nwo sɔhovolɛ noko 
le ngakyile a. Bɛle nyɛmoa mɔɔ lɛ agyakɛ nna mɔɔ bɛwo a bɛmaa bɛ mra nyɛfonlɛ 
na bɛvi bɛdi mɔɔ wɔ kpɔkɛmile nu la abusua nu a. Mɔɔ alimoama ne mɔ ziele 
bɛdi kɛ bɛfa bɛali bɔlɛ la, bɛzukoale sonla bɛnwunle ye na bɛhwenle bɛbikyelɛ 
menli. Bɛbɔ mɔdenle kpalɛ wɔ menli nganeɛdelɛ le kɛ ɛhulolɛ, basabasayɛlɛ nee 
ɛzulolɛ nwo na bɛda nwolɛ subane mɔɔ fɛta la ali bɛkile menli. Ndwea lɛ debie 
nvoanledelɛ subane titili bie. Eza bɛ nzo yɛ gyima kpalɛ na bɛkola bɛte alɛra 
dodo biala. Mɔɔ maa ndwea anwo ba nvasoɛ kpalɛ la a le kɛ, ɛbahola wɔanyɛne 
ye wɔamaa yeali gyima ngakyile. Ndwea mɔɔ sonle la kola boa anyeziliravolɛma 
dahuu, yɛɛ ndwea mɔɔ te gyinlabelɛ mɔɔ sonla wɔ nu la nganeɛ la kyekye sonla 
rɛle. Eza bɛfa bɛkpondɛ na bɛkile nvoanle mɔɔ anloa wɔ aze na milahyinli ɛngola 
ɛngile la. Ɔwɔ nu kɛ ndwea di gyima ngɛlɛma wɔ ndenle dɔɔnwo azo boa menli, 
noko akee bɛ ngoane mekɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo le sikalɛ kɛyɛ ɛvolɛ 10-15. Ɛye bolɛ 
mɔɔ bɛsonle wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ nu a, bɛnwu ndwea dɔɔnwo ne ala kɛ bɛle alɔvolɛ mɔɔ 
boka mbusua nwo wɔ ewiade ɛleka biala a.
Gyima
1. Kile gyima mɔɔ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛpepɛ bɛ bo la di la. Fa wɔ 
nyelebɛnloa ne toto ɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛdeɛ nwo.
a. Sukoavoma ne mɔɔ ze nwoma la dule adenle anoma.
b. Menwanle Eden ezukoa.
c. Kilehilevolɛ ne hɛlɛle taboabile fofolɛ ne azo.
d.	 Bɛhɔle Navologo.
e. Adenduvo ne dɔle kpanwo maanle ye.
7
MOBƆNU KPUYIA
1. Fa ɛ ti anwo edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ kilehile duma mɔɔ di ngilenu gyima la anu. 
Maa ndonwo nwiɔ na fa kile ɛ gɔnwo
2. Wɔ kilehilevolɛ ne bava adawu bie mɔɔ nvonleɛ wɔ nu la amaa wɔ. 
Kenga adawu ne na kilehile nuhua nvonleɛ ne mɔ.
3. Wowɔ adwenle wɔ kɛ dumagya si di gyima kɛ nyiavo nee dievo la 
anwo. Fa toto aneɛ ngakyile mɔɔ ɛbazukoa anzɛɛ ɛze la anwo.
4. Maa ndonwo nnu mɔɔ kile kɛ duma ɛlɛdi ɛdendɛsinli nu edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ 
titili gyima la. Ɛ nee sukoavoma ne amuala ɛwowɔ nwolɛ adwenle.
5. Wɔ bɛ ekpunli nwiɔ nwiɔ ne mɔ anu, bɛhɛlɛ ɛdendɛmunli bulu mɔɔ 
dumagya mɔɔ wɔ ko biala anu la ɛlɛdi yɛvo gyima la na bɛwowɔ 
adwenle bɛhile saa bɛhɛlɛ bɛ nee yɛkpɔkɛ ne bɛbɔ nu a. Bɛva bɛtoto 
Gana aneɛ ngakyile ne mɔ anwo na bɛ nee sukoavoma ne mɔ amuala 
ɛwowɔ nwolɛ adwenle.

NUNINYƐNE
Bɛzukoa dumangilenu anwo debie dɛba. Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ne mɔ anu bɛva 
dumangilenu mɔɔ bɛbava bɛaha ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ la bɛhɛlɛ 
ɛdendɛmunli nsa.
a. Wɔ sukulu suanu
b. Ɛ gɔnwo kpalɛ
c. Wɔ sukulu alie ne anwo
d.	 Wɔ abusua
Dumangilenu a le edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ kile duma nu anzɛɛ ka edwɛkɛ fale subane 
mɔɔ wɔ deɛ bie anwo la. Yɛfa dumangilenu yɛkile subane mɔɔ awie anzɛɛ deɛ bie 
lɛ anzɛɛ ɔmaa yɛfa deɛ bie subane yɛtoto fofolɛ nwo.
Ndonwo:
a. Kodwo kulo azua dɛba.
b. Kakula nrenyia ne le tendenle ɛdenra.
c. Aku ze nwoma tɛla ɔ diema nrenyia ne.
Wɔ (a) anu, edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ dɛba ɛlɛkile sua holɛ mɔɔ Kodwo kulo la. Wɔ (b) anu, 
edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ tendenle nee ɛdenra kile kɛ yɛsi yɛnwu kakula nrenyia ne ɛnyelɛ 
zo la. Noko wɔ (c) ne anu, edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ nwoma tɛla ɛlɛfa kɛsi Aku ze nwoma 
la atoto ɔ diema nrenyia ne ɛdeɛ ne anwo.
Mɛla/gyima mɔɔ dumangilenu di la
Mɛla mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛfa dumangilenu yɛdi gyima wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu la le 
ngakyile wɔ Gana aneɛ ko biala anu.
Wɔ	Nzema	nu,	dumangilenu	di	gyima	kɛ:
1. Ɔkile duma mɔɔ wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu la anu. Ndonwo:
a. Ɛkpɔnwɔ bile ne nriandi ndɛndɛ tɛla mgbɔnwɔ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ
b. Menwunle sua bedevinli.
2. Bɛta bɛtoa duma ne mɔɔ bɛlɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la ndinli zo. Ndonwo:
a. Sua bile ne ɛbu.
b. Raalɛ belane bie ɛhɔ suanu.

Bɛzukoa dumangilenu ekpunli ngakyile ne mɔ dɛba. Ndonwo bie mɔ mɔɔ boka 
nwo la a wɔ aze ɛke la:
Fɔɔnwohilelɛ dumangilenu anwo ndonwo wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu
a. Kale ɛhye le fofolɛ.
b. Sua ɛhendeɛ le me ze ɛdeɛ.
Ndotonwo dumangilenu anwo ndonwo wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu
a. Aleɛ ɛhye bolɛ ɛnye se fee.
b. Wɔ ezukoa ne le ekyi tɛla me deɛ ne.
Dodohilelɛ dumangilenu anwo ndonwo wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu.
a. Mendɔle awule bie.
b. Mbuluku dɔɔnwo wɔ me ɛlɛka ne anu.
Subanehilelɛ dumangilenu anwo ndonwo wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu.
a. Kale ne le dɛba.
b. Aleɛ ne le kɛlɛma.

a. nwanwane
b. koonwu
c. ɛya
d.	 tete
e. bedevinli
f. kpalɛ
g.	 wienyi
h. kɛlɛma
i. dɛba

 Akee bɛ nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛnlea bɛ ndonwo ne mɔ ngyehyɛleɛ ne. Duzu

Gyima 2
1. Maa dumangilenu anwo ndonwo bulu.
2. Fa dumangilenu ndonwo ne anu nnu kɛlɛ ɛdendɛmunli ngakyile ɛhye 
mɔ.
a. Ɛdendɛmunli sikalɛ

12
MOBƆNU KPUYIA
1. Kenga adawu ɛhye na kilehile dumangilenu mɔɔ wɔ nu la.
 Menli dɔɔnwo ne ala akee anye ɛlɛba bɛ nwo zo wɔ yɛ nyɛleɛ mɔɔ 
ɛlɛsɛkye yɛ nyambɔyia ne la. Ɔwɔ kɛ nyambɔyia anwobanebɔlɛ yɛ debie 
titili mɔɔ gyi yɛ kɔsɔɔti yɛ nye zo a. Noko akee menli ekyi bie ala a lɛ 
kɛ bɛsi bɛbɔ nyambɔyia anwo bane kpalɛ la adwenle ekyi a.Yɛ anyefuu 
subane ne mɔ a ɛlɛkɔ zo amaa yɛ nyambɔyia ne azɛkye kenle ko biala 
a. Ndonwo a le ninyɛne mɔɔ anwo ɛngyia nee ewula mgbane mgbane 
ɛgualɛ, wolɔba basabasa ɛgualɛ nee mɔɔ bokɛboka nwo la. Saa yɛanzi 
subane ɛtane ɛhye mɔ adenle a, mekɛ bie ɛlɛba mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ awolɛ 
ndoɔdozo ne kotia ngyegyelɛ mɔɔ yɛ anyefuu ɛbɛla ne kɛva kɛra la. 
Zɔhane a, ɛnee ɔhyia ɛsesebɛ kɛ me nee wɔ kɛyɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛhola biala 
la yɛkɛbɔ yɛ nyambɔyia ne anwo bane. Ɔle yɛ gyima titili kɛ yɛkɛva 
ngyehyɛleɛ fɔɔnwo yɛkɛgua adenle zo yɛkɛbɔ azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ Nyamenle 
ɛva ɛhyɛ yɛ la anwo bane. Ngyegyelɛ mɔɔ yɛ subane mɔɔ yɛda bɛ ali wɔ 
yɛ nyambɔyia ne anwo fa ba la a le azuyilɛ ndoɔdoazo, yɛ aleɛ ɛlualɛ 
mɔɔ ye guabelɛ wɔ aze ɛbuhenle mekɛ la nee mɔɔ bokɛboka nwo la
2. Fa dumangilenu ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔhile la kɛlɛ ɛdendɛmunli kpomgbondee 
bulu.

NUNINYƐNE
Saa yɛfa yɛkpɔkɛ nee yɛkpɔkɛngilenu yɛali gyima wɔ ɛdendɛmunli ɛhɛlɛlɛ nu 
wɔ Gana aneɛ aneɛ ne mɔ anu a ɔwɔ kɛ yɛnyia mɛla bie mɔ. Mɛla ɛhye mɔ boa 
maa yɛ ngɛlɛhɛlɛ ne mɔ anye da ɛkɛ na ɔmaa yɛto nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fɛta la yɛmaa 
kengavolɛ ne.Yɛfa aneɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛlɛ la anu mɛla ne mɔ yɛdi gyima a ɔboa ɔmaa 
yɛnyia ɛdendɛmunli mɔɔ ndelebɛbo wɔ nu la.
Yɛkpɔkɛ
Kolaa na yɛaha mɛla ne mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ la, maa yɛhakye mɔɔ yɛzukoa yɛva 
yɛkpɔkɛ anwo la. Nea ndonwo ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la. Edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ 
mɔɔ bɛha nuhua la biala le yɛkpɔkɛ.
1. Ɛyazonlɛnli ne so ɛya ne ɛyazonlɛ ɛlobɔ biala.
2. Ngakula ne mɔ kɔ sukulu Yalɛ biala.
3. Yɛwuluwlu nwonlomɔ biala yɛfa yɛkpundikpundi yɛ agbɔkɛ nu.
Yɛkpɔkɛ a le edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ anzɛɛ ɛdendɛsinli mɔɔ yɛfa yɛda nyɛleɛ, gyinlabelɛ 
anzɛɛ nzidwɛkɛ ali la. Yɛkpɔkɛ boka ɛdendɛmunli nu ngilenukpɔkɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ 
titili ne anwo. Yɛkile a yɛkpɔkɛ a le ngilenukpɔkɛ nu edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ titili ne a.
Mɛla mɔɔ wɔ yɛkpɔkɛ gyimalilɛ nwo wɔ 
ɛdendɛmunli nu la
Mɛla mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛfa yɛkpɔkɛ yɛdi gyima wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu la le ngakyile 
wɔ Gana aneɛ ko biala anu. Wɔ Nzema nu, mɛla ne mɔ bie ɛne:
1. Yɛkpɔkɛ ne kile nyɛleɛ mɔɔ yɛvo ne da ye ali wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu la.
a. Twea ne kpo alenkɛ ne anyunlu dahuu.
 Ɛke, yɛkpɔkɛ kpo ne kile mɔɔ yɛvo ne mɔɔ le ‘Twea ne’ la yɛ wɔ alenkɛ 
ne anyunlu la.
b. Sukoavoma ne ka basekɛ kɔ sukulu nwonlomɔ biala.
 Yɛkpɔkɛ ‘ka’ kile yɛvo ‘Sukoavoma ne’ nyɛleɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la.
2. Yɛkpɔkɛ kile gyinlabelɛ mɔɔ yɛvo ne wɔ nu wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu la. 
 Ndonwo:
 Kodwo anye liele wɔ sɔnea ne anzi.
15
SECTION 4 MƐLA MƆƆ BƐDUA ZO BƐKƐLƐ NZEMA ANEƐ NE LA
 Wɔ ɛke, yɛkpɔkɛ ‘liele’ maa yɛnwu gyinlabelɛ mɔɔ yɛvo ne ‘Kodwo’ hɔle 
nu wɔ sɔnea ne anzi la.
3. Yɛkpɔkɛ a le ngilenukpɔkɛ nu edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ titili ne a. Ndonwo:
a. Kale ne nriandi molozo.
 Yɛkpɔkɛ ‘nriandi’ a le titili wɔ ngilenukpɔkɛ ‘nriandi molozo’ anu a.
b. Sukoavoma ne ka basekɛ kɔ sukulu nwonlomɔ biala.

MUKENYE
Ngyɛnu ɛhye ka nwobie ngakyile ne mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ. Nwobiehanlɛ ɛhɛlɛlɛ le 
sukoanyia mɔɔ hyia wɔ ɛzukoalɛdeɛ le kɛ Nrelenza aneɛ nee tetedwɛkɛ ɛzukoalɛ 
nu na tɛ Gana aneɛ angome ɔ.
Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ngane ɛhye kahɔ awieleɛ la ɛbahola;
1. Wɔahɛlɛ kolakola anzɛɛ amaneɛbɔlɛ nwobie
2. Wɔahɛlɛ kɛside nwobie
3. Wɔahɛlɛ debieyɛlɛ anzɛɛ adwenlebɔlɛ nwobie
Adwenle Titili
• Nwobiehanlɛ anzɛɛ nwobie a le adenle mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛnwo adwenle 
anzɛɛ atiakunlukpɔkɛ ngakyile mɔɔ yɛlɛ na ɔgyi botane kpɔkyee bie azo 
la
• Ɛbazukoa nwobie ngakyile nsa:
• Kolakoladulɛ le adawu ɛhɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ ka edwɛkɛ fale bodane bie mɔɔ kile 
awie adwenle anzɛɛ sukoanwu mɔɔ lua amaneɛbɔlɛ anzɛɛ adawubɔlɛ 
ngyehyɛleɛ fɔɔnwo zo la.
• Kɛside nwobie le nwobiehɛlɛlɛ ngane ne mɔɔ ka kɛ debie bie si de la- 
debie, sonla, ɛleka sukoanwu, gyinlabelɛ nee mɔɔ bokɛboka nwolɛ la.
•  Adwenlebɔlɛ anzɛɛ debieyɛlɛ le nwobie mɔɔ bɛkilehile debie nu 
anzɛɛ adenle mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛyɛ debie la. Ɔda adwenlehilelɛ mɔɔ le 
fɔɔnwo la, ngilenu kpɔkyee wɔ tidwɛkɛ bie anwo, adengile bie anwo, 
anzɛɛ da adwenle ali.
• Nwobie biala lɛ ɔ ti anwo ngyehyɛleɛ nee ye subane.

ƐDENDƐMUNLI TITILI
Ɛdendɛmunli titili a le ɛdendɛmunli mɔɔ da adwenle titili mɔɔ wɔ ɛdendɛkpunli 
ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ nu ali la. Ɛdendɛmunli titili boavo a le ɛdendɛmunli mɔɔ boa maa yɛte 
adwenle titili mɔɔ wɔ ɛdendɛkpunli nu abo la.
Nwobiehanlɛ/Nwobie
Amaa wɔahɛlɛ nwobie mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la, ɛhyia sukoanyia. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛda 
adwenlekpɔkɛ ali na ɛdua ngyehyɛleɛ fɔɔnwo azo ɛsiezie ye gyɛlɛɛnye wɔ 
ɛdendɛkpunli nu. Ɛbahola wɔalua ɛhye azo a wɔayɛ a; adwenle mɔɔ bɔ atipɛne la 
ekpunli nu ɛgualɛ, kɛsi nzidwɛkɛ ne si la ali ɛlalɛ, na wɔahile nwolɛ daselɛ mɔɔ 
ɛlɛ la, ndotonwoyɛlɛ, ɛkile mɔɔ maa deɛ ne si nee nwolɛ ngyegyelɛ, ye ndoɔdoazo 
ɛhilelɛ nee mɔɔ bokɛboka nwo la.
• Nwobiehanlɛ le adenle mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛnwo adwenle anzɛɛ atiakunlukpɔkɛ 
ngakyile mɔɔ yɛlɛ la. Nwobie biala lɛ bodane kpɔkyee bie mɔɔ ɔgyi zo a.
Bɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ nwobie ngakyile nsa anwo wɔ ngyɛnu ɛhye anu mɔɔ 
kolakoladulɛ nwobie a bɔ ɔ bo a.
Kolakoladulɛ nwobie
Kolakoladulɛ le adawu ɛhɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ ka edwɛkɛ fale bodane bie mɔɔ kile awie 
adwenle anzɛɛ sukoanwu mɔɔ lua amaneɛbɔlɛ anzɛɛ adawubɔlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ 
fɔɔnwo zo la.Ɔkola ɔyɛ nɔhalɛ anzɛɛ anwie-nɔhalɛyɛ adawu. Adwenle mɔɔ wɔ 
kolakoladulɛ nwobie anwo la a le kɛ ɔfa adawubɔlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ le kɛ bodane, 
ngyegyelɛ, angɔbɛnzi-ngilenudwɛkɛ, nee mɔɔ bokɛboka nwolɛ la ɔdi gyima wɔ 
adenle fɔɔnwo zo ɔtwe kengavolɛ ne adwenle ɔsi mɔɔ ɔlɔkenga la azo. Mekɛ 
dɔɔnwo ne ala bɛgyinla tendɛvolɛ ne gyinlabelɛ zo a bɛkɛlɛ a, ɔgyi sukoanwu 
mɔɔ awie lɛ ye la anwo zo, ɔmaa daselɛ wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛkɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ 
la anwo, bɛta bɛkɛlɛ ye wɔ mgbanwo nu yɛɛ bɛdua adwenlebɔlɛ aneɛ zo.Ɔwɔ kɛ 
nuhua nzidwɛkɛ ne alilalɛ toɔdoa zo na ɔyɛ adawu mɔɔ ɔtwe menli adwenle ɔba 
zo a. Bɛkola bɛfa adwenlenu nvoninli nee aneɛnu ninyɛne bɛwulowula nu bɛmaa 
ɔtwe kengavolɛ ne anzɛɛ tievolɛ ne ɔmaa ɔda ye gyinlabelɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ nu la ali.
Kolakoladulɛ nwobie tidwɛkɛ ndonwo bie mɔ:
• Kɛlɛ adawu mɔɔ fale kenle mɔɔ ɔli moa mɔɔ ɛhɔle sukulu la anwo.
• Kilekɛ ɛzile ɛlile wɔ ɛnwomenlelielɛ mɔɔ ɛ rɛle ɛnrɛvi ye ɛlɛ la
• Abazobɔlɛ bie mɔɔ me nye die nwo la.

la nee nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ zɔhane aluma ne mɔ azo la. Ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ɛhye baboa amaa 
wɔanyia ndelebɛbo mɔɔ wɔ dumadonlɛ nwo la, ɛhulolɛ nee ɛbulɛ wɔamaa Gana 
maandeɛ ne nee ye tete agyadeɛ. Ngyɛnu ne eza da fuamunli azezielɛ maandeɛ 
ne ali. Adwenlenwowɔ ne bagyinla bɛ azezielɛ maandeɛ ndenle ne mɔlebɛbo, ye 
avinli nee ye awieleɛ ne mɔ azo wɔ wɔ maandeɛ ne anu nee Gana aneɛ gyɛne bie 
mɔ maandeɛ ne mɔ anwo. Eza noko ɛbazukoa nvaosɛ mɔɔ fuamunlibɔvoma ne, 
bɛ mbusua ne nee aneɛ ekpunli ne mɔɔ bɛvi nu la banyia wɔ fuamunli azezielɛ 
maandeɛ ne anwo la. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkola ɛkilehile koyɛlɛ nee ɛweɛne mɔɔ deda Gana 
aneɛ ekpunli ngakyile ne mɔ azezielɛ maandeɛ ne anu la.
Ngyɛnu ɛhye kahɔ awieleɛ la, ɛbahola:
• Wɔahile awozonle aluma bie mɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛ bo vi yɛɛ deɛmɔti yɛnyia 
bɛ la
• Wɔawowɔ adwenle wɔ adenle mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛsie kakula bɛlɛra aze la 
(Azezielɛ: mɔlebɛbo, avinli nee adwulaleɛ)
• Wɔava azezielɛ nwo maandeɛ ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ Gana la wɔatoto nwo.
Adwenle titili
• Awozonle aluma abo vi awozonle kpɔkyee bie ɛkɛ
• Bɛ nee sunsum mɔɔ lɛ tumi la a lɛ ngitanwo a

• Bɛkile menli mɔɔ aluma ne gua bɛ nwo zo la anzi adenle
• Fuamunli le sonla ɛnyinlɛnu ɛleka mɔɔ kile kɛ awie bahola awo a.
• Azubɔlɛ maandeɛ kile kɛ bɛlɛdie awie bɛado nu wɔ gyinlabelɛ bie anu.
• Bɛyɛ fuamunli ɛbɔlɛ maandeɛ bɛmaa ngakula mbɛlɛra noko akee aneɛ 
ekpunli ne bie yɛ maa ngakula mrenyia.
AWOZONLE ALUMA
Yɛlɛ aluma bie deda yɛ nwo zo ɔluakɛ yɛ nee sunsum bie mɔ mɔɔ bɛ tumi bo yɛ 
nwo zo la lɛ ngitanwo. Aluma ɛhye mɔ a yɛfɛlɛ bɛ awozonle aluma a.Kolaa na 
wɔagenga wɔava awozonle aluma nwo la ɔwɔ kɛ ɛnwu awozonle deɛholɛ.
Duzu a le awozonle?
Awozonle kola yɛ mraalɛ anzɛɛ mrenyia. Bɛle sunsum mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle bɛ la 
anu ko mɔɔ bɛ tumi ne bo sonla nee sunsum bie mɔ anwo zo a. Menli mɔɔ lɛ diedi 
kɛ awozonle lɛ tumi mɔɔ bo sonla nwo zo na bɛkola bɛkile dasanli nyɛleɛ bie mɔ 
mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la sonle bɛ. Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala bɛ nee sunsum ɛzonlenlɛ nee 
bɛ nyɛleɛ bie mɔ lɛ ngitanwo. Awozonle bie mɔ mɔɔ vi ɛzonlenlɛ ngakyile bie mɔ 
anu la a le Zɛyɔse, Apolo, Atena Hɛla, Felɛya, Nɔɔse, Lɔki, Ɔdini nee mɔɔ ɛha 
la. Bɛfa enililɛ bɛmaa bɛ na bɛsonle bɛ kɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛta la. Wɔ Gana, menli ekpunli 
anzɛɛ aneɛ ko biala noko lɛ bɛ awozonle mɔɔ bɛdie bɛ bɛdi na bɛsonle bɛ a. 
Awozonle bie mɔ mɔɔ ɛlie duma wɔ Gana la a le
• Ga: Dantu, Nae, Klote, La Kpa, nee mɔɔ bokɛboka nwo la
• Akan: Kune, Tegare, Nyamaa, Antoa, nee mɔɔ bokɛboka nwo la
• Dagomba: Tambo, nee mɔɔ bokɛboka nwo la
Awozonle dɔɔnwo wɔ Nzema. Bie mɔ ɛne:
1. Kumakpole, Tanoɛ: bɛwɔ Benyinli
2. Amɛnlɛnra, Tanoɛ Aya, Bulakpole: bɛwɔ Adoabo
3. Asuanua, Ɛzazo, Anweafutu: bɛwɔ Bameangɔ
4. Siane(Ankobra),Ɛwɔnwenle: bɛwɔ Sanwoma
Awozonle boni mɔ a ɛlie duma wɔ wɔ suazo a?

SECTION 6 AWOZONLE ALUMA NEE AZEZIELƐ
Awozonle aluma
Bɛfa awozonle aluma bɛto menli ɔlua bɛ diedi nee bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ne adiabo ngyinlazo 
ti. Awozonle aluma noko le aluma kpɔkyee mɔɔ mbusua, azua azua, ɛzonlenlɛ nee 
maandeɛ lɛ ɔlua ngitanwo mɔɔ bɛ nee awozonle ne mɔ lɛ la.
Awozonle aluma bie mɔ
Gana awozonle aluma bie mɔ a le:
1. Wɔ Anwɔnla ne mɔ anu, Anlo ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Anwɔnla maanzinli nu la 
sonle bozonle bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye ‘Afa’ la, ɔle bozonle mɔɔ vi anwuma yɛɛ ye 
belamunli ralɛ nrenyia ‘Bokɔ’ duma a le ‘Amuzu’
2. Wɔ Akanema ne mɔ anu, bɛdie bɛdi kɛ kenle mɔɔ wɔ dapɛne ne anu la ko 
biala lɛ nwolɛ bozonle. Ɛhye ati kenle ne mɔɔ bɛkɛwo wɔ wɔ dapɛne ne anu 
la lɛ bozonle duma mɔɔ bɛfa bɛto wɔ a. Ndonwo, ‘Adwo’ le bozonle duma 
mɔɔ kile Kenlenzile, yemɔti saa bɛwo kakula raalɛ Kenlenzile a bɛfɛlɛ ye 
‘Adwoa yɛɛ saa ɔle nrenyia a bɛfɛlɛ ye ‘Kwadwo’ la.
3. Saa ɛba Nzema a bɛdua moalɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia bɛkɛvi awozonle ne mɔ bie 
mɔ ɛkɛ ne la azo a bɛnyia awozonle aluma a. Ɛhye kile kɛ bɛdie bɛdi kɛ 
awozonle ne mɔ a yɛle bɛ moalɛ a. Ndonwo, saa awie hyia ralɛ na ɔlua 
bozonle bie ati ɔwo a bɛfa bozonle zɔhane duma ne bɛto kakula ne. Aluma 
ɛhye mɔ bie a le Siane, Amanzule nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Siane nee Amanzule le 
azule aluma.
Bɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛbabobɔ awozonle aluma mɔɔ wɔ anwuma ɛke la. Maa wɔ 
kilehilevolɛ ne ɛnlea saa ye ɛbobɔlɛ ne le fɔɔnwo a. Ɛze awozonle aluma mɔɔ wɔ 
wɔ suazo la bie mɔ ɔ ?
Nleka mɔɔ awozonle aluma ne mɔ abo vi la
Ɛleka mɔɔ yɛnyia awozonle aluma ne mɔ yɛfi la le ngakyile wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ ngakyile 
ko biala anu yɛɛ ye titili ne gyi menli ne mɔɔ to zɔhane aluma ne la diedi nee bɛ 
maandeɛ ngakyile mɔɔ bɛlɛ la azo. Ndonwo, Anwɔnla ne mɔ awozonle aluma ne 
mɔ abo vi Yeʋe (Ɛsɛlɛmanye Nyamenle), Akanema nyia bɛ awozonle aluma ne fi  
azudenle nu, Dangmema nyia bɛ deɛ ne fi (Nyamenle) mɔɔ maa anyelielɛ la ɛkɛ 
yɛɛ Nzemama noko nyia bɛ awozonle aluma fi ɛleka kpɔkyee mɔɔ bozonle bie de 
la. Ɔkola ɔyɛ azudenle, bozane anzɛɛ bɔnza nu.

SECTION 6 AWOZONLE ALUMA NEE AZEZIELƐ
Deɛmɔti yɛto awozonle aluma la
Deɛmɔti bɛto awozonle duma la gyi ngilenu dɔɔnwo azo. Bɛto awozonle aluma 
bɛfa bɛda gyima mɔɔ bozonle bie di la ali, yɛnyia aluma ɛhye mɔ ɔluakɛ yɛlɛ 
diedi kɛ bɛvi anwuma na bɛ nwo te. Bie mɔ noko kola yɛ anwosebɛ ɛwulalɛ mɔɔ 
yɛnyia ye yɛfi awozonle ne mɔ ɛkɛ la. Yɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛda aneɛ ekpunli 
bie maandeɛ ali anzɛɛ mɔɔ kile bozonle ne subane nee ye nyɛleɛ la.
Bieko noko a le kɛ, saa agyalɛma bie mɔ ɛnyia ralɛ a bɛkɔ nwolɛ abisa, bɛbɔ 
ɛwɔkɛ na bɛdie moalɛ bɛfi awozonle ne mɔ ɛkɛ. Ɛwɔkɛ ɛbɔlɛ ne anzi saa bɛwo a 
bɛlɛ diedi kɛ awozonle ne mɔ a yele bɛda ne maanle bɛ a ɔti bɛfa bozonle ne duma 
bɛto bɛda ne.
Nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ awozonle aluma ɛdonlɛ zo la
Awozonle aluma lɛ nvasoɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ menli mɔɔ sonle bɛ la ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu.
Nvasoɛ bie mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ lɛ awozonle aluma nyia bɛ la a wɔ aze ɛke la:
1. Bɛyɛ menli nzonlɛ. Awozonle aluma boa maa yɛnwu bozonle holɛ mɔɔ awie 
sonle ye la yɛɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ahenle vi la.
2. Ɔkile ngitanwolilɛ mɔɔ la ahenle nee bozonle ne avinli la.
3. Bɛto awozonle aluma bɛfi awolɛ ndoɔdoazo nu bɛfa bɛbɔ yɛ maandeɛ nee 
yɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nu tete agyadeɛ nwo bane.
4. Ɔkile diedi mɔɔ awovolɛ ne mɔ lɛ la.
5. Wɔ diedi bie mɔ anu saa bozonle duma la ɛ nwo zo a, bɛdie bɛdi kɛ ɔmaa 
wɔ tumi, anwobanebɔlɛ anzɛɛ sunsum nu anwosesebɛ.
Gyima 6.1
1. Fa ɛ ti anwo edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ kilehile edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ bozonle anu?
2. Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo ɛhɛlɛ Nzema aluma bulu na bɛhile awozonle aluma mɔɔ 
wɔ nu la.
3. Fa awozonle aluma ne mɔɔ ɛhilele wɔ wɔ aneɛ ne anu la toto aluma mɔɔ 
sukoavoma mɔɔ vi wɔ aneɛ ekpunli ne anu na ɛ nee bɛ gyi bango ko lɛ 
la anwo
4. Wɔ selɛ duma ne anzɛɛ wɔ nrelenza duma ne le bozonle duma ɔ? Kile 
ɛleka mɔɔ wɔ duma ne abo vi la. Saa ɛnlɛ bie a, fa awozonle aluma ne 
mɔ mɔɔ bɛhilele bɛ wɔ anwuma edwɛkɛmiza ne anu la bie na kile ɛleka 
mɔɔ yɛnyianle bɛ la.

FUAMUNLI AZEZIELƐ
Ngyɛnu ne ɛleka ɛhye ka azubɔlɛ maandeɛ ne mɔɔ kile kɛ mbɛda ɛdwu bɛ 
mgbanyileka la anwo edwɛkɛ. Ɔnea nyɛleɛ ngakyile ne mɔ mɔɔ kɔ zo wɔ mɔlebɛbo, 
avinli nee awieleɛ ne wɔ Gana maandeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu
Ndwenlenwo kpuyia
Ɛbahola wɔahile ɛnyelɛzo nzenzaleɛ nsa mɔɔ ɛnwunle ye wɔ wɔ sonlabaka ne anu 
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnyianle ɛvolɛ 10 kɔkpula 14 la ɔ?
Duzu a le fuamunli?
Ɛhye le mekɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ kakula nrenyia anzɛɛ raalɛ bie ɛbikye ye mgbanyifoa 
na ɔkola ɔwo la. Yɛta yɛnwu nzenzaleɛ ɛhye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ngakula mraalɛ ne 
mɔ ɛdwu ɛvolɛ 10-14 yɛɛ ngakula mrenyia ne mɔ noko kɛnyia ɛvolɛ12-16 la. 
Emomu, ngakyile kola ba nu; bie mɔ ɛdeɛ si ndɛ yɛɛ bie noko kola ka amozi.

Ɔle maandeɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ kakula raalɛ mɔɔ ɛyɛ fua na ɔkɛmoa zo la anwo

Nzemama Fuamunli Azezielɛ -
Kɛ bɛfɛlɛ fuamunli maandeɛ ne wɔ wɔ aneɛ ne anu ɛ? Mraalɛ nee mrenyia fa 
fuamunli azezielɛ maandeɛ ne anu ɔ?
Duzu a le azubɔlɛ maandeɛ ?
Azubɔlɛ maandeɛ a le nyɛleɛ anzɛɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛkile kɛ sonla ɛlɛfi  
ɛbɛlabɔlɛ anzɛɛ tɛnlabelɛ anzɛɛ gyinlabelɛ ko anu ahɔ fofolɛ nu la, mɔɔ eza yɛfɛlɛ 
ye sonla ɛnyilɛ nu maandeɛ la. Bɛkola bɛbɔ awie azu bɛwula sunsum nu gyima 
bie anu, fealeranu eku anzɛɛ ɛzonlenlɛ bie anu. Emomu, azubɔlɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛwowɔ 
nwolɛ adwenle wɔ ɛke la kile mɔɔ maa yɛnwu kɛ mbɛda ɛdwu bɛ mgbanyileka 
mɔɔ yɛfɛlɛ ye fuamunli azezielɛ la.
Azezielɛ maandeɛ ne
Aneɛ ekpunli ko biala lɛ nyɛleɛ ngakyile mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ azezielɛ maandeɛ ne 
anu a ɔlua maandeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ le ngakyile la ati. Nyɛleɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye kolaa na 
azezielɛ mekɛ ne adwu, azezielɛ mekɛ ne anu nee azezielɛ ne anzi la a bɛwowɔ 
nwolɛ adwenle wɔ aze ɛke la.

 Saa awovolɛ ne mɔ nwu kɛ nzenzaleɛ bie ɛra bɛ mra mraalɛ mɔɔ asɛɛ ɛbɔ

SECTION 6 AWOZONLE ALUMA NEE AZEZIELƐ
 Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala saa kakula raalɛ ne yɛ ye fua mɔɔ li moa mɔɔ yɛfɛlɛ ye 
fualɛ amunli la a, bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ ɛhye mɔ wɔ bɛ now a:
a. Bɛdi moa bɛye mbɛda ne mɔ bɛfi bɛ abusua ne anwo na bɛkɔsiezie bɛ 
bɛkendɛ gyimalilɛ ne.
b. Ngakula mraalɛ ne mɔ awovolɛ bɔ mgbanyima anzɛɛ menli mɔɔ di 
azezielɛ ne anwo gyima la amaneɛ.
c. Mraalɛ mgbanyima mɔɔ ze agyalɛ nwo maamulɛ la wula mbɛda ne mɔ 
sua nu na bɛfa agyalɛ nwo folɛdulɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la bɛmaa bɛ amaa 
kenlebie bɛahola bɛaziezie bɛ suanu kɛ nwuvolɛ mraalɛ.
d. Bɛfa ngakula mraalɛ ne mɔ bɛfa suanu ndetelɛ le kɛ aleɛdonlɛ, ewula 
ɛkpoanlɛ, ninyɛne ɛkpolɛ, bɛ nwo enililɛ nee mɔɔ ɛha la anu.
e. Bɛkile bɛ bɛ-sa-anloa gyima bie mɔ.
f. Bɛkile bɛ tete edwɛne nee nwolɛ agolezilɛ bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ maandeɛ ne 
anu la.
g. Bɛkilehile bɛ nla nu nyɛleɛ bie mɔ amaa bɛahola bɛ nee bɛ hu mɔ mɔɔ 
bagya bɛ wɔ maandeɛ ɛhye anzi la ali agitanwo wɔ ɛkpa zo kpalɛ.
2. Azezielɛ mumua ne
 Saa azezielɛ mumua ne dwu a gyimadivo ne (ɔkola ɔyɛ kɔmenle anzɛɛ raalɛ 
kpanyinli) fa fuamunlibɔvoma ne fa ɛhye mɔ anu.
 Ɔsiezie ɔ nwo na ɔye ɛdɛne ɔfa gyimalilɛ ne ɔfea Nyamenle nee sunsum 
ngakyile bie mɔ asa. Ɛdɛneyɛlɛ ne anzi bɛfa bɛ bɛwula sunsum nu nyɛleɛ 
ɛhye mɔ anu:
a. Bɛfa bɛ bɛfa sunsum nu sɔnea nu bɛnea saa bɛle bɛlamunli a(raalɛ mɔɔ 
ɛnze nrenyia la). Bie mɔ tɛnla bozane bile zo, bie mɔ bia azule nu, nyevile 
nu anzɛɛ kpɔkɛ nu kile nyɛleɛ ɛhye.
b. Bɛkpa/bɛpepɛ bɛ ti enrinli, bɛ nvunloma nu nee bɛ sakɛ
c. Bɛtɛnla bɛ wɔ sɛsɛbia anzɛɛ nwoma zo.
d. Bɛte bɛ nloa ( bɛfa aleɛ le kɛ kolonvia bɛdo, bana anzɛɛ elue afɔtɔ nee 
mɔɔ ɛha la)

Fuamunli azezielɛ maandeɛ ne ndotonwoyɛlɛ 
Ɛnweɛne bie mɔ mɔɔ deda Gana azezielɛ maandeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ avinli la.
Saa ɛye koyɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ azezielɛ maandeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ anu la a, aneɛ ekpunli 
ko biala lɛ nyɛleɛ kpɔkyee bie mɔɔ le ngakyile fi aneɛ ekpunli ngakyile bie ɛdeɛ 
nwo a. Bie mɔ a bɛla bɛ ali wɔ ɛke la.
Anwɔnlama
1. Bɛkola bɛfa dapɛne ko mɔɔ kɔdwu siane ko la bɛyɛ azezielɛ maandeɛ ne. 
Ɛhye gyi Anwɔnlama ekpunli holɛ nee bodane mɔɔ gyi bɛ nye zo la azo.
2. Bɛfa fuamunlibɔvoma ne bɛsie aako ne anzi na bɛmaa bɛ gɔnwo mɔ nee bɛ 
tɛnla na bɛdielie bɛ nye wɔ zɔhane mekɛ ne.
3. Wɔ azezielɛ mekɛ ne anu, kolonvia ne mɔɔ bɛme la le sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ kile 
ɛdanebɔlɛ a.
Kolɔboma
1. Kolɔboma yɛ azezielɛ maandeɛ maa ngakula mbɛlɛra ne mɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ 
bɛkɛbɔ Azɛlɛ Bozonle (Nene Kloweki) amaneɛ ne la. Bɛyɛ ye wɔ Siane 
Munrane ne anu yɛɛ ɔdi kenle nnu.
2. Kolaa na bɛayɛ azezielɛ maandeɛ ne la mbɛlɛra ne mɔ awovolɛ fa bɛ kɔmaa 
kɔmenle ne mɔɔ di Dipo ne anwo gyima la.

Akanema (Nvande nee Nzandelɛ)
1. Bɛfa kenle mɔtwɛ a bɛyɛ maandeɛ ne a. Ɛhye kola bɔ ɔ bo Kenlenzile anzɛɛ

2. Kolaa na bɛayɛ maandeɛ ne la, bɛfa mbɛlɛra ne mɔ bɛmaa Ɛhyema ne na 
ɔneɛnlea nu ɔnwu kɛ bɛle bɛlamunli na eza bie ɛtɛnrenzɛle a.
Kɛ Nzemama si sie kakula bɛlɛra aze ɛ?
Nzemama
Ɔle zɔ amgba kɛ Nzema tete azezielɛ maandeɛ nyɛleɛ dɔɔnwo ɛhakyi yɛɛ eza 
yɛhile koyɛlɛ nee ɛnweɛne bie mɔ mɔɔ la Gana aneɛ ekpunli ngakyile ne mɔ 
avinli la. Nzemama ɛdeɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛ na ɔmaa yɛda nzonlɛ la bie mɔ ɛne:
1. Bɛnea bɛnwu kɛ kakula bɛlɛra ne ɛyɛ fua na yemoa zo (yeyɛ fualɛ yedoa zo 
fane nsa la) kolaa na bɛazie ye aze.
2. Raalɛ mɔɔ akunlu raalɛ ɛtɛwule ɛlɛ, bɛlɛra mɔɔ bɛziele ye aze ɛtɛkyɛle la 
anzɛɛ bɛlɛra mɔɔ ɔka ekyii ɔbɔ fuamunli la a kola di fuamunlibɔvo ne anwo 
gyima a.
3. Bɛkpoto ewule wɔ kyɛnze nu na bɛava sempoama bɛagua nu na bɛakyekye 
kakula bɛlɛra ne anye kɛ ɔvula.
4. Bɛlɛ nyɛleɛ kpɔkyee bie mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛmaa bɛlɛra mɔɔ bɔ Mafolɛ anzɛɛ 
Ezohille abusua la.
5. Bɛmaa ngakula mɔɔ kɛra gyimalilɛ ne abo la fe afɔtɔ ne mɔɔ hale la na 
fuamunlibɔvo ne kye bɛ nuhua bie.
6. Bɛlɛra ne noko siezie ɔ nwo na ɔkɔ akpɔsa ɔfa ɔ nwo ɔkile kɛ yedwu agyalɛ 
na eza ɔyɛ ezuavolɛ ne mo.
Ngakula mrenyia fuamunli maandeɛ
Tɛ aneɛ ekpunli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti a lɛ ngakula mrenyia fuamunli azezielɛ maandeɛ 
a. Aneɛ ekpunli mɔɔ yɛkola yɛnwu ɛhye wɔ bɛ nu la bie mɔ a le Anwɔnlama, 
Sisalama, Ngɛnlama, Vagalama nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Ngakula mrenyia fuamunli 
azezielɛ ɛnle debie kpaziwɔkɛ biala kɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ ɛdeɛ ne la. Ndonwo, wɔ 
Anwɔnla maanzinli nu, etu ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛmaa ngakula mgbavolɛ ne mɔ la a 
bɛfɛlɛ ye ‘Tudedeasi’ la. Ɛhye kile kɛ bɛva etu ne bɛbɔ bɛ abusua ne anwo bane 
eza bɛva bɛli bɔlɛ.

4. Ɔsiezie bɛ nwonane nu nee sunsum nu ɔmaa agyalɛ
5. Ɔkile bɛ ɛbulɛ nee subane kpalɛ

Mobɔnu kpuyia wɔ awozonle aluma ne anwo

abusua ne anu nee wɔ suazo la.

ne duma bɛado bɛ mra ne mɔ wɔ wɔ suazo la anu ko.

SECTION 8 EDWƐKƐ (LITILEKYA)
Nzema Edwɛkɛ
Anloanudwɛkɛ nee Ngɛlɛhɛlɛdwɛkɛ
MUKENYE
Ngyɛnu ɛhye wowɔ adwenle fale Nzema anloanudwɛkɛ nee ngɛlɛhɛlɛdwɛkɛ nwo. 
Yɛbanwu ɛdɛneyelɛ wɔ anloanudwɛkɛ abo. Yɛbanwu nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛdɛneyelɛ 
zo yɛɛ kɛ bɛsi bɛye ɛdɛne la. Adwenlewowɔlɛ ne eza ka edwɛkɛ fale nvasoɛ mɔɔ 
wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ zo yɛɛ deɛmɔti bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛla anwo. Yɛbamaa wɔakpondɛ deɛmɔti 
ɛdɛneyelɛ nwo hyia wɔ wɔ maandeɛ ne anu la. Ngilenu ɛhye anwo hyia maa Gana 
aneɛ ne ɛzukoalɛ yɛɛ eza ɔbaboa amaa wɔanwu ngitanwolilɛ mɔɔ la aneɛ ne nee 
ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ngakyile mɔɔ fale ɛzonlenlɛ nwo la. Ngyɛnu ko ye ala kɛmaa ɛ nye 
kɛlie wɔ maandeɛ ne nee aneɛ gyɛne bie mɔ maandeɛ nwo. Eza ɔda mraalɛ ɛzunlɛ 
mɔɔ wɔ aneɛ ne anu la ali. Ɔbabuke ɛ nye wɔ kɛzi mraalɛ ɛzunlɛ kɔ zo wɔ wɔ 
maandeɛ ne anu la. Ɛbanleɛnlea ɛgengadeɛ bie mɔ mɔɔ fale mraalɛ ɛzunlɛ nwo la. 
Nwolɛ adwenlewowɔlɛ ne bagyinla gyima mɔɔ mraalɛ ɛzunlɛ di la azo.. Bieko, 
ngyɛnu ɛhye eza baha edwɛkɛ avale adawu nwo. Wɔ kilehilevolɛ ne baboa amaa 
bɛawowɔ adwenle wɔ nuninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ adawu nu mɔɔ le kɛ, numenli, bodane, 
ngyehyɛleɛ, nzileka, adawubɔvo nee mɔɔ ɛha la anwo.
Ngyɛnu ɛhye kahɔ awieleɛ la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkola:
• Ɛneɛnlea na ɛkile ɛdɛneyelɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne (sunsum ngakyile ne mɔ 
ɛvɛlɛlɛ, nrɛlaleɛ mumua ne, nee adwulaleɛ ne)
• Ɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ mraalɛ ɛzunlɛ nwo ( gyima nee nvasoɛ)
• Ɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ nuninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ adawu nu la anwo ( ndonwo a le 
numenli, bodane, ngyehyɛleɛ, nzileka, adawubɔvo nee mɔɔ ɛha la).
• Ɛyɛ adawu ɛgengadeɛ nvefenu ( tidwɛkɛ, bodane, edwɛmgbɔkɛ, aneɛnu 
ninyɛne nee mɔɔ ɛha la).

SECTION 8 EDWƐKƐ (LITILEKYA)
Adwenle Titili
• Ɛdɛneyelɛ le tete nzɛlɛlɛ.
• Ɛdɛneyelɛ lɛ ngyehyɛleɛ nsa, bɛmɛ a le: Sunsum ngakyile ne mɔ ɛvɛlɛlɛ, 
nrɛlaleɛ mumua nee adwulaleɛ.
• Bodane ne a le adwenle titili ne mɔɔ wɔ adawu ne anu la.
• Ngyehyɛleɛ ne kile kɛ adawu ne anu nzidwɛkɛ ne sisi la.
• Nzileka ne ka edwɛkɛ fale ɛleka mɔɔ adawu ne zile la yɛɛ mekɛ holɛ mɔɔ 
adawu ne hɔle zolɛ la.
• Adawubɔvo ne kile kɛ kɛlɛvo ne zile vale yɛvo ne hɛlɛle adawu ne la.
• Ɛzunlɛ kile sonla ɛnyilɛ nu maandeɛ ne mɔ ko; ɔkile kɛ yɛminli debie, 
yɛfa yɛsɛlɛ debie, yɛfa yɛkile nganeɛdelɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ nu la.
ƐDƐNEYELƐ
Adwenlewowɔlɛ ne bagyinla ngyehyɛleɛ nsa ne mɔɔ ɛdɛneyelɛ lɛ la azo. Ɔbanlea 
Sunsum ngakyile ne mɔ ɛvɛlɛlɛ, nrɛlaleɛ mumua ne nee ye adwulaleɛ ne.
Duzu a le Ɛdɛneyelɛ?
Ɔle adenle mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛgua nza anzɛɛ nzule yɛbɔ azu yɛmaa sunsum bie 
a. Ɔle nzɛlɛlɛ adenle mɔɔ menli mɔɔ dua awozonle zo sonle Nyamenle la fa di 
gyima a. Ɔle nyɛleɛ mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛfa nza, nzule anzɛɛ nwanye yɛgua aze yɛfɛlɛ 
sunsum bie mɔ mɔɔ adwenlekpɔkɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nzi a le kɛ yɛfa yɛ ngyianlɛdeɛ 
yɛado bɛ nyunlu la. (Ayim-Aboagye, 1993: 165). Wɔ ɛleka bie mɔ, ninyɛne le 
kɛ awule a bɛfa bɛye ɛdɛne a. Ɛdɛneyelɛ nyɛleɛ di gyima bedevinli wɔ Abibile 
maanle nu.Yɛdua ɛdɛneyelɛ zo yɛfɛlɛ mɔwuamra mɔɔ yɛdie yɛdi kɛ yɛ nee bɛ lɛ 
ngitanwolilɛ na bɛboka yɛ nwo wɔ maanle ayia nee gyimalilɛ ngakyile bie mɔ abo 
la. Wɔ Gana, mbusua mgbanyima nee maanle mgbanyima ye ɛdɛne wɔ maanle 
ayia ayia mɔɔ le kɛ dumadonlɛ, agyalɛ, ɛvoyia, belemgbunli ɛzielɛ nee mɔɔ ɛha 
la abo.

Nrɛlaleɛ mumua ne

sunsum ne mɔ ɛkɛ a.
Adwulaleɛ

menli mɔɔ lɛ gyimalilɛ ne anwo adwenle ɛtane la ɛli ye ɛnwonle zo. Ɛdɛneyevo 
ne eza sɛlɛ nyilalɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ gyimalilɛ ne anwo adwenle kpalɛ la.

maandeɛ nu la.

 BƐDI NE NEE ABƆNKYE RALƐ NE
 Ɛnee Abɔnkye ralɛ ekyi bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛmɔ ye mɛne ne mɔ ɛlɛnyi ndɛndɛ 
la ati, ɔmaanle ɔnwunle ɔ nwo kɛ yeyɛ Abɔnkye nyinli mɔɔ ɛyɛ koatee 
na ɔkola ɔ nwo zo nea a. ɛhye ati kenle ko nɔsolɛ mɔɔ ɛnee mbɔnkye ne 
mɔ vi adidi ba sua nu na ɔ nli vɛlɛle ye la, yeadɛne ye zo na ɔhɔle zo 
kɛ ɔdi ndile dudokaa ne. Mekɛ guale nu ekyii na ɔkamaa ɔ ti zo la ɛnee 
mbɔnkye ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛhɔ.
 Ɔhale ɔ ngome kye wɔ ɛkɛ. Ɛnee sɛnzɛne ne ɛlɛkadɔ. Ɛlawolɛ adendenle 
ne mɔ radɔle azɛlɛ ne azo. Anwoma mɔɔ anu le ɛyɛlɛyɛlɛ ekyi la rabɔle 
vale bɛ nu na ɔyɛle alɛra mɔɔ anu yɛ ɛzulolɛ la wɔ ndile ne anu. Abɔnkye 
ralɛ ne anwo wozole ye kɛmɔ Bɛdi ne anwo edwɛkɛ rale ye adwenle nu 
la ati. Akee ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔyɛ totolatotola wɔ adidi ɛleka ne na ɔzunle 
ɔvɛlɛle ɔ nli.Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔka ekyii ɔdwu mbaka mbaka ne anu la, ɛnee 
Bɛdi ne anyunlu ɛne!
 Abɔnkye ralɛ ne adwenle yɛle ye kɛ anyelazo ekyi wɔ ɛkɛ ne maa ye.
 ‘‘Mebodo wɔ, Ym. Bɛdi,’’ ɔvale anwowozolɛ ɔhanle ɛhye, ‘‘Meze kɛ 
ɛbahye me wɔali. Na emomu, mɔɔ li moa, mesɛlɛ wɔ di moa bɔ edwɛne 
maa me na mekulo kɛ mesi agole na medie me nye mekɛ dodo biala mɔɔ 
mekɛhola la.’’
 Bɛdi ne anye liele adwenle ne mɔɔ ɔhilele kɛ ɔhyia edwɛne ekyi kolaa na 
yeahye ye yeali la anwo. Yemɔti ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔbɔ anyelielɛ edwɛne mɔɔ 
yɛ fɛ. Ndɛndɛ zo ala, Abɔnkye ralɛ ne vale anyelielɛ wulule arɛlevilɛnu.
 Amuanrɛɛ ɛnee mbɔnkye ne mɔ lua ye nyaanyaa ɛlɛkɔ sua nu. Kɛmɔ 
maanlenu yɛle dii la ati, Bɛdi ne edwɛne ne dwule moa. Ahwea ne mɔɔ 
sinza mbɔnkye ne mɔ la yɛle bɛ nzo gyɛlɛbɛɛnye. Bɛdele edwɛne ne mɔɔ 
Bɛdi ne bɔ kolaa na yeali aleɛ la, ndɛndɛ ne ala, bɛnriandile kɛ bɛsia 
bɛahɔ bɛ adidi ɛleka ne. Bɛdi ne edwɛne ne rale awieleɛ arɛlevilɛnu, 
mɔɔ ɔnriandi wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Ahwea ne mɔ li ɔ nzi la, ɔvɛlɛle ɔ nwo koasea
